ch02-s01-history-and-application-of-six-.translation: 虽然六西格玛的根源通常归因于丰田和摩托罗拉等公司，但该方法实际上植根于可以追溯到 19 世纪的概念。在深入研究六西格玛的历史之前，了解传统质量计划（如全面质量管理）和持续过程改进方法（如六西格玛）之间的区别非常重要。

sentences.source: While the roots of Six Sigma are commonly attributed to companies such as Toyota and Motorola, the methodology is actually grounded in concepts that date as far back as the 19th century.
sentences.translation: 虽然六西格玛的根源通常归因于丰田和摩托罗拉等公司，但该方法实际上植根于可以追溯到 19 世纪的概念。

sentences.source: Before delving into the history of Six Sigma, it’s important to understand the difference between traditional quality programs, such as Total Quality Management, and continuous process improvement methods, such as Six Sigma.
sentences.translation: 在深入研究六西格玛的历史之前，了解传统质量计划（如全面质量管理）和持续过程改进方法（如六西格玛）之间的区别非常重要。

ch02-s01-history-and-application-of-six-.translation: 大多数现代质量和改进计划都可以追溯到相同的根源。质量计划和持续流程改进方法都旨在实现减少错误和缺陷、提高流程效率、提高客户满意度和提高利润等目标。但质量计划关注的是实现特定目标。该程序要么永远运行，不断地朝着同一个目标努力，要么实现了最终目标，并且必须为新目标重新设置。

sentences.source: Most modern quality and improvement programs can be traced back to the same roots.
sentences.translation: 大多数现代质量和改进计划都可以追溯到相同的根源。

sentences.source: Both quality programs and continuous process improvement methods look to achieve goals such as reducing errors and defects, making processes more efficient, improving customer satisfaction, and boosting profits.
sentences.translation: 质量计划和持续流程改进方法都旨在实现减少错误和缺陷、提高流程效率、提高客户满意度和提高利润等目标。

sentences.source: But quality programs are concerned with achieving a specific goal.
sentences.translation: 但质量计划关注的是实现特定目标。

sentences.source: The program either runs forever, constantly working toward the same goal, or it achieves the end goal and must be reset for a new goal.
sentences.translation: 该程序要么永远运行，不断地朝着同一个目标努力，要么实现了最终目标，并且必须为新目标重新设置。

ch02-s01-history-and-application-of-six-.translation: 六西格玛致力于灌输一种持续改进和质量的文化，从内到外优化组织的绩效。六西格玛固有的文化元素使组织能够实施小规模和全面的改进，从而极大地影响效率和成本。 六西格玛确实致力于每个项目的个人目标，但这些项目是整体改进文化的一部分，而在实践中，这种改进永远不会完成。 六西格玛制定了保障措施和策略，以便即使在项目被认为完成后，也可以采取控制措施以确保进展继续进行，并且不可能回到旧的方式。

sentences.source: Six Sigma seeks to instill a culture of continuous improvement and quality that optimizes performance of an organization from the inside out.
sentences.translation: 六西格玛致力于灌输一种持续改进和质量的文化，从内到外优化组织的绩效。

sentences.source: It’s the cultural element inherent in Six Sigma that lets organizations enact both small and sweeping improvements that drastically impact efficiencies and costs.
sentences.translation: 六西格玛固有的文化元素使组织能够实施小规模和全面的改进，从而极大地影响效率和成本。

sentences.source: Six Sigma does work toward individual goals with regard to each project, but the projects are part of the overall culture of improvement that, in practice, is never done.
sentences.translation: 六西格玛确实致力于每个项目的个人目标，但这些项目是整体改进文化的一部分，而在实践中，这种改进永远不会完成。

sentences.source: Six Sigma creates safeguards and tactics so that, even after a project is considered complete, controls are in place to ensure progress continues and it is impossible to revert to old ways.
sentences.translation: 六西格玛制定了保障措施和策略，以便即使在项目被认为完成后，也可以采取控制措施以确保进展继续进行，并且不可能回到旧的方式。

ch02-s02-the-development-of-statistical-.translation: 六西格玛应用统计学来定义、测量、分析、验证和控制流程。事实上，六西格玛团队通常使用称为 DMAIC 或 DMADV 的方法来完成改进并开发流程控制。 DMAIC 代表定义、测量、分析、改进和控制。这是六西格玛项目的五个阶段，旨在改进现有流程。在开发新流程时，团队使用 DMADV，它代表定义、测量、分析、设计和验证。第 11 章讨论了这两种方法，第 3 单元提供了有关 DMAIC 每个阶段的深入信息。

sentences.source: Six Sigma applies statistics to define, measure, analyze, verify, and control processes.
sentences.translation: 六西格玛应用统计学来定义、测量、分析、验证和控制流程。

sentences.source: In fact, Six Sigma teams usually use methodologies known as DMAIC or DMADV to accomplish improvements and develop controls for processes.
sentences.translation: 事实上，六西格玛团队通常使用称为 DMAIC 或 DMADV 的方法来完成改进并开发流程控制。

sentences.source: DMAIC stands for Define, Measure, Analyze, Improve, and Control.
sentences.translation: DMAIC 代表定义、测量、分析、改进和控制。

sentences.source: These are the five phases of a Six Sigma project to improve a process that already exists.
sentences.translation: 这是六西格玛项目的五个阶段，旨在改进现有流程。

sentences.source: When developing a new process, teams use DMADV, which stands for Define, Measure, Analyze, Design, and Verify.
sentences.translation: 在开发新流程时，团队使用 DMADV，它代表定义、测量、分析、设计和验证。

sentences.source: Both methods are discussed in Chapter 11, and Unit 3 provides in-depth information about each phase of DMAIC.
sentences.translation: 第 11 章讨论了这两种方法，第 3 单元提供了有关 DMAIC 每个阶段的深入信息。

ch02-s02-the-development-of-statistical-.translation: 为六西格玛方法提供支柱的统计过程控制的根源始于卡尔·弗里德里希·高斯 (Carl Friedrich Gauss) 在 19 世纪对正态曲线的发展。 今天我们知道，正态曲线只是几种可能的概率分布模型之一。它可能是使用最广泛的模型，其他模型都是从正态曲线发展而来的。概率分布模型将在后面的统计章节中讨论

sentences.source: The roots of statistical process control, which provide a backbone for Six Sigma methods, began with the development of the normal curve by Carl Friedrich Gauss in the 19th century.
sentences.translation: 为六西格玛方法提供支柱的统计过程控制的根源始于卡尔·弗里德里希·高斯 (Carl Friedrich Gauss) 在 19 世纪对正态曲线的发展。

sentences.source: We know today that the normal curve is just one of several possible probability distribution models.
sentences.translation: 今天我们知道，正态曲线只是几种可能的概率分布模型之一。

sentences.source: It is perhaps the most widely used model, and the other models developed from the normal curve.
sentences.translation: 它可能是使用最广泛的模型，其他模型都是从正态曲线发展而来的。

sentences.source: Probability distribution models are discussed in later chapters on statistics
sentences.translation: 概率分布模型将在后面的统计章节中讨论

ch02-s02-the-development-of-statistical-.translation: 20 世纪初，由于工程师兼学者沃尔特·休哈特 (Walter Shewhart) 的贡献，统计过程控制再次得到了巨大的推动。休哈特对质量的贡献很多，但有两个具体的想法脱颖而出。首先，休哈特是第一人

sentences.source: In the early part of the 20th century, statistical process control received another big boost thanks to contributions from an engineer and scholar named Walter Shewhart.
sentences.translation: 20 世纪初，由于工程师兼学者沃尔特·休哈特 (Walter Shewhart) 的贡献，统计过程控制再次得到了巨大的推动。

sentences.source: Shewhart's contributions to quality are many, but two specific ideas stand out.
sentences.translation: 休哈特对质量的贡献很多，但有两个具体的想法脱颖而出。

sentences.source: First, Shewhart was the first person
sentences.translation: 首先，休哈特是第一人

ch02-s02-the-development-of-statistical-.translation: 将西格玛水平和质量密切相关。他将需要修正的流程定义为正在三西格玛执行的流程。如果你回顾一下第一章和理论上的亚马逊例子，四西格玛和三西格玛之间的成本差异超过 7800 万美元；相比之下，五格玛和四西格玛之间的差距仅约为760万美元。由于随着西格玛水平的降低，错误和成本呈指数级增加，因此休哈特的定义在商业中具有非常实际的应用。虽然六西格玛作为一种方法力求朝着每百万机会缺陷数数数数 (DPMO) 低于 3.4 的目标迈进，但如果流程的质量随着接近三西格玛而下降，与错误相关的成本也会大幅增加，这也是事实。

sentences.source: to closely relate sigma level and quality.
sentences.translation: 将西格玛水平和质量密切相关。

sentences.source: He defined a process in need of correction as one that is performing at three sigma.
sentences.translation: 他将需要修正的流程定义为正在三西格玛执行的流程。

sentences.source: If you look back to Chapter 1 and the theoretical Amazon example, the cost difference between four sigma and three sigma is over $78 million;
sentences.translation: 如果你回顾一下第一章和理论上的亚马逊例子，四西格玛和三西格玛之间的成本差异超过 7800 万美元；

sentences.source: in comparison, the difference between five and four sigma is only approximately $7.6 million.
sentences.translation: 相比之下，五格玛和四西格玛之间的差距仅约为760万美元。

sentences.source: Because errors and costs exponentially increase as sigma level decreases, Shewhart’s definition has very practical applications in business.
sentences.translation: 由于随着西格玛水平的降低，错误和成本呈指数级增加，因此休哈特的定义在商业中具有非常实际的应用。

sentences.source: While Six Sigma as a method seeks to move ever toward less than 3.4 defects per million opportunities (dpmo), it is also true that if the quality of a process decreases, as it approaches three sigma, the costs associated with errors increase substantially.
sentences.translation: 虽然六西格玛作为一种方法力求朝着每百万机会缺陷数数数数 (DPMO) 低于 3.4 的目标迈进，但如果流程的质量随着接近三西格玛而下降，与错误相关的成本也会大幅增加，这也是事实。

ch02-s02-the-development-of-statistical-.translation: 其次，休哈特被认为是控制图之父。控制图在高级统计章节中进行了深入介绍，它是统计过程控制的重要组成部分，可以让组织在实施六西格玛计划后保持改进的绩效。当学者们在越来越多的领域撰写有关统计理论应用的文章时，休哈特开发了将这些概念专门应用于制造和工业过程的方法。

sentences.source: Second, Shewhart is considered the father of control charts.
sentences.translation: 其次，休哈特被认为是控制图之父。

sentences.source: Control charts, which are covered in depth in the chapters on advanced statistics, are a critical component of statistical process control that lets organizations maintain improved performance after a Six Sigma initiative.
sentences.translation: 控制图在高级统计章节中进行了深入介绍，它是统计过程控制的重要组成部分，可以让组织在实施六西格玛计划后保持改进的绩效。

sentences.source: At a time when scholars were writing about the theoretical application of statistics in a growing number of fields, Shewhart developed ways to apply these concepts to manufacturing and industrial processes specifically.
sentences.translation: 当学者们在越来越多的领域撰写有关统计理论应用的文章时，休哈特开发了将这些概念专门应用于制造和工业过程的方法。

ch02-s02-the-development-of-statistical-.translation: 同一时期，爱德华兹·戴明在美国农业部工作。戴明是一位物理学家和数学家，负责该机构研究生院的课程教学，他安排休哈特到那里演讲。后来，戴明将休哈特的统计概念带到了美国人口普查局，这可能是第一次将他的理论应用到工业或制造环境之外。

sentences.source: During the same time period, W.
sentences.translation: 同一时期，爱德华兹·戴明在美国农业部工作。

sentences.source: Edwards Deming was working for the U.S.
sentences.translation: 同一时期，爱德华兹·戴明在美国农业部工作。

sentences.source: Department of Agriculture.
sentences.translation: 同一时期，爱德华兹·戴明在美国农业部工作。

sentences.source: A physicist and mathematician, Deming was in charge of teaching courses at the agency’s graduate school and he arranged for Shewhart to come and speak there.
sentences.translation: 戴明是一位物理学家和数学家，负责该机构研究生院的课程教学，他安排休哈特到那里演讲。

sentences.source: Later, Deming brought Shewhart's statistical concepts to the United States Census Bureau, applying his theories outside of an industrial or manufacturing environment for possibly the first time.
sentences.translation: 后来，戴明将休哈特的统计概念带到了美国人口普查局，这可能是第一次将他的理论应用到工业或制造环境之外。

ch02-s02-the-development-of-statistical-.translation: 戴明的想法之一被称为 PDCA 循环，或计划-执行-检查-行动循环。 这个想法是，当您认识到需要改变并制定改进计划时，就会出现改进。接下来，你通过测试你的想法来做一些事情。使用测试结果，您可以检查或验证您的改进是否有效。然后您采取行动，将您的改进引入生产环境或将改进扩展到测试环境之外。 PDCA 是一个循环，这意味着它永远不会结束；总有需要改进的地方。这是六西格玛的核心宗旨。

sentences.source: One of Deming’s ideas is called the PDCA cycle, or plan-do-check-act cycle.
sentences.translation: 戴明的想法之一被称为 PDCA 循环，或计划-执行-检查-行动循环。

sentences.source: The idea is that improvement comes when you recognize there is a need for change and make a plan to create improvement.
sentences.translation: 这个想法是，当您认识到需要改变并制定改进计划时，就会出现改进。

sentences.source: Next, you do something by testing your ideas.
sentences.translation: 接下来，你通过测试你的想法来做一些事情。

sentences.source: Using the results of the test, you check or verify that your improvements are working.
sentences.translation: 使用测试结果，您可以检查或验证您的改进是否有效。

sentences.source: Then you act, bringing your improvements to a production environment or scaling improvements outside of the test environment.
sentences.translation: 然后您采取行动，将您的改进引入生产环境或将改进扩展到测试环境之外。

sentences.source: The fact that PDCA is a cycle means it never ends;
sentences.translation: PDCA 是一个循环，这意味着它永远不会结束；

sentences.source: there are always improvements to be made.
sentences.translation: 总有需要改进的地方。

sentences.source: This is a core tenet of Six Sigma.
sentences.translation: 这是六西格玛的核心宗旨。

ch02-s02-the-development-of-statistical-.translation: 第二次世界大战后，戴明在日本代表美国政府担任多种职务。在战后的日本，戴明与统计学家成为了朋友，并说服了至少一位著名工程师，统计过程控制与日本需要大幅推动经济和生产绩效以克服战争造成的损害有关。最终，戴明成为日本制造公司的一位受人尊敬的老师和顾问，植入了很快成为丰田生产系统（Toyota Production System）或精益六西格玛的思想和概念。

sentences.source: Following World War II, Deming worked in Japan on behalf of the United States government in several capacities.
sentences.translation: 第二次世界大战后，戴明在日本代表美国政府担任多种职务。

sentences.source: While in post-war Japan, Deming befriended statisticians and convinced at least one notable engineer that statistical process control was relevant to Japan's need to drastically drive economic and production performance to overcome damage from the war.
sentences.translation: 在战后的日本，戴明与统计学家成为了朋友，并说服了至少一位著名工程师，统计过程控制与日本需要大幅推动经济和生产绩效以克服战争造成的损害有关。

sentences.source: In the end, Deming became a valued teacher and consultant to manufacturing companies in Japan, planting the ideas and concepts that would soon become the Toyota Production System, or Lean Six Sigma.
sentences.translation: 最终，戴明成为日本制造公司的一位受人尊敬的老师和顾问，植入了很快成为丰田生产系统（Toyota Production System）或精益六西格玛的思想和概念。

ch02-s03-continuous-process-improvement-.translation: 戴明的教导和日本工业在灾难性战争后成功东山再起的需要相结合，为丰田带来了成果。丰田领导层在二战之前就已经考虑过质量概念，但考虑到 20 世纪 40 年代和 50 年代日本经济和资源的性质，提高性能和效率成为更重要的目标。丰田领导者借鉴亨利·福特的制造理念，应用统计数据和新的质量概念创建了一个系统，他们认为该系统可以提高产量并允许生产可变产品，同时降低成本并确保质量。

sentences.source: Deming's teachings and the need for Japanese industry to make a successful comeback following a catastrophic war combined to bear fruit for Toyota.
sentences.translation: 戴明的教导和日本工业在灾难性战争后成功东山再起的需要相结合，为丰田带来了成果。

sentences.source: Toyota’s leadership had visited the concepts of quality prior to WWII, but improved performance and efficiency became a more critical goal given the nature of Japan's economy and resources in the 1940s and 50s.
sentences.translation: 丰田领导层在二战之前就已经考虑过质量概念，但考虑到 20 世纪 40 年代和 50 年代日本经济和资源的性质，提高性能和效率成为更重要的目标。

sentences.source: Taking manufacturing ideas attributed to Henry Ford, Toyota leaders applied statistics and new quality concepts to create a system they felt would increase production and allow for variable products while reducing costs and ensuring quality.
sentences.translation: 丰田领导者借鉴亨利·福特的制造理念，应用统计数据和新的质量概念创建了一个系统，他们认为该系统可以提高产量并允许生产可变产品，同时降低成本并确保质量。

ch02-s03-continuous-process-improvement-.translation: 有几个人在丰田生产系统的最终发展中发挥了重要作用。他们在流程中注入了自动化机械、防止缺陷发生的质量控制以及尚未应用如此详细和一致性的效率工具。丰田喜一郎（Kiichiro Toyoda）曾有过工厂工作经验。在之前的工作中，他通过输送机和其他自动化系统提高了纺织厂的流程效率。丰田章男在丰田制造过程中的某些生产线上引入了相同的概念。后来，丰田英二（Eiji Toyoda）和大野耐一（Taiichi Ohno）引入了“准时生产”（Just-in-Time）和“自动化”（Jidoka）的概念，它们是丰田生产系统的支柱。

sentences.source: Several individuals were instrumental in the ultimate development of the Toyota Production System.
sentences.translation: 有几个人在丰田生产系统的最终发展中发挥了重要作用。

sentences.source: They infused the process with automated machinery, quality controls to keep defects from occurring, and efficiency tools that had not yet been applied with such detail and consistency.
sentences.translation: 他们在流程中注入了自动化机械、防止缺陷发生的质量控制以及尚未应用如此详细和一致性的效率工具。

sentences.source: One man, Kiichiro Toyoda, had previous factory experience.
sentences.translation: 丰田喜一郎（Kiichiro Toyoda）曾有过工厂工作经验。

sentences.source: In his previous jobs, he added efficiencies to processes in textile mills through conveyor and other automated systems.
sentences.translation: 在之前的工作中，他通过输送机和其他自动化系统提高了纺织厂的流程效率。

sentences.source: Toyoda introduced the same concepts on certain lines in the Toyota manufacturing process.
sentences.translation: 丰田章男在丰田制造过程中的某些生产线上引入了相同的概念。

sentences.source: Later, Eiji Toyoda and Taiichi Ohno introduced concepts known as Just-in-Time and jidoka, which are the pillars of the Toyota Production System.
sentences.translation: 后来，丰田英二（Eiji Toyoda）和大野耐一（Taiichi Ohno）引入了“准时生产”（Just-in-Time）和“自动化”（Jidoka）的概念，它们是丰田生产系统的支柱。

ch02-s03-continuous-process-improvement-.translation: 驱动丰田系统的原则以及后来的精益流程管理或精益六西格玛的基础包括：

sentences.source: The principles driving Toyota's system, and later, the foundation of Lean Process Management or Lean Six Sigma, include:
sentences.translation: 驱动丰田系统的原则以及后来的精益流程管理或精益六西格玛的基础包括：

sentences.source: Defining customer values
sentences.translation: 定义客户价值

ch02-s03-continuous-process-improvement-.translation: 确定客户需求和愿望的价值流

sentences.source: Identifying the value stream for customer needs and desires
sentences.translation: 确定客户需求和愿望的价值流

sentences.source: Identifying waste in the process
sentences.translation: 识别过程中的浪费

sentences.source: Creation of a continuous process flow
sentences.translation: 创建连续的工艺流程

ch02-s03-continuous-process-improvement-.translation: 不断努力减少达到客户满意度所需的步骤数量和时间

sentences.source: Continually working to reduce the number of steps and time it takes to reach customer satisfaction
sentences.translation: 不断努力减少达到客户满意度所需的步骤数量和时间

ch02-s03-continuous-process-improvement-.translation: 精益管理高度关注消除任何流程中的浪费。浪费会增加流程的成本和时间，因此任何形式的浪费都是不可取的。

sentences.source: Lean management is highly concerned with removing waste from any process.
sentences.translation: 精益管理高度关注消除任何流程中的浪费。

sentences.source: Waste increases costs and time spent on a process, making it undesirable in any form.
sentences.translation: 浪费会增加流程的成本和时间，因此任何形式的浪费都是不可取的。

ch02-s04-motorola-s-focus-on-defects-en-.translation: 虽然六西格玛的基础是在19世纪末20世纪初奠定的，但直到20世纪80年代中期这些概念才在美国获得大规模成功。丰田开发其系统几十年后，摩托罗拉的工程师开始质疑他们的质量管理计划的有效性。这些问题在一家日本公司收购摩托罗拉电视后首次出现

sentences.source: Though the basis for Six Sigma was laid in the late 19th and early 20th centuries, it wasn't until the mid- 1980s that these concepts saw large-scale success in the United States.
sentences.translation: 虽然六西格玛的基础是在19世纪末20世纪初奠定的，但直到20世纪80年代中期这些概念才在美国获得大规模成功。

sentences.source: Decades after Toyota developed its system, engineers at Motorola began to question how effective their quality management programs were.
sentences.translation: 丰田开发其系统几十年后，摩托罗拉的工程师开始质疑他们的质量管理计划的有效性。

sentences.source: Those questions first arose after a Japanese company took over a Motorola television
sentences.translation: 这些问题在一家日本公司收购摩托罗拉电视后首次出现

ch02-s04-motorola-s-focus-on-defects-en-.translation: 制造工厂。通过应用精益概念，新公司开始生产缺陷数量仅为摩托罗拉自家电视机 1/20 的电视机。

sentences.source: manufacturing plant.
sentences.translation: 制造工厂。

sentences.source: By applying Lean concepts, the new company began creating televisions that demonstrated 1/20th the amount of defects as Motorola’s own television sets.
sentences.translation: 通过应用精益概念，新公司开始生产缺陷数量仅为摩托罗拉自家电视机 1/20 的电视机。

ch02-s04-motorola-s-focus-on-defects-en-.translation: 当时，摩托罗拉各部门将缺陷与一千个机会的比率来衡量。摩托罗拉首席执行官鲍勃·高尔文(Bob Galvin)向他的团队提出了挑战。他希望看到质量和产量的提高——不仅仅是任何改进；而是任何改进。他希望在五年内将业绩提高十倍。工程师 Bill Smith 和摩托罗拉团队的新成员 Mikel Harry 博士开始研究这个问题。

sentences.source: At the time, departments across Motorola measured defects as a ratio of a thousand opportunities.
sentences.translation: 当时，摩托罗拉各部门将缺陷与一千个机会的比率来衡量。

sentences.source: Bob Galvin, the CEO of Motorola, issued a challenge to his team.
sentences.translation: 摩托罗拉首席执行官鲍勃·高尔文(Bob Galvin)向他的团队提出了挑战。

sentences.source: He wanted to see an improvement in quality and production—not just any improvement;
sentences.translation: 他希望看到质量和产量的提高——不仅仅是任何改进；

sentences.source: he wanted a ten-fold improvement in half a decade.
sentences.translation: 他希望在五年内将业绩提高十倍。

sentences.source: Engineer Bill Smith and a new addition to the Motorola team – Dr.
sentences.translation: 工程师 Bill Smith 和摩托罗拉团队的新成员 Mikel Harry 博士开始研究这个问题。

sentences.source: Mikel Harry – began to work on the problem.
sentences.translation: 工程师 Bill Smith 和摩托罗拉团队的新成员 Mikel Harry 博士开始研究这个问题。

ch02-s04-motorola-s-focus-on-defects-en-.translation: 该团队意识到，根据一千个机会来衡量错误并不能提供真正的统计过程控制所需的详细程度。相反，工程师们想要针对一百万个机会来衡量缺陷。我们知道西格玛水平已经被定义，使用西格玛水平作为质量衡量标准的想法始于休哈特。对于摩托罗拉工程师来说，从对更准确数据的渴望到将六西格玛的基本概念作为目标和方法论，并不是一个漫长的跳跃。

sentences.source: The team realized that measuring errors against a thousand opportunities didn't provide the level of detail needed for true statistical process control.
sentences.translation: 该团队意识到，根据一千个机会来衡量错误并不能提供真正的统计过程控制所需的详细程度。

sentences.source: Instead, the engineers wanted to measure defects against a million opportunities.
sentences.translation: 相反，工程师们想要针对一百万个机会来衡量缺陷。

sentences.source: We know that sigma levels were already defined and the idea of using sigma levels as a measure of quality began with Shewhart.
sentences.translation: 我们知道西格玛水平已经被定义，使用西格玛水平作为质量衡量标准的想法始于休哈特。

sentences.source: It wasn't a long jump for the Motorola engineers to make from their desire for more accurate data to the basic concepts of Six Sigma as both a goal and a methodology.
sentences.translation: 对于摩托罗拉工程师来说，从对更准确数据的渴望到将六西格玛的基本概念作为目标和方法论，并不是一个漫长的跳跃。

ch02-s04-motorola-s-focus-on-defects-en-.translation: 在接下来的二十年里，摩托罗拉致力于完善其六西格玛方法论，并在此过程中看到了积极的成果。 除了统计工具之外，该团队还创建了一个循序渐进的流程，几乎任何行业的任何团队都可以通过该流程取得收益和改进。这种类型的统计过程控制首次在全公司范围内大规模地脱离制造环境。摩托罗拉将该方法应用于客户服务、工程和技术支持。它使用该流程在组织内部和外部的利益相关者之间创建协作环境。它非常成功；据摩托罗拉称，该公司在 12 年内通过持续的流程改进举措节省了超过 160 亿美元。 5

sentences.source: Throughout the next two decades, Motorola worked to perfect its Six Sigma methodology, seeing positive results along the way.
sentences.translation: 在接下来的二十年里，摩托罗拉致力于完善其六西格玛方法论，并在此过程中看到了积极的成果。

sentences.source: In addition to statistical tools, the team created a step-by-step process by which any team--in almost any industry--could make gains and improvements.
sentences.translation: 除了统计工具之外，该团队还创建了一个循序渐进的流程，几乎任何行业的任何团队都可以通过该流程取得收益和改进。

sentences.source: For the first time, this type of statistical process control was taken out of the manufacturing environment on a large scale company-wide.
sentences.translation: 这种类型的统计过程控制首次在全公司范围内大规模地脱离制造环境。

sentences.source: Motorola applied the method to customer service, engineering, and technical support.
sentences.translation: 摩托罗拉将该方法应用于客户服务、工程和技术支持。

sentences.source: It used the process to create a collaborative environment between stakeholders inside and outside of the organization.
sentences.translation: 它使用该流程在组织内部和外部的利益相关者之间创建协作环境。

sentences.source: It was highly successful;
sentences.translation: 它非常成功；

sentences.source: according to Motorola, the company saved more than $16 billion as a result of continuous process improvement initiatives within 12 years.5
sentences.translation: 据摩托罗拉称，该公司在 12 年内通过持续的流程改进举措节省了超过 160 亿美元。

ch02-s04-motorola-s-focus-on-defects-en-.translation: 不过，摩托罗拉所做的不仅仅是改进自己的系统和产品。高尔文带领他的团队与世界分享六西格玛。摩托罗拉及其团队发表了有关六西格玛方法的文章和书籍，并努力培训其他人。通过这种方式，他们创建了一种基于统计的方法，可以在任何组织或行业内教授和实施。

sentences.source: Motorola did more than improve its own systems and products, though.
sentences.translation: 不过，摩托罗拉所做的不仅仅是改进自己的系统和产品。

sentences.source: Galvin directed his team to share Six Sigma with the world.
sentences.translation: 高尔文带领他的团队与世界分享六西格玛。

sentences.source: Motorola and its team published articles and books on the Six Sigma method and implemented efforts to train others.
sentences.translation: 摩托罗拉及其团队发表了有关六西格玛方法的文章和书籍，并努力培训其他人。

sentences.source: In this way, they created a methodology based on statistics that could be taught and implemented within any organization or industry.
sentences.translation: 通过这种方式，他们创建了一种基于统计的方法，可以在任何组织或行业内教授和实施。

ch02-s05-abb-allied-signal-and-general-e.translation: 离开摩托罗拉后，Harry 博士加入了 Asea Brown Boveri。在ABB，哈利与理查德·施罗德合作，后者也成为了六西格玛的冠军。事实上，两人后来共同创办了六西格玛学院。在ABB，哈利逐渐认识到六西格玛演变过程中的一个关键理念：商业，或者说利润，在某些方面先于质量。事实上，质量是业务的驱动因素。如果质量不好，顾客就不会购买。由于有能力做出支持六西格玛计划的个人都受到金钱的高度激励，哈利将财务策略纳入了六西格玛的方法论中。该方法首次将利润底线作为主要目标，其他关注点和目标源于财务主导的目标。

sentences.source: After leaving Motorola, Dr.
sentences.translation: 离开摩托罗拉后，Harry 博士加入了 Asea Brown Boveri。

sentences.source: Harry joined Asea Brown Boveri.
sentences.translation: 离开摩托罗拉后，Harry 博士加入了 Asea Brown Boveri。

sentences.source: At ABB, Harry worked with Richard Schroeder, who would also become a champion for Six Sigma.
sentences.translation: 在ABB，哈利与理查德·施罗德合作，后者也成为了六西格玛的冠军。

sentences.source: In fact, the two men later cofounded the Six Sigma Academy.
sentences.translation: 事实上，两人后来共同创办了六西格玛学院。

sentences.source: At ABB, Harry came to realize a key idea in the evolution of Six Sigma: business, or profits, in some ways came before quality.
sentences.translation: 在ABB，哈利逐渐认识到六西格玛演变过程中的一个关键理念：商业，或者说利润，在某些方面先于质量。

sentences.source: Quality, in fact, was a driving factor of business.
sentences.translation: 事实上，质量是业务的驱动因素。

sentences.source: Customers didn’t make purchases if quality was poor.
sentences.translation: 如果质量不好，顾客就不会购买。

sentences.source: Because the individuals with the ability to decide in favor of Six Sigma initiatives were highly motivated by dollars, Harry incorporated financial tactics into the Six Sigma methodology.
sentences.translation: 由于有能力做出支持六西格玛计划的个人都受到金钱的高度激励，哈利将财务策略纳入了六西格玛的方法论中。

sentences.source: For the first time, the method was focused on the bottom-line as a primary goal with other concerns and goals stemming from financially-led goals.
sentences.translation: 该方法首次将利润底线作为主要目标，其他关注点和目标源于财务主导的目标。

ch02-s05-abb-allied-signal-and-general-e.translation: 1993 年，施罗德和哈利都换了工作，加入了 Allied Signal 的团队。 Allied Signal 当时的首席执行官是拉里·博西迪 (Larry Bossidy)。他对六西格玛很感兴趣，但意识到高管和其他高层领导在尝试与分析师、流程工程师和六西格玛专家互动和协作时遇到了知识障碍。 Bossidy 建议公司的领导力必须是

sentences.source: In 1993, both Schroeder and Harry changed jobs, joining the team at Allied Signal.
sentences.translation: 1993 年，施罗德和哈利都换了工作，加入了 Allied Signal 的团队。

sentences.source: Allied Signal’s CEO at the time was Larry Bossidy.
sentences.translation: Allied Signal 当时的首席执行官是拉里·博西迪 (Larry Bossidy)。

sentences.source: He was interested in Six Sigma but realized that executives and other high- level leaders experienced knowledge barriers while attempting to interact and collaborate with analysts, process engineers, and Six Sigma experts.
sentences.translation: 他对六西格玛很感兴趣，但意识到高管和其他高层领导在尝试与分析师、流程工程师和六西格玛专家互动和协作时遇到了知识障碍。

sentences.source: Bossidy suggested that leadership at a company had to be
sentences.translation: Bossidy 建议公司的领导力必须是

sentences.translation: 5 《六西格玛的历史》，iSixSigma。

sentences.source: http://www.isixsigma.com/new-to-six-sigma/history/history-six-sigma/
sentences.translation: http://www.isixsigma.com/new-to-six-sigma/history/history-six-sigma/

ch02-s05-abb-allied-signal-and-general-e.translation: 精通六西格玛，能够选择成功的正确项目，并在全公司范围内支持这些项目，以确保成功。

sentences.source: well-versed in Six Sigma to pick the right projects for success and support those projects on a company- wide basis to ensure success.
sentences.translation: 精通六西格玛，能够选择成功的正确项目，并在全公司范围内支持这些项目，以确保成功。

ch02-s05-abb-allied-signal-and-general-e.translation: 哈利有时被称为六西格玛之父，他创建了一个教育行政领导人的系统。他与 Allied Signal 的其他人一起开发了系统，使六西格玛能够由整个组织的领导层有效部署。

sentences.source: Harry, who is sometimes referred to as the father of Six Sigma, created a system for educating executive leaders.
sentences.translation: 哈利有时被称为六西格玛之父，他创建了一个教育行政领导人的系统。

sentences.source: In conjunction with others at Allied Signal, he developed systems that allowed Six Sigma to be effectively deployed by leadership throughout an organization in its entirety.
sentences.translation: 他与 Allied Signal 的其他人一起开发了系统，使六西格玛能够由整个组织的领导层有效部署。

ch02-s05-abb-allied-signal-and-general-e.translation: 大约在同一时间，GE首席执行官杰克·韦尔奇进入了六西格玛的舞台。在了解六西格玛之前，韦尔奇曾表示他并不是质量衡量标准的支持者。他此前曾批评质量计划是一种严厉的方法，对取得成果几乎没有作用。 1995年，韦尔奇邀请Larry Bossidy在GE公司会议上发言。他还要求分析GE实施六西格玛的好处。当时，GE正在三点到四西格玛之间表演。如果公司升级到六西格玛，潜在的节省成本是巨大的；估计为 7 至 100 亿美元。6

sentences.source: Around the same time, GE CEO Jack Welch entered into the Six Sigma arena.
sentences.translation: 大约在同一时间，GE首席执行官杰克·韦尔奇进入了六西格玛的舞台。

sentences.source: Prior to learning about Six Sigma, Welch had stated he was not a proponent of quality measures.
sentences.translation: 在了解六西格玛之前，韦尔奇曾表示他并不是质量衡量标准的支持者。

sentences.source: He’d previously criticized quality programs as heavy-handed approaches that did little to deliver results.
sentences.translation: 他此前曾批评质量计划是一种严厉的方法，对取得成果几乎没有作用。

sentences.source: Welch invited Larry Bossidy to speak at a GE corporate meeting in 1995.
sentences.translation: 1995年，韦尔奇邀请Larry Bossidy在GE公司会议上发言。

sentences.source: He also requested an analysis regarding the benefits of implementing Six Sigma at GE.
sentences.translation: 他还要求分析GE实施六西格玛的好处。

sentences.source: At that time, GE was performing at between three and four sigma.
sentences.translation: 当时，GE正在三点到四西格玛之间表演。

sentences.source: The potential savings should the company rise to six sigma were enormous;
sentences.translation: 如果公司升级到六西格玛，潜在的节省成本是巨大的；

sentences.source: estimates were $7 to $10 billion.6
sentences.translation: 估计为 7 至 100 亿美元。

ch02-s05-abb-allied-signal-and-general-e.translation: 韦尔奇被称为六西格玛的拥护者，并不是因为他对统计过程控制或六西格玛工具集的开发做出了重大贡献，而是因为他准确地展示了领导者应该如何对待六西格玛。他还将六西格玛目标与员工奖励结构挂钩，使通用电气成为历史上成功的六西格玛组织。员工的薪酬不再仅仅基于财务绩效因素；他们还根据六西格玛的表现进行评估。突然之间，各级员工都有了参与持续流程改进的个人理由，并且为员工和经理提供了六西格玛培训以取得成功。

sentences.source: Welch is known as a champion of Six Sigma not because he contributed in major ways to the development of statistical process controls or the Six Sigma toolsets, but because he demonstrated exactly how leaders should approach Six Sigma.
sentences.translation: 韦尔奇被称为六西格玛的拥护者，并不是因为他对统计过程控制或六西格玛工具集的开发做出了重大贡献，而是因为他准确地展示了领导者应该如何对待六西格玛。

sentences.source: He also made GE a historically successful Six Sigma organization by tying Six Sigma goals to employee reward structures.
sentences.translation: 他还将六西格玛目标与员工奖励结构挂钩，使通用电气成为历史上成功的六西格玛组织。

sentences.source: Employees were no longer only compensated based on financial performance factors;
sentences.translation: 员工的薪酬不再仅仅基于财务绩效因素；

sentences.source: they were also evaluated based on Six Sigma performance.
sentences.translation: 他们还根据六西格玛的表现进行评估。

sentences.source: Suddenly, employees at every level had a personal reason to become involved in continuous process improvement, and employees and managers were supplied with the Six Sigma training to succeed.
sentences.translation: 突然之间，各级员工都有了参与持续流程改进的个人理由，并且为员工和经理提供了六西格玛培训以取得成功。

ch02-s06-continued-growth-of-six-sigma-e.translation: 继GE、摩托罗拉等企业的成功之后，全国各地企业纷纷实施六西格玛。不幸的是，在急于实施该流程的过程中，许多组织执行的改进效果不佳，或者在继续改进之前未能充分了解统计过程控制。尽管六西格玛方法已被各组织用来节省数百万甚至数十亿美元并提高效率，但一些公司对这一过程的品味不佳。这种糟糕的品味导致了以下误解和神话，这些误解和神话至今在许多行业仍然普遍存在：

sentences.source: Following the success of corporations such as GE and Motorola, companies across the country rushed to implement Six Sigma.
sentences.translation: 继GE、摩托罗拉等企业的成功之后，全国各地企业纷纷实施六西格玛。

sentences.source: Unfortunately, in the rush to implement the process, many organizations executed improvements poorly or failed to gain an adequate understanding of statistical process control before moving forward with improvements.
sentences.translation: 不幸的是，在急于实施该流程的过程中，许多组织执行的改进效果不佳，或者在继续改进之前未能充分了解统计过程控制。

sentences.source: Although Six Sigma methods have been used by organizations to gain millions—even billions—in savings and efficiencies, some companies walked away with a bad taste for the process.
sentences.translation: 尽管六西格玛方法已被各组织用来节省数百万甚至数十亿美元并提高效率，但一些公司对这一过程的品味不佳。

sentences.source: That bad taste has resulted in the following misconceptions and myths that are still prevalent today in many industries:
sentences.translation: 这种糟糕的品味导致了以下误解和神话，这些误解和神话至今在许多行业仍然普遍存在：

ch02-s06-continued-growth-of-six-sigma-e.translation: 六西格玛只关注指标，忽视常识。事实上恰恰相反：六西格玛通常从传统的常识想法开始，通常是通过头脑风暴得出的，并用数据验证这些假设。这个神话的原因是双重的。首先，习惯于打电话而不被询问的管理者和其他人突然在六西格玛的环境中受到询问。他们不仅受到质疑，而且有时硬数据证明他们是错误的。其次，在某些情况下，数据被不适当地用于支持违背常识或传统的结论。当这些结论被证明是错误的时，人们很容易指责六西格玛的过程对所涉及的统计理论缺乏足够的理解。

sentences.source: Six Sigma is solely concerned with metrics and ignores common sense.
sentences.translation: 六西格玛只关注指标，忽视常识。

sentences.source: The opposite is actually true: Six Sigma often starts with traditional common sense ideas, often arrived at through brainstorming, and validates those assumptions with data.
sentences.translation: 事实上恰恰相反：六西格玛通常从传统的常识想法开始，通常是通过头脑风暴得出的，并用数据验证这些假设。

sentences.source: The reason for this myth is twofold.
sentences.translation: 这个神话的原因是双重的。

sentences.source: First, managers and others who are used to making calls without being questioned are suddenly questioned in a Six Sigma environment.
sentences.translation: 首先，习惯于打电话而不被询问的管理者和其他人突然在六西格玛的环境中受到询问。

sentences.source: Not only are they questioned, but hard data sometimes proves them wrong.
sentences.translation: 他们不仅受到质疑，而且有时硬数据证明他们是错误的。

sentences.source: Second, in some cases data is improperly used to support conclusions that are against common sense or tradition.
sentences.translation: 其次，在某些情况下，数据被不适当地用于支持违背常识或传统的结论。

sentences.source: When those conclusions turn out to be faulty, it’s easy to blame the process of Six Sigma there is a lack of adequate understanding of the statistical theories involved.
sentences.translation: 当这些结论被证明是错误的时，人们很容易指责六西格玛的过程对所涉及的统计理论缺乏足够的理解。

ch02-s06-continued-growth-of-six-sigma-e.translation: 六西格玛太贵了。虽然一开始在整个企业范围内采用六西格玛的成本可能会很高，部分原因是培训需要，但慢慢地将这些概念融入公司往往成本非常高

sentences.source: Six Sigma is too expensive.
sentences.translation: 六西格玛太贵了。

sentences.source: While enterprise-wide adoption of Six Sigma can be costly at first, due in part to training needs, slowly integrating the concepts into a company often costs very
sentences.translation: 虽然一开始在整个企业范围内采用六西格玛的成本可能会很高，部分原因是培训需要，但慢慢地将这些概念融入公司往往成本非常高

sentences.source: 6 “The Evolution of Six Sigma,” PQA.net.
sentences.translation: 6 “六西格玛的演变”，PQA.net。

sentences.source: http://www.pqa.net/ProdServices/sixsigma/W06002009.html
sentences.translation: http://www.pqa.net/ProdServices/sixsigma/W06002009.html

ch02-s06-continued-growth-of-six-sigma-e.translation: 从长远来看很少。组织必须在采用六西格玛的方式与预算问题之间取得平衡，但如果实施得当，六西格玛所带来的节省通常会超过其初始投资。

sentences.source: little in the long run.
sentences.translation: 从长远来看很少。

sentences.source: Organizations have to balance how they adopt Six Sigma with budgetary concerns—but when implemented correctly, Six Sigma generally leads to savings that more than cover its initial investment.
sentences.translation: 组织必须在采用六西格玛的方式与预算问题之间取得平衡，但如果实施得当，六西格玛所带来的节省通常会超过其初始投资。

ch02-s06-continued-growth-of-six-sigma-e.translation: 六西格玛可以解决任何问题。与反对者相反的是六西格玛的热烈拥护者，他们相信自己可以像药膏一样使用这种方法来解决任何问题。虽然六西格玛可以应用于任何流程问题，但它并不总是与文化或人的问题相关。如果士气或其他人力资源问题是问题的根源，那么统计数据就无济于事。然而，如果由于流程难以配合或表现不佳而导致士气低落，则可以使用六西格玛来改进流程，从而提高士气。

sentences.source: Six Sigma can fix anything.
sentences.translation: 六西格玛可以解决任何问题。

sentences.source: Opposite the nay-sayers are Six Sigma cheerleaders who believe they can apply the method like a salve to any problem.
sentences.translation: 与反对者相反的是六西格玛的热烈拥护者，他们相信自己可以像药膏一样使用这种方法来解决任何问题。

sentences.source: While Six Sigma can be applied to any problem of process, it’s not always relevant to problems of culture or people.
sentences.translation: 虽然六西格玛可以应用于任何流程问题，但它并不总是与文化或人的问题相关。

sentences.source: If morale or other human resource problems are at the root of an issue, statistics can’t help.
sentences.translation: 如果士气或其他人力资源问题是问题的根源，那么统计数据就无济于事。

sentences.source: However, if morale is low because a process is difficult to work with or is performing poorly, Six Sigma can be used to improve the process, thereby improving morale.
sentences.translation: 然而，如果由于流程难以配合或表现不佳而导致士气低落，则可以使用六西格玛来改进流程，从而提高士气。

ch02-s07-applying-six-sigma-knowledge-en.translation: 六西格玛是通过受控的项目选择和管理流程来应用的。一旦确定了关注领域，领导者通常会向分析师、六西格玛专家和主题专家寻求成本效益分析。 六西格玛团队试图量化流程的损坏程度（通过计算西格玛水平、缺陷成本、停机时间和其他指标）以及解决问题可能需要花费多少费用。然后根据严重性以及组织解决问题的能力对问题进行优先级排序。团队开始研究优先级列表，不时返回分析以确保列表没有改变。 本书的大部分内容涵盖了团队使用六西格玛识别和解决问题的方法。

sentences.source: Six Sigma is applied via a controlled project selection and management process.
sentences.translation: 六西格玛是通过受控的项目选择和管理流程来应用的。

sentences.source: Once areas of concern are identified, leaders usually turn to analysts, Six Sigma experts, and subject-matter-experts for cost- benefit analyses.
sentences.translation: 一旦确定了关注领域，领导者通常会向分析师、六西格玛专家和主题专家寻求成本效益分析。

sentences.source: Six Sigma teams attempt to quantify how broken a process is (by calculating sigma level, costs of defects, downtime, and other metrics) and how much it might cost to address the problem.
sentences.translation: 六西格玛团队试图量化流程的损坏程度（通过计算西格玛水平、缺陷成本、停机时间和其他指标）以及解决问题可能需要花费多少费用。

sentences.source: Problems are then prioritized according to severity as well as an organization’s ability to address the issue.
sentences.translation: 然后根据严重性以及组织解决问题的能力对问题进行优先级排序。

sentences.source: Teams begin working through the priority list, returning to the analysis from time to time to ensure the list has not changed.
sentences.translation: 团队开始研究优先级列表，不时返回分析以确保列表没有改变。

sentences.source: The majority of this book covers the methods by which teams identify and address problems using Six Sigma.
sentences.translation: 本书的大部分内容涵盖了团队使用六西格玛识别和解决问题的方法。

sentences.source: The Levels of Six Sigma Certification
sentences.translation: 六西格玛认证的级别

ch02-s07-applying-six-sigma-knowledge-en.translation: 拥有六西格玛认证证明个人已表现出六西格玛的实际应用和知识。一些组织提供内部认证流程。大多数人通过参加在线或现场六西格玛培训课程来寻求认证。大多数提供六西格玛教育的组织也提供认证途径。您可以参加各种级别的认证课程； 六西格玛的等级是根据腰带等级来区分的。

sentences.source: Possessing a Six Sigma certification proves that an individual has demonstrated practical applications and knowledge of Six Sigma.
sentences.translation: 拥有六西格玛认证证明个人已表现出六西格玛的实际应用和知识。

sentences.source: Some organizations offer in-house certification processes.
sentences.translation: 一些组织提供内部认证流程。

sentences.source: Most people seek certification by enrolling in online or onsite Six Sigma training course.
sentences.translation: 大多数人通过参加在线或现场六西格玛培训课程来寻求认证。

sentences.source: Most organizations that offer Six Sigma education also offer a path to certification.
sentences.translation: 大多数提供六西格玛教育的组织也提供认证途径。

sentences.source: You can take courses for certification at various levels;
sentences.translation: 您可以参加各种级别的认证课程；

sentences.source: Six Sigma levels are differentiated by belt level.
sentences.translation: 六西格玛的等级是根据腰带等级来区分的。

sentences.source: White Belt
sentences.translation: 白带

ch02-s07-applying-six-sigma-knowledge-en.translation: 经过认证的六西格玛白带熟悉六西格玛方法论的基本原则，尽管他们通常不是流程改进团队的正式成员。 白带培训对于组织内的辅助人员来说是对六西格玛的一个很好的介绍，并且可以提供理解项目团队为何这样做所需的信息。该培训使员工能够审查项目流程，了解里程碑会议中提供的信息，并更好地参与项目选择流程。 当组织试图实施六西格玛文化时，白带培训也可以应用于所有级别的员工。值得注意的是，白带培训通常只提供对六西格玛非常基本的介绍和概述，以至于并非所有六西格玛专业人士都认可它是真正的六西格玛认证。

sentences.source: A certified Six Sigma White belt is familiar with the basic tenets of the Six Sigma methodology, though they aren’t often regular members of process improvement teams.
sentences.translation: 经过认证的六西格玛白带熟悉六西格玛方法论的基本原则，尽管他们通常不是流程改进团队的正式成员。

sentences.source: White belt training is a good introduction to Six Sigma for auxiliary staff members within an organization and can provide the information necessary for understanding why project teams do what they do.
sentences.translation: 白带培训对于组织内的辅助人员来说是对六西格玛的一个很好的介绍，并且可以提供理解项目团队为何这样做所需的信息。

sentences.source: The training lets employees review project processes, understand information presented in milestone meetings, and better participate in project selection processes.
sentences.translation: 该培训使员工能够审查项目流程，了解里程碑会议中提供的信息，并更好地参与项目选择流程。

sentences.source: White belt training can also be used across all levels of employees when organizations are attempting to implement a Six Sigma culture.
sentences.translation: 当组织试图实施六西格玛文化时，白带培训也可以应用于所有级别的员工。

sentences.source: It is worth noting that White Belt training usually only provides a very basic introduction and overview of Six Sigma, so much so that not all Six Sigma professionals recognize it as a true Six Sigma certification.
sentences.translation: 值得注意的是，白带培训通常只提供对六西格玛非常基本的介绍和概述，以至于并非所有六西格玛专业人士都认可它是真正的六西格玛认证。

sentences.source: Yellow Belt
sentences.translation: 黄带

ch02-s07-applying-six-sigma-knowledge-en.translation: 黄带认证比白带高一级：它仍然被认为是六西格玛概念的基本介绍，但黄带学习了经常用于改进流程的 DMAIC 方法的基本信息。六西格玛黄带培训中经常包含以下概念：

sentences.source: A yellow belt certification is a step above white belt: it is still considered a basic introduction to the concepts of Six Sigma, but a yellow belt learns basic information about the DMAIC method often used to improve processes.
sentences.translation: 黄带认证比白带高一级：它仍然被认为是六西格玛概念的基本介绍，但黄带学习了经常用于改进流程的 DMAIC 方法的基本信息。

sentences.source: The following concepts are often included in Six Sigma yellow belt training:
sentences.translation: 六西格玛黄带培训中经常包含以下概念：

sentences.source: Six Sigma roles
sentences.translation: 六西格玛角色

sentences.source: Team development and management
sentences.translation: 团队发展与管理

ch02-s07-applying-six-sigma-knowledge-en.translation: 基本质量工具，例如帕累托图、运行图、散点图和直方图

sentences.source: Basic quality tools such as Pareto charts, run charts, scatter diagrams and histograms
sentences.translation: 基本质量工具，例如帕累托图、运行图、散点图和直方图

sentences.source: Common Six Sigma metrics
sentences.translation: 常见六西格玛指标

sentences.source: Data collection
sentences.translation: 数据收集

sentences.source: Measurement system analysis
sentences.translation: 测量系统分析

sentences.source: Root cause analysis
sentences.translation: 根本原因分析

sentences.source: An introduction to hypothesis testing
sentences.translation: 假设检验简介

ch02-s07-applying-six-sigma-knowledge-en.translation: 在黄带层面，培训通常旨在了解整体方法和基本数据收集。 黄带人员不需要知道如何进行假设检验，但必须了解假设检验的语言以及从假设检验中得出的结论。 黄带人员通常是需要了解整个流程以及实施原因的员工。

sentences.source: At the yellow belt level, training is often geared toward understanding of the overall methodology and basic data collection.
sentences.translation: 在黄带层面，培训通常旨在了解整体方法和基本数据收集。

sentences.source: Yellow belts don’t need to know how to conduct hypothesis testing, but they must understand the language of hypothesis testing and the conclusions that are drawn from such tests.
sentences.translation: 黄带人员不需要知道如何进行假设检验，但必须了解假设检验的语言以及从假设检验中得出的结论。

sentences.source: Yellow belts are often employees who need to know about the overall process and why it is being implemented.
sentences.translation: 黄带人员通常是需要了解整个流程以及实施原因的员工。

sentences.source: Green Belt
sentences.translation: 绿带

ch02-s07-applying-six-sigma-knowledge-en.translation: 获得认证的绿带人员在六西格玛团队内工作，通常在黑带或黑带大师的监督下。在某些情况下，绿带人员可能会自己领导或处理较小的项目。 绿带人员一般具备中级统计分析能力；他们可能会解决数据和分析问题，帮助黑带人员将六西格玛工具应用到项目中，或者向组织内的其他人传授整体六西格玛方法论。

sentences.source: Certified green belts work within Six Sigma teams, usually under the supervision of a black belt or master black belt.
sentences.translation: 获得认证的绿带人员在六西格玛团队内工作，通常在黑带或黑带大师的监督下。

sentences.source: In some cases, green belts might lead or handle smaller projects on their own.
sentences.translation: 在某些情况下，绿带人员可能会自己领导或处理较小的项目。

sentences.source: Green belts are generally equipped with intermediate statistical analysis capabilities;
sentences.translation: 绿带人员一般具备中级统计分析能力；

sentences.source: they might address data and analysis concerns, help Black Belts apply Six Sigma tools to a project, or teach others within an organization about the overall Six Sigma methodology.
sentences.translation: 他们可能会解决数据和分析问题，帮助黑带人员将六西格玛工具应用到项目中，或者向组织内的其他人传授整体六西格玛方法论。

ch02-s07-applying-six-sigma-knowledge-en.translation: 绿带人员可以是中层管理人员、业务分析师、项目经理以及其他有理由定期参与流程改进计划但可能不是组织内全职六西格玛专家的人员。有时，绿带人员被认为是六西格玛方法论的工蜂，因为他们在经过认证的黑带人员的监督下承担了大部分统计数据的收集和分析工作。

sentences.source: Green Belts can be middle managers, business analysts, project managers, and others who have a reason to be involved regularly with process improvement initiatives but who might not be a full-time Six Sigma expert within an organization.
sentences.translation: 绿带人员可以是中层管理人员、业务分析师、项目经理以及其他有理由定期参与流程改进计划但可能不是组织内全职六西格玛专家的人员。

sentences.source: Sometimes, Green Belts are considered the worker bees of the Six Sigma methodology because they undertake most of the statistical data collection and analysis under the supervision of certified Black Belts.
sentences.translation: 有时，绿带人员被认为是六西格玛方法论的工蜂，因为他们在经过认证的黑带人员的监督下承担了大部分统计数据的收集和分析工作。

ch02-s07-applying-six-sigma-knowledge-en.translation: 绿带培训中经常包含以下概念：

sentences.source: The following concepts are often included in Green Belt training:
sentences.translation: 绿带培训中经常包含以下概念：

ch02-s07-applying-six-sigma-knowledge-en.translation: 黄带认证所列全部信息

sentences.source: All of the information listed for yellow belt certification
sentences.translation: 黄带认证所列全部信息

sentences.source: Failure mode and effects analysis
sentences.translation: 失效模式及影响分析

sentences.source: Project and team management
sentences.translation: 项目和团队管理

sentences.source: Probability and the Central Limit Theorem
sentences.translation: 概率和中心极限定理

sentences.source: Statistical distributions
sentences.translation: 统计分布

sentences.source: Descriptive statistics
sentences.translation: 描述性统计

ch02-s07-applying-six-sigma-knowledge-en.translation: 如何进行基本假设检验

sentences.source: How to perform basic hypothesis testing
sentences.translation: 如何进行基本假设检验

sentences.source: Waste elimination and Kaizen
sentences.translation: 消除废物和改善

sentences.source: Basic control charts
sentences.translation: 基本控制图

sentences.source: Black Belt
sentences.translation: 黑带

ch02-s07-applying-six-sigma-knowledge-en.translation: 经过认证的六西格玛黑带通常担任流程改进项目的项目负责人。他们还可能在整个公司担任管理、分析师或规划职务。黑带认证的常见最低要求包括为黄带和绿带人员列出的所有内容，此外还包括：

sentences.source: A certified Six Sigma Black Belt usually works as the project leader on process improvement projects.
sentences.translation: 经过认证的六西格玛黑带通常担任流程改进项目的项目负责人。

sentences.source: They might also work within management, analyst, or planning roles throughout a company.
sentences.translation: 他们还可能在整个公司担任管理、分析师或规划职务。

sentences.source: Common minimum requirements for black belt certification include everything listed for yellow and green belts in addition to:
sentences.translation: 黑带认证的常见最低要求包括为黄带和绿带人员列出的所有内容，此外还包括：

ch02-s07-applying-six-sigma-knowledge-en.translation: 先进的项目和团队管理技能

sentences.source: Advanced project and team management skills
sentences.translation: 先进的项目和团队管理技能

ch02-s07-applying-six-sigma-knowledge-en.translation: 了解六西格玛头脑风暴和项目工具的广泛列表

sentences.source: Knowledge of the expansive list of Six Sigma brainstorming and project tools
sentences.translation: 了解六西格玛头脑风暴和项目工具的广泛列表

sentences.source: Intermediate to advanced statistics
sentences.translation: 中级到高级统计

ch02-s07-applying-six-sigma-knowledge-en.translation: 了解其他流程改进和质量计划，包括精益和全面质量管理

sentences.source: An understanding of other process improvement and quality programs, including Lean and Total Quality Management
sentences.translation: 了解其他流程改进和质量计划，包括精益和全面质量管理

sentences.source: An ability to design processes
sentences.translation: 设计流程的能力

ch02-s07-applying-six-sigma-knowledge-en.translation: 用于绘制流程图表的高级功能，包括流程图和价值流图

sentences.source: Advanced capabilities for diagraming processes, including flow charts and value stream maps
sentences.translation: 用于绘制流程图表的高级功能，包括流程图和价值流图

ch02-s07-applying-six-sigma-knowledge-en.translation: 使用Excel或Minitab等软件进行分析

sentences.source: Use of software to conduct analysis, such as Excel or Minitab
sentences.translation: 使用Excel或Minitab等软件进行分析

sentences.source: Master Black Belt
sentences.translation: 黑带大师

ch02-s07-applying-six-sigma-knowledge-en.translation: 黑带大师是六西格玛所能达到的最高认证级别。 在商业组织内，黑带人员大师通常管理黑带人员和绿带人员，就特别困难的项目问题提供咨询，提供有关挑战性统计概念的建议和教育，并对其他人进行六西格玛方法论的培训。

sentences.source: A Master Black Belt is the highest certification level achievable for Six Sigma.
sentences.translation: 黑带大师是六西格玛所能达到的最高认证级别。

sentences.source: Within a business organization, Master Black Belts usually manage Black Belts and Green Belts, consult on especially difficult project concerns, offer advice and education about challenging statistical concepts, and train others in Six Sigma methodology.
sentences.translation: 在商业组织内，黑带人员大师通常管理黑带人员和绿带人员，就特别困难的项目问题提供咨询，提供有关挑战性统计概念的建议和教育，并对其他人进行六西格玛方法论的培训。

sentences.source: Certification Exams
sentences.translation: 认证考试

ch02-s07-applying-six-sigma-knowledge-en.translation: 大多数认证计划要求个人通过认证考试；有些要求绿带和黑带候选人还以六西格玛项目经验的形式展示他们的知识。

sentences.source: Most certification programs require individuals to pass an exam for certification;
sentences.translation: 大多数认证计划要求个人通过认证考试；

sentences.source: some require that green and black belt candidates also demonstrate their knowledge in the form of Six Sigma project experience.
sentences.translation: 有些要求绿带和黑带候选人还以六西格玛项目经验的形式展示他们的知识。

ch02-s07-applying-six-sigma-knowledge-en.translation: 如果白人或黄带认证需要考试，考试通常相当短，涵盖了方法论的基本概念。 绿带考试时间较长，可能包括有关统计和一些基本计算的问题。 黑带考试通常需要四个小时才能完成；他们测试理解和应用。考试可能包括困难的统计问题或有关项目负责人如何处理各种情况的问题。虽然考试因组织而异，但本书是根据六西格玛认证委员会 (CSSC) 发布的知识体系要求设计的。

sentences.source: If an exam is required for white or yellow belt certification, it is usually fairly short and covers basic concepts about the methodology.
sentences.translation: 如果白人或黄带认证需要考试，考试通常相当短，涵盖了方法论的基本概念。

sentences.source: Green belt exams are longer and might include questions about statistics and some basic calculations.
sentences.translation: 绿带考试时间较长，可能包括有关统计和一些基本计算的问题。

sentences.source: Black belt exams often take up to four hours to complete;
sentences.translation: 黑带考试通常需要四个小时才能完成；

sentences.source: they test for understanding and application.
sentences.translation: 他们测试理解和应用。

sentences.source: Exams might include difficult statistical problems or questions about how a project leader might handle various situations.
sentences.translation: 考试可能包括困难的统计问题或有关项目负责人如何处理各种情况的问题。

sentences.source: While exams differ by organization, this book is designed based on The Council for Six Sigma Certification’s (CSSC) published body-of-knowledge requirements.
sentences.translation: 虽然考试因组织而异，但本书是根据六西格玛认证委员会 (CSSC) 发布的知识体系要求设计的。

sentences.source: Quality Methods
sentences.translation: 质量方法

ch03-s01-other-process-improvement-and-q.translation: 通过研究六西格玛的历史，您已经意识到该方法与过去一个世纪发展的许多其他质量驱动举措密切相关。这在一定程度上是正确的，因为所有成功的企业最终都寻求做同样的事情：为客户提供他们需要的产品或服务，同时赚取尽可能多的利润。

sentences.source: By studying the history of Six Sigma, you’ve already realized that the methodology is closely related to a number of other quality-driven initiatives developed over the past century.
sentences.translation: 通过研究六西格玛的历史，您已经意识到该方法与过去一个世纪发展的许多其他质量驱动举措密切相关。

sentences.source: This is true in part because all successful businesses ultimately seek to do the same thing: serve a customer a product or service they need while making as much profit as possible.
sentences.translation: 这在一定程度上是正确的，因为所有成功的企业最终都寻求做同样的事情：为客户提供他们需要的产品或服务，同时赚取尽可能多的利润。

ch03-s01-other-process-improvement-and-q.translation: 虽然六西格玛包含解决几乎任何流程问题所需的所有工具，但熟悉其他类型的流程改进和质量方法也很重要。其中一些方法，例如 Lean 和 JumpStart，在六西格玛方法中增加了价值。其他的可能会与六西格玛项目一起被外部资源使用。即使您不使用或不使用其中某些程序，您也需要与更熟悉其他方法的领导层和业务合作伙伴进行沟通。以更加全球化的质量管理方法构建六西格玛概念的能力可以帮助您为自己的项目赢得支持。

sentences.source: While Six Sigma encompasses all the tools you need to approach virtually any problem of process, familiarity with other types of process improvement and quality methods is important.
sentences.translation: 虽然六西格玛包含解决几乎任何流程问题所需的所有工具，但熟悉其他类型的流程改进和质量方法也很重要。

sentences.source: Some of these methods, such as Lean and JumpStart, add value within a Six Sigma approach.
sentences.translation: 其中一些方法，例如 Lean 和 JumpStart，在六西格玛方法中增加了价值。

sentences.source: Others might be used by outside resources alongside a Six Sigma project.
sentences.translation: 其他的可能会与六西格玛项目一起被外部资源使用。

sentences.source: Even if you don’t use or work with some of these programs, you will need to communicate with leadership and business partners who are more familiar with other methods.
sentences.translation: 即使您不使用或不使用其中某些程序，您也需要与更熟悉其他方法的领导层和业务合作伙伴进行沟通。

sentences.source: The ability to frame Six Sigma concepts in a more global quality management approach can help you win support for your own projects.
sentences.translation: 以更加全球化的质量管理方法构建六西格玛概念的能力可以帮助您为自己的项目赢得支持。

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 精益流程管理

sentences.source: Lean Process Management
sentences.translation: 精益流程管理

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 精益原则常常与六西格玛原则齐头并进。虽然精益最初是作为减少制造环境中浪费的概念而开发的，但精益流程管理的思想可以应用于涉及商品或服务的移动或创建的任何流程。即使这些服务是虚拟的或数字的，例如在计算机化的工作流程中，情况也是如此。

sentences.source: Lean principles often go hand-in-hand with Six Sigma principles.
sentences.translation: 精益原则常常与六西格玛原则齐头并进。

sentences.source: While Lean originally developed as a concept for reducing waste in a manufacturing environment, the ideas of Lean Process Management can be applied to any process that involves the movement or creation of goods or services.
sentences.translation: 虽然精益最初是作为减少制造环境中浪费的概念而开发的，但精益流程管理的思想可以应用于涉及商品或服务的移动或创建的任何流程。

sentences.source: This is true even if those services are virtual or digital, such as in a computerized workflow process.
sentences.translation: 即使这些服务是虚拟的或数字的，例如在计算机化的工作流程中，情况也是如此。

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 精益与六西格玛的相似之处之一是它关注持续改进；与六西格玛一样，精益提供废物清除工具，以便对流程进行日常控制和改进。事实上，精益的持续改进工具之一被称为“Kaizen”，这是一个日语单词，大致翻译为“变得更好”。 Kaizen 环境中每一次变革的目的都是为了持续消除浪费和/或为客户创造更多价值。

sentences.source: One of the ways that Lean is similar to Six Sigma is that it is concerned with continuous improvements;
sentences.translation: 精益与六西格玛的相似之处之一是它关注持续改进；

sentences.source: like Six Sigma, Lean provides waste-removal tools so daily control and improvements can be made to processes.
sentences.translation: 与六西格玛一样，精益提供废物清除工具，以便对流程进行日常控制和改进。

sentences.source: In fact, one of Lean’s continuous improvement tools is called Kaizen, a Japanese word that translates loosely to “change for the better.” The purpose of every change in a Kaizen environment is to eliminate waste and/or create more value for the customer on a continuous basis.
sentences.translation: Kaizen 环境中每一次变革的目的都是为了持续消除浪费和/或为客户创造更多价值。

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 精益流程管理可以部署在项目环境或日常生产中。与六西格玛一样，精益更多地是一种整体的质量文化，而不是单一的质量活动。许多组织使用精益原则来改进流程。 通过简单地制定一些精益原则，管理人员就可以大幅提高部门的产量并降低成本。

sentences.source: Lean Process Management can be deployed within a project environment or in daily production.
sentences.translation: 精益流程管理可以部署在项目环境或日常生产中。

sentences.source: Like Six Sigma, Lean is more about an overall culture of quality than a single quality event.
sentences.translation: 与六西格玛一样，精益更多地是一种整体的质量文化，而不是单一的质量活动。

sentences.source: Many organizations use Lean principles to make improvements in processes.
sentences.translation: 许多组织使用精益原则来改进流程。

sentences.source: By simply instituting some of the Lean principles, managers can drastically increase production and reduce costs for their departments.
sentences.translation: 通过简单地制定一些精益原则，管理人员就可以大幅提高部门的产量并降低成本。

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 由于精益原则非常有效，并且与六西格玛原则非常契合，出于本书的目的，我们通常将精益视为六西格玛方法论的一部分。

sentences.source: Because Lean principles are so effective and fit so well with Six Sigma principles, for the purpose of this book, we will often treat Lean as a part of the Six Sigma methodology.
sentences.translation: 由于精益原则非常有效，并且与六西格玛原则非常契合，出于本书的目的，我们通常将精益视为六西格玛方法论的一部分。

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 全面质量管理

sentences.source: Total Quality Management
sentences.translation: 全面质量管理

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 全面质量管理（TQM）是 20 世纪最后 25 年从事商业工作的人都熟知的一个短语。 TQM 质量方法是美国商业环境中最早采用的正式方法之一。最初开发于 20 世纪 50 年代，全面质量

sentences.source: Total Quality Management, or TQM, is a phrase well-known by anyone who worked in business in the last quarter of the 20th century.
sentences.translation: 全面质量管理（TQM）是 20 世纪最后 25 年从事商业工作的人都熟知的一个短语。

sentences.source: The TQM approach to quality is one of the first formal methods enacted in business environments in the United States.
sentences.translation: TQM 质量方法是美国商业环境中最早采用的正式方法之一。

sentences.source: Originally developed in the 1950s, Total Quality
sentences.translation: 最初开发于 20 世纪 50 年代，全面质量

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 直到上世纪80年代，管理才开始受到全国企业的欢迎。全面质量管理曾一度受到高管和其他领导者的欢迎，以至于它实际上成为某些员工的一个笑话，他们认为在质量上花费了大量的精力和费用，却没有得到同等的效益。事实上，如果你还记得上一章的话，通用电气的杰克·韦尔奇（Jack Welch）也有这种感觉。

sentences.source: Management didn’t become popular with companies across the country until the 80s.
sentences.translation: 直到上世纪80年代，管理才开始受到全国企业的欢迎。

sentences.source: At one point, TQM was so popular with executives and other leaders that it actually became something of a joke among certain workforces who believed that much effort and expense was expended on quality without an equal resulting benefit.
sentences.translation: 全面质量管理曾一度受到高管和其他领导者的欢迎，以至于它实际上成为某些员工的一个笑话，他们认为在质量上花费了大量的精力和费用，却没有得到同等的效益。

sentences.source: In fact, if you remember from the last chapter, Jack Welch at GE felt this way.
sentences.translation: 事实上，如果你还记得上一章的话，通用电气的杰克·韦尔奇（Jack Welch）也有这种感觉。

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 虽然全面质量管理计划在结果方面往往有些乏善可陈，但该方法是当前改进和质量方法（如六西格玛）的重要起点。全面质量管理并非没有结果：与任何方法一样，结果在很大程度上取决于计划的实施方式和组织文化。因此，全面质量管理及其变体至今仍在许多行业中发挥着作用。成功的全面质量管理计划的一些要求包括：

sentences.source: While Total Quality Management programs were often somewhat lackluster when it came to results, the method was an essential stepping point to current improvement and quality methods such as Six Sigma.
sentences.translation: 虽然全面质量管理计划在结果方面往往有些乏善可陈，但该方法是当前改进和质量方法（如六西格玛）的重要起点。

sentences.source: TQM was not without its results: as with any method, results depended highly on the way the program was implemented and the culture of the organization.
sentences.translation: 全面质量管理并非没有结果：与任何方法一样，结果在很大程度上取决于计划的实施方式和组织文化。

sentences.source: For this reason, TQM and its variations are still in play in many industries today.
sentences.translation: 因此，全面质量管理及其变体至今仍在许多行业中发挥着作用。

sentences.source: Some requirements for a successful TQM program include:
sentences.translation: 成功的全面质量管理计划的一些要求包括：

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 组织各个层面，尤其是领导者的严格质量承诺

sentences.source: A strict quality commitment at all levels of the organization, especially among leaders
sentences.translation: 组织各个层面，尤其是领导者的严格质量承诺

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 授权员工在流程中工作时可以做出高质量决策，而无需不断寻求领导层对这些决策的批准

sentences.source: Empowered employees who can make quality decisions while working within the process without constantly seeking leadership approval for those decisions
sentences.translation: 授权员工在流程中工作时可以做出高质量决策，而无需不断寻求领导层对这些决策的批准

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 促进高质量工作的奖励和认可结构，使员工有理由做出质量决策

sentences.source: A reward and recognition structure to promote quality work so that employees have a reason to make quality-making decisions
sentences.translation: 促进高质量工作的奖励和认可结构，使员工有理由做出质量决策

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 在制定长期决策时考虑质量和质量改进目标的战略规划

sentences.source: Strategic planning that takes quality and quality improvement goals into account when making long-term decisions
sentences.translation: 在制定长期决策时考虑质量和质量改进目标的战略规划

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 让组织进行改进和监控质量的系统

sentences.source: Systems that let organizations make improvements and monitor quality
sentences.translation: 让组织进行改进和监控质量的系统

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 成功的全面质量管理计划需要八个关键要素：道德、诚信、信任、培训、团队合作、领导力、认可和沟通。您可以将这些元素视为构建高质量、持久建筑所需的组件的一部分。 道德、诚信和信任成为质量的基础。培训、团队合作和领导力是构建优质组织的基石。诚实、开放、简洁的沟通是将一切联系在一起的砂浆，认可是覆盖一切的屋顶，为员工提供了追求和保持质量的理由。

sentences.source: Successful TQM initiatives require eight key elements: ethics, integrity, trust, training, teamwork, leadership, recognition, and communication.
sentences.translation: 成功的全面质量管理计划需要八个关键要素：道德、诚信、信任、培训、团队合作、领导力、认可和沟通。

sentences.source: You can view these elements as if they were part of the components needed to build a high-quality, lasting building.
sentences.translation: 您可以将这些元素视为构建高质量、持久建筑所需的组件的一部分。

sentences.source: Ethics, integrity, and trust become the foundation for quality.
sentences.translation: 道德、诚信和信任成为质量的基础。

sentences.source: Training, teamwork, and leadership are the bricks by which quality organizations are built.
sentences.translation: 培训、团队合作和领导力是构建优质组织的基石。

sentences.source: Honest, open, and concise communication is the mortar that binds everything else together, and recognition is the roof that covers everything, providing employees with a reason to seek and maintain quality.
sentences.translation: 诚实、开放、简洁的沟通是将一切联系在一起的砂浆，认可是覆盖一切的屋顶，为员工提供了追求和保持质量的理由。

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: TQM 理念的最大优势之一是它开始迫使组织将自己视为一个实体，而不是许多松散相关的实体或部门。在 20 世纪下半叶开发质量方法之前，许多组织都是通过严重孤立的部门来运营的。一个部门常常不了解另一个部门在做什么，这导致了大量的返工和浪费。每个部门可能会寻求更高的质量水平或流程改进，但最终，组织的实力取决于最薄弱的部分。

sentences.source: One of the biggest advantages of the TQM mentality is that it began to force organizations to see themselves as one entity rather than a number of loosely related entities or departments.
sentences.translation: TQM 理念的最大优势之一是它开始迫使组织将自己视为一个实体，而不是许多松散相关的实体或部门。

sentences.source: Prior to the quality methods developed in the last half of the 20th century, many organizations were run via heavily siloed departments.
sentences.translation: 在 20 世纪下半叶开发质量方法之前，许多组织都是通过严重孤立的部门来运营的。

sentences.source: One department often did not understand what another was doing, which caused a great deal of rework and waste.
sentences.translation: 一个部门常常不了解另一个部门在做什么，这导致了大量的返工和浪费。

sentences.source: Each department might seek higher quality levels or process improvements, but in the end, the organization was only as strong as the weakest element.
sentences.translation: 每个部门可能会寻求更高的质量水平或流程改进，但最终，组织的实力取决于最薄弱的部分。

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: TQM 开始大规模改变部门思维：组织开始采用企业方法进行决策、质量和客户服务。商业领袖开始将公司视为一系列相互关联的流程，以实现单一的最终目标。在全面质量管理的范围内，业务流程再造的想法开始发展。

sentences.source: TQM began to change departmental thinking on a massive scale: organizations began to take enterprise approaches to decision making, quality, and customer service.
sentences.translation: TQM 开始大规模改变部门思维：组织开始采用企业方法进行决策、质量和客户服务。

sentences.source: Business leaders started to look at companies as a series of linked processes operating toward a single end goal.
sentences.translation: 商业领袖开始将公司视为一系列相互关联的流程，以实现单一的最终目标。

sentences.source: Within the bounds of TQM, the ideas for business process reengineering began to develop.
sentences.translation: 在全面质量管理的范围内，业务流程再造的想法开始发展。

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: TQM 开始大规模改变部门思维：组织开始采用企业方法进行决策、质量和客户服务。商业领袖开始将公司视为一系列相互关联的流程，以实现单一的最终目标。在全面质量管理的范围内，业务流程再造的想法开始发展。

sentences.source: Organizations using TQM often experienced benefits such as:
sentences.translation: TQM 开始大规模改变部门思维：组织开始采用企业方法进行决策、质量和客户服务。

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 提高员工敬业度和士气

sentences.source: Improved employee engagement and morale
sentences.translation: 提高员工敬业度和士气

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 生产或产品成本降低

sentences.source: A reduction in production or product costs
sentences.translation: 生产或产品成本降低

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 减少循环时间

sentences.source: Decreased cycle times
sentences.translation: 减少循环时间

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 客户更满意

sentences.source: More satisfied customers
sentences.translation: 客户更满意

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 业务流程再造

sentences.source: Business Process Reengineering
sentences.translation: 业务流程再造

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 六西格玛、精益和全面质量管理都致力于在大大小小的规模上进行持续的变革，使组织更加接近完美的典范。就精益而言，该模型是一个零浪费的流程；在六西格玛中，模型统计为六西格玛。在全面质量管理中，组织通常会在努力实现完美之前定义自己的完美版本。业务流程重组（BPR）不太关心增量质量胜利，而更关心整个组织或流程架构的根本性变化。

sentences.source: Six Sigma, Lean and TQM are all concerned with making continuous changes on both a large and small scale that bring an organization ever closer to a model of perfection.
sentences.translation: 六西格玛、精益和全面质量管理都致力于在大大小小的规模上进行持续的变革，使组织更加接近完美的典范。

sentences.source: In the case of Lean, that model is a process that has zero waste;
sentences.translation: 就精益而言，该模型是一个零浪费的流程；

sentences.source: in Six Sigma, the model is statistically 6 sigma.
sentences.translation: 在六西格玛中，模型统计为六西格玛。

sentences.source: In TQM, organizations often define their own version of perfection before working toward it.
sentences.translation: 在全面质量管理中，组织通常会在努力实现完美之前定义自己的完美版本。

sentences.source: Business Process Reengineering, or BPR, is less concerned with incremental quality wins and more concerned with a radical change across an entire organization or process architecture.
sentences.translation: 业务流程重组（BPR）不太关心增量质量胜利，而更关心整个组织或流程架构的根本性变化。

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 业务流程再造，也称为业务流程重新设计，通常涉及整个组织中发生的技术流程。 这些流程可能包括系统、软件、数据存储、云和网络流程，以及由人类用户操作和维护的基于计算机的工作流程。由于自动化和计算机元素与 BPR 流程的紧密集成，参与 BPR 工作的组织必须严重依赖内部和外部技术资源。随着流程的开发或重新设计，内部资源提供编程、集成和故障排除服务。外部资源可以是 BPR 顾问、签约程序员和开发人员，或者是推出新软件产品的供应商。

sentences.source: Business process reengineering, which is also called business process redesign, is most often concerned with the technical processes that occur throughout an organization.
sentences.translation: 业务流程再造，也称为业务流程重新设计，通常涉及整个组织中发生的技术流程。

sentences.source: Those processes might include systems, software, data storage, cloud and web processes, and computer-based workflows operated and maintained by human users.
sentences.translation: 这些流程可能包括系统、软件、数据存储、云和网络流程，以及由人类用户操作和维护的基于计算机的工作流程。

sentences.source: Because of the intense integration of automation and computer elements into processes with BPR, organizations that enter BPR endeavors have to rely heavily on both inside and outside technical resources.
sentences.translation: 由于自动化和计算机元素与 BPR 流程的紧密集成，参与 BPR 工作的组织必须严重依赖内部和外部技术资源。

sentences.source: Inside resources provide programming, integration, and troubleshooting services as processes are developed or redesigned.
sentences.translation: 随着流程的开发或重新设计，内部资源提供编程、集成和故障排除服务。

sentences.source: Outside resources can be BPR consultants, contracted programmers and developers, or vendors bringing new software products to the table.
sentences.translation: 外部资源可以是 BPR 顾问、签约程序员和开发人员，或者是推出新软件产品的供应商。

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 正如您可能想象的那样，BPR 计划的成本可能很高，这就是为什么它们通常仅在组织期望指数级收益或确定当前流程已过时或严重损坏时才部署。

sentences.source: As you can probably imagine, BPR initiatives can be costly, which is why they are often deployed only when an organization expects exponential gain or has determined that current processes are obsolete or badly broken.
sentences.translation: 正如您可能想象的那样，BPR 计划的成本可能很高，这就是为什么它们通常仅在组织期望指数级收益或确定当前流程已过时或严重损坏时才部署。

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: BPR 项目往往遵循一个通用的地图，尽管没有像六西格玛那样有一套明确的原则。大多数项目都会经历规划、设计和实施阶段。在规划过程中，团队使用流程图和流程架构原则来定义当前状态的企业范围流程。团队寻找改进的机会，并集体讨论整个组织流程的新架构。

sentences.source: BPR projects tend to follow a common map, though there isn’t a defined set of principles as there is with Six Sigma.
sentences.translation: BPR 项目往往遵循一个通用的地图，尽管没有像六西格玛那样有一套明确的原则。

sentences.source: Most projects go through planning, design, and implementation phases.
sentences.translation: 大多数项目都会经历规划、设计和实施阶段。

sentences.source: During planning, teams use process mapping and process architecture principles to define enterprise-wide processes in their current state.
sentences.translation: 在规划过程中，团队使用流程图和流程架构原则来定义当前状态的企业范围流程。

sentences.source: Teams look for opportunities for improvement and brainstorm new architectures for processes throughout the organization.
sentences.translation: 团队寻找改进的机会，并集体讨论整个组织流程的新架构。

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 在设计阶段，BPR 团队使用验证技术 3 确保他们规划的解决方案能够在企业结构内发挥作用。他们还开始构建工具和程序来整合这些变化；在此过程中，技术团队可能会使用本章稍后描述的 Scrum 方法。

sentences.source: During the design phase, BPR teams use validation techniques 3 to ensure solutions they are planning will work within the enterprise structure.
sentences.translation: 在设计阶段，BPR 团队使用验证技术 3 确保他们规划的解决方案能够在企业结构内发挥作用。

sentences.source: They also begin to build tools and programs to integrate the changes;
sentences.translation: 他们还开始构建工具和程序来整合这些变化；

sentences.source: technical teams might use the Scrum methods described later in this chapter at this point in the process.
sentences.translation: 在此过程中，技术团队可能会使用本章稍后描述的 Scrum 方法。

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 最后，组织实施他们所做的改变。由于变更本质上通常是程序化的，因此实施通常包括严格的变更管理和测试程序。技术环境中的测试包括以下步骤：

sentences.source: Finally, organizations implement the changes they have made.
sentences.translation: 最后，组织实施他们所做的改变。

sentences.source: Since changes are often programmatic in nature, implementation usually includes a rigorous change management and testing procedure.
sentences.translation: 由于变更本质上通常是程序化的，因此实施通常包括严格的变更管理和测试程序。

sentences.source: Testing in technical environments includes steps such as:
sentences.translation: 技术环境中的测试包括以下步骤：

sentences.translation: 基本功能的沙箱测试

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 由训练有素的技术资源进行质量保证测试

sentences.translation: 由训练有素的技术资源进行质量保证测试

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: Beta 测试期间，经验丰富的主题专家在有限的现场环境中审查程序的各个方面

sentences.source: Beta testing during which experienced subject matter experts vet all aspects of a program in a limited live environment
sentences.translation: Beta 测试期间，经验丰富的主题专家在有限的现场环境中审查程序的各个方面

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 向企业推出该计划，通常以分阶段的方式进行，在此期间技术资源随时待命以立即解决故障排除问题

sentences.source: A rollout of the program to the enterprise, often conducted in a phased approach during which technical resources are on call to immediately resolve troubleshooting issues
sentences.translation: 向企业推出该计划，通常以分阶段的方式进行，在此期间技术资源随时待命以立即解决故障排除问题

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 转为常规职能，以正常能力提供技术资源来处理偶尔出现的问题

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 鲁姆勒-布拉什

sentences.source: Rummler-Brache
sentences.translation: 鲁姆勒-布拉什

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 随着过程改进方法在 20 世纪 80 年代及以后变得越来越流行，个人经常采用一种或另一种方法的一部分并将其集成到新的改进或质量计划中。就这样，制造业以外的企业开始实施融入精益和六西格玛元素的点点滴滴的方法。其中一个程序被称为 Rummler-Brache。

sentences.source: As process improvement methods became increasingly popular in the 1980s and later, individuals often took portions of one method or another and integrated it into new improvement or quality programs.
sentences.translation: 随着过程改进方法在 20 世纪 80 年代及以后变得越来越流行，个人经常采用一种或另一种方法的一部分并将其集成到新的改进或质量计划中。

sentences.source: In this manner, companies outside of the manufacturing industry began implementing bits and pieces of methods that incorporated Lean and Six Sigma elements.
sentences.translation: 就这样，制造业以外的企业开始实施融入精益和六西格玛元素的点点滴滴的方法。

sentences.source: One such program is known as Rummler- Brache.
sentences.translation: 其中一个程序被称为 Rummler-Brache。

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: Rummler-Brache 是由 Geary Rummler 和 Alan Brache 在 80 年代首创的。他们开发了自己的咨询公司使用的专有程序，但该方法的详细信息已被其他人发布和使用。该方法旨在通过使用一组实用工具来解决业务问题和流程问题，从而影响流程和组织的积极变化。

sentences.source: Rummler-Brache was pioneered in the 80s by Geary Rummler and Alan Brache.
sentences.translation: Rummler-Brache 是由 Geary Rummler 和 Alan Brache 在 80 年代首创的。

sentences.source: They developed what remains a proprietary program used by their own consulting firm, but details of the method have been published and used by others.
sentences.translation: 他们开发了自己的咨询公司使用的专有程序，但该方法的详细信息已被其他人发布和使用。

sentences.source: The method seeks to affect positive change in processes and organizations by using a set of practical tools to address business issues and process problems.
sentences.translation: 该方法旨在通过使用一组实用工具来解决业务问题和流程问题，从而影响流程和组织的积极变化。

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: Rummler-Brache 的基本组成部分之一被称为九盒模型。该模型由三个性能级别和三个性能维度的矩阵创建。绩效级别包括执行者、过程和组织。维度是管理、设计和目标。当放置在网格上时，级别和尺寸形成九个框，如下所示。

sentences.source: One of the foundational components of Rummler-Brache is known as the Nine Boxes Model.
sentences.translation: Rummler-Brache 的基本组成部分之一被称为九盒模型。

sentences.source: The model is created by a matrix of three performance levels and three performance dimensions.
sentences.translation: 该模型由三个性能级别和三个性能维度的矩阵创建。

sentences.source: Performance levels are the performer, the process, and the organization.
sentences.translation: 绩效级别包括执行者、过程和组织。

sentences.source: Dimensions are management, design, and goal.
sentences.translation: 维度是管理、设计和目标。

sentences.source: When placed on a grid, the levels and dimensions form nine boxes, as seen below.
sentences.translation: 当放置在网格上时，级别和尺寸形成九个框，如下所示。

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 管理

sentences.source: Management
sentences.translation: 管理

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 设计目标

sentences.source: Design Goals
sentences.translation: 设计目标

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 表演者

sentences.source: Performer
sentences.translation: 表演者

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 关注反馈、后果和奖励

sentences.source: Concerned with feedback, consequences, and rewards
sentences.translation: 关注反馈、后果和奖励

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 关注个人层面的绩效指标和要求

sentences.source: Concerned with performance metrics and requirements at an individual level
sentences.translation: 关注个人层面的绩效指标和要求

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 关注完成工作所需的工具和培训以及工作文档

sentences.translation: 关注完成工作所需的工具和培训以及工作文档

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 关注流程、工作空间或系统的设计

sentences.source: Concerned with the design of the process, work space, or system
sentences.translation: 关注流程、工作空间或系统的设计

sentences.translation: 工艺流程

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 关心谁拥有该流程以及他们如何改进它

sentences.source: Concerned with who owns the process and how they might improve it
sentences.translation: 关心谁拥有该流程以及他们如何改进它

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 关注业务和客户的需求

sentences.source: Concerned with the requirements of the business and the customer
sentences.translation: 关注业务和客户的需求

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 关注整体组织结构图和流程架构

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 关注运营计划和顶级指标

sentences.source: Concerned with operating plans and top-level metrics
sentences.translation: 关注运营计划和顶级指标

sentences.translation: 组织机构

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 关注整体领导文化和绩效评估的要求

sentences.source: Concerned with overall leadership culture and the requirements of performance evaluation
sentences.translation: 关注整体领导文化和绩效评估的要求

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: Rummler-Brache 的改进分为六个阶段：

sentences.source: Rummler-Brache approaches improvement in six phases:
sentences.translation: Rummler-Brache 的改进分为六个阶段：

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 改进计划。在第一阶段，领导层和主题专家致力于做出改进并开始寻找变革机会。

sentences.source: Improvement planning.
sentences.translation: 改进计划。

sentences.source: During the first phase, leadership and subject-matter-experts commit to making improvements and begin to identify opportunities for change.
sentences.translation: 在第一阶段，领导层和主题专家致力于做出改进并开始寻找变革机会。

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 定义。在第二阶段，定义项目目标和范围，并组建团队来进行改进。

sentences.source: Definition.
sentences.translation: 定义。

sentences.source: During the second phase, project goals and scopes are defined and teams are formed to create improvements.
sentences.translation: 在第二阶段，定义项目目标和范围，并组建团队来进行改进。

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 分析与设计。团队使用分析来了解当前问题并定义和验证可行的解决方案。

sentences.source: Analysis and Design.
sentences.translation: 分析与设计。

sentences.source: Teams use analysis to understand the current problem and to define and validate workable solutions.
sentences.translation: 团队使用分析来了解当前问题并定义和验证可行的解决方案。

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 实施。团队实施流程变更。根据变更的类型，这可能包括规划变更、员工再培训、机械或设备变更或政策变更。

sentences.source: Implementation.
sentences.translation: 实施。

sentences.source: Teams implement process changes.
sentences.translation: 团队实施流程变更。

sentences.source: Depending on the type of change, this might include programming changes, retraining staff, changes in machinery or equipment, or policy changes.
sentences.translation: 根据变更的类型，这可能包括规划变更、员工再培训、机械或设备变更或政策变更。

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 流程管理。团队在变更期间和变更后立即监控流程，以确保改进按计划发挥作用。

sentences.source: Management of process.
sentences.translation: 流程管理。

sentences.source: Teams monitor the process during and immediately following the change to ensure improvements function as planned.
sentences.translation: 团队在变更期间和变更后立即监控流程，以确保改进按计划发挥作用。

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 流程移交给日常团队。流程的管理移交给日常团队，通常会采取某种类型的控制来确保持续成功。

sentences.source: Processes are turned over to daily teams.
sentences.translation: 流程移交给日常团队。

sentences.source: Management of the process is turned over to daily teams, often with some type of control in place to ensure continued success.
sentences.translation: 流程的管理移交给日常团队，通常会采取某种类型的控制来确保持续成功。

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: Scrum

sentences.source: Scrum
sentences.translation: Scrum

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: Scrum 是一种专门针对技术部门敏捷编程工作的项目开发方法。当团队想要在短时间内创建新技术产品或将新开发集成到现有产品上时，可以使用 Scrum。通常，Scrum 项目持续两到四个星期，这对于编程项目来说传统上是一个非常紧张的时间表。 Scrum 的诞生是因为编程和开发团队需要一种方法来满足其他部门的持续技术设计和改进需求，而无需大幅增加编程、测试员工时间或雇用更多技术人员。 Scrum 还可用于加快软件和应用程序产品的生产或上市速度。

sentences.source: Scrum is a project development method specific to Agile programming endeavors in technical departments.
sentences.translation: Scrum 是一种专门针对技术部门敏捷编程工作的项目开发方法。

sentences.source: Scrum is used when teams want to create new technical products or integrate new developments on existing products within a short time frame.
sentences.translation: 当团队想要在短时间内创建新技术产品或将新开发集成到现有产品上时，可以使用 Scrum。

sentences.source: Commonly, Scrum projects last between two and four weeks, which is traditionally a very tight timeline for programming projects.
sentences.translation: 通常，Scrum 项目持续两到四个星期，这对于编程项目来说传统上是一个非常紧张的时间表。

sentences.source: Scrum was developed as programming and development teams needed a way to meet continuous technical design and improvement needs from other departments without substantially increasing programming, testing employee hours, or hiring more technical staff.
sentences.translation: Scrum 的诞生是因为编程和开发团队需要一种方法来满足其他部门的持续技术设计和改进需求，而无需大幅增加编程、测试员工时间或雇用更多技术人员。

sentences.source: Scrum can also be used to drive faster times to production or market for software and application products.
sentences.translation: Scrum 还可用于加快软件和应用程序产品的生产或上市速度。

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: Scrum 是与本书中讨论的其他流程改进计划相关的概念，因为当今的许多项目都需要某种类型的技术资源或变更。当项目团队致力于验证和衡量时，技术部门通常会同时部署 Scrum 概念，以满足截止日期前改进项目的开发需求。

sentences.source: Scrum is a related concept to other process improvement initiatives discussed in the book because many projects today call for some type of technical resource or change.
sentences.translation: Scrum 是与本书中讨论的其他流程改进计划相关的概念，因为当今的许多项目都需要某种类型的技术资源或变更。

sentences.source: While project teams are working to validate and measure, technical departments often simultaneously deploy Scrum concepts to meet development needs for the improvement project by deadline.
sentences.translation: 当项目团队致力于验证和衡量时，技术部门通常会同时部署 Scrum 概念，以满足截止日期前改进项目的开发需求。

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: Scrum 项目分为三个主要阶段：

sentences.source: Scrum projects feature three main phases:
sentences.translation: Scrum 项目分为三个主要阶段：

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 赛前。开发团队分析可用数据和业务需求。他们利用这些信息来提出新产品或升级的概念。通常，这涉及将业务和流程概念转化为计算机和技术概念。

sentences.source: The pregame.
sentences.translation: 赛前。

sentences.source: Development teams analyze available data and business requirements.
sentences.translation: 开发团队分析可用数据和业务需求。

sentences.source: They use this information to come up with the concept for the new product or upgrade.
sentences.translation: 他们利用这些信息来提出新产品或升级的概念。

sentences.source: Often, this involves translating business and process concepts into computer and technical concepts.
sentences.translation: 通常，这涉及将业务和流程概念转化为计算机和技术概念。

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 游戏。团队开始通过编程冲刺来开发产品。冲刺是按顺序完成的较小的开发阶段，通常在进入下一个冲刺之前对工作进行审查和验证。通过在开发过程中验证工作，团队能够更快地创建工作产品。

sentences.source: The game.
sentences.translation: 游戏。

sentences.source: Teams begin to develop the product via programming sprints.
sentences.translation: 团队开始通过编程冲刺来开发产品。

sentences.source: Sprints are smaller phases of development that are completed in sequence, usually with a review and validation of the work before moving on to the next sprint.
sentences.translation: 冲刺是按顺序完成的较小的开发阶段，通常在进入下一个冲刺之前对工作进行审查和验证。

sentences.source: By validating work during development, teams are able to create working products faster.
sentences.translation: 通过在开发过程中验证工作，团队能够更快地创建工作产品。

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 赛后。即使在开发过程中进行验证，团队仍然必须遵循质量保证、测试和变更管理程序。产品发布的质量准备工作在最后阶段进行。

sentences.source: The postgame.
sentences.translation: 赛后。

sentences.source: Even though validation occurs during development, teams still have to follow quality assurance, testing, and change management procedures.
sentences.translation: 即使在开发过程中进行验证，团队仍然必须遵循质量保证、测试和变更管理程序。

sentences.source: Quality preparation for product release is handled in the final phase.
sentences.translation: 产品发布的质量准备工作在最后阶段进行。

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 客户体验管理方法（CEM）

sentences.source: The Customer Experience Management Method (CEM)
sentences.translation: 客户体验管理方法（CEM）

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: 与 Rummler-Brache 一样，客户体验管理方法（CEM 方法）是由流程改进顾问创建的，旨在满足制造以外的组织的需求。 CEM 将一些流程改进工具与客户关系管理结合起来。它由维珍集团于 20 世纪 90 年代开发，并在整个 90 年代和 21 世纪初期流行起来。

sentences.source: Like Rummler-Brache, the Customer Experience Management Method, or CEM Method, was created by process improvement consultants to address needs in organizations outside of manufacturing.
sentences.translation: 与 Rummler-Brache 一样，客户体验管理方法（CEM 方法）是由流程改进顾问创建的，旨在满足制造以外的组织的需求。

sentences.source: CEM combines some process improvement tools with customer relations management.
sentences.translation: CEM 将一些流程改进工具与客户关系管理结合起来。

sentences.source: It was developed in the 1990s by the Virgin Group and became popular throughout the 90s and early part of the 21st century.
sentences.translation: 它由维珍集团于 20 世纪 90 年代开发，并在整个 90 年代和 21 世纪初期流行起来。

ch03-s02-other-formal-quality-or-process.translation: CEM 方法采用由外向内的方法来改进流程，重点关注客户想要什么或需要什么以及组织中的每个流程如何满足该需求。 CEM 的主要目的是使整个组织的流程与客户满意度目标保持一致。 因此，即使与客户没有直接关系的流程也是根据客户来定义的。

sentences.source: The CEM Method takes an outside-in approach to process improvement, focusing on what the customer wants or needs and how each process in an organization serves that need.
sentences.translation: CEM 方法采用由外向内的方法来改进流程，重点关注客户想要什么或需要什么以及组织中的每个流程如何满足该需求。
