sentences.translation: 该过程本身是获取输入并将其输出的一系列步骤。

ch07-s04-defining-process-components-the.translation: SIPOC 图的好处

sentences.source: Benefits of a SIPOC Diagram
sentences.translation: SIPOC 图的好处

ch07-s04-defining-process-components-the.translation: SIPOC 图是理解流程组件和流程相关性最常用的工具之一，因为它非常有效且简单。团队可以在一次头脑风暴会议中创建 SIPOC 图，但有效的图表通常需要流程所有者和一个或多个日常熟悉该流程的 SME 在场。

sentences.source: The SIPOC diagram is one of the most often used tools for understanding process components and process relevance because it is so effective and simple.
sentences.translation: SIPOC 图是理解流程组件和流程相关性最常用的工具之一，因为它非常有效且简单。

sentences.source: Teams can create SIPOC diagrams in a single brainstorming session, though effective diagramming usually requires the presence of a process owner and one or more SMEs who are familiar with the process on a daily level.
sentences.translation: 团队可以在一次头脑风暴会议中创建 SIPOC 图，但有效的图表通常需要流程所有者和一个或多个日常熟悉该流程的 SME 在场。

ch07-s04-defining-process-components-the.translation: SIPOC 图还可以无限扩展。团队可以在非常精细的层面上绘制流程图，但他们也可以使用 SIPOC 绘制整个业务图。我们将逐步创建 SIPOC 图，然后提供一些不同级别的 SIPOC 示例来说明可扩展性。

sentences.source: SIPOC diagrams are also infinitely scalable.
sentences.translation: SIPOC 图还可以无限扩展。

sentences.source: Teams can diagram processes at a very minute level, but they can also use SIPOC to diagram an entire business.
sentences.translation: 团队可以在非常精细的层面上绘制流程图，但他们也可以使用 SIPOC 绘制整个业务图。

sentences.source: We’ll walk through creating a SIPOC diagram and then provide some examples of SIPOCs at various levels to illustrate scalability.
sentences.translation: 我们将逐步创建 SIPOC 图，然后提供一些不同级别的 SIPOC 示例来说明可扩展性。

ch07-s04-defining-process-components-the.translation: 创建 SIPOC 图

sentences.source: Creating a SIPOC Diagram
sentences.translation: 创建 SIPOC 图

ch07-s04-defining-process-components-the.translation: 您可以创建 SIPOC 图作为个人练习或在团队环境中。 SIPOC 可以使用计算机和软件工具（例如 Word 或 Excel）创建，但您也可以在白板或纸上徒手绘制它们。手绘图表是一种有价值的头脑风暴工具，因为团队可以在讨论流程时快速编辑图表的草稿。请记住这一点：本书中提供的许多图表看起来很干净，因为它们已经被输入和编辑过。 当您绘制自己的流程时，它们一开始可能会因编辑、箭头、草稿和插入而显得混乱。 “编辑”或在头脑风暴过程中制定规则可能会限制在此过程中流动的想法和信息。完成头脑风暴后，您始终可以创建图表的干净副本以供演示之用。

sentences.source: You can create a SIPOC diagram as an individual exercise or within a team environment.
sentences.translation: 您可以创建 SIPOC 图作为个人练习或在团队环境中。

sentences.source: SIPOCs can be created using a computer and software tool such as Word or Excel, but you can also draw them freehand on a whiteboard or piece of paper.
sentences.translation: SIPOC 可以使用计算机和软件工具（例如 Word 或 Excel）创建，但您也可以在白板或纸上徒手绘制它们。

sentences.source: Freehand diagramming is a valuable brainstorming tool because teams can quickly edit the rough draft of the diagram as they discuss a process.
sentences.translation: 手绘图表是一种有价值的头脑风暴工具，因为团队可以在讨论流程时快速编辑图表的草稿。

sentences.source: Keep this in mind :many of the diagrams presented in this book look clean because they have already been typed and edited.
sentences.translation: 请记住这一点：本书中提供的许多图表看起来很干净，因为它们已经被输入和编辑过。

sentences.source: As you diagram your own processes, they can tend to look messy at first with edits, arrows, scratch outs, and inserts. “Editing” or putting rules on the brainstorming process can limit the ideas and information that flow during the process.
sentences.translation: 当您绘制自己的流程时，它们一开始可能会因编辑、箭头、草稿和插入而显得混乱。

sentences.source: You can always create a clean copy of the diagram for presentation purposes when you are finished brainstorming.
sentences.translation: 完成头脑风暴后，您始终可以创建图表的干净副本以供演示之用。

ch07-s04-defining-process-components-the.translation: 步骤 1：创建泳道 SIPOC 图基于泳道。泳道可让您展示跨职能活动和资源如何与您的流程相关。 SIPOC 图有五个通道：供应商、输入、流程、输出和客户各一个。您最终会得到如下图所示的结果。

sentences.source: Step 1: Create Swim Lanes A SIPOC diagram is based on swim lanes.
sentences.translation: 步骤 1：创建泳道 SIPOC 图基于泳道。

sentences.source: Swim lanes let you show how cross-functional activities and resources relate to your process.
sentences.translation: 泳道可让您展示跨职能活动和资源如何与您的流程相关。

sentences.source: A SIPOC diagram gets five lanes: one each for Suppliers, Inputs, Process, Outputs, and Customers.
sentences.translation: SIPOC 图有五个通道：供应商、输入、流程、输出和客户各一个。

sentences.source: You’ll end up with something that looks like the figure below.
sentences.translation: 您最终会得到如下图所示的结果。

ch07-s04-defining-process-components-the.translation: 步骤 2：设置边界并命名您的流程 在开始 SIPOC 会议之前，为您的流程或责任的开始和结束位置设置定义。如果您不了解流程的范围，那么您的 SIPOC 会议可能会失控或生成对您的项目无用的图表。

sentences.source: Step 2: Set Boundaries and Name Your Process Before beginning a SIPOC session, set a definition for where your process or responsibility begins and ends.
sentences.translation: 步骤 2：设置边界并命名您的流程 在开始 SIPOC 会议之前，为您的流程或责任的开始和结束位置设置定义。

sentences.source: If you don’t understand the scope of your process, then your SIPOC session can get out of hand or produce a diagram that isn’t useful for your project.
sentences.translation: 如果您不了解流程的范围，那么您的 SIPOC 会议可能会失控或生成对您的项目无用的图表。

ch07-s04-defining-process-components-the.translation: 为流程命名有助于团队更轻松地识别业务的特定方面。例如，致力于改进医疗办公室内流程的团队可能会考虑名为“收集新患者信息”的流程。通过命名该流程，团队设置了一些范围限制：团队将讨论与从患者那里收集信息相关的事情。范围进一步限于工作人员从新患者收集信息的过程。

sentences.source: Naming your process helps the team identify more readily with a specific aspect of the business.
sentences.translation: 为流程命名有助于团队更轻松地识别业务的特定方面。

sentences.source: For example, a team working to improve processes within a medical office might look at a process named “Gathering New Patient Information.” By naming the process, the team has put some scope limitations in place: the team will talk about things related to gathering information from patients.
sentences.translation: 例如，致力于改进医疗办公室内流程的团队可能会考虑名为“收集新患者信息”的流程。

sentences.source: The scope is further limited to the process by which staff gathers information from new patients.
sentences.translation: 范围进一步限于工作人员从新患者收集信息的过程。

ch07-s04-defining-process-components-the.translation: 当您完成 SIPOC 图表练习时，您可以回顾您定义的名称和范围，以使团队能够专注于讨论任务。

sentences.source: As you work through the SIPOC diagramming exercise, you can point back to the name and the scope you’ve defined to keep the team on task with the discussion.
sentences.translation: 当您完成 SIPOC 图表练习时，您可以回顾您定义的名称和范围，以使团队能够专注于讨论任务。

ch07-s04-defining-process-components-the.translation: 步骤 3：完成泳道 您可以按任何顺序完成 SIPOC 泳道，但最佳实践通常让团队按以下顺序输入数据：

sentences.source: Step 3: Complete Swim Lanes You can complete SIPOC swim lanes in any order, but best practices usually have teams enter data in the following order:
sentences.translation: 步骤 3：完成泳道 您可以按任何顺序完成 SIPOC 泳道，但最佳实践通常让团队按以下顺序输入数据：

ch07-s04-defining-process-components-the.translation: 工艺流程

sentences.source: Process
sentences.translation: 工艺流程

ch07-s04-defining-process-components-the.translation: 输出

sentences.source: Outputs
sentences.translation: 输出

ch07-s04-defining-process-components-the.translation: 客户

sentences.source: Customer
sentences.translation: 客户

ch07-s04-defining-process-components-the.translation: 输入

sentences.source: Inputs
sentences.translation: 输入

ch07-s04-defining-process-components-the.translation: 供应商

sentences.source: Suppliers
sentences.translation: 供应商

ch07-s04-defining-process-components-the.translation: 实际上，团队会在整个流程中思考问题，因此您将反复返回泳道以移动信息并添加新信息。

sentences.source: Realistically, teams will think of things as they work through the process, so you’ll be returning to swim lanes repeatedly to move information around and add new information.
sentences.translation: 实际上，团队会在整个流程中思考问题，因此您将反复返回泳道以移动信息并添加新信息。

ch07-s04-defining-process-components-the.translation: SIPOC 通常不是实际流程的低级或详细地图，因此在完成流程泳道时让团队保持高水平。您可以简单地在该部分中输入流程的名称，也可以列出该流程所需的一些高级步骤。 如果团队不确定输出和输入，列出步骤是一个很好的练习——开始可视化流程通常有助于了解该流程如何与公司其他流程和资源连接。

sentences.source: A SIPOC isn’t usually a low-level or detailed map of the actual process, so keep teams high-level when completing the process swim lane.
sentences.translation: SIPOC 通常不是实际流程的低级或详细地图，因此在完成流程泳道时让团队保持高水平。

sentences.source: You can simply enter the name of the process in that section, or you can list some of the high level steps required for the process.
sentences.translation: 您可以简单地在该部分中输入流程的名称，也可以列出该流程所需的一些高级步骤。

sentences.source: Listing steps is a good exercise if teams aren’t sure about outputs and inputs – beginning to visualize the process usually helps ideas flow about how the process is connected to other processes and resources in the company.
sentences.translation: 如果团队不确定输出和输入，列出步骤是一个很好的练习——开始可视化流程通常有助于了解该流程如何与公司其他流程和资源连接。

ch07-s04-defining-process-components-the.translation: 为了防止会议变成详细的流程图活动，请要求团队用少于五到七个步骤来描述该流程。通过将流程步骤限制为简短的动词-名词组合（例如“输入信息”、“收钱”或“放置标签”）来使事情变得简单。

sentences.source: To keep the session from turning into a detailed process mapping activity, ask the team to describe the process in less than five to seven steps.
sentences.translation: 为了防止会议变成详细的流程图活动，请要求团队用少于五到七个步骤来描述该流程。

sentences.source: Keep things simple by limiting process steps to short verb-noun combos such as “Enter information,” “Collect money,” or “Place labels.”
sentences.translation: 通过将流程步骤限制为简短的动词-名词组合（例如“输入信息”、“收钱”或“放置标签”）来使事情变得简单。

ch07-s04-defining-process-components-the.translation: 名称输出和客户

sentences.source: Name Outputs and Customers
sentences.translation: 名称输出和客户

ch07-s04-defining-process-components-the.translation: 一旦有了基本的流程定义，就从输入或输出开始。询问团队“这个过程会产生什么？这个过程会产生什么结果？”这些答案进入输出泳道。

sentences.source: Once you have a rudimentary process definition, begin with either inputs or outputs.
sentences.translation: 一旦有了基本的流程定义，就从输入或输出开始。

sentences.source: Ask the team “What does this process make?
sentences.translation: 询问团队“这个过程会产生什么？

sentences.source: What comes out of this process?” Those answers go into the outputs swim lane.
sentences.translation: ”这些答案进入输出泳道。

ch07-s04-defining-process-components-the.translation: 接下来，询问团队“谁或什么使用了此过程中产生的东西？”将这些答案放在客户泳道中。请记住，客户可以是外部的，也可以是内部的，在自动化的情况下，另一个流程可以是客户。

sentences.source: Next, ask the team “Who or what uses the things that come from this process?” Place those answers in the customer swim lane.
sentences.translation: 接下来，询问团队“谁或什么使用了此过程中产生的东西？

sentences.source: Remember that customers can be external or internal, and another process can be the customer in cases of automation.
sentences.translation: 请记住，客户可以是外部的，也可以是内部的，在自动化的情况下，另一个流程可以是客户。

ch07-s04-defining-process-components-the.translation: 名称输入和供应商

sentences.source: Name Inputs and Suppliers
sentences.translation: 名称输入和供应商

ch07-s04-defining-process-components-the.translation: 询问团队“该流程需要执行什么？该流程需要哪些原材料或材料？”将这些答案记录在输入部分。

sentences.source: Ask the team “What does the process need to perform?
sentences.translation: 询问团队“该流程需要执行什么？

sentences.source: What raw goods or materials feed the process?” Record those answers in the inputs section.
sentences.translation: 该流程需要哪些原材料或材料？

ch07-s04-defining-process-components-the.translation: 如果您愿意，您可以将输入的想法分为两种类型。首先，你有实际的输入——通过创建输出的过程转换的商品和服务。其次，你有这个过程的推动者。从技术上讲，这些不是输入，因为它们不进入流程，也不会被流程更改；相反，它们是流程正常运行所必需的。机械是推动者。在从钢板上切割金属零件的过程中，进行切割的机器是一个推动者。虽然这不是必需的，但在 SIPOC 上分离推动因素可以帮助您定义流程并为项目后期提供附加信息。

sentences.source: You can divide the idea of inputs into two types, if you like.
sentences.translation: 如果您愿意，您可以将输入的想法分为两种类型。

sentences.source: First, you have the actual inputs – the goods and services that are transformed by the process to create the outputs.
sentences.translation: 首先，你有实际的输入——通过创建输出的过程转换的商品和服务。

sentences.source: Second, you have enablers of the process.
sentences.translation: 其次，你有这个过程的推动者。

sentences.source: These aren’t technically inputs because they don’t enter the process and aren’t changed by the process;
sentences.translation: 从技术上讲，这些不是输入，因为它们不进入流程，也不会被流程更改；

sentences.source: instead, they are required for the process to function.
sentences.translation: 相反，它们是流程正常运行所必需的。

sentences.source: Machinery is an enabler.
sentences.translation: 机械是推动者。

sentences.source: In a process that cuts metal parts from a steel sheet, the machine that does the cutting is an enabler.
sentences.translation: 在从钢板上切割金属零件的过程中，进行切割的机器是一个推动者。

sentences.source: While it’s not required, separating enablers on your SIPOC helps you define the process and provides additional information for later in the project.
sentences.translation: 虽然这不是必需的，但在 SIPOC 上分离推动因素可以帮助您定义流程并为项目后期提供附加信息。

ch07-s04-defining-process-components-the.translation: 获得输入列表后，询问团队：“输入从哪里来？谁或什么为流程提供这些东西？”与客户一样，供应商可以是外部的，也可以是内部的。供应商可能会在工厂提供用于制作糖果的原糖；营销部门可能会提供销售部门用来创建订单的线索。

sentences.source: Once you have a list of inputs, ask the team, “Where do the inputs come from?
sentences.translation: 获得输入列表后，询问团队：“输入从哪里来？

sentences.source: Who or what supplies the process with these things?” As with customers, suppliers can be external or internal.
sentences.translation: ”与客户一样，供应商可以是外部的，也可以是内部的。

sentences.source: A vendor might provide the raw sugar that goes into the candy in a factory;
sentences.translation: 供应商可能会在工厂提供用于制作糖果的原糖；

sentences.source: the marketing department might provide the leads that the sales department uses to create orders.
sentences.translation: 营销部门可能会提供销售部门用来创建订单的线索。

ch07-s04-defining-process-components-the.translation: 供应商也可以是其他流程，特别是在自动化环境中，并且您可以在原始 SIPOC 图中输入一个包含多个供应商的列表。 例如，支持票进入信息技术 (IT) 部门。票证的提供者既可以是提交票证的最终用户，也可以是将票证路由到适当的工作队列的自动化流程。如果您正在记录促成因素，则可以将最终用户记录为供应商，将自动化流程记录为促成因素。

sentences.source: Suppliers can also be other processes, particularly in an automated environment, and you can have a list of several suppliers for one input in a raw SIPOC diagram.
sentences.translation: 供应商也可以是其他流程，特别是在自动化环境中，并且您可以在原始 SIPOC 图中输入一个包含多个供应商的列表。

sentences.source: For example, support tickets come into the Information Technology (IT) department.
sentences.translation: 例如，支持票进入信息技术 (IT) 部门。

sentences.source: The supplier of the ticket could be both the end-user submitting the ticket and the automated process that routes the ticket to the appropriate work queue.
sentences.translation: 票证的提供者既可以是提交票证的最终用户，也可以是将票证路由到适当的工作队列的自动化流程。

sentences.source: If you are documenting enablers, you might record the end-user as the supplier and the automated process as the enabler.
sentences.translation: 如果您正在记录促成因素，则可以将最终用户记录为供应商，将自动化流程记录为促成因素。

ch07-s04-defining-process-components-the.translation: 步骤 4：验证信息 通过验证图表，确保您对高层次流程的理解是准确的。如果您组建了一个包含中小企业的综合团队，该团队可以自行验证大部分信息。不过，对于团队不确定的任何事情寻求第二意见总是一个好主意。邀请其他 SME 或流程负责人与团队一起简要查看图表并提供反馈。

sentences.source: Step 4: Validate the Information Ensure that your understanding of the process at this high level is accurate by validating your diagram.
sentences.translation: 步骤 4：验证信息 通过验证图表，确保您对高层次流程的理解是准确的。

sentences.source: If you’ve put together a comprehensive team that includes SMEs, the team can validate most of the information on its own.
sentences.translation: 如果您组建了一个包含中小企业的综合团队，该团队可以自行验证大部分信息。

sentences.source: It’s always a good idea to get a second opinion on anything the team isn’t sure about, though.
sentences.translation: 不过，对于团队不确定的任何事情寻求第二意见总是一个好主意。

sentences.source: Invite other SMEs or the process owner to review the diagram briefly with the team and provide feedback.
sentences.translation: 邀请其他 SME 或流程负责人与团队一起简要查看图表并提供反馈。

ch07-s05-tips-for-a-sipoc-brainstorming-.translation: 在团队会议期间创建初始 SIPOC 图的最佳方法之一是在大纸或白板上。通过在白板上绘制泳道或在墙上为每个泳道挂一张纸来创建泳道。为团队提供便利贴和记号笔；在便利贴上书写，而不是直接在黑板或纸上书写。这使您可以在处理图表时快速移动组件。

sentences.source: One of the best ways to create an initial SIPOC diagram during a team session is on large pieces of paper or a whiteboard.
sentences.translation: 在团队会议期间创建初始 SIPOC 图的最佳方法之一是在大纸或白板上。

sentences.source: Create swim lanes by drawing them on the whiteboard or hanging a piece of paper for each swim lane on the wall.
sentences.translation: 通过在白板上绘制泳道或在墙上为每个泳道挂一张纸来创建泳道。

sentences.source: Provide the team with sticky notes and markers;
sentences.translation: 为团队提供便利贴和记号笔；

sentences.source: write on sticky notes instead of writing directly on the board or paper.
sentences.translation: 在便利贴上书写，而不是直接在黑板或纸上书写。

sentences.source: This lets you move components around quickly as you work through the diagram.
sentences.translation: 这使您可以在处理图表时快速移动组件。

ch07-s06-sample-sipoc-diagrams-en-001.translation: 以下是一些 SIPOC 图示例。第一个图位于最高级别：流程就是业务本身。第二张图展示了一个自动化流程。第三张图说明了以人为本的工厂流程并包括推动因素。

sentences.source: Here are some sample SIPOC diagrams.
sentences.translation: 以下是一些 SIPOC 图示例。

sentences.source: The first diagram is at the highest level: the process is the business itself.
sentences.translation: 第一个图位于最高级别：流程就是业务本身。

sentences.source: The second diagram features an automated process.
sentences.translation: 第二张图展示了一个自动化流程。

sentences.source: The third diagram illustrates a people-powered factory process and includes enablers.
sentences.translation: 第三张图说明了以人为本的工厂流程并包括推动因素。

sentences.source: Business-Level SIPOC Diagram
sentences.translation: 业务级 SIPOC 图

ch07-s06-sample-sipoc-diagrams-en-003.translation: 该图显示了一家中型印刷公司的 SIPOC。这是一个非常高级、简化的 SIPOC，显示客户和供应商如何提供信息和项目；然后，印刷公司将这些投入转化为印刷名片等产品。最终产品将交付给下订单的个人、企业和营销专业人士。

sentences.source: This diagram shows the SIPOC for a mid-sized printing company.
sentences.translation: 该图显示了一家中型印刷公司的 SIPOC。

sentences.source: It’s a very high-level, simplified SIPOC that shows how customers and vendors provide information and items;
sentences.translation: 这是一个非常高级、简化的 SIPOC，显示客户和供应商如何提供信息和项目；

sentences.source: the printing company then turns those inputs into products such as printed business cards.
sentences.translation: 然后，印刷公司将这些投入转化为印刷名片等产品。

sentences.source: The final product goes to individuals, businesses, and marketing professionals who placed the order.
sentences.translation: 最终产品将交付给下订单的个人、企业和营销专业人士。

ch07-s06-sample-sipoc-diagrams-en-005.translation: 大多数时候，六西格玛团队不会处理业务级的SIPOC图。但是，如果团队包括来自部门或公司外部的成员，例如协助改进的供应商或顾问，那么从高级图表开始可以帮助业务外部的人员了解公司的总体目标。

sentences.source: Most of the time, a Six Sigma team won’t deal with a business-level SIPOC diagram.
sentences.translation: 大多数时候，六西格玛团队不会处理业务级的SIPOC图。

sentences.source: However, if the team includes members from outside the division or company, such as vendors or consultants assisting with an improvement, then starting with a high-level diagram can help those outside of the business understand the overall goals of the company.
sentences.translation: 但是，如果团队包括来自部门或公司外部的成员，例如协助改进的供应商或顾问，那么从高级图表开始可以帮助业务外部的人员了解公司的总体目标。

sentences.source: SIPOC of an Automated Process
sentences.translation: 自动化流程的 SIPOC

ch07-s06-sample-sipoc-diagrams-en-007.translation: 下图展示了邮购药房的自动化流程。该过程将标签贴在要填充相应药物的瓶子上。该过程的范围只是瓶子的标签。

sentences.source: The diagram below represents an automated process in a mail-order pharmacy.
sentences.translation: 下图展示了邮购药房的自动化流程。

sentences.source: The process in question puts labels on bottles that are to be filled with corresponding medications.
sentences.translation: 该过程将标签贴在要填充相应药物的瓶子上。

sentences.source: The scope of the process is only the labeling of the bottles.
sentences.translation: 该过程的范围只是瓶子的标签。

ch07-s06-sample-sipoc-diagrams-en-010.translation: 因为这是自动化流程链中的一个流程，所以几乎所有组件都是机器、流程和事物。在贴标之前，机器会按尺寸对瓶子进行分类。该机器根据需要向贴标站供料。贴标完成后，另一个站将灌装瓶子。

sentences.source: Because this is a process within a chain of automated processes, almost all of the components are machines, processes, and things.
sentences.translation: 因为这是自动化流程链中的一个流程，所以几乎所有组件都是机器、流程和事物。

sentences.source: Prior to labeling, a machine sorts bottles by size.
sentences.translation: 在贴标之前，机器会按尺寸对瓶子进行分类。

sentences.source: That machine feeds the labeling station as needed.
sentences.translation: 该机器根据需要向贴标站供料。

sentences.source: After the labeling is done, another station fills the bottles.
sentences.translation: 贴标完成后，另一个站将灌装瓶子。

sentences.source: SIPOC with Enablers Noted
sentences.translation: SIPOC 已指出推动因素

ch07-s06-sample-sipoc-diagrams-en-012.translation: 下面的 SIPOC 图说明了如何为您的流程记录促成因素。所讨论的过程发生在一家制造家具的工厂；在此过程中，一个人在装配线上将腿固定在高脚凳上。出于本说明的目的，支腿连接是完成产品的最后一步，这意味着产品从支腿连接站移动到包装和运输。

sentences.source: The SIPOC diagram below illustrates how enablers might be recorded for your process.
sentences.translation: 下面的 SIPOC 图说明了如何为您的流程记录促成因素。

sentences.source: The process in question takes place in a factory that makes furniture;
sentences.translation: 所讨论的过程发生在一家制造家具的工厂；

sentences.source: in this process, a person attaches legs to a barstool on an assembly line.
sentences.translation: 在此过程中，一个人在装配线上将腿固定在高脚凳上。

sentences.source: For the purposes of this illustration, leg attachment is the last step in the completion of the product, which means the product moves from the leg attachment station to packing and shipping.
sentences.translation: 出于本说明的目的，支腿连接是完成产品的最后一步，这意味着产品从支腿连接站移动到包装和运输。

ch07-s06-sample-sipoc-diagrams-en-015.translation: 如果没有输送机，参与此过程的人员将不得不手动移动物品。将腿添加到凳子上并不是 100% 需要传送带，但它可以使整个过程以更高效的速度进行。可以说，也不需要钻头——可以手动安装螺钉——但这确实可以使工艺以大规模生产所需的速度进行。

sentences.source: Without the conveyor machine, the people in involved in this process would have to move items manually.
sentences.translation: 如果没有输送机，参与此过程的人员将不得不手动移动物品。

sentences.source: The conveyor isn’t 100 percent required for legs to be added to the stool, but it enables the process to move at a more efficient pace.
sentences.translation: 将腿添加到凳子上并不是 100% 需要传送带，但它可以使整个过程以更高效的速度进行。

sentences.source: A case could be made that the drill isn’t required either – screws can be installed manually – but it’s certainly what enables the process to move at a speed required for mass production.
sentences.translation: 可以说，也不需要钻头——可以手动安装螺钉——但这确实可以使工艺以大规模生产所需的速度进行。

ch07-s06-sample-sipoc-diagrams-en-016.translation: 仅仅通过这个简单的流程 SIPOC 图，六西格玛团队就已经知道差异可能隐藏在哪里、流程中的效率驱动因素以及流程与整体业务的关系。

sentences.source: With just this simple SIPOC diagram of a process, a Six Sigma team would already have some idea about where variation could be hiding, what drives efficiencies in the process, and how the process relates to the overall business.
sentences.translation: 仅仅通过这个简单的流程 SIPOC 图，六西格玛团队就已经知道差异可能隐藏在哪里、流程中的效率驱动因素以及流程与整体业务的关系。

ch07-s06-sample-sipoc-diagrams-en-017.translation: 创建您自己的 SIPOC 图

sentences.source: Create Your Own SIPOC Diagram
sentences.translation: 创建您自己的 SIPOC 图

ch07-s06-sample-sipoc-diagrams-en-018.translation: 无论是在团队中工作还是独自工作，选择一个您了解的流程并练习创建自己的图表。选择与您的业务相关的流程或您有经验的业务示例。使用下一页上的模板来帮助您入门。

sentences.source: Whether working in a team or on your own, choose a process you know about and practice creating your own diagram.
sentences.translation: 无论是在团队中工作还是独自工作，选择一个您了解的流程并练习创建自己的图表。

sentences.source: Pick a process associated with your business or a business example you have experience with.
sentences.translation: 选择与您的业务相关的流程或您有经验的业务示例。

sentences.source: Use the templates on the next page to get you started.
sentences.translation: 使用下一页上的模板来帮助您入门。

ch08-s01-quality-en-001.translation: 最简洁的质量定义之一来自国际标准化组织 (ISO)。 ISO 9000 将质量定义为“一组固有特性满足要求的程度。”7

sentences.source: One of the most concise definitions of quality comes from the International Organization for Standardization, or ISO.
sentences.translation: 最简洁的质量定义之一来自国际标准化组织 (ISO)。

sentences.source: ISO 9000 defines quality as the “degree to which a set of inherent characteristics fulfills requirements.”7
sentences.translation: ISO 9000 将质量定义为“一组固有特性满足要求的程度。

ch08-s01-quality-en-002.translation: 同一份文件将需求定义为隐含的、强制性的或陈述的期望或需求，并且 ISO 指出需求可以由不同的兴趣点生成。六西格玛团队应该对所有兴趣点产生的需求感兴趣，但往往最关注的是客户产生的需求。各种类型的要求可能包括：

sentences.source: The same document defines requirements as expectations or needs that are implied, obligatory, or stated, and the ISO notes that requirements can be generated by different interest points.
sentences.translation: 同一份文件将需求定义为隐含的、强制性的或陈述的期望或需求，并且 ISO 指出需求可以由不同的兴趣点生成。

sentences.source: A Six Sigma team should be interested in requirements generated by all interest points, but often focuses most on those generated by the customer.
sentences.translation: 六西格玛团队应该对所有兴趣点产生的需求感兴趣，但往往最关注的是客户产生的需求。

sentences.source: Various types of requirements might include:
sentences.translation: 各种类型的要求可能包括：

ch08-s01-quality-en-003.translation: 客户期望，通常是明示或暗示的值。这意味着客户想要他或她订购的产品。对交付速度的期望可以以客户调查反馈的形式表述。

sentences.source: Customer expectations, which are typically stated or implied values.
sentences.translation: 客户期望，通常是明示或暗示的值。

sentences.source: It’s implied that a customer wants the product he or she ordered.
sentences.translation: 这意味着客户想要他或她订购的产品。

sentences.source: Expectations of delivery speed might be stated in the form of feedback in customer surveys.
sentences.translation: 对交付速度的期望可以以客户调查反馈的形式表述。

ch08-s01-quality-en-004.translation: 合规性或监管规则是强制性的。例如，银行必须保护信用卡信息——它们有义务遵守政府规则和行业支付卡信息数据安全标准 (PCI-DSS)。同样，医疗保健组织必须保护患者数据的机密性和安全性；根据《健康保险流通与责任法案》(HIPAA)，他们有义务这样做。

sentences.source: Compliance or regulatory rules, which are obligatory.
sentences.translation: 合规性或监管规则是强制性的。

sentences.source: For example, banks must protect credit card information—they are obligated by rules from government and the industry’s Payment Card Information Data Security Standards (PCI-DSS).
sentences.translation: 例如，银行必须保护信用卡信息——它们有义务遵守政府规则和行业支付卡信息数据安全标准 (PCI-DSS)。

sentences.source: Similarly, healthcare organizations must protect the confidentiality and security of patient data;
sentences.translation: 同样，医疗保健组织必须保护患者数据的机密性和安全性；

sentences.source: they are obligated to do so under the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA).
sentences.translation: 根据《健康保险流通与责任法案》(HIPAA)，他们有义务这样做。

ch08-s01-quality-en-005.translation: 品牌期望来自内部领导层。通常会说明品牌期望；虽然在监管支持的意义上不是强制性的，但对于高品质、特定的声音或其他独特因素是品牌塑造组成部分的公司来说，品牌期望可能会被视为强制性的。例如，可口可乐拥有一个全球知名的品牌。虽然该品牌的组成部分，例如徽标或汽水罐的设计，不受法规强制，也可能不是客户所要求的，但可口可乐本身认为这些组成部分很重要，并在其中投入资源和精力，因为它重视自己的品牌。

sentences.source: Brand expectations, which come from in-house leadership.
sentences.translation: 品牌期望来自内部领导层。

sentences.source: Brand expectations are typically stated;
sentences.translation: 通常会说明品牌期望；

sentences.source: while not obligatory in the sense of being backed by regulation, companies for which high-quality, a specific voice, or other unique factor is a component of branding might treat brand expectations as obligatory.
sentences.translation: 虽然在监管支持的意义上不是强制性的，但对于高品质、特定的声音或其他独特因素是品牌塑造组成部分的公司来说，品牌期望可能会被视为强制性的。

sentences.source: Coca-Cola, for example, has a brand that is recognizable around the globe.
sentences.translation: 例如，可口可乐拥有一个全球知名的品牌。

sentences.source: While components of that brand, such as the design of logos or soda cans, aren’t mandated by regulations and might not be required by customers, Coca-Cola itself holds these components as important and puts resources and effort into them because it values its brand.
sentences.translation: 虽然该品牌的组成部分，例如徽标或汽水罐的设计，不受法规强制，也可能不是客户所要求的，但可口可乐本身认为这些组成部分很重要，并在其中投入资源和精力，因为它重视自己的品牌。

ch08-s01-quality-en-006.translation: 在本章中，我们将专门研究对流程和流程改进至关重要的质量因素以及与质量相关的总体成本。

sentences.source: In this chapter, we’ll take a look specifically at quality factors critical to processes and process improvement as well as costs associated with quality in general.
sentences.translation: 在本章中，我们将专门研究对流程和流程改进至关重要的质量因素以及与质量相关的总体成本。

ch08-s02-critical-to-quality-characteris.translation: 关键质量特性（CTQ）特性或 CTQ 是组织或过程中质量主要驱动因素或参数。通常，CTQ 是可以衡量的关键特征； 其中所述指标的表现提供了有关客户是否满意的信息。

sentences.source: Critical to quality characteristics, or CTQs, are the factors or parameters that are the major drivers of quality within an organization or process.
sentences.translation: 关键质量特性（CTQ）特性或 CTQ 是组织或过程中质量主要驱动因素或参数。

sentences.source: Usually, CTQs are key characteristics that can be measured;
sentences.translation: 通常，CTQ 是可以衡量的关键特征；

sentences.source: where the performance of said metric provides information about whether or not the customer is going to be satisfied.
sentences.translation: 其中所述指标的表现提供了有关客户是否满意的信息。

ch08-s02-critical-to-quality-characteris.translation: CTQ 与 CTC 密切相关，或者对客户特征至关重要，但它们不是同一件事。有些东西可能是关键质量特性（CTQ）——甚至对客户对服务或产品的最终感受至关重要——但并不直接对客户至关重要。 CTQ 是内部问题，但它们推动 CTC。

sentences.source: CTQs are closely related to CTCs, or critical to customer characteristics, but they are not the same thing.
sentences.translation: CTQ 与 CTC 密切相关，或者对客户特征至关重要，但它们不是同一件事。

sentences.source: Something can be critical to quality – even critical to how a customer ultimately feels about a service or product – without being critical to the customer directly.
sentences.translation: 有些东西可能是关键质量特性（CTQ）——甚至对客户对服务或产品的最终感受至关重要——但并不直接对客户至关重要。

sentences.source: CTQs are internal concerns, but they drive CTCs.
sentences.translation: CTQ 是内部问题，但它们推动 CTC。

ch08-s02-critical-to-quality-characteris.translation: 7 参见 ISO 9000:2015 术语 3.9.11： https://www.iso.org/obp/ui/#iso:std:iso:9000:ed-3:v1:en:term:3.9.11

sentences.source: 7 https://www.iso.org/obp/ui/#iso:std:iso:9000:ed-3:v1:en:term:3.9.11
sentences.translation: 7 参见 ISO 9000:2015 术语 3.9.11： https://www.iso.org/obp/ui/#iso:std:iso:9000:ed-3:v1:en:term:3.9.11

ch08-s02-critical-to-quality-characteris.translation: 让我们看一些 CTQ 和 CTC 的示例，以了解这两个因素之间的区别和关系。

sentences.source: Let’s look at some examples of CTQs and CTCs to understand the difference and the relationship between these two factors.
sentences.translation: 让我们看一些 CTQ 和 CTC 的示例，以了解这两个因素之间的区别和关系。

ch08-s02-critical-to-quality-characteris.translation: 一条裤子

sentences.source: A Pair of Pants
sentences.translation: 一条裤子

ch08-s02-critical-to-quality-characteris.translation: 当顾客购买裤子时，他或她通常关心裤子合身和外观。它们是否舒适、尺寸是否正确、服装是否符合顾客的个人风格？

sentences.source: When a customer purchases a pair of pants, he or she is usually concerned with how the pants fit and look.
sentences.translation: 当顾客购买裤子时，他或她通常关心裤子合身和外观。

sentences.source: Are they comfortable, is the size correct, and does the clothing match the customer’s personal style?
sentences.translation: 它们是否舒适、尺寸是否正确、服装是否符合顾客的个人风格？

ch08-s02-critical-to-quality-characteris.translation: 很难衡量裤子是否舒适，但制造商可以根据客户对各种类型裤子的反馈，了解某种面料和某种剪裁对目标受众来说最舒适。制造商还可以为每种尺寸确定适当的尺寸。在制造过程中，应用了这些对质量至关重要的因素：仅使用符合确定规格的织物。然后将织物裁剪成特定的尺寸并以特定的方式缝制在一起——尺寸和缝制方法是关键质量特性（CTQ）。

sentences.source: It’s hard to create a measurement for whether pants are comfortable, but a manufacturer can take customer feedback on various types of pants and learn that a certain fabric with a certain cut is most comfortable for the target audience.
sentences.translation: 很难衡量裤子是否舒适，但制造商可以根据客户对各种类型裤子的反馈，了解某种面料和某种剪裁对目标受众来说最舒适。

sentences.source: The manufacturer can also determine appropriate measurements for each size.
sentences.translation: 制造商还可以为每种尺寸确定适当的尺寸。

sentences.source: During the manufacturing process, these critical-to-quality factors are applied: only fabric that meets the specifications identified is used.
sentences.translation: 在制造过程中，应用了这些对质量至关重要的因素：仅使用符合确定规格的织物。

sentences.source: The fabric is then cut to specific measurements and sewn together in a specific manner – measurements and sewing methods are critical to quality.
sentences.translation: 然后将织物裁剪成特定的尺寸并以特定的方式缝制在一起——尺寸和缝制方法是关键质量特性（CTQ）。

ch08-s02-critical-to-quality-characteris.translation: 然而，普通顾客并不想了解每块布料的精确尺寸或接缝的缝制方式。他们想要穿上一条裤子并体验舒适合身的感觉。

sentences.source: The average customer, however, doesn’t want to hear about the exact measurements of each fabric piece or the way the seams were sewn.
sentences.translation: 然而，普通顾客并不想了解每块布料的精确尺寸或接缝的缝制方式。

sentences.source: They want to put on a pair of pants and experience a comfortable fit.
sentences.translation: 他们想要穿上一条裤子并体验舒适合身的感觉。

ch08-s02-critical-to-quality-characteris.translation: 巧克力棒

sentences.source: Chocolate Bars
sentences.translation: 巧克力棒

ch08-s02-critical-to-quality-characteris.translation: 一家巧克力公司进行了一项调查，以找出其最新产品的销售未达到预期的原因。反馈表明巧克力太甜了——巧克力的味道和甜度对顾客特征至关重要。

sentences.source: A chocolate company conducts a survey to find out why sales of its newest product haven’t performed as expected.
sentences.translation: 一家巧克力公司进行了一项调查，以找出其最新产品的销售未达到预期的原因。

sentences.source: The feedback suggests that the chocolate is too sweet – the taste and the sweetness of the chocolate is a critical to customer characteristic.
sentences.translation: 反馈表明巧克力太甜了——巧克力的味道和甜度对顾客特征至关重要。

ch08-s02-critical-to-quality-characteris.translation: 该公司可能会调整其配方，减少巧克力中的糖含量。在这种情况下，配方和糖的量是一个关键的质量特性（CTQ）因素。但是，如果客户反馈表明注重健康的消费者根本不想购买含这么多糖的巧克力棒怎么办？那么配方中的糖量就变成了 CTQ 和 CTC。 它对巧克力棒的口味质量至关重要，但顾客也可能会查看巧克力棒上的营养信息，并根据巧克力中的糖含量做出购买决定。

sentences.source: The company might tweak its formula, reducing the amount of sugar that goes into the chocolate.
sentences.translation: 该公司可能会调整其配方，减少巧克力中的糖含量。

sentences.source: The recipe – and the amount of sugar -- is a critical to quality factor in this case.
sentences.translation: 在这种情况下，配方和糖的量是一个关键的质量特性（CTQ）因素。

sentences.source: But what if the customer feedback indicated that health-conscious consumers simply didn’t want to buy a chocolate bar with so much sugar in it?
sentences.translation: 但是，如果客户反馈表明注重健康的消费者根本不想购买含这么多糖的巧克力棒怎么办？

sentences.source: Then the amount of sugar in the recipe becomes both a CTQ and a CTC.
sentences.translation: 那么配方中的糖量就变成了 CTQ 和 CTC。

sentences.source: It is critical to the quality of the taste of the bar, but customers might also look at the nutritional information on the bar and make purchasing decisions based on the amount of sugar in the chocolate.
sentences.translation: 它对巧克力棒的口味质量至关重要，但顾客也可能会查看巧克力棒上的营养信息，并根据巧克力中的糖含量做出购买决定。

ch08-s02-critical-to-quality-characteris.translation: 移动应用程序开发

sentences.source: Mobile App Development
sentences.translation: 移动应用程序开发

ch08-s02-critical-to-quality-characteris.translation: 如果企业想要为其客户推出移动应用程序，那么一个明显的以客户为中心的需求是该应用程序可以在客户的手机上运行。客户并不关心企业在相关平台上启动应用程序所需经历的流程，但企业必须满足 Apple、Android、Windows 或其他移动操作系统的标准。这些要求成为移动应用程序开发的一些 CTQ，尽管平台的某些要求可能看起来与客户关于愿望或需求的陈述完全无关。

sentences.source: If a business wants to launch a mobile app for its customers, then an obvious customer-centric need is that the app works on the customer’s phone.
sentences.translation: 如果企业想要为其客户推出移动应用程序，那么一个明显的以客户为中心的需求是该应用程序可以在客户的手机上运行。

sentences.source: The customer doesn’t care about the process the business needs to go through to launch the app on the platform in question, but the business must meet the criteria for Apple, Android, Windows, or other mobile operating systems.
sentences.translation: 客户并不关心企业在相关平台上启动应用程序所需经历的流程，但企业必须满足 Apple、Android、Windows 或其他移动操作系统的标准。

sentences.source: Those requirements become some of the CTQs for the mobile app development, even though certain requirements from the platforms might not appear to be at all related to statements from customers about desires or needs.
sentences.translation: 这些要求成为移动应用程序开发的一些 CTQ，尽管平台的某些要求可能看起来与客户关于愿望或需求的陈述完全无关。

ch08-s02-critical-to-quality-characteris.translation: 为什么要识别 CTQ？

sentences.source: Why Identify CTQs?
sentences.translation: 为什么要识别 CTQ？

ch08-s02-critical-to-quality-characteris.translation: 在流程改进环境中，CTQ 对于缩小工作范围和了解如何实施变革至关重要。考虑第 5 章中讨论的 80/20 规则。通常，CTQ 是推动 80% 客户满意度的因素、特征或输出。通过改善这几个关键因素，团队可以极大地影响客户满意度和整个流程的绩效。确定 CTQ 可以让团队利用可用的时间、金钱和人力资源实现最大程度的改进。

sentences.source: In a process improvement environment, CTQs are critical to narrowing work scope and understanding how to enact change.
sentences.translation: 在流程改进环境中，CTQ 对于缩小工作范围和了解如何实施变革至关重要。

sentences.source: Consider the 80/20 rule discussed in Chapter 5.
sentences.translation: 考虑第 5 章中讨论的 80/20 规则。

sentences.source: Often, CTQs are the factors, characteristics, or outputs that drive 80 percent of customer satisfaction.
sentences.translation: 通常，CTQ 是推动 80% 客户满意度的因素、特征或输出。

sentences.source: By improving these few critical factors, teams can substantially impact customer satisfaction and the performance of the overall process.
sentences.translation: 通过改善这几个关键因素，团队可以极大地影响客户满意度和整个流程的绩效。

sentences.source: Identifying CTQs lets teams create the most improvement possible with the time, money, and people resources available.
sentences.translation: 确定 CTQ 可以让团队利用可用的时间、金钱和人力资源实现最大程度的改进。

ch08-s02-critical-to-quality-characteris.translation: 在项目环境之外，了解 CTQ 可以让组织保持最佳质量。通过管理一些关键指标，团队可以持续确保出色的产出，并在潜在的改进领域成为客户面临的问题之前识别出来。

sentences.source: Outside of a project environment, understanding CTQs lets organizations stay on top of quality.
sentences.translation: 在项目环境之外，了解 CTQ 可以让组织保持最佳质量。

sentences.source: By managing a few critical metrics, teams can ensure excellent output in a continuous fashion and identify potential areas for improvement before they become customer-facing problems.
sentences.translation: 通过管理一些关键指标，团队可以持续确保出色的产出，并在潜在的改进领域成为客户面临的问题之前识别出来。

ch08-s02-critical-to-quality-characteris.translation: 使用 CTQ 树将客户需求转换为质量指标 在第 5 章中，我们介绍了客户之声（VOC）或 VOC 的概念。 六西格玛团队在定义问题和实现项目目标时通常会从某种类型的 VOC 数据开始。团队要么在项目的前几个阶段进行调查，听取统计上相关的客户群体的意见，要么团队从内部客户那里接收有关流程的反馈。有时，团队开始时使用的 VOC 信息很简单，例如冠军或高管人员对内部流程或项目的期望发表声明。 当 VOC 数据如此有限时，团队可能必须更加努力地用数据验证假设，然后再进行 CTQ 分析。

sentences.source: Using a CTQ Tree to Convert Customer Needs to Quality Metrics In Chapter 5, we introduced the concept of the Voice of the Customer, or VoC.
sentences.translation: 使用 CTQ 树将客户需求转换为质量指标 在第 5 章中，我们介绍了客户之声（VOC）或 VOC 的概念。

sentences.source: Six Sigma teams usually start with some type of VoC data when they are defining a problem and working on goals for a project.
sentences.translation: 六西格玛团队在定义问题和实现项目目标时通常会从某种类型的 VOC 数据开始。

sentences.source: Either the team conducts surveys to hear from a statistically relevant group of customers during the first few phases of a project, or the team receives feedback from internal customers about a process.
sentences.translation: 团队要么在项目的前几个阶段进行调查，听取统计上相关的客户群体的意见，要么团队从内部客户那里接收有关流程的反馈。

sentences.source: Sometimes, the VoC information a team begins with is something as simple as a champion or executive- level individual making a statement about expectations for an internal process or project.
sentences.translation: 有时，团队开始时使用的 VOC 信息很简单，例如冠军或高管人员对内部流程或项目的期望发表声明。

sentences.source: When VoC data is limited in such a fashion, teams might have to work harder to validate assumptions with data before moving on to CTQ analysis.
sentences.translation: 当 VOC 数据如此有限时，团队可能必须更加努力地用数据验证假设，然后再进行 CTQ 分析。

ch08-s02-critical-to-quality-characteris.translation: 为了更好地了解如何衡量流程质量，团队必须将 VOC 声明转换为 CTQ。实现此目的的最佳方法之一是通过称为 CTQ 树的图表过程。

sentences.source: To gain a better understanding of how to measure the quality of a process, teams must convert VoC statements to CTQs.
sentences.translation: 为了更好地了解如何衡量流程质量，团队必须将 VOC 声明转换为 CTQ。

sentences.source: One of the best ways to do this is through a diagramming process known as a CTQ tree.
sentences.translation: 实现此目的的最佳方法之一是通过称为 CTQ 树的图表过程。

ch08-s02-critical-to-quality-characteris.translation: CTQ 树从特定且关键的客户需求开始，将需求分解为驱动因素，并使用驱动因素创建需求。特定要求更容易转换为可衡量的质量组件。虽然每棵 CTQ 树都是独一无二的，但它们都以通用的形式开始。 CTQ树的常见结构如下所示。

sentences.source: A CTQ tree begins with specific and critical customer needs, breaks that need down into drivers, and uses the drivers to create requirements.
sentences.translation: CTQ 树从特定且关键的客户需求开始，将需求分解为驱动因素，并使用驱动因素创建需求。

sentences.source: Specific requirements are easier to convert to measurable quality components.
sentences.translation: 特定要求更容易转换为可衡量的质量组件。

sentences.source: While each CTQ tree is unique, they begin with a common form.
sentences.translation: 虽然每棵 CTQ 树都是独一无二的，但它们都以通用的形式开始。

sentences.source: The common structure of a CTQ tree is shown below.
sentences.translation: CTQ树的常见结构如下所示。

ch08-s02-critical-to-quality-characteris.translation: 创建 CTQ 树时，您不必遵循相同的驱动因素和需求模式。有些客户需求会比其他需求有更多的驱动因素；有些司机会有更多要求。您可能还拥有多个 CTQ 树 - 您需要为您确定的对客户至关重要的每一项需求创建一棵。

sentences.source: When creating a CTQ tree, you don’t have to follow an equal pattern for drivers and requirements.
sentences.translation: 创建 CTQ 树时，您不必遵循相同的驱动因素和需求模式。

sentences.source: Some customer needs will have more drivers than others;
sentences.translation: 有些司机会有更多要求。

sentences.source: some drivers will have more requirements.
sentences.translation: 有些司机会有更多要求。

sentences.source: You might also have multiple CTQ trees – you’ll want to create one for every need you identify that is critical to a customer.
sentences.translation: 您可能还拥有多个 CTQ 树 - 您需要为您确定的对客户至关重要的每一项需求创建一棵。

ch08-s02-critical-to-quality-characteris.translation: 确定客户的关键需求

sentences.source: Identify Critical-to-Customer Needs
sentences.translation: 确定客户的关键需求

ch08-s02-critical-to-quality-characteris.translation: 通过创建对客户至关重要的需求列表来开始 CTQ 树流程。例如，从事在线支票访问流程处理的银行可能会将可访问性、用户友好界面和信息安全性视为对客户至关重要的主要需求。从广义上定义需求，以帮助在稍后的图表过程中捕获所有驱动因素和需求。

sentences.source: Begin the CTQ tree process by creating a list of needs that are critical to the customer.
sentences.translation: 通过创建对客户至关重要的需求列表来开始 CTQ 树流程。

sentences.source: A bank working on processes dealing with online checking access might identify accessibility, user-friendly interfaces, and security of information as the major critical-to-customer needs, for example.
sentences.translation: 例如，从事在线支票访问流程处理的银行可能会将可访问性、用户友好界面和信息安全性视为对客户至关重要的主要需求。

sentences.source: Define needs in broad terms to help catch all drivers and requirements later in the diagramming process.
sentences.translation: 从广义上定义需求，以帮助在稍后的图表过程中捕获所有驱动因素和需求。

ch08-s02-critical-to-quality-characteris.translation: 定义需求的最佳方法是直接询问客户反馈，但时间和资源并不总是允许进行调查。 六西格玛团队也许能够利用通过最近的调查或反馈表收集的数据，这是退而求其次的事情。在没有客户反馈的情况下，与一组了解客户并具有客户经验的员工一起集思广益，讨论关键需求。当客户是最终用户时，来自销售、客户服务和投诉部门的主题专家通常可以提供可行的信息。您还可以使用 SIPOC 图的输出开始构建 CTQ 树；根据您在 SIPOC 上构造输出的方式，您可能需要定义输出的关键质量因数作为 CTQ 树图的起点。

sentences.source: The best way to define needs is to directly ask customers for feedback, but time and resources don’t always allow for surveys.
sentences.translation: 定义需求的最佳方法是直接询问客户反馈，但时间和资源并不总是允许进行调查。

sentences.source: Six Sigma teams might be able to take advantage of data collected via recent surveys or feedback forms, which is the next-best thing.
sentences.translation: 六西格玛团队也许能够利用通过最近的调查或反馈表收集的数据，这是退而求其次的事情。

sentences.source: In the absence of customer feedback, brainstorm critical needs with a group of employees who has knowledge of and experience with the customer.
sentences.translation: 在没有客户反馈的情况下，与一组了解客户并具有客户经验的员工一起集思广益，讨论关键需求。

sentences.source: Subject matter experts from sales, customer service, and complaint departments can often provide viable information when the customer is the end-user.
sentences.translation: 当客户是最终用户时，来自销售、客户服务和投诉部门的主题专家通常可以提供可行的信息。

sentences.source: You can also begin a CTQ tree with the outputs of your SIPOC diagram;
sentences.translation: 您还可以使用 SIPOC 图的输出开始构建 CTQ 树；

sentences.source: depending on how you structured the outputs on a SIPOC, you might need to define critical quality factors for the output as a starting point for your CTQ tree diagram.
sentences.translation: 根据您在 SIPOC 上构造输出的方式，您可能需要定义输出的关键质量因数作为 CTQ 树图的起点。

ch08-s02-critical-to-quality-characteris.translation: 识别质量驱动因素

sentences.source: Identify Drivers of Quality
sentences.translation: 识别质量驱动因素

ch08-s02-critical-to-quality-characteris.translation: 一旦您获得了关键需求列表，请一次处理一个需求，以创建类似于上图的树。 确定满足客户需求必须存在或满足的质量驱动因素。例如，暖通空调服务公司的客户可能需要优质的服务。满足这种需求的驱动因素可能包括友好的服务技术人员、乐于助人且知识渊博的员工以及对服务呼叫的及时响应。

sentences.source: Once you have a list of critical needs, work with one need at a time to create a tree similar to the diagram above.
sentences.translation: 一旦您获得了关键需求列表，请一次处理一个需求，以创建类似于上图的树。

sentences.source: Identify quality drivers that must be present or met for the customer need to be fulfilled.
sentences.translation: 确定满足客户需求必须存在或满足的质量驱动因素。

sentences.source: For example, customers of an HVAC service company might require excellent service.
sentences.translation: 例如，暖通空调服务公司的客户可能需要优质的服务。

sentences.source: Drivers for that need might include friendly service technicians, helpful and knowledgeable employees, and a timely response to service calls.
sentences.translation: 满足这种需求的驱动因素可能包括友好的服务技术人员、乐于助人且知识渊博的员工以及对服务呼叫的及时响应。

ch08-s02-critical-to-quality-characteris.translation: 驱动因素是客户需求和要求之间的过渡点；您不一定必须能够衡量驱动因素，但您希望它们比您已经确定的广泛客户需求更详细一些，并且您希望尽可能朝着可衡量因素的方向发展。

sentences.source: Drivers are the transition point between customer needs and requirements;
sentences.translation: 驱动因素是客户需求和要求之间的过渡点；

sentences.source: you don’t necessarily have to be able to measure drivers, but you want them to be a bit more detailed than the broad customer needs you already identified and you want to be flowing in the direction of measureable factors when possible.
sentences.translation: 您不一定必须能够衡量驱动因素，但您希望它们比您已经确定的广泛客户需求更详细一些，并且您希望尽可能朝着可衡量因素的方向发展。

ch08-s02-critical-to-quality-characteris.translation: 列出每个驱动程序的要求

sentences.source: List Requirements for Each Driver
sentences.translation: 列出每个驱动程序的要求

ch08-s02-critical-to-quality-characteris.translation: 需求是关于关键质量特性（CTQ）特征的最详细的细分。您可以通过这些指标来了解司机的表现是否适当，从而满足客户的需求。

sentences.source: Requirements are the most detailed breakdown regarding critical to quality characteristics.
sentences.translation: 需求是关于关键质量特性（CTQ）特征的最详细的细分。

sentences.source: These are the things that you can measure that lead you to understand whether drivers are performing appropriately so customer needs are met.
sentences.translation: 您可以通过这些指标来了解司机的表现是否适当，从而满足客户的需求。

ch08-s02-critical-to-quality-characteris.translation: 例如，让我们看一下 CTQ 树格式的 HVAC 示例。

sentences.source: For example, let’s look at our HVAC example in a CTQ tree format.
sentences.translation: 例如，让我们看一下 CTQ 树格式的 HVAC 示例。

ch08-s02-critical-to-quality-characteris.translation: 您可以在上面的 CTQ 树中看到驱动程序已转换为需求 - 并且每个需求都可以用数字来衡量。在某些情况下，驱动程序到需求的转换相当于一个硬数字。本章开头的巧克力棒示例描述了这样一个场景：如果公司认为含有四分之一杯糖的配方是正确的配方，那么质量的过程指标恰好是四分之一杯糖。

sentences.source: You can see in the above CTQ tree that drivers have been converted to requirements – and each of those requirements can be measured with numbers.
sentences.translation: 您可以在上面的 CTQ 树中看到驱动程序已转换为需求 - 并且每个需求都可以用数字来衡量。

sentences.source: In some cases, driver-to-requirement conversions equate to a hard number.
sentences.translation: 在某些情况下，驱动程序到需求的转换相当于一个硬数字。

sentences.source: The chocolate bar example at the beginning of this chapter features such a scenario: if the company deems that the recipe with a quarter cup of sugar is the correct recipe, then the process metric for quality is exactly a quarter cup of sugar.
sentences.translation: 本章开头的巧克力棒示例描述了这样一个场景：如果公司认为含有四分之一杯糖的配方是正确的配方，那么质量的过程指标恰好是四分之一杯糖。

ch08-s02-critical-to-quality-characteris.translation: 在其他示例中，公司可能会为例外情况提供余地，或者理解流程不会每次都达到确切的数字。例如，暖通空调团队不可能在接到电话后恰好 24 小时内到达客户家中 - 如果服务技术人员能够早于 24 小时到达，大多数人都会希望他们这样做。这意味着公司必须为需求创建一个定义：多少个小时后客户才会认为技术人员不合时宜？以我们的示例公司为例，该时间为 48 小时。另一种情况下的要求可能是 24 小时。

sentences.source: In other examples, companies might provide leeway for exceptions or the understanding that a process is not going to hit an exact number every single time.
sentences.translation: 在其他示例中，公司可能会为例外情况提供余地，或者理解流程不会每次都达到确切的数字。

sentences.source: For example, an HVAC team cannot possibly arrive at a customer’s home exactly 24 hours after a phone call is made – and if the service technicians can arrive earlier than 24 hours, most people would want them to.
sentences.translation: 例如，暖通空调团队不可能在接到电话后恰好 24 小时内到达客户家中 - 如果服务技术人员能够早于 24 小时到达，大多数人都会希望他们这样做。

sentences.source: That means the company has to create a definition for the requirement: how many hours is it before a customer considers a technician untimely?
sentences.translation: 这意味着公司必须为需求创建一个定义：多少个小时后客户才会认为技术人员不合时宜？

sentences.source: In the case of our example company, it’s 48 hours.
sentences.translation: 以我们的示例公司为例，该时间为 48 小时。

sentences.source: The requirement in another situation might be 24 hours.
sentences.translation: 另一种情况下的要求可能是 24 小时。

ch08-s02-critical-to-quality-characteris.translation: 由于团队将使用 CTQ 树中的需求来开发流程测量和成功指标，因此在团队将每个需求纳入项目或流程之前对其进行审查非常重要。 应将要求与 VOC 数据、现有测量以及主题专家和领导者的经验和知识进行比较。团队应该问自己和其他人“如果满足这些要求，客户会满意吗？”如果答案是否定的，那么需求就需要改进。团队还可以考虑询问“这些要求在现实世界中是否可能”。如果答案是否定的，那么流程或需求都需要工作。

sentences.source: Because teams will use the requirements from the CTQ trees to develop process measurements and metrics for success, it is extremely important that each requirement is vetted before teams incorporate it into the project or process.
sentences.translation: 由于团队将使用 CTQ 树中的需求来开发流程测量和成功指标，因此在团队将每个需求纳入项目或流程之前对其进行审查非常重要。

sentences.source: Requirements should be compared to VoC data, to existing measurements, and to experience and knowledge from subject matter experts and leaders.
sentences.translation: 应将要求与 VOC 数据、现有测量以及主题专家和领导者的经验和知识进行比较。

sentences.source: The team should ask themselves and others “If these requirements are met, will the customer be satisfied?” If the answer is ever no, then the requirements need work.
sentences.translation: 团队应该问自己和其他人“如果满足这些要求，客户会满意吗？

sentences.source: The team might also consider asking “Are these requirements possible in the real world.” If the answer is no, then either the process or the requirements needs work.
sentences.translation: 团队还可以考虑询问“这些要求在现实世界中是否可能”。

ch08-s03-the-coq-and-the-copq-en-001.translation: 六西格玛团队必须时刻意识到，质量是有代价的。在谈论质量成本时，许多组织都会考虑所谓的劣质成本 (CoPQ)。低质量成本被定义为与流程产生的缺陷相关的成本或费用。质量实际上有更广泛的成本——避免低质量也需要付出代价。质量成本 (CoQ) 涵盖与在整个组织或流程中保持良好质量相关的费用。有时，这被称为优质成本。在本节中，我们将讨论这两种类型的成本衡量，它们与六西格玛的总体关系，以及它们与六西格玛团队和项目的关系。

sentences.source: Six Sigma teams must always be aware that quality comes at a cost.
sentences.translation: 六西格玛团队必须时刻意识到，质量是有代价的。

sentences.source: When talking about quality costs, many organizations consider what is known as the cost of poor quality, or CoPQ.
sentences.translation: 在谈论质量成本时，许多组织都会考虑所谓的劣质成本 (CoPQ)。

sentences.source: The cost of poor quality is defined as the costs or expenses associated with defects created by a process.
sentences.translation: 低质量成本被定义为与流程产生的缺陷相关的成本或费用。

sentences.source: Quality actually has a broader cost – avoiding poor quality comes at an expense as well.
sentences.translation: 质量实际上有更广泛的成本——避免低质量也需要付出代价。

sentences.source: The cost of quality, or CoQ, covers the expenses associated with maintaining good quality throughout an organization or process.
sentences.translation: 质量成本 (CoQ) 涵盖与在整个组织或流程中保持良好质量相关的费用。

sentences.source: Sometimes, this is referred to as the cost of good quality.
sentences.translation: 有时，这被称为优质成本。

sentences.source: In this section, we’ll talk about both types of cost measurements, how they relate to Six Sigma in general, and how they relate to Six Sigma teams and projects.
sentences.translation: 在本节中，我们将讨论这两种类型的成本衡量，它们与六西格玛的总体关系，以及它们与六西格玛团队和项目的关系。

sentences.source: The Cost of Poor Quality
sentences.translation: 质量差的成本

ch08-s03-the-coq-and-the-copq-en-003.translation: 在某些方面，低质量的成本比与整体质量相关的成本更容易衡量。 CoPQ 通常分为两大类：与外部故障相关的成本和与内部故障相关的成本。外部和内部故障通常被称为不合格成本——它们是当产出不符合关键质量特性（CTQ）要求时发生的费用。

sentences.source: In some ways, the cost of poor quality is easier to measure than the cost associated with overall quality.
sentences.translation: 在某些方面，低质量的成本比与整体质量相关的成本更容易衡量。

sentences.source: CoPQ is usually broken into two major categories: costs associated with external failures and costs associated with internal failures.
sentences.translation: CoPQ 通常分为两大类：与外部故障相关的成本和与内部故障相关的成本。

sentences.source: External and internal failures are often referred to as the costs of nonconformity – they are the expenses that occur when outputs do not conform to critical to quality requirements.
sentences.translation: 外部和内部故障通常被称为不合格成本——它们是当产出不符合关键质量特性（CTQ）要求时发生的费用。

sentences.source: External Failures
sentences.translation: 外部故障

ch08-s03-the-coq-and-the-copq-en-005.translation: 外部故障通常发生在产品或服务交付后，这意味着它们与客户不满意直接相关。外部故障可能包括因产品、服务、系统或信息质量而导致销售额下降而导致的收入损失。其他类型的外部损失包括与客户投诉相关的维修、退货或返工相关的费用；与保修相关的费用；由于客户恶意或不良口碑而导致收入或销售损失。

sentences.source: External failures usually occur after products or services have been delivered, which means they are directly associated with customer dissatisfaction.
sentences.translation: 外部故障通常发生在产品或服务交付后，这意味着它们与客户不满意直接相关。

sentences.source: External failures might include revenue losses associated with a reduction in sales because of the quality of products, services, systems, or information.
sentences.translation: 外部故障可能包括因产品、服务、系统或信息质量而导致销售额下降而导致的收入损失。

sentences.source: Other types of external losses include expenses associated with repairs, returns, or rework associated with a customer complaint;
sentences.translation: 其他类型的外部损失包括与客户投诉相关的维修、退货或返工相关的费用；

sentences.source: expenses associated with warranties;
sentences.translation: 与保修相关的费用；

sentences.source: or loss of revenue or sales because of customer ill will or bad word-of-mouth.
sentences.translation: 由于客户恶意或不良口碑而导致收入或销售损失。

sentences.source: Internal Failures
sentences.translation: 内部故障

ch08-s03-the-coq-and-the-copq-en-007.translation: 当产品、服务或流程不符合公司设定的要求，并且以不满意的方式向客户提供产品或服务时，就会发生内部故障。内部故障通常通过报废、重做或修复工作来处理。显然，这种返工会增加材料和劳动力成本，但也会导致与延误、零件或库存短缺以及缺乏灵活性或适应能力相关的损失。例如，如果某个流程的质量很差，以至于其生产的产品中有 50% 需要返工，那么该流程的日产量可能会比实际产量少 40%。这意味着该流程可以服务更少的客户，产生更少的产出，并且对公司利润的总体贡献更少。

sentences.source: Internal failures occur when products, services, or processes don’t conform to the requirements set by the company, and the product or service is provided to the customer in an unsatisfactory fashion.
sentences.translation: 当产品、服务或流程不符合公司设定的要求，并且以不满意的方式向客户提供产品或服务时，就会发生内部故障。

sentences.source: Internal failures are usually handled by scrapping the work, redoing the work, or repairing the work.
sentences.translation: 内部故障通常通过报废、重做或修复工作来处理。

sentences.source: Obviously, such rework results in added material and labor costs, but it also results in losses associated with delays, shortages of parts or inventory, and lack of flexibility or the ability to adapt.
sentences.translation: 显然，这种返工会增加材料和劳动力成本，但也会导致与延误、零件或库存短缺以及缺乏灵活性或适应能力相关的损失。

sentences.source: For example, if a process has such poor quality that 50 percent of the items produced by it require rework, then the process might be producing 40 percent less on a daily basis than it could be.
sentences.translation: 例如，如果某个流程的质量很差，以至于其生产的产品中有 50% 需要返工，那么该流程的日产量可能会比实际产量少 40%。

sentences.source: That means the process can serve fewer customers, generate less output, and contribute less overall to the company’s profit.
sentences.translation: 这意味着该流程可以服务更少的客户，产生更少的产出，并且对公司利润的总体贡献更少。

sentences.source: Calculating the Cost of Poor Quality
sentences.translation: 计算低质量的成本

ch08-s03-the-coq-and-the-copq-en-009.translation: 了解低质量的成本对于六西格玛组织至关重要，因为它可以让领导者了解财务需求与质量改进需求之间的关系。质量差的成本越高，组织就越有可能致力于改进。

sentences.source: Understanding the cost of poor quality is critical to Six Sigma organizations because it lets leaders understand how financial needs are related to the need for quality improvements.
sentences.translation: 了解低质量的成本对于六西格玛组织至关重要，因为它可以让领导者了解财务需求与质量改进需求之间的关系。

sentences.source: The higher the cost of poor quality, the more likely an organization will work toward improvement.
sentences.translation: 质量差的成本越高，组织就越有可能致力于改进。

ch08-s03-the-coq-and-the-copq-en-010.translation: 在项目或流程层面，质量差的成本可能有助于确定改进预算。如果流程中的质量问题导致组织每月损失 5,000 美元，那么成本为 20,000 美元但每月在质量方面节省 3,000 美元的项目将在短短 7 个月内收回成本。在另一端，一个

sentences.source: At a project or process level, the cost of poor quality might help determine budgets for improvement.
sentences.translation: 在项目或流程层面，质量差的成本可能有助于确定改进预算。

sentences.source: If poor quality within the process is costing an organization $5,000 a month, a project that costs $20,000 but saves $3,000 a month in quality would pay for itself in just seven months.
sentences.translation: 如果流程中的质量问题导致组织每月损失 5,000 美元，那么成本为 20,000 美元但每月在质量方面节省 3,000 美元的项目将在短短 7 个月内收回成本。

sentences.source: On the other end, a
sentences.translation: 在另一端，一个

ch08-s03-the-coq-and-the-copq-en-011.translation: 项目成本为 100,000 美元，而低质量成本每月仅为 1,000 美元，则不太可能有意义。

sentences.source: project that costs $100,000 when the costs of poor quality are only $1,000 a month is less likely to make sense.
sentences.translation: 项目成本为 100,000 美元，而低质量成本每月仅为 1,000 美元，则不太可能有意义。

sentences.source: The equation for CoPQ is:
sentences.translation: CoPQ 的方程式为：

ch08-s03-the-coq-and-the-copq-en-013.translation: CoPQ = 外部故障成本 + 内部故障成本

sentences.source: CoPQ = External Failure Costs + Internal Failure Costs
sentences.translation: CoPQ = 外部故障成本 + 内部故障成本

ch08-s03-the-coq-and-the-copq-en-014.translation: 虽然等式看起来很简单，但确定与低质量相关的所有成本可能很困难。大多数专家使用冰山的比喻来解释低质量的隐性成本。从表面上看，你看到的是冰山很小的一角——明显的劣质成本。这些可能包括报废、再加工、保修索赔、客户退货和额外运费等。

sentences.source: While the equation seems simple, identifying all of the costs associated with poor quality can be difficult.
sentences.translation: 虽然等式看起来很简单，但确定与低质量相关的所有成本可能很困难。

sentences.source: Most experts use the metaphor of an iceberg to explain the hidden costs of poor quality.
sentences.translation: 大多数专家使用冰山的比喻来解释低质量的隐性成本。

sentences.source: On the surface, you see the very small tip of the iceberg—the obvious costs of poor quality.
sentences.translation: 从表面上看，你看到的是冰山很小的一角——明显的劣质成本。

sentences.source: These might be things such as scrap, reprocessing, warranty claims, customer returns, and extra shipping.
sentences.translation: 这些可能包括报废、再加工、保修索赔、客户退货和额外运费等。

ch08-s03-the-coq-and-the-copq-en-015.translation: 然而，在表面之下，冰山总是要大得多。低质量成本通常也是如此，隐性成本可能包括：

sentences.source: Beneath the surface, however, an iceberg is always much bigger.
sentences.translation: 然而，在表面之下，冰山总是要大得多。

sentences.source: The same is usually true of the cost of poor quality, and hidden costs might include:
sentences.translation: 低质量成本通常也是如此，隐性成本可能包括：

sentences.source: Loss of customer loyalty
sentences.translation: 客户忠诚度丧失

sentences.source: Loss of morale
sentences.translation: 士气低落

ch08-s03-the-coq-and-the-copq-en-018.translation: 如果士气长时间低迷，就会导致员工流失

sentences.source: Loss of employees if morale remains low for extended periods
sentences.translation: 如果士气长时间低迷，就会导致员工流失

ch08-s03-the-coq-and-the-copq-en-019.translation: 与安排或重新安排相关的冲突

sentences.source: Conflicts associated with scheduling or rescheduling
sentences.translation: 与安排或重新安排相关的冲突

ch08-s03-the-coq-and-the-copq-en-020.translation: 合规问题（包括罚款）的风险较高

sentences.source: Higher risks of compliance issues, including fines
sentences.translation: 合规问题（包括罚款）的风险较高

sentences.source: Higher administrative costs
sentences.translation: 行政成本较高

ch08-s03-the-coq-and-the-copq-en-022.translation: 不可预测的收入、销售额或产量

sentences.source: Unpredictable revenue, sales, or production
sentences.translation: 不可预测的收入、销售额或产量

ch08-s03-the-coq-and-the-copq-en-023.translation: 计算低质量的成本在整个企业层面上是极其困难的，但在流程层面上仍然是中等难度的。不存在列出所有可能成本并将其表述为美元金额的方法。对于组织来说，在计算 CoPQ 时开发一种在整个企业中使用的简化方法是一个好主意。至少，组织中的六西格玛专家可以考虑定义一种特定的方式来列出全公司范围内的低质量成本，以便各个流程团队在向领导汇报时使用类似的措施。

sentences.source: Calculating the cost of poor quality is extremely difficult on an enterprise-wide level and still moderately difficult on a process level.
sentences.translation: 计算低质量的成本在整个企业层面上是极其困难的，但在流程层面上仍然是中等难度的。

sentences.source: A method for listing all possible costs and formulizing them to dollar amounts doesn’t exist.
sentences.translation: 不存在列出所有可能成本并将其表述为美元金额的方法。

sentences.source: It’s a good idea for organizations to develop a streamlined method that is used throughout the enterprise when calculating CoPQ.
sentences.translation: 对于组织来说，在计算 CoPQ 时开发一种在整个企业中使用的简化方法是一个好主意。

sentences.source: At the very least, Six Sigma experts in the organization might consider defining a specific way of listing costs of poor quality company-wide so that various process teams are using similar measures when they report to leadership.
sentences.translation: 至少，组织中的六西格玛专家可以考虑定义一种特定的方式来列出全公司范围内的低质量成本，以便各个流程团队在向领导汇报时使用类似的措施。

sentences.source: The Cost of Quality
sentences.translation: 质量成本

ch08-s03-the-coq-and-the-copq-en-025.translation: 质量成本（CoQ）包括劣质成本和优质成本。除了内部和外部故障成本之外，CoQ 还包括预防和评估成本。预防和评估成本通常被称为合格成本——它们是与确保产出符合关键质量特性（CTQ）要求相关的费用。

sentences.source: The cost of quality, or CoQ, includes the cost of poor quality and the cost of good quality.
sentences.translation: 质量成本（CoQ）包括劣质成本和优质成本。

sentences.source: In addition to internal and external failure costs, CoQ includes prevention and appraisal costs.
sentences.translation: 除了内部和外部故障成本之外，CoQ 还包括预防和评估成本。

sentences.source: Prevention and appraisal costs are often referred to as the costs of conformity – they are the expenses related to ensuring outputs conform to critical to quality requirements.
sentences.translation: 预防和评估成本通常被称为合格成本——它们是与确保产出符合关键质量特性（CTQ）要求相关的费用。

sentences.source: Prevention Costs
sentences.translation: 预防成本

ch08-s03-the-coq-and-the-copq-en-027.translation: 预防成本是与旨在阻止错误或缺陷发生的任何活动相关的费用。防错会产生预防成本，稍后有关控制过程的章节将对此进行详细介绍。例如，如果一家公司生产烘焙食品，在该过程中的某个时刻，人员或机器必须测量成分以添加到面团批次中。防止这种过程出错的一种方法是提供专门的机器，只允许将特定数量的每种成分引入批次中。这样的机器可能会非常昂贵；它还必须由合格的操作员管理，并由适当的维修和清洁人员维护。所有这些活动都会产生成本，这些成本本质上可能被认为是预防性的。

sentences.source: The costs of prevention are the expenses that are related to any activity meant to stop an error or defect from occurring.
sentences.translation: 预防成本是与旨在阻止错误或缺陷发生的任何活动相关的费用。

sentences.source: Error-proofing, which is covered in detail in later chapters on controlling processes, results in prevention costs.
sentences.translation: 防错会产生预防成本，稍后有关控制过程的章节将对此进行详细介绍。

sentences.source: For example, if a company produces baked goods, at some point in the process people or machines must measure ingredients to add to dough batches.
sentences.translation: 例如，如果一家公司生产烘焙食品，在该过程中的某个时刻，人员或机器必须测量成分以添加到面团批次中。

sentences.source: One way to error-proof such a process is to provide specialized machinery that will only allow a specific amount of each ingredient to be introduced to a batch.
sentences.translation: 防止这种过程出错的一种方法是提供专门的机器，只允许将特定数量的每种成分引入批次中。

sentences.source: Such a machine would likely be quite expensive;
sentences.translation: 这样的机器可能会非常昂贵；

sentences.source: it would also have to be managed by a qualified operator and maintained by appropriate repair and cleaning staff.
sentences.translation: 它还必须由合格的操作员管理，并由适当的维修和清洁人员维护。

sentences.source: All of that activity would generate costs which might be considered preventative in nature.
sentences.translation: 所有这些活动都会产生成本，这些成本本质上可能被认为是预防性的。

ch08-s03-the-coq-and-the-copq-en-028.translation: 其他类型的预防成本包括与质量规划、审查或以质量为重点的教育和培训相关的费用。 质量审查和评估流程也会产生预防成本，无论这些审查是与供应商、产品、流程还是人员相关。客户调查、技术手册的创建、创建和管理需求和规范的工作以及工作描述的管理都可能导致预防成本。甚至家政成本也可能被视为预防性成本，特别是如果需要清洁的工作环境来减少产品制造中的缺陷或错误。

sentences.source: Other types of prevention costs include expenses related to quality planning, reviews, or education and training focused on quality.
sentences.translation: 其他类型的预防成本包括与质量规划、审查或以质量为重点的教育和培训相关的费用。

sentences.source: Quality review and evaluation processes also create prevention costs, whether those reviews are related to suppliers, products, processes, or people.
sentences.translation: 质量审查和评估流程也会产生预防成本，无论这些审查是与供应商、产品、流程还是人员相关。

sentences.source: Customer surveys, the creation of technical manuals, work to create and manage requirements and specifications, and the management of job descriptions can all lead to prevention costs.
sentences.translation: 客户调查、技术手册的创建、创建和管理需求和规范的工作以及工作描述的管理都可能导致预防成本。

sentences.source: Even housekeeping costs might be considered preventative costs, especially if a clean work environment is required to reduce flaws or errors in product manufacturing.
sentences.translation: 甚至家政成本也可能被视为预防性成本，特别是如果需要清洁的工作环境来减少产品制造中的缺陷或错误。

sentences.source: Appraisal Costs
sentences.translation: 评估费用

ch08-s03-the-coq-and-the-copq-en-030.translation: 评估成本是与旨在确保整个流程或组织的高水平质量的任何活动相关的成本。如果制造工厂雇用了一名质量控制专家，并且该人的工作是检查生产线上的零件，并将工作退回进行更正或报告质量水平作为指标，那么该人的工资以及与其就业相关的任何费用都是评估成本。在某些情况下，这些费用也可能被视为预防成本，但在计算 CoQ 时不会被重复计算。

sentences.source: Appraisal costs are those associated with any activity meant to ensure high levels of quality across a process or organization.
sentences.translation: 评估成本是与旨在确保整个流程或组织的高水平质量的任何活动相关的成本。

sentences.source: If a manufacturing plant hires a quality control specialist, and that person’s job is to review parts that come down the manufacturing line and either return the work for correction or report the level of quality as a metric, then the salary of that person and any expenses related to his or her employment are appraisal costs.
sentences.translation: 如果制造工厂雇用了一名质量控制专家，并且该人的工作是检查生产线上的零件，并将工作退回进行更正或报告质量水平作为指标，那么该人的工资以及与其就业相关的任何费用都是评估成本。

sentences.source: In some cases, those expenses might also be considered prevention costs, but they would not be counted twice when calculating CoQ.
sentences.translation: 在某些情况下，这些费用也可能被视为预防成本，但在计算 CoQ 时不会被重复计算。

ch08-s03-the-coq-and-the-copq-en-031.translation: 其他类型的评估成本可能包括与产品、服务或流程的质量审核相关的费用、校准和测量设备或软件的成本以及现场测试的成本。原型检查、咨询费用、财务报告和审计、安全检查、安全检查、供应商认证、员工调查和客户反馈都是可能存在评估成本的领域的进一步示例。

sentences.source: Other types of appraisal costs might include expenses related to quality audits on products, services, or processes, the cost of calibration and measurement equipment or software, and the costs of field tests.
sentences.translation: 其他类型的评估成本可能包括与产品、服务或流程的质量审核相关的费用、校准和测量设备或软件的成本以及现场测试的成本。

sentences.source: Prototype inspections, consulting expenses, financial reporting and auditing, security checks, safety checks, supplier certifications, employee surveys, and customer feedback are all further examples of areas where appraisal costs might exist.
sentences.translation: 原型检查、咨询费用、财务报告和审计、安全检查、安全检查、供应商认证、员工调查和客户反馈都是可能存在评估成本的领域的进一步示例。

sentences.source: Calculating the Cost of Quality
sentences.translation: 计算质量成本

sentences.source: The equation for CoQ is:
sentences.translation: CoQ 的方程式为：

ch08-s03-the-coq-and-the-copq-en-034.translation: CoQ = CoPQ + 预防成本 + 评估成本

sentences.source: CoQ = CoPQ + Prevention Costs + Appraisal Costs
sentences.translation: CoQ = CoPQ + 预防成本 + 评估成本

ch08-s03-the-coq-and-the-copq-en-035.translation: 计算 CoQ 时也存在计算 CoPQ 所固有的相同挑战。同样的冰山类比是相关的，预防和评估活动通常具有隐性成本，例如不必要的加班、文书工作或系统费用。

sentences.source: The same challenges inherent in calculating CoPQ also exist when calculating CoQ.
sentences.translation: 计算 CoQ 时也存在计算 CoPQ 所固有的相同挑战。

sentences.source: The same iceberg analogy is relevant, and prevention and appraisal activities often have hidden costs such as unnecessary overtime, paperwork, or system expenses.
sentences.translation: 同样的冰山类比是相关的，预防和评估活动通常具有隐性成本，例如不必要的加班、文书工作或系统费用。

sentences.source: The Cost of Quality and Six Sigma
sentences.translation: 质量成本与六西格玛

ch08-s03-the-coq-and-the-copq-en-037.translation: 传统观点可能会说，如果低质量的成本下降，高质量的成本可能会上升。换句话说，你必须在质量上花钱才能获得好的质量。虽然从历史上看，许多组织可能都是如此，但六西格玛公司的情况并非如此。 因为六西格玛致力于创造流程中固有的质量——这意味着事情第一次就做对了，缺陷也减少了——质量成本往往会下降，而质量本身会上升。

sentences.source: Traditional wisdom might say that if the cost of poor quality goes down, the cost of good quality is likely to go up.
sentences.translation: 传统观点可能会说，如果低质量的成本下降，高质量的成本可能会上升。

sentences.source: You have to spend money on quality to have good quality, in other words.
sentences.translation: 换句话说，你必须在质量上花钱才能获得好的质量。

sentences.source: While historically that might be true for many organizations, it is not the case in a Six Sigma company.
sentences.translation: 虽然从历史上看，许多组织可能都是如此，但六西格玛公司的情况并非如此。

sentences.source: Because Six Sigma works to create quality that is inherent in the process – meaning things are done right the first time and defects are reduced – the costs of quality often go down while quality itself goes up.
sentences.translation: 因为六西格玛致力于创造流程中固有的质量——这意味着事情第一次就做对了，缺陷也减少了——质量成本往往会下降，而质量本身会上升。

ch08-s03-the-coq-and-the-copq-en-038.translation: 在第一章中，我们表明西格玛水平较高（因此质量较高）的流程缺陷较少。随着西格玛水平的提高，缺陷以指数方式减少。由于缺陷较少，质量差的成本也成倍降低。但六西格玛也一次又一次地降低了整体质量的成本。随着六西格玛工具和方法的应用提高了流程的西格玛水平，预防和评估的成本也随之下降。

sentences.source: In Chapter 1, we showed that a process with a higher sigma level (and thus, higher quality) has fewer defects.
sentences.translation: 在第一章中，我们表明西格玛水平较高（因此质量较高）的流程缺陷较少。

sentences.source: Defects decrease in an exponential manner as sigma level rises.
sentences.translation: 随着西格玛水平的提高，缺陷以指数方式减少。

sentences.source: Because there are fewer defects, the costs of poor quality are exponentially reduced as well.
sentences.translation: 由于缺陷较少，质量差的成本也成倍降低。

sentences.source: But time and again, Six Sigma has also reduced the cost of overall quality.
sentences.translation: 但六西格玛也一次又一次地降低了整体质量的成本。

sentences.source: As the sigma level of processes is increased via the application of Six Sigma tools and methodology, the cost of both prevention and appraisal goes down as well.
sentences.translation: 随着六西格玛工具和方法的应用提高了流程的西格玛水平，预防和评估的成本也随之下降。

ch08-s03-the-coq-and-the-copq-en-039.translation: 将质量成本联系起来的一种方法——也许是企业中最常见的方法——是占销售额的百分比。质量成本占销售额的百分比通常与西格玛值密切相关，您可以根据公司或流程的西格玛值来预测质量成本。下表显示了 CoQ 与 sigma 值相关的平均范围。正如您所看到的，随着公司提高西格玛水平，他们的质量成本大幅节省。

sentences.source: One way of relating the cost of quality – and perhaps the most common way of doing so among corporations – is as a percent of sales.
sentences.translation: 将质量成本联系起来的一种方法——也许是企业中最常见的方法——是占销售额的百分比。

sentences.source: The cost of quality as a percent of sales typically aligns so closely with sigma values that you can predict the cost of quality based on a company’s or process’s sigma value.
sentences.translation: 质量成本占销售额的百分比通常与西格玛值密切相关，您可以根据公司或流程的西格玛值来预测质量成本。

sentences.source: The average ranges for CoQ in relation to sigma values are shown in the table below.
sentences.translation: 下表显示了 CoQ 与 sigma 值相关的平均范围。

sentences.source: As you can see, as companies improve their sigma levels, they experience a substantial savings in the cost of quality.
sentences.translation: 正如您所看到的，随着公司提高西格玛水平，他们的质量成本大幅节省。

sentences.source: Managing Cost of Quality
sentences.translation: 管理质量成本

ch08-s03-the-coq-and-the-copq-en-042.translation: 六西格玛是管理质量成本的最佳方法之一，因为它致力于将质量融入到每个流程中。当处理质量成本较高的组织或流程时，团队和领导层可以应用基于分类的方法来降低这些成本。虽然没有组织可以 100% 消除质量成本，但目标应该是零失败成本（无论是内部还是外部）以及最小的预防和评估成本。

sentences.source: Six Sigma is one of the best methodologies for managing the cost of quality because it works to build quality into every process.
sentences.translation: 六西格玛是管理质量成本的最佳方法之一，因为它致力于将质量融入到每个流程中。

sentences.source: When approaching an organization or process that has a high cost of quality, teams and leadership can apply a triage-based method to reduce those costs.
sentences.translation: 当处理质量成本较高的组织或流程时，团队和领导层可以应用基于分类的方法来降低这些成本。

sentences.source: While no organization can remove quality costs 100 percent, the goal should be zero costs of failure, either internal or external, and minimal preventative and appraisal costs.
sentences.translation: 虽然没有组织可以 100% 消除质量成本，但目标应该是零失败成本（无论是内部还是外部）以及最小的预防和评估成本。

ch08-s03-the-coq-and-the-copq-en-043.translation: 首先，团队应该关注与失败相关的成本。检测与不合格相关的成本通常更容易、更便宜，而寻求纠正一些关键故障原因的改进可能会对整体质量和总成本产生重大影响。六西格玛改进项目不是在流程上增加层层质量计划来确保质量——这只会增加预防或评估活动并增加质量成本——而是将预防措施纳入流程本身。换句话说，高效的六西格玛流程是自我调节的。他们建立了制衡机制，不断减少缺陷和返工。

sentences.source: First, teams should concentrate on costs associated with failures.
sentences.translation: 首先，团队应该关注与失败相关的成本。

sentences.source: It’s often easier and less expensive to detect costs associated with nonconformance, and improvements that seek to correct causes for a few critical failures can have a big impact on overall quality and total cost.
sentences.translation: 检测与不合格相关的成本通常更容易、更便宜，而寻求纠正一些关键故障原因的改进可能会对整体质量和总成本产生重大影响。

sentences.source: Instead of adding layers of quality programs over processes to ensure quality – which only adds prevention or appraisal activities and increases the cost of quality – Six Sigma improvement projects build preventative measures into processes themselves.
sentences.translation: 六西格玛改进项目不是在流程上增加层层质量计划来确保质量——这只会增加预防或评估活动并增加质量成本——而是将预防措施纳入流程本身。

sentences.source: In other words, efficient Six Sigma processes are self-regulating.
sentences.translation: 换句话说，高效的六西格玛流程是自我调节的。

sentences.source: They have built in checks and balances that work to constantly reduce defects and rework.
sentences.translation: 他们建立了制衡机制，不断减少缺陷和返工。

ch08-s03-the-coq-and-the-copq-en-044.translation: 将故障停止点构建到流程中的好处包括：

sentences.source: The benefit of building failure stop-points into a process include:
sentences.translation: 将故障停止点构建到流程中的好处包括：

ch08-s03-the-coq-and-the-copq-en-045.translation: 及早发现错误确实发生，从而降低隐性成本。当错误无法进入下一个流程或客户时，您可以避免与士气低落、客户忠诚度降低或产品退货相关的许多问题和成本。

sentences.source: Earlier detection when errors do occur, which keeps hidden costs down.
sentences.translation: 及早发现错误确实发生，从而降低隐性成本。

sentences.source: When the error can’t make it to the next process or to the customer, you avoid many issues and costs associated with low morale, reduced customer loyalty, or product returns.
sentences.translation: 当错误无法进入下一个流程或客户时，您可以避免与士气低落、客户忠诚度降低或产品退货相关的许多问题和成本。

ch08-s03-the-coq-and-the-copq-en-046.translation: 员工能够支持和管理更高的质量。当员工拥有质量时，他们更有可能努力工作以创造最佳产出。相比之下，评估式的质量计划可能会引发因受到密切关注而产生的偏执感，或者在员工心中建立质量观念与报复或纠正观念之间的关系。持续表现不佳确实需要解决，但员工在听到“质量”一词时不应默认抱有消极心态。

sentences.source: Employees are able to support and manage higher quality.
sentences.translation: 员工能够支持和管理更高的质量。

sentences.source: When quality is something employees have ownership of, they are more likely to work hard to create the best possible output.
sentences.translation: 当员工拥有质量时，他们更有可能努力工作以创造最佳产出。

sentences.source: In contrast, appraisal-style quality programs can spark feelings of paranoia at being closely watched or create a relationship in employee minds between the idea of quality and the idea of reprisal or correction.
sentences.translation: 相比之下，评估式的质量计划可能会引发因受到密切关注而产生的偏执感，或者在员工心中建立质量观念与报复或纠正观念之间的关系。

sentences.source: Poor performance on a continuous basis does need to be addressed, but employees should not default to a negative mindset when they hear the word quality.
sentences.translation: 持续表现不佳确实需要解决，但员工在听到“质量”一词时不应默认抱有消极心态。

ch08-s03-the-coq-and-the-copq-en-047.translation: 过程中的质量保证实际上比过程后或过程中的预防和评估方法更有效。统计过程控制和六西格玛改进可以将流程提升到六西格玛水平。为了确保相同水平的性能（每百万个机会中有 3.4 个缺陷），质量保证员工需要检查数百万个零件并确保只有极少数存在缺陷。对于大多数组织（如果有的话）来说，这根本不是一个经济的选择。

sentences.source: In-process quality assurance is actually more effective than post-process or over-process prevention and appraisal methods.
sentences.translation: 过程中的质量保证实际上比过程后或过程中的预防和评估方法更有效。

sentences.source: Statistical process control and Six Sigma improvements can push a process to six sigma level.
sentences.translation: 统计过程控制和六西格玛改进可以将流程提升到六西格玛水平。

sentences.source: To ensure the same level of performance – 3.4 defects per million opportunities – quality assurance employees would need to review millions of parts and ensure only a very tiny few had defects.
sentences.translation: 为了确保相同水平的性能（每百万个机会中有 3.4 个缺陷），质量保证员工需要检查数百万个零件并确保只有极少数存在缺陷。

sentences.source: It’s simply not an economical option for most, if any, organization.
sentences.translation: 对于大多数组织（如果有的话）来说，这根本不是一个经济的选择。

ch08-s03-the-coq-and-the-copq-en-048.translation: 在团队使用本书讨论的六西格玛和精益流程管理方法来降低失败成本后，团队可以转向预防和评估成本。通常，在高西格玛水平运行的过程中，预防和评估活动是 Muda 的一种形式。它们可以从流程中删除，而不会影响最终产品、质量、客户满意度或员工士气。在某些情况下，从流程中取消预防或评估实际上会对质量、生产以及客户和员工满意度产生积极影响。

sentences.source: After teams use the Six Sigma and Lean process management methods discussed throughout this book to reduce failure costs, teams can turn to prevention and appraisal costs.
sentences.translation: 在团队使用本书讨论的六西格玛和精益流程管理方法来降低失败成本后，团队可以转向预防和评估成本。

sentences.source: Often, in a process that is functioning at a high sigma level, prevention and appraisal activities are a form of muda.
sentences.translation: 通常，在高西格玛水平运行的过程中，预防和评估活动是 Muda 的一种形式。

sentences.source: They can be expunged from the process without impacting the end product, quality, customer satisfaction, or employee morale.
sentences.translation: 它们可以从流程中删除，而不会影响最终产品、质量、客户满意度或员工士气。

sentences.source: In some cases, removing prevention or appraisal from processes actually creates a positive impact on quality, production, and customer and employee satisfaction.
sentences.translation: 在某些情况下，从流程中取消预防或评估实际上会对质量、生产以及客户和员工满意度产生积极影响。

sentences.source: Identifying Prevention and Appraisal Activities
sentences.translation: 识别预防和评估活动

ch08-s03-the-coq-and-the-copq-en-050.translation: 消除与质量相关的 Muda 的第一步是识别它。流程图、意大利面条图和价值流图是发现流程中不需要包含的活动的宝贵工具。所有这些工具都将在第 9 单元中进行深入介绍。

sentences.source: The first step to removing quality-related muda is identifying it.
sentences.translation: 消除与质量相关的 Muda 的第一步是识别它。

sentences.source: Process maps, spaghetti diagrams, and value stream maps are valuable tools for uncovering activities that don’t need to be included in a process.
sentences.translation: 流程图、意大利面条图和价值流图是发现流程中不需要包含的活动的宝贵工具。

sentences.source: All of these tools are covered in depth in Unit 9.
sentences.translation: 所有这些工具都将在第 9 单元中进行深入介绍。

ch08-s03-the-coq-and-the-copq-en-051.translation: 无论您是在绘制流程，还是只是与流程负责人或六西格玛团队讨论各个组成部分，提出有关价值和必要性的问题也可以帮助识别预防和评估的误区。如果您认为与流程相关的活动可能是不必要的预防或评估形式，请询问：

sentences.source: Whether you’re mapping a process or simply discussing various components with process owners or a Six Sigma team, asking questions about value and necessity can also help identify muda of prevention and appraisal.
sentences.translation: 无论您是在绘制流程，还是只是与流程负责人或六西格玛团队讨论各个组成部分，提出有关价值和必要性的问题也可以帮助识别预防和评估的误区。

sentences.source: If you think an activity related to a process might be an unnecessary form of prevention or appraisal, ask:
sentences.translation: 如果您认为与流程相关的活动可能是不必要的预防或评估形式，请询问：

ch08-s03-the-coq-and-the-copq-en-052.translation: 活动本身是否能为产出增加任何价值？

sentences.source: Does the activity itself add any value to the output?
sentences.translation: 活动本身是否能为产出增加任何价值？

ch08-s03-the-coq-and-the-copq-en-053.translation: 该活动是否大幅减少了流程产生输出所需的时间？

sentences.source: Does the activity substantially reduce the time it takes for the process to produce an output?
sentences.translation: 该活动是否大幅减少了流程产生输出所需的时间？

ch08-s03-the-coq-and-the-copq-en-054.translation: 该活动是否大幅增加了流程成本？

sentences.source: Does the activity substantially increase the cost of the process?
sentences.translation: 该活动是否大幅增加了流程成本？

ch08-s03-the-coq-and-the-copq-en-055.translation: 如果该活动旨在防止流程中的缺陷，是否可以提高该活动的效率？

sentences.source: If the activity is designed to prevent defects within the process, can the activity be made more efficient?
sentences.translation: 如果该活动旨在防止流程中的缺陷，是否可以提高该活动的效率？

ch08-s03-the-coq-and-the-copq-en-056.translation: 如果该活动旨在防止缺陷，是否可以降低该活动的成本？

sentences.source: If the activity is designed to prevent defects, can the activity be made less expensive?
sentences.translation: 如果该活动旨在防止缺陷，是否可以降低该活动的成本？

ch08-s03-the-coq-and-the-copq-en-057.translation: 如果一项活动旨在捕获有关流程的质量数据以用于报告目的，那么这些报告是否必要？

sentences.source: If an activity is designed to capture quality data about the process for reporting purposes, are those reports necessary?
sentences.translation: 如果一项活动旨在捕获有关流程的质量数据以用于报告目的，那么这些报告是否必要？

ch08-s03-the-coq-and-the-copq-en-058.translation: 如果质量报告是必要的——无论是因为合规性等强制性要求，还是因为报告在另一个流程中提供了价值——报告是否可以自动化以减少相关费用？

sentences.source: If quality reports are necessary– either because of obligatory requirements such as compliance or because the reports provide value in another process – can the reports be automated to reduce associated expense?
sentences.translation: 如果质量报告是必要的——无论是因为合规性等强制性要求，还是因为报告在另一个流程中提供了价值——报告是否可以自动化以减少相关费用？

ch08-s03-the-coq-and-the-copq-en-059.translation: 这些问题的答案可帮助团队确定可以消除 Muda 的领域或可以改进质量相关流程的领域。

sentences.source: The answers to these questions help teams identify areas where muda can be removed or where quality-related processes can be improved.
sentences.translation: 这些问题的答案可帮助团队确定可以消除 Muda 的领域或可以改进质量相关流程的领域。

ch08-s04-quality-is-critical-to-success-.translation: 当六西格玛团队从流程中消除与质量相关的成本和不必要的活动时，至关重要的是他们不会真正消除质量。虽然确实不必存在传统的质量计划和成本来确保减少缺陷和提高客户满意度，但同样正确的是，您必须用其他形式的控制来取代这些计划。读完本书后，您将了解从统计过程控制到防错的许多工具，您可以使用它们在流程中创建质量。

sentences.source: When Six Sigma teams are expunging quality-related costs and unnecessary activities from processes, it is critical that they don’t actually remove quality.
sentences.translation: 当六西格玛团队从流程中消除与质量相关的成本和不必要的活动时，至关重要的是他们不会真正消除质量。

sentences.source: While it’s true that traditional quality programs and costs don’t have to be present to ensure a reduction in defects and an improvement in customer satisfaction, it’s equally true that you have to replace those programs with some other form of control.
sentences.translation: 虽然确实不必存在传统的质量计划和成本来确保减少缺陷和提高客户满意度，但同样正确的是，您必须用其他形式的控制来取代这些计划。

sentences.source: By the end of this book, you will have learned about a number of tools, from statistical process control to poka yokes, which you can use to create quality within a process.
sentences.translation: 读完本书后，您将了解从统计过程控制到防错的许多工具，您可以使用它们在流程中创建质量。

ch08-s04-quality-is-critical-to-success-.translation: 还值得注意的是，单个六西格玛团队，甚至整个部门致力于六西格玛，无法仅凭一己之力降低组织的质量成本。企业领导层必须相信，当将控制纳入流程中时，质量会更好，并且他们必须愿意通过培训和示例来传达这一事实。 一些公司选择使用六西格玛来改进流程，同时维持传统质量、合规和审计部门的费用。对于某些行业，例如医疗保健或金融，法律法规可能会强制规定审计和其他评估和预防成本。除了该任务之外，最好总是删除任何不提供额外价值的质量活动。

sentences.source: It’s also worth noting that a single Six Sigma team – or even an entire department devoted to Six Sigma – can’t reduce the costs of quality in an organization on their own.
sentences.translation: 还值得注意的是，单个六西格玛团队，甚至整个部门致力于六西格玛，无法仅凭一己之力降低组织的质量成本。

sentences.source: Corporate leadership must buy into the belief that quality is better when controls are incorporated within the process, and they have to be willing to communicate this fact via training and example.
sentences.translation: 企业领导层必须相信，当将控制纳入流程中时，质量会更好，并且他们必须愿意通过培训和示例来传达这一事实。

sentences.source: Some companies choose instead to use Six Sigma to improve processes while maintaining the expense of traditional quality, compliance, and audit departments.
sentences.translation: 一些公司选择使用六西格玛来改进流程，同时维持传统质量、合规和审计部门的费用。

sentences.source: For some industries, such as healthcare or finance, audits and other appraisal and prevention costs might be mandated by laws and regulations.
sentences.translation: 对于某些行业，例如医疗保健或金融，法律法规可能会强制规定审计和其他评估和预防成本。
