sentences.source: However, the team has determined that certain tasks must be accomplished during the Measure phase.
sentences.translation: 在 DMAIC 项目中，通常在每个阶段（定义、测量、分析、改进和控制）结束时设置里程碑。

sentences.source: First, they have to create some definitions of terms so everyone is on the same page when discussing measurements.
sentences.translation: 在 DMAIC 项目中，通常在每个阶段（定义、测量、分析、改进和控制）结束时设置里程碑。

sentences.source: Second, the team has to gather data about the temperature at which ingredients are stored and cooked.
sentences.translation: 但是，团队可以设置自定义里程碑，如果发起人要批准项目的大量资源或资金请求，则他们可能需要特定的里程碑。

sentences.source: Finally, the team wants to actively observe sandwich shop employees in order to measure the time it takes to make various sandwiches.
sentences.translation: 但是，团队可以设置自定义里程碑，如果发起人要批准项目的大量资源或资金请求，则他们可能需要特定的里程碑。

ch10-s03-timelines-scheduling-and-milest.translation: 确定时间表后，设置里程碑会议和日期，以帮助团队保持正轨，并通知赞助商或支持者进展情况。在 DMAIC 项目中，通常在每个阶段（定义、测量、分析、改进和控制）结束时设置里程碑。但是，团队可以设置自定义里程碑，如果发起人要批准项目的大量资源或资金请求，则他们可能需要特定的里程碑。

sentences.source: The team might set up internal milestones for the Measure phase, stating that definitions will be created by January 25, temperature data collected by February 5, and time data collected by February 10.
sentences.translation: 确定时间表后，设置里程碑会议和日期，以帮助团队保持正轨，并通知赞助商或支持者进展情况。

ch10-s03-timelines-scheduling-and-milest.translation: 您还可以在团队环境中设置里程碑来管理目标和任务；这些里程碑可以保留在团队内部。例如，在三明治连锁店工作的团队希望改进三明治的制作过程。他们设立了以下里程碑：

sentences.source: By breaking each phase, and each larger task, into smaller parts, it is easier for the team to stay on track and complete work.
sentences.translation: 您还可以在团队环境中设置里程碑来管理目标和任务；

sentences.source: Smaller tasks seem more manageable, so they are more likely to be accomplished.
sentences.translation: 例如，在三明治连锁店工作的团队希望改进三明治的制作过程。

ch10-s04-budgets-en-001.translation: 团队，尤其是团队领导者，必须始终关注项目预算。虽然成功是由最终客户根据绩效、质量和满意度来评价的，但六西格玛团队也对公司领导负责。对于领导者来说，成功还可以通过时间和预算来衡量。强大的时间表和良好的里程碑可以帮助您满足时间要求，而对财务驱动因素的了解、强有力的沟通和财务监督可以帮助您将项目控制在预算之内。

sentences.source: Teams, and especially team leaders, must always be concerned with project budgets.
sentences.translation: 团队，尤其是团队领导者，必须始终关注项目预算。

sentences.source: While success is rated by end customers in terms of performance, quality, and satisfaction, Six Sigma teams also answer to corporate leadership.
sentences.translation: 虽然成功是由最终客户根据绩效、质量和满意度来评价的，但六西格玛团队也对公司领导负责。

sentences.source: For leaders, success is also measured in terms of time and budget.
sentences.translation: 对于领导者来说，成功还可以通过时间和预算来衡量。

sentences.source: A strong timeline and good milestones help you meet time requirements, and an understanding of financial drivers, strong communication, and financial oversight help you keep a project within budget.
sentences.translation: 强大的时间表和良好的里程碑可以帮助您满足时间要求，而对财务驱动因素的了解、强有力的沟通和财务监督可以帮助您将项目控制在预算之内。

ch10-s04-budgets-en-002.translation: 在六西格玛项目中处理预算时面临的挑战之一是所有团队成员并不总是完全了解财务驱动因素。在某些情况下，财务信息甚至可能受到限制；例如，雇主通常不希望向各个团队成员公开有关员工薪酬的具体数据。 在这种情况下，某些信息和分析可能需要仅由项目主导的黑带执行，特别是在数据至关重要或敏感的情况下。

sentences.source: One of the challenges when dealing with budgets in a Six Sigma project is that all team members are not always completely aware of financial drivers.
sentences.translation: 在六西格玛项目中处理预算时面临的挑战之一是所有团队成员并不总是完全了解财务驱动因素。

sentences.source: In some cases, financial information might even be restricted;
sentences.translation: 在某些情况下，财务信息甚至可能受到限制；

sentences.source: employers don’t generally want specific data about employee pay made public to various team members, for example.
sentences.translation: 例如，雇主通常不希望向各个团队成员公开有关员工薪酬的具体数据。

sentences.source: Some information and analysis might need to be performed solely by a project-leading Black Belt in such cases, especially if data is critical or sensitive.
sentences.translation: 在这种情况下，某些信息和分析可能需要仅由项目主导的黑带执行，特别是在数据至关重要或敏感的情况下。

ch10-s04-budgets-en-003.translation: 除了对敏感数据的关注之外，当所有团队成员都了解尽可能多的驱动因素和数据时，流程改进项目效果最好。当团队知道冠军愿意代表他们寻求多少资金时，他们就可以就如何改进流程做出现实的决定。有时，由于预算原因，最有可能产生最大改进的解决方案并不可行。例如，如果改进项目的预算为 50,000 美元，团队就无法实施需要 80,000 美元机械资本投资的解决方案。

sentences.source: Outside of concerns with sensitive data, process improvement projects work best when all team members are made aware of as many of the drivers and data as possible.
sentences.translation: 除了对敏感数据的关注之外，当所有团队成员都了解尽可能多的驱动因素和数据时，流程改进项目效果最好。

sentences.source: When teams know how much funding a champion is willing to seek on their behalf, they can make realistic decisions about how to improve a process.
sentences.translation: 当团队知道冠军愿意代表他们寻求多少资金时，他们就可以就如何改进流程做出现实的决定。

sentences.source: Sometimes, the solution that is most likely to generate the most improvement isn’t viable because of budget.
sentences.translation: 有时，由于预算原因，最有可能产生最大改进的解决方案并不可行。

sentences.source: If an improvement project has a budget of $50,000, the team can’t implement a solution that requires an $80,000 capital investment in machinery, for example.
sentences.translation: 例如，如果改进项目的预算为 50,000 美元，团队就无法实施需要 80,000 美元机械资本投资的解决方案。

ch10-s04-budgets-en-004.translation: 预算问题因组织而异。在一些组织中，领导者最关心团队的具体支出，包括新设备、雇用新人员或购买新产品或软件的费用。一些组织对项目预算采取更细粒度的方法，考虑团队在项目上花费的时间费用以及与团队环境之外的培训和实施解决方案相关的费用。

sentences.source: Budget concerns vary by organization.
sentences.translation: 预算问题因组织而异。

sentences.source: In some organizations, leaders are most concerned with specific expenditures by a team, including expenses on new equipment, hiring new personnel, or purchasing new products or software.
sentences.translation: 在一些组织中，领导者最关心团队的具体支出，包括新设备、雇用新人员或购买新产品或软件的费用。

sentences.source: Some organizations take a more granular approach to project budgets, considering the expense of hours spent by the team on the project as well as the expenses associated with training and implementing a solution outside of the team environment.
sentences.translation: 一些组织对项目预算采取更细粒度的方法，考虑团队在项目上花费的时间费用以及与团队环境之外的培训和实施解决方案相关的费用。

ch10-s04-budgets-en-005.translation: 六西格玛团队领导者必须确保他们了解领导者和组织如何管理项目预算。第一次与组织或赞助商合作意味着就预算如何计算、赞助商愿意为增加预算付出多少努力以及六西格玛领导者在维持预算方面的预期角色进行诚实和彻底的对话。

sentences.source: Six Sigma team leaders must ensure they understand how leaders and organizations manage project budgets.
sentences.translation: 六西格玛团队领导者必须确保他们了解领导者和组织如何管理项目预算。

sentences.source: Working for the first time with an organization or sponsor means having honest and thorough conversations about how budgets are calculated, how much sponsors are willing to work for increases in a budget, and what the Six Sigma leader’s expected role in maintaining budgets is.
sentences.translation: 第一次与组织或赞助商合作意味着就预算如何计算、赞助商愿意为增加预算付出多少努力以及六西格玛领导者在维持预算方面的预期角色进行诚实和彻底的对话。

sentences.source: Defined Measures of Success
sentences.translation: 明确的成功衡量标准

ch10-s04-budgets-en-007.translation: 最后，六西格玛团队必须制定明确的成功衡量标准。为了最好地管理六西格玛项目和团队，领导者必须确保所有团队成员、领导者和发起人就成功的含义达成一致。如果根本没有定义成功，团队就会面临范围蔓延的风险，并迷失在一个似乎永远不会结束的项目中。如果成功没有明确定义，团队就有可能在无法令客户、发起人或团队所有成员满意的情况下完成项目。如果发起人和团队对于成功是什么样的意见不一致，团队可能会认为他们已经完成了一个成功的项目，而领导层则认为该项目是失败的。

sentences.source: Finally, Six Sigma teams must create a well-defined measure of success.
sentences.translation: 最后，六西格玛团队必须制定明确的成功衡量标准。

sentences.source: To best manage a Six Sigma project and team, leaders have to ensure all team members, leaders, and sponsors agree on what success means.
sentences.translation: 为了最好地管理六西格玛项目和团队，领导者必须确保所有团队成员、领导者和发起人就成功的含义达成一致。

sentences.source: If success isn’t defined at all, the team risks scope creep and getting lost in a project that never seems to end.
sentences.translation: 如果根本没有定义成功，团队就会面临范围蔓延的风险，并迷失在一个似乎永远不会结束的项目中。

sentences.source: If success isn’t well-defined, teams risk concluding a project without satisfying the customer, sponsor, or all members of the team.
sentences.translation: 如果成功没有明确定义，团队就有可能在无法令客户、发起人或团队所有成员满意的情况下完成项目。

sentences.source: If a sponsor and the team don’t agree on what success looks like, the team could think they’ve concluded a successful project while leadership believes the project was a failure.
sentences.translation: 如果发起人和团队对于成功是什么样的意见不一致，团队可能会认为他们已经完成了一个成功的项目，而领导层则认为该项目是失败的。

ch10-s04-budgets-en-008.translation: 最后，成功的六西格玛团队管理取决于许多与其他努力的成功领导相同的理念。 选择合适的人员、明确期望、以有组织的方式开展工作以及诚实和开放地对待进展，有助于团队的每个成员取得成功并提供价值。

sentences.source: In the end, successful Six Sigma team management hinges on many of the same concepts as successful leadership in other endeavors does.
sentences.translation: 最后，成功的六西格玛团队管理取决于许多与其他努力的成功领导相同的理念。

sentences.source: Choosing the right people, being clear about expectations, approaching work in an organized manner, and being honest and open about progress helps every member of the team succeed and provide value.
sentences.translation: 选择合适的人员、明确期望、以有组织的方式开展工作以及诚实和开放地对待进展，有助于团队的每个成员取得成功并提供价值。

sentences.source: DMADV
sentences.translation: DMADV

ch11-s01-introduction-to-dmaic-and-dmadv.translation: 六西格玛与其他质量改进和管理方法论的区别之一是每个项目都采用结构化方法。旨在改进现有流程的项目遵循称为 DMAIC 流程的成功路线图； DMAIC 分为五个阶段：定义、测量、分析、改进和控制。 DMAIC 项目的主要活动包括确定造成问题（Y）的关键输入或原因（X）、验证这些原因、集思广益并选择解决方案、实施解决方案以及创建控制计划以确保维持改进的状态。

sentences.source: One of the things that sets Six Sigma apart from some other quality improvement and management methodologies is a structured approach to every project.
sentences.translation: 六西格玛与其他质量改进和管理方法论的区别之一是每个项目都采用结构化方法。

sentences.source: Projects that are meant to improve an existing process follow a road-map for success known as the DMAIC process;
sentences.translation: 旨在改进现有流程的项目遵循称为 DMAIC 流程的成功路线图；

sentences.source: DMAIC is broken into five phases: Define, Measure, Analyze, Improve, and Control.
sentences.translation: DMAIC 分为五个阶段：定义、测量、分析、改进和控制。

sentences.source: The main activities of a DMAIC project include identifying the critical inputs or causes (the Xs) that are creating the problem (the Y), verifying those causes, brainstorming and selecting solutions, implementing solutions, and creating a control plan to ensure the improved state is maintained.
sentences.translation: DMAIC 项目的主要活动包括确定造成问题（Y）的关键输入或原因（X）、验证这些原因、集思广益并选择解决方案、实施解决方案以及创建控制计划以确保维持改进的状态。

ch11-s01-introduction-to-dmaic-and-dmadv.translation: DMAIC 方法的设计具有相当的包容性——绝大多数寻求改进项目的团队都能够将他们的活动纳入 DMAIC 步骤，因为这些步骤的设计允许一定的灵活性。但有时，团队意识到修复或改进流程并不是实现组织持续改进的正确方法。相反，流程可能需要完全替换或重新设计，以满足客户满意度或组织改进的目标。在这种情况下，团队可以采用 DMADV 方法。

sentences.source: The DMAIC methodology is designed to be fairly inclusive – the vast majority of teams who are seeking to improve a project will be able to fit their activities in to the DMAIC steps because those steps are designed to allow some flexibility.
sentences.translation: DMAIC 方法的设计具有相当的包容性——绝大多数寻求改进项目的团队都能够将他们的活动纳入 DMAIC 步骤，因为这些步骤的设计允许一定的灵活性。

sentences.source: Sometimes, though, teams realize that fixing or improving a process isn’t the right way to achieve sustained improvement for the organization.
sentences.translation: 但有时，团队意识到修复或改进流程并不是实现组织持续改进的正确方法。

sentences.source: Instead, a process might need to be completely replaced or redesigned to meet goals for customer satisfaction or organizational improvement.
sentences.translation: 相反，流程可能需要完全替换或重新设计，以满足客户满意度或组织改进的目标。

sentences.source: In such cases, teams can employ the DMADV method.
sentences.translation: 在这种情况下，团队可以采用 DMADV 方法。

ch11-s01-introduction-to-dmaic-and-dmadv.translation: DMADV 代表定义、测量、分析、设计和验证。该方法的管理原则与 DMAIC 的管理原则非常相似，但最后两个阶段旨在推出和测试全​​新的流程。 如果满足以下条件，六西格玛团队可能会通过 DMADV 进行改进：

sentences.source: DMADV stands for Define, Measure, Analyze, Design, and Verify.
sentences.translation: DMADV 代表定义、测量、分析、设计和验证。

sentences.source: The principles governing the method are very similar to those governing DMAIC, but the last two phases are geared toward rolling out and testing a completely new process.
sentences.translation: 该方法的管理原则与 DMAIC 的管理原则非常相似，但最后两个阶段旨在推出和测试全​​新的流程。

sentences.source: Six Sigma teams might approach improvements through DMADV if:
sentences.translation: 如果满足以下条件，六西格玛团队可能会通过 DMADV 进行改进：

ch11-s01-introduction-to-dmaic-and-dmadv.translation: 该企业想要推出新服务或产品。

sentences.source: The business wants to launch a new service or product.
sentences.translation: 该企业想要推出新服务或产品。

ch11-s01-introduction-to-dmaic-and-dmadv.translation: 由于升级需求或使业务流程、机器或员工与未来目标保持一致，业务领导者决定更换流程。

sentences.source: Business leaders decide to replace a process because of upgrade needs or to align business processes, machinery, or employees with future goals.
sentences.translation: 由于升级需求或使业务流程、机器或员工与未来目标保持一致，业务领导者决定更换流程。

ch11-s01-introduction-to-dmaic-and-dmadv.translation: 六西格玛团队发现改进流程不太可能实现项目所需的成功。

sentences.source: A Six Sigma team discovers that improving a process is not likely to provide the success desired from a project.
sentences.translation: 六西格玛团队发现改进流程不太可能实现项目所需的成功。

ch11-s01-introduction-to-dmaic-and-dmadv.translation: 大多数团队在进入项目时都知道他们是采用 DMAIC 还是 DMADV 方法，但当团队意识到需要完整的流程替换时，一些 DMAIC 项目可能会变成 DMADV 项目（通常是在定义、测量或分析阶段）。 在项目中期改用新方法可能需要一些资源调整，并可能影响项目进度，这意味着让支持者和赞助商了解团队进度和决策势在必行。

sentences.source: Most teams go into the project knowing whether they are employing DMAIC or DMADV approaches, but some DMAIC projects can become DMADV projects – usually during the Define, Measure, or Analyze stages – when the team realizes the need for a complete process replacement.
sentences.translation: 大多数团队在进入项目时都知道他们是采用 DMAIC 还是 DMADV 方法，但当团队意识到需要完整的流程替换时，一些 DMAIC 项目可能会变成 DMADV 项目（通常是在定义、测量或分析阶段）。

sentences.source: Switching to the new methodology during the middle of the project might require some shuffling of resources and could impact project schedules, which means keeping champions and sponsors informed of team progress and decisions is imperative.
sentences.translation: 在项目中期改用新方法可能需要一些资源调整，并可能影响项目进度，这意味着让支持者和赞助商了解团队进度和决策势在必行。

ch11-s01-introduction-to-dmaic-and-dmadv.translation: 值得注意的是，一些组织并未在任何项目中正式使用 DMADV 方法，部分原因是他们发现坚持单一方法的术语更容易。这些组织仍可能通过改变 DMAIC 改进和控制阶段处理的一些活动来完成流程重新设计项目。简而言之，团队确实使用了 DMADV 方法，但他们使用与 DMAIC 相关的措辞来简化组织各个级别的六西格玛教育。

sentences.source: It’s worth noting that some organizations don’t formally use the DMADV approach for any project, in part because they find it easier to stick with the nomenclature of a single methodology.
sentences.translation: 值得注意的是，一些组织并未在任何项目中正式使用 DMADV 方法，部分原因是他们发现坚持单一方法的术语更容易。

sentences.source: These organizations might still complete process redesign projects by altering some of the activities handled in the Improve and Control stages of DMAIC.
sentences.translation: 这些组织仍可能通过改变 DMAIC 改进和控制阶段处理的一些活动来完成流程重新设计项目。

sentences.source: In short, the teams do use the DMADV approach, but they use the verbiage associated with DMAIC to streamline Six Sigma education across all levels of the organization.
sentences.translation: 简而言之，团队确实使用了 DMADV 方法，但他们使用与 DMAIC 相关的措辞来简化组织各个级别的六西格玛教育。

ch11-s02-dmaic-versus-dmadv-en-001.translation: DMAIC 和 DMADV 之间的主要区别在于团队设定的目标和已完成项目的结果。在某些方面，DMADV 项目可能感觉它有更切实的成果，但实际上，这两种方法都在寻求提供更好的质量、更高的效率、更多的产量、更多的利润、更高的客户满意度或这些东西的某种组合。我们将在本章中介绍这两种方法的每个阶段。但首先，让我们看一下每个阶段的一些快速定义，因为它们与 DMAIC 和 DMADV 相关。

sentences.source: The major differences between DMAIC and DMADV are the goals the team sets and the outcome of the completed project.
sentences.translation: DMAIC 和 DMADV 之间的主要区别在于团队设定的目标和已完成项目的结果。

sentences.source: In some ways, a DMADV project might feel like it has a more tangible outcome, but in reality, both methods are seeking to deliver better quality, better efficiency, more production, more profits, higher customer satisfaction, or some combination of these things.
sentences.translation: 在某些方面，DMADV 项目可能感觉它有更切实的成果，但实际上，这两种方法都在寻求提供更好的质量、更高的效率、更多的产量、更多的利润、更高的客户满意度或这些东西的某种组合。

sentences.source: We’ll introduce each of the phases of both methods in this chapter.
sentences.translation: 我们将在本章中介绍这两种方法的每个阶段。

sentences.source: But first, let’s look at some quick definitions of each phase as they relate to DMAIC versus DMADV.
sentences.translation: 但首先，让我们看一下每个阶段的一些快速定义，因为它们与 DMAIC 和 DMADV 相关。

sentences.source: Phase 1: Define
sentences.translation: 第一阶段：定义

ch11-s02-dmaic-versus-dmadv-en-003.translation: 在 DMAIC 项目期间，定义阶段涉及识别问题、定义项目需求以及设定成功目标。要求和目标设定可能与多种因素相关，并且在一定程度上取决于领导团队的指导和预期预算，六西格玛领导者可以在该阶段使用各种工具来创建允许各种项目类型的灵活性。

sentences.source: During a DMAIC project, the Define phase is concerned with identifying the problem, defining requirements for the project, and setting goals for success.
sentences.translation: 在 DMAIC 项目期间，定义阶段涉及识别问题、定义项目需求以及设定成功目标。

sentences.source: Requirements and goal setting might relate to a variety of factors and are dependent somewhat on guidance from the leadership team and expected budgets, and Six Sigma leaders can use various tools within the phase to create flexibility that allows for a variety of project types.
sentences.translation: 要求和目标设定可能与多种因素相关，并且在一定程度上取决于领导团队的指导和预期预算，六西格玛领导者可以在该阶段使用各种工具来创建允许各种项目类型的灵活性。

ch11-s02-dmaic-versus-dmadv-en-004.translation: 在 DMADV 项目中，定义阶段稍微严格一些。团队还必须识别问题并开始定义需求，但必须在变更管理环境中制定需求。有时，组织制定了变革管理计划，这意味着六西格玛团队必须将该计划的所有要求纳入 DMADV 阶段。该团队还致力于定义客户要求，以创建一个可以与流程开发进行比较的衡量尺。

sentences.source: In a DMADV project, the Define stage is slightly more rigid.
sentences.translation: 在 DMADV 项目中，定义阶段稍微严格一些。

sentences.source: Teams also have to identify a problem and begin defining requirements, but requirements must be made within a change-management environment.
sentences.translation: 团队还必须识别问题并开始定义需求，但必须在变更管理环境中制定需求。

sentences.source: Sometimes, organizations have a change management program in place, which means Six Sigma teams must incorporate all requirements of that program into the DMADV phases.
sentences.translation: 有时，组织制定了变革管理计划，这意味着六西格玛团队必须将该计划的所有要求纳入 DMADV 阶段。

sentences.source: The team also works to define customer requirements to create a measuring stick to which the process development can be compared.
sentences.translation: 该团队还致力于定义客户要求，以创建一个可以与流程开发进行比较的衡量尺。

sentences.source: Phase 2: Measure
sentences.translation: 第二阶段： 测量

ch11-s02-dmaic-versus-dmadv-en-007.translation: DMAIC 测量阶段是团队使用数据验证他们对流程和问题的假设的阶段。假设的验证也合并到分析阶段。测量阶段的大部分时间用于实际收集数据并以可分析的方式对其进行格式化。如果尚未捕获数据，测量可能是六西格玛项目中最困难的任务之一。团队可能必须构建工具来捕获数据、创建数字数据查询、筛选大量数据以查找相关信息，或者在某些手动过程中手动捕获数据。

sentences.source: The DMAIC Measure phase is when teams use data to validate their assumptions about the process and the problem.
sentences.translation: DMAIC 测量阶段是团队使用数据验证他们对流程和问题的假设的阶段。

sentences.source: Validation of assumptions also merges into the analyze phase.
sentences.translation: 假设的验证也合并到分析阶段。

sentences.source: The bulk of the measure phase is occupied with actually gathering data and formatting it in a way that can be analyzed.
sentences.translation: 测量阶段的大部分时间用于实际收集数据并以可分析的方式对其进行格式化。

sentences.source: Measuring can be one of the most difficult tasks in a Six Sigma project if data isn’t already being captured.
sentences.translation: 如果尚未捕获数据，测量可能是六西格玛项目中最困难的任务之一。

sentences.source: Teams might have to build tools to capture data, create queries for digital data, sift through enormous amounts of data to find relevant information, or capture data by hand in some manual process.
sentences.translation: 团队可能必须构建工具来捕获数据、创建数字数据查询、筛选大量数据以查找相关信息，或者在某些手动过程中手动捕获数据。

ch11-s02-dmaic-versus-dmadv-en-008.translation: 使用实际数据验证定义阶段的假设后，团队可能会重新审视问题陈述、目标和其他与流程相关的定义。如果团队在 Define 时留下了这些内容的“粗略草案”，那么他们应该在 Measure 时留下最终草案。团队还在测量阶段工作，测量流程中的关键输入和步骤，为定义做好准备。

sentences.source: After validating assumptions from the Define stage with actual data, the team might revisit problem statements, goals, and other process-related definitions.
sentences.translation: 使用实际数据验证定义阶段的假设后，团队可能会重新审视问题陈述、目标和其他与流程相关的定义。

sentences.source: If the team leaves Define with a “rough draft” of these things, they should leave Measure with a final draft.
sentences.translation: 如果团队在 Define 时留下了这些内容的“粗略草案”，那么他们应该在 Measure 时留下最终草案。

sentences.source: Teams also work during Measure phases to measure key inputs and steps in the process in preparation for Define.
sentences.translation: 团队还在测量阶段工作，测量流程中的关键输入和步骤，为定义做好准备。

ch11-s02-dmaic-versus-dmadv-en-009.translation: 通过 DMADV 方法工作的团队可能会在测量阶段做一些相同的事情，但活动通常更有针对性。团队可能会收集数据和测量结果，帮助他们定义新流程的性能要求。

sentences.source: Teams working through a DMADV approach might do some of the same things during the Measure phase, but activities are typically more targeted.
sentences.translation: 通过 DMADV 方法工作的团队可能会在测量阶段做一些相同的事情，但活动通常更有针对性。

sentences.source: Teams will likely collect data and measurements that help them define performance requirements for the new process.
sentences.translation: 团队可能会收集数据和测量结果，帮助他们定义新流程的性能要求。

sentences.source: Phase 3: Analyze
sentences.translation: 第三阶段：分析

ch11-s02-dmaic-versus-dmadv-en-011.translation: 在 DMAIC 项目的分析阶段，团队提出关于输入和输出之间以及 X 和 Y 之间因果关系的假设，他们将因果关系缩小到至关重要的少数（使用帕累托原理等方法），并使用统计分析和数据来验证他们迄今为止所做的假设和假设。在 DMAIC 项目中，分析阶段往往会进入改进阶段；用于验证假设和可能的解决方案的假设检验可以从分析开始，并继续进入改进阶段。

sentences.source: During the Analyze phase of a DMAIC project, teams develop hypotheses about causal relationships between inputs and outputs and between Xs and Ys, they narrow causation down to the vital few (using methods such as the Pareto principle), and they use statistical analysis and data to validate the hypotheses and assumptions they’ve made so far.
sentences.translation: 在 DMAIC 项目的分析阶段，团队提出关于输入和输出之间以及 X 和 Y 之间因果关系的假设，他们将因果关系缩小到至关重要的少数（使用帕累托原理等方法），并使用统计分析和数据来验证他们迄今为止所做的假设和假设。

sentences.source: The Analyze phase tends to flow into the Improve phase in a DMAIC project;
sentences.translation: 在 DMAIC 项目中，分析阶段往往会进入改进阶段；

sentences.source: hypothesis testing to validate assumptions and possible solutions might begin in Analyze and continue into the Improve phase.
sentences.translation: 用于验证假设和可能的解决方案的假设检验可以从分析开始，并继续进入改进阶段。

ch11-s02-dmaic-versus-dmadv-en-012.translation: 使用 DMADV 的团队还可能确定因果关系，但他们通常更关心确定用于衡量和设计新流程的最佳实践和基准。团队还可以通过识别增值和非增值活动、定位可能存在瓶颈或错误的区域以及细化需求以更好地满足项目的需求和目标来开始流程设计工作。

sentences.source: A team using DMADV might also identify cause and effect relationships, but they are usually more concerned with identifying best practices and benchmarks by which to measure and design the new process.
sentences.translation: 使用 DMADV 的团队还可能确定因果关系，但他们通常更关心确定用于衡量和设计新流程的最佳实践和基准。

sentences.source: Teams might also begin process design work by identifying value- and non value-added activities, locating areas where bottlenecks or errors are likely, and refining requirements to better meet the needs and goals of the project.
sentences.translation: 团队还可以通过识别增值和非增值活动、定位可能存在瓶颈或错误的区域以及细化需求以更好地满足项目的需求和目标来开始流程设计工作。

sentences.source: Phase 4: Improve or Design
sentences.translation: 第四阶段：改进或设计

ch11-s02-dmaic-versus-dmadv-en-014.translation: 六西格玛团队在项目的改进阶段开始开发从分析阶段开始的想法。 他们使用统计数据和现实世界的观察来测试假设和解决方案。假设测试实际上从分析阶段开始，但在改进阶段继续，因为团队选择解决方案并开始实施它们。团队还致力于标准化解决方案，为将改进的流程推广到日常生产和非团队员工做好准备。团队还开始衡量结果，并为最后阶段构建的控制奠定基础。

sentences.source: Six Sigma teams start developing the ideas that began in the Analyze phase during the Improve phase of a project.
sentences.translation: 六西格玛团队在项目的改进阶段开始开发从分析阶段开始的想法。

sentences.source: They use statistics and real-world observation to test hypotheses and solutions.
sentences.translation: 他们使用统计数据和现实世界的观察来测试假设和解决方案。

sentences.source: Hypothesis testing actually begins in the analyze phase, but is continued during the improve phase as teams select solutions and begin to implement them.
sentences.translation: 假设测试实际上从分析阶段开始，但在改进阶段继续，因为团队选择解决方案并开始实施它们。

sentences.source: Teams also work to standardize solutions in preparation for rolling improved processes to daily production and non-team employees.
sentences.translation: 团队还致力于标准化解决方案，为将改进的流程推广到日常生产和非团队员工做好准备。

sentences.source: Teams also start measuring results and lay the foundation for controls that will be built in the last phase.
sentences.translation: 团队还开始衡量结果，并为最后阶段构建的控制奠定基础。

ch11-s02-dmaic-versus-dmadv-en-015.translation: 第四阶段是 DMADV 项目开始与 DMAIC 项目产生重大分歧的阶段。该团队实际上致力于设计一个新流程，其中确实涉及上面提到的一些解决方案测试，但也涉及映射、工作流程原则以及积极构建新的基础设施。这可能意味着安装新设备、雇用和培训新员工或开发新的软件工具。团队还在第四阶段开始实施新的系统和流程。

sentences.source: The fourth phase is where DMADV projects begin to diverge substantially from DMAIC projects.
sentences.translation: 第四阶段是 DMADV 项目开始与 DMAIC 项目产生重大分歧的阶段。

sentences.source: The team actually works to design a new process, which does involve some of the solutions testing mentioned above, but also involves mapping, workflow principles, and actively building new infrastructures.
sentences.translation: 该团队实际上致力于设计一个新流程，其中确实涉及上面提到的一些解决方案测试，但也涉及映射、工作流程原则以及积极构建新的基础设施。

sentences.source: That might mean putting new equipment in place, hiring and training new employees, or developing new software tools.
sentences.translation: 这可能意味着安装新设备、雇用和培训新员工或开发新的软件工具。

sentences.source: Teams also start to implement the new systems and processes during the fourth phase.
sentences.translation: 团队还在第四阶段开始实施新的系统和流程。

sentences.source: Phase 5: Control or Verify
sentences.translation: 第五阶段：控制或验证

ch11-s02-dmaic-versus-dmadv-en-017.translation: 对于 DMAIC 和 DMADV 团队来说，控制或验证阶段是解决未解决问题并将项目过渡到日常工作环境的阶段。建立控制和标准是为了维持改进，但这些改进的责任转移到流程所有者。在过渡期间，六西格玛团队可能会与流程所有者及其部门合作，解决改进中的任何问题。

sentences.source: For DMAIC and DMADV teams, the control or verify phase is where loose ends are tied and the project is transitioned to a daily work environment.
sentences.translation: 对于 DMAIC 和 DMADV 团队来说，控制或验证阶段是解决未解决问题并将项目过渡到日常工作环境的阶段。

sentences.source: Controls and standards are established so that improvements can be maintained, but the responsibility for those improvements is transitioned to the process owner.
sentences.translation: 建立控制和标准是为了维持改进，但这些改进的责任转移到流程所有者。

sentences.source: During the transition, the Six Sigma team might work with the process owner and his or her department to troubleshoot any problems with the improvement.
sentences.translation: 在过渡期间，六西格玛团队可能会与流程所有者及其部门合作，解决改进中的任何问题。

sentences.source: Which Methodology Would You Use?
sentences.translation: 您会使用哪种方法？

ch11-s02-dmaic-versus-dmadv-en-019.translation: 考虑以下改进项目。您认为六西格玛团队可能会使用哪种方法来处理每个项目？

sentences.source: Consider the following improvement projects.
sentences.translation: 考虑以下改进项目。

sentences.source: Which methodology do you think a Six Sigma team might use to approach each project?
sentences.translation: 您认为六西格玛团队可能会使用哪种方法来处理每个项目？

ch11-s02-dmaic-versus-dmadv-en-020.translation: 1. 一家企业希望创建一款智能手机应用程序来帮助客户进行和管理预约。 2. 医生办公室收到了大量来自患者的投诉，因为预约太难、预约沟通混乱、或者患者去预约却被告知没有预约。 3. 一家生产披萨盒的公司对小尺寸披萨盒的利润率并不满意。

sentences.translation: 1. 一家企业希望创建一款智能手机应用程序来帮助客户进行和管理预约。

sentences.source: A business wants to create a smartphone app to help customers make and manage appointments.
sentences.translation: 1. 一家企业希望创建一款智能手机应用程序来帮助客户进行和管理预约。
2. 医生办公室收到了大量来自患者的投诉，因为预约太难、预约沟通混乱、或者患者去预约却被告知没有预约。

sentences.source: A doctor’s office has had numerous complaints from patients because it is too hard to get appointments, appointment communications are confusing, or patients show up for appointments and are told they don’t have an appointment.
sentences.translation: 2. 医生办公室收到了大量来自患者的投诉，因为预约太难、预约沟通混乱、或者患者去预约却被告知没有预约。
3. 一家生产披萨盒的公司对小尺寸披萨盒的利润率并不满意。

sentences.source: A company that manufactures pizza boxes isn’t happy with the profit margins in the small size boxes.
sentences.translation: 3. 一家生产披萨盒的公司对小尺寸披萨盒的利润率并不满意。

ch11-s02-dmaic-versus-dmadv-en-021.translation: 处理示例 1 中业务改进的团队将选择 DMADV 方法。他们正在创造一种尚不存在的产品；虽然团队正在满足已经存在的需求并正在改进整个流程（预约的设置），但应用程序本身是一个新流程和新产品。 该应用程序需要进行设计、集成到现有系统中，并在全面实施之前对最终产品进行测试。

sentences.source: The team handling an improvement for the business in example 1 would choose a DMADV approach.
sentences.translation: 处理示例 1 中业务改进的团队将选择 DMADV 方法。

sentences.source: They are creating a product that doesn’t yet exist;
sentences.translation: 他们正在创造一种尚不存在的产品；

sentences.source: while the team is meeting a need that already exists and is improving an overall process – the setting of appointments – the app itself is a new process and a new product.
sentences.translation: 虽然团队正在满足已经存在的需求并正在改进整个流程（预约的设置），但应用程序本身是一个新流程和新产品。

sentences.source: The app will need to be designed, integrated into existing systems, and the final product tested before full implementation.
sentences.translation: 该应用程序需要进行设计、集成到现有系统中，并在全面实施之前对最终产品进行测试。

ch11-s02-dmaic-versus-dmadv-en-022.translation: 示例 2 针对现有流程，因此团队将从 DMAIC 方法开始。团队可能会在此过程中确定一种解决方案是开发新的预约设置软件或用其他供应商的软件替换现有软件。在某些情况下，这可能需要转向 DMADV，但如前所述，并非所有组织都会这样做。一些组织将继续 DMAIC 流程并修改每个阶段的活动以适应当前项目的需求。

sentences.source: Example 2 is for an existing process, so the team would begin with a DMAIC approach.
sentences.translation: 示例 2 针对现有流程，因此团队将从 DMAIC 方法开始。

sentences.source: It’s possible that the team might determine during the process that one solution might be to develop a new appointment-setting software or replace existing software with something from a different vendor.
sentences.translation: 团队可能会在此过程中确定一种解决方案是开发新的预约设置软件或用其他供应商的软件替换现有软件。

sentences.source: In some cases, that might warrant a switch to DMADV, but, as previously stated, not all organizations would do so.
sentences.translation: 在某些情况下，这可能需要转向 DMADV，但如前所述，并非所有组织都会这样做。

sentences.source: Some organizations would continue with the DMAIC process and modify the activities in each phase to fit the needs of the project at hand.
sentences.translation: 一些组织将继续 DMAIC 流程并修改每个阶段的活动以适应当前项目的需求。

ch11-s02-dmaic-versus-dmadv-en-023.translation: 示例 3 是让许多团队采用 DMAIC 方法的经典示例。问题尚未确定，但组织知道目标和期望尚未实现。领导团队可能会与主题专家和一名或多名六西格玛专家合作，在确定一个或多个改进项目之前了解有关流程的更多信息。

sentences.source: Example 3 is a classic example of what brings many teams to the DMAIC method.
sentences.translation: 示例 3 是让许多团队采用 DMAIC 方法的经典示例。

sentences.source: The problem hasn’t yet been defined, but the organization knows that goals and expectations are not being met.
sentences.translation: 问题尚未确定，但组织知道目标和期望尚未实现。

sentences.source: A leadership team might work with subject matter experts and one or more Six Sigma experts to discover more about the processes involved before settling on one or more improvement projects.
sentences.translation: 领导团队可能会与主题专家和一名或多名六西格玛专家合作，在确定一个或多个改进项目之前了解有关流程的更多信息。

ch11-s03-define-en-001.translation: 在六西格玛流程改进项目的定义阶段，团队创建所谓的项目章程和基本工作计划。章程是项目的概要。它提供了一些通用信息以及团队希望完成的任务的摘要。章程通常包含团队成员列表、对结果负责的人员姓名、问题陈述、目标以及成功范围和指标的一些基本定义。一些章程还包括项目的粗略时间表估计。

sentences.source: During the Define phase of a Six Sigma process improvement project, teams create what is known as a project charter and a basic plan for work.
sentences.translation: 在六西格玛流程改进项目的定义阶段，团队创建所谓的项目章程和基本工作计划。

sentences.source: A charter is a synopsis of the project.
sentences.translation: 章程是项目的概要。

sentences.source: It provides some common information and a summary of what the team hopes to accomplish.
sentences.translation: 它提供了一些通用信息以及团队希望完成的任务的摘要。

sentences.source: The charter usually features a list of team members, names of those responsible for outcomes, a problem statement, a goal, and some basic definitions of scope and metrics for success.
sentences.translation: 章程通常包含团队成员列表、对结果负责的人员姓名、问题陈述、目标以及成功范围和指标的一些基本定义。

sentences.source: Some charters also include a rough timeline estimate for the project.
sentences.translation: 一些章程还包括项目的粗略时间表估计。

ch11-s03-define-en-002.translation: 此外，在定义阶段，团队创建或列出可衡量的客户需求，并创建有关流程的高级文档（包括流程图）。通常，团队会从 SIPOC 图开始帮助他们开始理解流程。团队还应该在定义阶段识别利益相关者。利益相关者是组织内部和外部的个人，他们对改进项目的成功具有一定程度的影响。通过了解利益相关者是谁，团队可以在整个项目中与各个人员保持联系，根据需要与这些利益相关者进行沟通，以确保所创建的任何改进的未来可行性。识别利益相关者的一种方法是通过利益相关者分析。

sentences.source: Also during the Define phase, teams create or list measurable customer requirements and create high- level documents about the process (including process maps).
sentences.translation: 此外，在定义阶段，团队创建或列出可衡量的客户需求，并创建有关流程的高级文档（包括流程图）。

sentences.source: Often, teams will start with a SIPOC diagram to help them begin to understand a process.
sentences.translation: 通常，团队会从 SIPOC 图开始帮助他们开始理解流程。

sentences.source: Teams should also identify stakeholders during the Define phase.
sentences.translation: 团队还应该在定义阶段识别利益相关者。

sentences.source: Stakeholders are individuals, both within and without an organization, who have some level of influence on the success of an improvement project.
sentences.translation: 利益相关者是组织内部和外部的个人，他们对改进项目的成功具有一定程度的影响。

sentences.source: By understanding who stakeholders are, teams can remain in contact with various persons throughout the project, communicating with those stakeholders as needed to ensure future viability of any improvement that is created.
sentences.translation: 通过了解利益相关者是谁，团队可以在整个项目中与各个人员保持联系，根据需要与这些利益相关者进行沟通，以确保所创建的任何改进的未来可行性。

sentences.source: One way to identify stakeholders is through a Stakeholder Analysis.
sentences.translation: 识别利益相关者的一种方法是通过利益相关者分析。

ch11-s03-define-en-003.translation: 定义阶段积极行动的技巧

sentences.source: Tips for Positive Movement in the Define Stage
sentences.translation: 定义阶段积极行动的技巧

ch11-s03-define-en-004.translation: 六西格玛团队在项目定义阶段面临的最大挑战之一是产生积极的、有针对性的动力，为项目的其余部分奠定基础。作为六西格玛团队

sentences.source: One of the biggest challenges Six Sigma teams face when in the Define phase of a project is generating positive, targeted momentum that sets the foundation for the rest of the project.
sentences.translation: 六西格玛团队在项目定义阶段面临的最大挑战之一是产生积极的、有针对性的动力，为项目的其余部分奠定基础。

sentences.source: As a Six Sigma team
sentences.translation: 作为六西格玛团队

ch11-s03-define-en-005.translation: 作为领导者，您可以通过在定义阶段让团队尽可能集中注意力来增加成功的机会。首先向可能不熟悉六西格玛和 DMAIC 的辅助团队成员解释六西格玛流程和项目的目的。接下来，作为一个团队工作，制定项目如何运行的基本规则，包括如何组织和管理会议、如何沟通信息以及每个团队成员在项目期间可能负责的工作。

sentences.source: leader, you can increase chances of success by keeping the team as focused as possible during the Define stage.
sentences.translation: 作为领导者，您可以通过在定义阶段让团队尽可能集中注意力来增加成功的机会。

sentences.source: Begin by explaining the Six Sigma process and the purpose of the project for any ancillary team members who may not be familiar with Six Sigma and DMAIC.
sentences.translation: 首先向可能不熟悉六西格玛和 DMAIC 的辅助团队成员解释六西格玛流程和项目的目的。

sentences.source: Next, work as a team to create ground rules for how the project will run – including how meetings are organized and managed, how information will be communicated, and what each team member might be responsible for during the project.
sentences.translation: 接下来，作为一个团队工作，制定项目如何运行的基本规则，包括如何组织和管理会议、如何沟通信息以及每个团队成员在项目期间可能负责的工作。

ch11-s03-define-en-006.translation: 创建章程和项目计划，以便团队有重点关注的事情。如果可能的话，让项目负责人花时间与团队在一起。直接听取执行领导者关于项目的期望和领导层的支持有助于激励团队。同时，确保冠军不会介入接管该项目，因为这不是他或她的职责。

sentences.source: Create a charter and project plan so the team has something to focus on.
sentences.translation: 创建章程和项目计划，以便团队有重点关注的事情。

sentences.source: If possible, have the Champion of the project spend time with the team.
sentences.translation: 如果可能的话，让项目负责人花时间与团队在一起。

sentences.source: Hearing directly from an executive leader about expectations and the support of leadership for the project helps motivate a team.
sentences.translation: 直接听取执行领导者关于项目的期望和领导层的支持有助于激励团队。

sentences.source: At the same time, ensure the Champion doesn’t step in to take over the project, as this isn’t his or her role.
sentences.translation: 同时，确保冠军不会介入接管该项目，因为这不是他或她的职责。

ch11-s03-define-en-007.translation: 定义也是解释抄写员和计时员的角色并讨论头脑风暴的目的的好时机。一些六西格玛的领导喜欢让团队成员轮流主持小组的各种练习，这样可以让每个人更紧密地融入到流程中，并帮助各级团队成员更多地了解六西格玛。

sentences.source: Define is also a good time to explain the roles of scribe and time keeper and talk about the purpose of brainstorming.
sentences.translation: 定义也是解释抄写员和计时员的角色并讨论头脑风暴的目的的好时机。

sentences.source: Some Six Sigma leaders like to let team members take turns facilitating various exercises for the group, as this integrates each person more tightly within the process and helps team members at all levels learn more about Six Sigma.
sentences.translation: 一些六西格玛的领导喜欢让团队成员轮流主持小组的各种练习，这样可以让每个人更紧密地融入到流程中，并帮助各级团队成员更多地了解六西格玛。

ch11-s04-measure-en-001.translation: 一旦团队很好地掌握了流程的作用、工作原理、问题是什么以及项目的目标是什么，团队就会从“定义”转向“衡量”。通常，阶段之间的过渡以收费站审查为标志，其中团队向冠军或六西格玛领导委员会展示其定义工作。冠军或董事会提供反馈并决定团队是否准备好继续进行衡量。

sentences.source: Once a team has a good grasp of what the process does and how it works, what the problem is, and what the goal for the project is, the team moves from Define to Measure.
sentences.translation: 一旦团队很好地掌握了流程的作用、工作原理、问题是什么以及项目的目标是什么，团队就会从“定义”转向“衡量”。

sentences.source: Usually, the transition between phases is marked by a tollgate review wherein the team presents its Define work to a champion or a Six Sigma leadership board.
sentences.translation: 通常，阶段之间的过渡以收费站审查为标志，其中团队向冠军或六西格玛领导委员会展示其定义工作。

sentences.source: The champion or board provides feedback and makes the decision about whether the team is ready to move on to Measure.
sentences.translation: 冠军或董事会提供反馈并决定团队是否准备好继续进行衡量。

ch11-s04-measure-en-002.translation: 在测量阶段，团队负责为流程创建基线指标，并完善问题陈述和定义阶段的其他输出。创建基线指标可以让团队在改进开始之前了解如何衡量流程以及流程的实际执行情况。它还提供了一个比较点，以便团队可以展示他们在 DMAIC 方法结束时为项目带来了多少改进。

sentences.source: During the Measure phase, the team is concerned with creating a baseline metric for the process and refining problem statements and other outputs of the Define stage.
sentences.translation: 在测量阶段，团队负责为流程创建基线指标，并完善问题陈述和定义阶段的其他输出。

sentences.source: Creating a baseline metric lets teams understand how a process should be measured and how the process is really performing before improvements begin.
sentences.translation: 创建基线指标可以让团队在改进开始之前了解如何衡量流程以及流程的实际执行情况。

sentences.source: It also provides a comparison point so teams can show how much improvement they’ve brought to a project at the end of the DMAIC method.
sentences.translation: 它还提供了一个比较点，以便团队可以展示他们在 DMAIC 方法结束时为项目带来了多少改进。

ch11-s04-measure-en-003.translation: 在测量阶段，团队负责为流程创建基线指标，并完善问题陈述和定义阶段的其他输出。创建基线指标可以让团队在改进开始之前了解如何衡量流程以及流程的实际执行情况。它还提供了一个比较点，以便团队可以展示他们在 DMAIC 方法结束时为项目带来了多少改进。

sentences.source: One of the biggest challenges, especially for teams and team members who are new to the Six Sigma method, can be deciding what to measure.
sentences.translation: 在测量阶段，团队负责为流程创建基线指标，并完善问题陈述和定义阶段的其他输出。

sentences.source: Many times, inexperienced teams end up spending time collecting data that doesn’t provide answers or can’t be used for the process.
sentences.translation: 创建基线指标可以让团队在改进开始之前了解如何衡量流程以及流程的实际执行情况。

sentences.source: Because the Measure phase starts with some educated guesswork and trial-and-error, teams and Six Sigma leaders have to keep a close eye on progress and redirect work when measurements are not creating the answers or production required.
sentences.translation: 创建基线指标可以让团队在改进开始之前了解如何衡量流程以及流程的实际执行情况。

ch11-s04-measure-en-004.translation: 在测量阶段，团队负责为流程创建基线指标，并完善问题陈述和定义阶段的其他输出。创建基线指标可以让团队在改进开始之前了解如何衡量流程以及流程的实际执行情况。它还提供了一个比较点，以便团队可以展示他们在 DMAIC 方法结束时为项目带来了多少改进。

sentences.source: A successful Measure phase requires strong observation skills, an understanding of the reasons behind measure, knowledge of data types such as discrete and continuous, tools for measurement assessment, and a strong background in statistical analysis.
sentences.translation: 在测量阶段，团队负责为流程创建基线指标，并完善问题陈述和定义阶段的其他输出。

sentences.source: Some of the tools often deployed in the Measure phase, such as the CTQ tree and sigma level calculation, were covered in previous chapters.
sentences.translation: 在测量阶段，团队负责为流程创建基线指标，并完善问题陈述和定义阶段的其他输出。

ch11-s04-measure-en-005.translation: 在测量阶段，团队负责为流程创建基线指标，并完善问题陈述和定义阶段的其他输出。创建基线指标可以让团队在改进开始之前了解如何衡量流程以及流程的实际执行情况。它还提供了一个比较点，以便团队可以展示他们在 DMAIC 方法结束时为项目带来了多少改进。

sentences.source: Tips for an Effective Measure Phase
sentences.translation: 在测量阶段，团队负责为流程创建基线指标，并完善问题陈述和定义阶段的其他输出。

ch11-s04-measure-en-006.translation: 最大的挑战之一，尤其是对于刚接触六西格玛方法的团队和团队成员来说，可能是决定测量什么。很多时候，缺乏经验的团队最终会花时间收集无法提供答案或无法用于流程的数据。由于测量阶段是从一些有根据的猜测和反复试验开始的，因此团队和六西格玛领导者必须密切关注进展情况，并在测量无法产生所需的答案或生产时重新调整工作方向。

sentences.source: The Measure phase is often the most challenging phase for a Six Sigma team leader, especially when working with teams that are inexperienced in the methodology.
sentences.translation: 最大的挑战之一，尤其是对于刚接触六西格玛方法的团队和团队成员来说，可能是决定测量什么。

sentences.source: When teams start to really dig deep
sentences.translation: 很多时候，缺乏经验的团队最终会花时间收集无法提供答案或无法用于流程的数据。

ch11-s04-measure-en-007.translation: 最大的挑战之一，尤其是对于刚接触六西格玛方法的团队和团队成员来说，可能是决定测量什么。很多时候，缺乏经验的团队最终会花时间收集无法提供答案或无法用于流程的数据。由于测量阶段是从一些有根据的猜测和反复试验开始的，因此团队和六西格玛领导者必须密切关注进展情况，并在测量无法产生所需的答案或生产时重新调整工作方向。

sentences.source: into a process and begin to measure things, they often get a true idea about how challenging the problem really is.
sentences.translation: 最大的挑战之一，尤其是对于刚接触六西格玛方法的团队和团队成员来说，可能是决定测量什么。

sentences.source: They might also have a difficult time understanding how and when to measure things, and collecting data that hasn’t been collected before can be time consuming and tedious.
sentences.translation: 很多时候，缺乏经验的团队最终会花时间收集无法提供答案或无法用于流程的数据。

sentences.source: Because of all these challenges, teams might enter what is called a storming stage—team members question the viability of the project, rail against the Champion or the team leader, complain how much time the project is taking from other duties, or stop showing up to meetings altogether.
sentences.translation: 由于测量阶段是从一些有根据的猜测和反复试验开始的，因此团队和六西格玛领导者必须密切关注进展情况，并在测量无法产生所需的答案或生产时重新调整工作方向。

ch11-s04-measure-en-008.translation: 最大的挑战之一，尤其是对于刚接触六西格玛方法的团队和团队成员来说，可能是决定测量什么。很多时候，缺乏经验的团队最终会花时间收集无法提供答案或无法用于流程的数据。由于测量阶段是从一些有根据的猜测和反复试验开始的，因此团队和六西格玛领导者必须密切关注进展情况，并在测量无法产生所需的答案或生产时重新调整工作方向。

sentences.source: Six Sigma leaders can reduce the impact of storming on a team by demonstrating a calm approach to each aspect of the project and redirecting the strong emotion of storming to more productive work.
sentences.translation: 最大的挑战之一，尤其是对于刚接触六西格玛方法的团队和团队成员来说，可能是决定测量什么。

sentences.source: If you can identify an easy task or problem, letting the team work on that and accomplish something immediately can reduce the excitement of storming;
sentences.translation: 最大的挑战之一，尤其是对于刚接触六西格玛方法的团队和团队成员来说，可能是决定测量什么。

sentences.source: Six Sigma leaders should also ensure work is fairly distributed and that each team member knows exactly what his or her responsibilities are.
sentences.translation: 由于测量阶段是从一些有根据的猜测和反复试验开始的，因此团队和六西格玛领导者必须密切关注进展情况，并在测量无法产生所需的答案或生产时重新调整工作方向。

ch11-s05-analyze-en-001.translation: 一旦测量数据被收集——或正在收集过程中——六西格玛团队通常会进入分析阶段。 同样，收费站审查通常在阶段之间进行，但测量和分析之间的界限通常比定义和测量之间的界限更模糊。在某些情况下，团队必须测量、分析，然后进行更多测量——特别是在流程尚未制定指标的情况下。

sentences.source: Once measurements are collected – or are in the process of being collected – Six Sigma teams usually move on to the Analyze phase.
sentences.translation: 一旦测量数据被收集——或正在收集过程中——六西格玛团队通常会进入分析阶段。

sentences.source: Again, a tollgate review is often conducted between phases, but the lines between Measure and Analyze are often blurrier than the lines between Define and Measure.
sentences.translation: 同样，收费站审查通常在阶段之间进行，但测量和分析之间的界限通常比定义和测量之间的界限更模糊。

sentences.source: In some cases, a team has to measure, analyze, and then measure some more – particularly if metrics aren’t already in place for a process.
sentences.translation: 在某些情况下，团队必须测量、分析，然后进行更多测量——特别是在流程尚未制定指标的情况下。

ch11-s05-analyze-en-002.translation: 分析阶段是团队对流程执行侦查工作的阶段。使用定义和测量阶段收集的线索以及发起人、流程所有者和主题专家提供的信息，团队尝试确定问题的根本原因；他们还使用统计分析和其他工具来验证原因，然后再开始确定可能的解决方案。在分析阶段，团队使用各种工具——其中一些工具已在前面的章节中介绍过。分析阶段常用的工具包括帕累托图、运行图、直方图、因果图、散点图、流程图和价值分析。

sentences.source: Analyze phases are when teams perform detective work on the process.
sentences.translation: 分析阶段是团队对流程执行侦查工作的阶段。

sentences.source: Using the clues gathered during the Define and Measure phases, along with information provided by the sponsor, process owner, and subject matter experts, teams attempt to identify root causes for a problem;
sentences.translation: 使用定义和测量阶段收集的线索以及发起人、流程所有者和主题专家提供的信息，团队尝试确定问题的根本原因；

sentences.source: they also use statistical analysis and other tools to verify causes before turning to the work of identifying possible solutions.
sentences.translation: 他们还使用统计分析和其他工具来验证原因，然后再开始确定可能的解决方案。

sentences.source: During the Analyze phase, teams use a variety of tools – some of which were introduced in earlier chapters.
sentences.translation: 在分析阶段，团队使用各种工具——其中一些工具已在前面的章节中介绍过。

sentences.source: Tools common in the Analyze phase include Pareto charts, run charts, histograms, cause-and- effect diagrams, scatter diagrams, process maps, and value analysis.
sentences.translation: 分析阶段常用的工具包括帕累托图、运行图、直方图、因果图、散点图、流程图和价值分析。

ch11-s05-analyze-en-003.translation: 当团队完成分析阶段时，他们也开始为改进阶段做准备。在分析过程中，团队可能会开始研究可能的解决方案并选择解决方案、制定改进计划并准备一些有关改进工作的基本文档。团队是否在分析期间开始这项工作通常取决于单个项目以及六西格玛团队领导想要进行的方式。六西格玛团队领导应确保团队不会一次性承担太多项目，并且早期改进工作不会降低分析阶段工作的效率。

sentences.source: As teams work through the Analyze phase, they also start preparing for the Improve phase.
sentences.translation: 当团队完成分析阶段时，他们也开始为改进阶段做准备。

sentences.source: During Analyze, teams might begin working on possible solutions and selecting solutions, developing improvement plans, and preparing some basic documentation about improvement work.
sentences.translation: 在分析过程中，团队可能会开始研究可能的解决方案并选择解决方案、制定改进计划并准备一些有关改进工作的基本文档。

sentences.source: Whether a team begins this work during Analyze often depends on the individual project and the manner in which the Six Sigma team leader would like to proceed.
sentences.translation: 团队是否在分析期间开始这项工作通常取决于单个项目以及六西格玛团队领导想要进行的方式。

sentences.source: The Six Sigma team leader should ensure that teams aren’t taking on too much of the project at one time and that working on early Improve work doesn’t reduce the efficacy of the work done for the Analyze phase.
sentences.translation: 六西格玛团队领导应确保团队不会一次性承担太多项目，并且早期改进工作不会降低分析阶段工作的效率。

sentences.source: Team members won’t understand how you came to the conclusions you are presenting, which makes it less likely they will get behind the solution or improvement in a positive way.
