sentences.translation: 3. 单击“插入”>“统计图表”>“更多统计图表”

ch14-s03-graphical-analysis-en-033.translation: 4. 选择“盒子和晶须”，然后单击“确定”。

sentences.translation: 4. 选择“盒子和晶须”，然后单击“确定”。

sentences.source: Select Box and Whisker and click OK.
sentences.translation: 4. 选择“盒子和晶须”，然后单击“确定”。

ch14-s03-graphical-analysis-en-035.translation: 5. 使用普通的 Excel 图表编辑功能，根据需要编辑图表的标题和数据标签。

sentences.translation: 5. 使用普通的 Excel 图表编辑功能，根据需要编辑图表的标题和数据标签。

sentences.source: Using normal Excel chart editing functions, edit the title and data labels of your chart as desired.
sentences.translation: 5. 使用普通的 Excel 图表编辑功能，根据需要编辑图表的标题和数据标签。

ch14-s03-graphical-analysis-en-037.translation: 虽然六西格玛黑带能够通过假设检验或其他分析来支持结论，但经理可能只需要这个箱形图就可以批准她对监视器的请求。很容易看出第二台显示器确实提高了员工的生产能力。另一件值得注意的事情是，每个盒子和晶须的分布是相似的，这在某种程度上是预期的。高生产商的产量仍将最多，而低生产商的产量仍将低于高生产商，即使每个人在新设置下生产的产量略有增加。

sentences.source: While a Six Sigma Black Belt would be able to back up the conclusion with hypothesis testing or other analytics, the manager might get her request for monitors approved with nothing more than this box plot.
sentences.translation: 虽然六西格玛黑带能够通过假设检验或其他分析来支持结论，但经理可能只需要这个箱形图就可以批准她对监视器的请求。

sentences.source: It’s easy to see that the second monitor did increase production capability for staff.
sentences.translation: 很容易看出第二台显示器确实提高了员工的生产能力。

sentences.source: Another thing worth noting is that the distributions for each of the boxes and whiskers is similar, which is somewhat expected.
sentences.translation: 另一件值得注意的事情是，每个盒子和晶须的分布是相似的，这在某种程度上是预期的。

sentences.source: High producers are still going to produce the most, and low producers are still going to produce less than high produces, even if everyone is producing slightly more with the new set-up.
sentences.translation: 高生产商的产量仍将最多，而低生产商的产量仍将低于高生产商，即使每个人在新设置下生产的产量略有增加。

ch14-s03-graphical-analysis-en-038.translation: 请注意，本章中使用的两个示例使用的数据集差异很大，可以在箱线图上直观地看到。情况并非总是如此，这就是为什么箱线图和其他图形表示通常只是分析的起点。

sentences.source: Note that the two examples used in this chapter used data sets that were different enough to be visually noticeable on a box plot.
sentences.translation: 请注意，本章中使用的两个示例使用的数据集差异很大，可以在箱线图上直观地看到。

sentences.source: This isn’t always the case, which is why box plots and other graphical representations are often only the starting point for analysis.
sentences.translation: 情况并非总是如此，这就是为什么箱线图和其他图形表示通常只是分析的起点。

ch14-s04-statistical-analysis-en-001.translation: 假设检验让六西格玛专家根据对样本进行的统计分析得出有关总体的结论。由于结论是基于样本而不是整个总体，因此总是存在一定的错误风险。您可能已经看到或听到过带有正/负的民意调查结果：“60%，正负 2 个百分点，今天会投票给候选人。”该正/负就是错误风险的值。

sentences.source: Because statistical analysis is covered in several future units, this section lists some common statistical analysis tools with definitions.
sentences.translation: 假设检验让六西格玛专家根据对样本进行的统计分析得出有关总体的结论。

ch14-s04-statistical-analysis-en-002.translation: 假设检验让六西格玛专家根据对样本进行的统计分析得出有关总体的结论。由于结论是基于样本而不是整个总体，因此总是存在一定的错误风险。您可能已经看到或听到过带有正/负的民意调查结果：“60%，正负 2 个百分点，今天会投票给候选人。”该正/负就是错误风险的值。

sentences.source: Hypothesis Testing
sentences.translation: 假设检验让六西格玛专家根据对样本进行的统计分析得出有关总体的结论。

ch14-s04-statistical-analysis-en-003.translation: 假设检验让六西格玛专家根据对样本进行的统计分析得出有关总体的结论。由于结论是基于样本而不是整个总体，因此总是存在一定的错误风险。您可能已经看到或听到过带有正/负的民意调查结果：“60%，正负 2 个百分点，今天会投票给候选人。”该正/负就是错误风险的值。

sentences.source: Hypothesis testing lets Six Sigma experts draw conclusions about the population based on statistical analysis performed on a sample.
sentences.translation: 假设检验让六西格玛专家根据对样本进行的统计分析得出有关总体的结论。

sentences.source: Because the conclusions are based on samples and not the entire population, there is always some risk of error.
sentences.translation: 由于结论是基于样本而不是整个总体，因此总是存在一定的错误风险。

sentences.source: You might have seen or heard poll results given with a plus/minus in the result: “60 percent, plus or minus 2 percentage points, would vote for the candidate today.” That plus/minus is the value for the error risk.
sentences.translation: 您可能已经看到或听到过带有正/负的民意调查结果：“60%，正负 2 个百分点，今天会投票给候选人。

ch14-s04-statistical-analysis-en-004.translation: 在统计分析中，样本不能很好地代表总体的风险称为 α 风险和 β 风险。使用有关样本以及 alpha 和 beta 风险的信息，

sentences.source: In statistical analysis, the risk that a sample doesn’t offer a good representation of the population is known as the alpha-risk and the beta-risk.
sentences.translation: 在统计分析中，样本不能很好地代表总体的风险称为 α 风险和 β 风险。

sentences.source: Using information about the sample and alpha and beta risks,
sentences.translation: 使用有关样本以及 alpha 和 beta 风险的信息，

ch14-s04-statistical-analysis-en-005.translation: 统计学家计算所谓的 p 值。 p 值是一种概率估计，它告诉统计学家根据样本数据得出的假设或结论不正确的可能性有多大。

sentences.source: statisticians calculate what is called the p-value.
sentences.translation: 统计学家计算所谓的 p 值。

sentences.source: The p-value is a probability estimate that tells statisticians how likely an assumption or conclusion drawn on sample data will be incorrect.
sentences.translation: p 值是一种概率估计，它告诉统计学家根据样本数据得出的假设或结论不正确的可能性有多大。

ch14-s04-statistical-analysis-en-006.translation: 统计软件消除了设置和运行假设检验过程中的大量手动计算。例如，使用 Minitab，六西格玛专家只需点击几下鼠标即可对准备好的数据进行假设检验。他们必须知道在哪种情况下使用哪种类型的假设检验。

sentences.source: Statistical software removes a lot of the manual calculations from the process of setting up and running hypothesis tests.
sentences.translation: 统计软件消除了设置和运行假设检验过程中的大量手动计算。

sentences.source: With Minitab, for example, Six Sigma experts can conduct hypothesis tests on prepared data with a few mouse clicks.
sentences.translation: 例如，使用 Minitab，六西格玛专家只需点击几下鼠标即可对准备好的数据进行假设检验。

sentences.source: They do have to know which types of hypothesis tests to use in which situations.
sentences.translation: 他们必须知道在哪种情况下使用哪种类型的假设检验。

sentences.source: Correlation and Regression Analysis
sentences.translation: 相关性和回归分析

ch14-s04-statistical-analysis-en-008.translation: 回归和相关分析帮助六西格玛专家了解流程中的变量如何相关。回归分析帮助团队定义一个自变量（可能是输入）和一个因变量（可能是输出）之间的关系。烤箱内的温度与蛋糕是否正确烘烤有关系吗？两者的关系有多密切？一个人的工作时数是否会影响他或她的生产力？团队能否显示出员工临近轮班结束时生产力下降之间的相关性？这些是回归分析可以回答的问题类型。

sentences.source: Regression and correlation analysis helps Six Sigma experts understand how variables within a process might be related.
sentences.translation: 回归和相关分析帮助六西格玛专家了解流程中的变量如何相关。

sentences.source: Regression analysis helps teams define the relationship between one independent variable – possibly an input – and one dependent variable – possibly an output.
sentences.translation: 回归分析帮助团队定义一个自变量（可能是输入）和一个因变量（可能是输出）之间的关系。

sentences.source: Does the temperature in the oven have a relationship to whether the cake is baked correctly, and how close are the two things related?
sentences.translation: 烤箱内的温度与蛋糕是否正确烘烤有关系吗？

sentences.source: Does the number of hours a person works have an impact on his or her productivity – can the team show a correlation between lower production as employees approach the end of a shift?
sentences.translation: 团队能否显示出员工临近轮班结束时生产力下降之间的相关性？

sentences.source: These are the types of questions that regression analysis can answer.
sentences.translation: 这些是回归分析可以回答的问题类型。

ch14-s04-statistical-analysis-en-009.translation: 为了进行回归分析，所研究的两个变量都必须采用数字格式。为了对烤箱温度与蛋糕烘焙是否正确之间的关系进行回归分析，六西格玛团队在不同的温度下烘焙蛋糕，并对蛋糕的“熟度”进行数字评分。 1 分表示蛋糕根本没有煮熟； 5 分表示蛋糕烘焙完美。 10点的时候，蛋糕完全烧焦了。 温度和相应的额定值见下面的数据表。

sentences.source: To work with regression analysis, both of the variables being studied have to be in numerical format.
sentences.translation: 为了进行回归分析，所研究的两个变量都必须采用数字格式。

sentences.source: To conduct a regression analysis regarding the relationship between oven temperature and whether a cake is baked correctly, a Six Sigma team baked cakes at varying temperatures and rated them numerically on “doneness.” A rating of 1 indicated the cake hardly cooked at all;
sentences.translation: 为了对烤箱温度与蛋糕烘焙是否正确之间的关系进行回归分析，六西格玛团队在不同的温度下烘焙蛋糕，并对蛋糕的“熟度”进行数字评分。

sentences.source: a rating of 5 indicated a perfectly baked cake.
sentences.translation: 5 分表示蛋糕烘焙完美。

sentences.source: At 10, the cake was completely burned.
sentences.translation: 10点的时候，蛋糕完全烧焦了。

sentences.source: The temperatures and corresponding ratings are seen in the data table below.
sentences.translation: 温度和相应的额定值见下面的数据表。

ch14-s04-statistical-analysis-en-011.translation: 使用这些数据，团队创建了带有趋势线的散点图，如下所示。

sentences.source: Using this data, the team creates a scatter diagram with a trend line, as seen below.
sentences.translation: 使用这些数据，团队创建了带有趋势线的散点图，如下所示。

ch14-s04-statistical-analysis-en-013.translation: 只要看一下这张图，您就可以看出确实存在某种关系。数据图紧密聚集在趋势线周围，这表明随着温度升高，蛋糕的熟度也会升高。

sentences.source: Just looking at this graph, you can tell that a relationship does exist.
sentences.translation: 只要看一下这张图，您就可以看出确实存在某种关系。

sentences.source: The data plots are gathered tightly around the trend line, which indicates that as temperature rises so does the doneness of the cake.
sentences.translation: 数据图紧密聚集在趋势线周围，这表明随着温度升高，蛋糕的熟度也会升高。

sentences.source: Design of Experiments
sentences.translation: 实验设计

ch14-s04-statistical-analysis-en-015.translation: 相关性和回归分析并不总能提供团队确定变量之间关系所需的信息，尤其是当这些关系复杂或存在多个变量时。由于分析阶段为改进阶段奠定了基础，因此团队在决定实施解决方案之前必须尽可能确定其分析结论。实验设计可以提供该确定性级别所需的更精细的细节和分析。

sentences.source: Correlation and regression analysis doesn’t always provide the information a team needs to determine relationships between variables, especially when those relationships are complex, or multiple variables are present.
sentences.translation: 相关性和回归分析并不总能提供团队确定变量之间关系所需的信息，尤其是当这些关系复杂或存在多个变量时。

sentences.source: Because the analyze phase sets the stage for the improve phase, teams have to be as certain as possible in their analytical conclusions before they decide on solutions for implementation.
sentences.translation: 由于分析阶段为改进阶段奠定了基础，因此团队在决定实施解决方案之前必须尽可能确定其分析结论。

sentences.source: A design of experiments can provide the more granular details and analysis required for that level of certainty.
sentences.translation: 实验设计可以提供该确定性级别所需的更精细的细节和分析。

ch14-s04-statistical-analysis-en-016.translation: 实验设计 (DOE) 通过 Minitab 等统计分析软件进行。团队可以针对一个因素或多个因素设置实验。

sentences.source: Design of experiments, or DoE, is performed via statistical analysis software such as Minitab.
sentences.translation: 实验设计 (DOE) 通过 Minitab 等统计分析软件进行。

sentences.source: Teams can set up experiments for one factor or multiple factors.
sentences.translation: 团队可以针对一个因素或多个因素设置实验。

ch14-s05-analyze-tollgate-checklist-en-0.translation: o 主要根本原因已确定。 o 团队已优先考虑根本原因。 o 冠军或发起人同意进入改进阶段的团队优先事项。 o 在可能的情况下，根本原因假设有统计数据支持。 o 理解流程中变量之间的关系。 o 在可能的情况下，变量关系已通过统计分析得到确认。

sentences.source: o Primary root causes have been identified.
sentences.translation: o 主要根本原因已确定。

sentences.source: o Team has prioritized root causes.
sentences.translation: o 团队已优先考虑根本原因。

sentences.source: o Champion or sponsor agrees with team priorities moving into the improve phase.
sentences.translation: o 冠军或发起人同意进入改进阶段的团队优先事项。

sentences.source: o Where possible, root cause assumptions are backed by statistical data.
sentences.translation: o 在可能的情况下，根本原因假设有统计数据支持。

sentences.source: o Relationships between variables within a process are understood.
sentences.translation: o 理解流程中变量之间的关系。

sentences.source: o Where possible, variable relationships have been confirmed with statistical analysis.
sentences.translation: o 在可能的情况下，变量关系已通过统计分析得到确认。

ch15-s01-improve-en-001.translation: 在DMAIC项目的改进阶段，六西格玛团队针对分析阶段确定的根本原因集思广益，讨论可能的解决方案，并根据成本、解决方案的有效性以及解决方案实施的可能性对这些解决方案进行排名。分析排名用于确定优先级并选择要实施的解决方案。团队通过 Beta 测试或小规模推广来试用解决方案，收集解决方案的数据，并通过统计分析验证解决方案是否按预期工作。一旦团队确信该解决方案能够解决问题，就会计划并实施该解决方案的全面部署。

sentences.source: During the improve phase of a DMAIC project, Six Sigma teams brainstorm possible solutions for the root causes identified in the analyze phase and rank those solutions according to costs, how effective the solution would be, and how likely the solution could be implemented.
sentences.translation: 在DMAIC项目的改进阶段，六西格玛团队针对分析阶段确定的根本原因集思广益，讨论可能的解决方案，并根据成本、解决方案的有效性以及解决方案实施的可能性对这些解决方案进行排名。

sentences.source: Analytical rankings are used to prioritize and select solutions for implementation.
sentences.translation: 分析排名用于确定优先级并选择要实施的解决方案。

sentences.source: Teams pilot solutions through beta tests or small roll outs, collect data on the solution, and verify that the solution is working as expected via statistical analysis.
sentences.translation: 团队通过 Beta 测试或小规模推广来试用解决方案，收集解决方案的数据，并通过统计分析验证解决方案是否按预期工作。

sentences.source: Once the team is confident that the solution works to address the problem, it plans and implements a full rollout of the solution.
sentences.translation: 一旦团队确信该解决方案能够解决问题，就会计划并实施该解决方案的全面部署。

ch15-s02-solutions-selection-matrix-en-0.translation: 解决方案选择矩阵是一种分析工具，可让团队针对分析阶段确定的任何根本原因提出解决方案并对其进行排名。虽然如果发现多个优先根本原因，团队可以同时处理多个解决方案，但黑带和其他团队领导必须始终了解项目的时间表、资源、范围和目的。如果单个解决方案提供了足够的积极影响来实现项目目标，那么可能会保留其他解决方案以供将来的改进项目使用。如果一种解决方案能够取得成果，但另一种解决方案特别容易实施并提供额外的积极成果，那么团队可能会决定同时实施这两种解决方案。

sentences.source: A solutions selection matrix is an analytical tool that lets teams propose and rank solutions for any of the root causes identified in the analyze phase.
sentences.translation: 解决方案选择矩阵是一种分析工具，可让团队针对分析阶段确定的任何根本原因提出解决方案并对其进行排名。

sentences.source: While teams can work simultaneously on multiple solutions if multiple prioritized root causes were found, Black Belt and other team leaders must remain cognizant of timelines, resources, scope, and the purpose of the project.
sentences.translation: 虽然如果发现多个优先根本原因，团队可以同时处理多个解决方案，但黑带和其他团队领导必须始终了解项目的时间表、资源、范围和目的。

sentences.source: If a single solution provides enough positive impact to reach project goals, then other solutions might be saved for future improvement projects.
sentences.translation: 如果单个解决方案提供了足够的积极影响来实现项目目标，那么可能会保留其他解决方案以供将来的改进项目使用。

sentences.source: If one solution would reach results, but another solution would be especially easy to implement and provide additional positive results, the team is likely to decide to implement both.
sentences.translation: 如果一种解决方案能够取得成果，但另一种解决方案特别容易实施并提供额外的积极成果，那么团队可能会决定同时实施这两种解决方案。

ch15-s02-solutions-selection-matrix-en-0.translation: 可以在 Excel 中创建解决方案选择矩阵，团队应以集思广益的方式共同处理该文档。在解决方案集思广益期间，最好让整个团队以及相关主题专家和利益相关者参与其中。这确保了团队提出的解决方案更有可能适合流程和业务；一旦使用矩阵选择解决方案，团队还可能必须获得赞助商、拥护者或领导委员会的支持，然后才能部分或全面实施。当解决方案需要支出或会影响项目范围之外的流程和人员时尤其如此。

sentences.source: A solutions selection matrix can be created in Excel, and teams should work on the document together in a brainstorming capacity.
sentences.translation: 可以在 Excel 中创建解决方案选择矩阵，团队应以集思广益的方式共同处理该文档。

sentences.source: It’s a good idea to include the entire team as well as relevant subject matter experts and stakeholders during solutions brainstorming.
sentences.translation: 在解决方案集思广益期间，最好让整个团队以及相关主题专家和利益相关者参与其中。

sentences.source: This ensures the solutions the team comes up with are more likely to be a realistic fit for the process and business;
sentences.translation: 这确保了团队提出的解决方案更有可能适合流程和业务；

sentences.source: once solutions are selected using the matrix, teams will also likely have to get sponsor, champion, or leadership council support before a partial or full implementation is possible.
sentences.translation: 一旦使用矩阵选择解决方案，团队还可能必须获得赞助商、拥护者或领导委员会的支持，然后才能部分或全面实施。

sentences.source: This is especially true where solutions require expenditure or will impact processes and people outside of the project’s scope.
sentences.translation: 当解决方案需要支出或会影响项目范围之外的流程和人员时尤其如此。

ch15-s02-solutions-selection-matrix-en-0.translation: 解决方案选择矩阵示例如下图所示。

sentences.source: An example solutions selection matrix is pictured below.
sentences.translation: 解决方案选择矩阵示例如下图所示。

ch15-s02-solutions-selection-matrix-en-0.translation: 该矩阵通过以下方式完成：

sentences.source: The matrix is completed by:
sentences.translation: 该矩阵通过以下方式完成：

ch15-s02-solutions-selection-matrix-en-0.translation: 1. 在第一列中输入问题陈述。 如果团队决定该陈述应该是，这应该是在测量阶段达成的最终问题陈述

sentences.translation: 1. 在第一列中输入问题陈述。

sentences.source: Entering the problem statement in the first column.
sentences.translation: 1. 在第一列中输入问题陈述。

sentences.source: This should be the final problem statement that was arrived at during the measure phase if the team decided that the statement should be
sentences.translation: 如果团队决定该陈述应该是，这应该是在测量阶段达成的最终问题陈述

ch15-s02-solutions-selection-matrix-en-0.translation: 收集数据后更改。否则，这可能是定义阶段的问题陈述。 2. 输入分析阶段经过优先级验证的根本原因。如果团队打算在改进阶段尝试解决多个根本原因，则应该为每个根本原因创建一个解决方案选择矩阵。 3. 在第三栏中集思广益潜在的解决方案。在头脑风暴过程中，团队不应质疑或尝试分析解决方案，而应记录任何看似可行的建议解决方案。唯一可能被忽视的解决方案是那些显然超出范围或不可能的解决方案，但领导头脑风暴活动的黑带必须运用他或她自己对此类建议的洞察力。 4. 在很高的层面上注意到可以实施解决方案的实用方法。在分析章节中使用的一个示例中，一家商业面包店因缺乏烘焙说明而出现问题。在这种情况下，六西格玛团队可能会建议向员工提供适当的指示。解决方案的实现方法是书面文档和培训。 5. 评级解决方案。创建可能的解决方案和实用方法的列表后，团队对每种可能性的有效性、可行性和成本效益进行评级。每个类别的评分在 1 到 10 之间。

sentences.source: altered after gathering data.
sentences.translation: 收集数据后更改。

sentences.source: Otherwise, this can be the problem statement from the define phase.
sentences.translation: 否则，这可能是定义阶段的问题陈述。
2. 输入分析阶段经过优先级验证的根本原因。

sentences.source: Entering a priority validated root cause from the analyze phase.
sentences.translation: 2. 输入分析阶段经过优先级验证的根本原因。

sentences.source: If the team is going to attempt to solve more than one root cause during the improve phase, it should create a solutions selection matrix for each root cause.
sentences.translation: 如果团队打算在改进阶段尝试解决多个根本原因，则应该为每个根本原因创建一个解决方案选择矩阵。
3. 在第三栏中集思广益潜在的解决方案。

sentences.source: Brainstorming potential solutions in column three.
sentences.translation: 3. 在第三栏中集思广益潜在的解决方案。

sentences.source: During the brainstorming process, teams should not question or attempt to analyze solutions, but should record any solution suggested that seems at all viable.
sentences.translation: 在头脑风暴过程中，团队不应质疑或尝试分析解决方案，而应记录任何看似可行的建议解决方案。

sentences.source: The only solutions that might be ignored are those that are clearly out of scope or impossible, but the Black Belt leading the brainstorming exercise will have to use his or her own discernment about such suggestions.
sentences.translation: 唯一可能被忽视的解决方案是那些显然超出范围或不可能的解决方案，但领导头脑风暴活动的黑带必须运用他或她自己对此类建议的洞察力。
4. 在很高的层面上注意到可以实施解决方案的实用方法。

sentences.source: Noting, at a very high level, the practical methods by which a solution could be implemented.
sentences.translation: 4. 在很高的层面上注意到可以实施解决方案的实用方法。

sentences.source: In one example used in the analyze chapter, a commercial bakery had a problem that was caused by lack of baking instructions.
sentences.translation: 在分析章节中使用的一个示例中，一家商业面包店因缺乏烘焙说明而出现问题。

sentences.source: In this case, the Six Sigma team might propose that staff be provided with proper instructions.
sentences.translation: 在这种情况下，六西格玛团队可能会建议向员工提供适当的指示。

sentences.source: The method by which that solution occurs is written documentation and training.
sentences.translation: 解决方案的实现方法是书面文档和培训。
5. 评级解决方案。

sentences.source: Rating solutions.
sentences.translation: 5. 评级解决方案。

sentences.source: After a list of possible solutions and practical methods is created, the team rates each possibility on effectiveness, feasibility, and cost-benefit.
sentences.translation: 创建可能的解决方案和实用方法的列表后，团队对每种可能性的有效性、可行性和成本效益进行评级。

sentences.source: Each category is given a rating between 1 and 10.
sentences.translation: 每个类别的评分在 1 到 10 之间。

ch15-s02-solutions-selection-matrix-en-0.translation: a.有效性衡量解决方案消除问题根源的程度，1 表示无效，10 表示非常有效。 b.可行性是实施改进所需努力的衡量标准，1 表示由于所需的努力或资源而不可行，10 表示高度可行。 c.成本效益是对项目成本与预期节省的比较的估计指标。该评级不是正式的成本效益分析，而是高级别的估计。如果预计节省的成本超过与项目相关的成本，团队就会将该解决方案评为最高级别。否则，团队会将解决方案排名较低。 6. 将有效性、可行性和成本效益的分数相乘，计算出总分。总体得分可用于确定解决方案的优先级，并选择具有最佳总体有效性、可行性和成本效益评级的解决方案。

sentences.source: a.
sentences.translation: a.有效性衡量解决方案消除问题根源的程度，1 表示无效，10 表示非常有效。

sentences.source: Effectiveness is the measure of how well a solution will eliminate a root cause for a problem, with 1 being not effective and 10 being highly effective.
sentences.translation: a.有效性衡量解决方案消除问题根源的程度，1 表示无效，10 表示非常有效。

sentences.source: b.
sentences.translation: a.有效性衡量解决方案消除问题根源的程度，1 表示无效，10 表示非常有效。

sentences.source: Feasibility is the measure of effort required to implement the improvement, with 1 being not feasible because of the effort or resources required and 10 being highly feasible.
sentences.translation: b.可行性是实施改进所需努力的衡量标准，1 表示由于所需的努力或资源而不可行，10 表示高度可行。

sentences.source: c.
sentences.translation: c.成本效益是对项目成本与预期节省的比较的估计指标。

sentences.source: Cost-benefit is an estimated measure of how the costs of a project compare to the savings expected.
sentences.translation: c.成本效益是对项目成本与预期节省的比较的估计指标。

sentences.source: This rating is not a formal cost benefit analysis, but is a high-level estimation.
sentences.translation: 该评级不是正式的成本效益分析，而是高级别的估计。

sentences.source: If savings are expected to outweigh the costs associated with a project, the team ranks the solution as high.
sentences.translation: 如果预计节省的成本超过与项目相关的成本，团队就会将该解决方案评为最高级别。

sentences.source: Otherwise, the team ranks the solution low.
sentences.translation: 否则，团队会将解决方案排名较低。
6. 将有效性、可行性和成本效益的分数相乘，计算出总分。

sentences.source: The scores for effectiveness, feasibility, and cost-benefit are multiplied to calculate an overall score.
sentences.translation: 6. 将有效性、可行性和成本效益的分数相乘，计算出总分。

sentences.source: The overall score can be used to prioritize solutions and select the solution that features the best overall effectiveness, feasibility, and cost-benefit rating.
sentences.translation: 总体得分可用于确定解决方案的优先级，并选择具有最佳总体有效性、可行性和成本效益评级的解决方案。

ch15-s02-solutions-selection-matrix-en-0.translation: 考虑根据分析章节中使用的医疗索赔拒绝示例创建的可能的解决方案选择矩阵。

sentences.source: Consider a possible solutions selection matrix created regarding the medical claims denial example used in the analyze chapter.
sentences.translation: 考虑根据分析章节中使用的医疗索赔拒绝示例创建的可能的解决方案选择矩阵。

ch15-s02-solutions-selection-matrix-en-0.translation: 在分析章节中，帕累托分析表明，及时提交问题是索赔被拒率高的根本原因。在上面的解决方案选择矩阵中，团队在发现由于索赔计费人员没有及时获得所有正确信息而未按时提交索赔后，确定了四种可能的解决方案并确定了优先级。

sentences.source: During the analyze chapter, a Pareto analysis indicated that timely filing issues were a root cause for high claims denials.
sentences.translation: 在分析章节中，帕累托分析表明，及时提交问题是索赔被拒率高的根本原因。

sentences.source: In the solutions selection matrix above, a team has identified and prioritized four possible solutions after discovering that claims were not filed on time because claims billing staff didn’t have all the proper information in time.
sentences.translation: 在上面的解决方案选择矩阵中，团队在发现由于索赔计费人员没有及时获得所有正确信息而未按时提交索赔后，确定了四种可能的解决方案并确定了优先级。

ch15-s02-solutions-selection-matrix-en-0.translation: 第一个解决方案是要求前台收集尽可能多的信息。该团队对该解决方案的有效性给予了中等评级，因为它没有解决索赔中仍然可能缺少临床信息的事实。但是，该过程可以有效地收集人口统计信息，并且不需要大量费用或精力来实施，因此团队对其他类别的评价很高。

sentences.source: The first solution is to require the front desk to collect as much information as possible.
sentences.translation: 第一个解决方案是要求前台收集尽可能多的信息。

sentences.source: The team gave this solution a mid-range rating for effectiveness because it doesn’t address the fact that clinical information can still be missing from the claim.
sentences.translation: 该团队对该解决方案的有效性给予了中等评级，因为它没有解决索赔中仍然可能缺少临床信息的事实。

sentences.source: But, the process would be effective at gathering demographic information and would not require large expense or effort to implement, so the team rated it high for the other categories.
sentences.translation: 但是，该过程可以有效地收集人口统计信息，并且不需要大量费用或精力来实施，因此团队对其他类别的评价很高。

ch15-s02-solutions-selection-matrix-en-0.translation: 接下来，团队考虑创建并需要患者电子邮件或门户系统，以便计费人员在信息丢失时可以快速与患者沟通。由于并非所有患者都有电子邮件，而且许多患者不太可能使用这样的系统，因此该团队将该解决方案的可行性和有效性评为较低。

sentences.source: Next, the team considered creating and requiring a patient email or portal system so billing staff could communicate quickly with patients when information was missing.
sentences.translation: 接下来，团队考虑创建并需要患者电子邮件或门户系统，以便计费人员在信息丢失时可以快速与患者沟通。

sentences.source: Because not all patients have email and many would be unlikely to use such a system, the team ranked this solution as low for feasibility and effectiveness.
sentences.translation: 由于并非所有患者都有电子邮件，而且许多患者不太可能使用这样的系统，因此该团队将该解决方案的可行性和有效性评为较低。

ch15-s02-solutions-selection-matrix-en-0.translation: 该团队考虑的第三个解决方案是要求临床医生在就诊患者期间绘制图表时包含计费所需的所有信息。该团队认为这个解决方案相当有效，但临床医生在处理患者问题时不太可能花时间如此彻底。该解决方案还可能会减慢医生就诊的速度，从而对收入产生负面影响。

sentences.source: The third solution considered by the team was requiring clinicians to include all information necessary for billing as they charted during the visit with the patient.
sentences.translation: 该团队考虑的第三个解决方案是要求临床医生在就诊患者期间绘制图表时包含计费所需的所有信息。

sentences.source: The team thought this solution would be fairly effective, but that clinicians would be unlikely to take the time to be so thorough when dealing with patient issues.
sentences.translation: 该团队认为这个解决方案相当有效，但临床医生在处理患者问题时不太可能花时间如此彻底。

sentences.source: The solution might also slow physician visits, resulting in a negative impact to revenue.
sentences.translation: 该解决方案还可能会减慢医生就诊的速度，从而对收入产生负面影响。

ch15-s02-solutions-selection-matrix-en-0.translation: 最后，团队考虑了一个解决方案，让某些工作人员负责信息缺失的索赔。由于这些工作人员可以专注于遗漏的索赔，并通过团队构建的新工作流程进行工作，因此他们更有可能按时提交索赔。总体而言，团队

sentences.source: Finally, the team considered a solution that put certain staff members in charge of claims with missing information.
sentences.translation: 最后，团队考虑了一个解决方案，让某些工作人员负责信息缺失的索赔。

sentences.source: Because those staff members could concentrate on missing claims and would work through a new workflow built by the team, they would be more likely to file claims on time.
sentences.translation: 由于这些工作人员可以专注于遗漏的索赔，并通过团队构建的新工作流程进行工作，因此他们更有可能按时提交索赔。

sentences.source: Overall, the team
sentences.translation: 总体而言，团队

ch15-s02-solutions-selection-matrix-en-0.translation: 该解决方案排名最高，但他们决定同时实施解决方案一和方案四，因为解决方案一只需很少的努力，并且实际上有助于推动解决方案四的成功。

sentences.source: ranked this solution highest, but they decided to implement both solutions one and four because solution one required so little effort and would actually help drive the success of solution four.
sentences.translation: 该解决方案排名最高，但他们决定同时实施解决方案一和方案四，因为解决方案一只需很少的努力，并且实际上有助于推动解决方案四的成功。

ch15-s03-cost-benefit-analysis-en-001.translation: 当团队在流程中包含适当的个人时，解决方案选择矩阵非常擅长识别最佳的实施解决方案。不过，领导委员会和执行发起人通常希望获得有关解决方案预期成本和收益的更多信息，因此团队应该准备好创建成本收益分析。 在测量和分析阶段之后，黑带人员通常拥有此类分析所需的许多要素，但团队可能还需要与会计、财务或业务规划部门合作，以获得所需的准确财务详细信息。

sentences.source: When teams include the appropriate individuals in the process, a solutions selection matrix is very adept at identifying the best possible solutions for implementation.
sentences.translation: 当团队在流程中包含适当的个人时，解决方案选择矩阵非常擅长识别最佳的实施解决方案。

sentences.source: Leadership councils and executive sponsors often want more information about the costs and benefits expected for a solution, though, so teams should be prepared to create a cost benefit analysis.
sentences.translation: 不过，领导委员会和执行发起人通常希望获得有关解决方案预期成本和收益的更多信息，因此团队应该准备好创建成本收益分析。

sentences.source: Black Belts often have many of the elements required for such an analysis after the measure and analyze phases, but teams might also need to work with accounting, finance, or business planning departments to gain accurate financial details required.
sentences.translation: 在测量和分析阶段之后，黑带人员通常拥有此类分析所需的许多要素，但团队可能还需要与会计、财务或业务规划部门合作，以获得所需的准确财务详细信息。

ch15-s03-cost-benefit-analysis-en-002.translation: 成本效益分析的目标是将实施解决方案的成本与解决方案预期的货币效益进行比较。成本包括软件开发或购买、设备购买、建筑开发或翻新、额外劳动力或雇用、培训费用、额外供应品等费用，以及与解决方案实施过程中的中断相关的任何损失。好处可能包括增加产品利润、增加收入、节省或避免成本，以及无形的好处，例如提高员工士气或保留客户。

sentences.source: The goal of a cost benefits analysis is to compare the costs of implementing a solution with the monetary benefits expected from the solution.
sentences.translation: 成本效益分析的目标是将实施解决方案的成本与解决方案预期的货币效益进行比较。

sentences.source: Costs include expenses such as software development or purchase, equipment purchase, building development or renovation, additional labor or hiring, training expenses, additional supplies, and any losses associated with disruption as the solution is implemented.
sentences.translation: 成本包括软件开发或购买、设备购买、建筑开发或翻新、额外劳动力或雇用、培训费用、额外供应品等费用，以及与解决方案实施过程中的中断相关的任何损失。

sentences.source: Benefits might include an increase in product margin, increase in revenue, cost savings or avoidance, and intangible benefits such as increase to staff morale or customer retention.
sentences.translation: 好处可能包括增加产品利润、增加收入、节省或避免成本，以及无形的好处，例如提高员工士气或保留客户。

ch15-s03-cost-benefit-analysis-en-003.translation: 六西格玛团队通常无法处理详细的成本效益分析，例如由注册会计师完成的成本效益分析，但他们可以通过投资回收期分析法创建成本效益关系的概念。这是进行此类分析的最简单方法，并为领导提供项目“获得回报”之前的预计时间。

sentences.source: Six Sigma teams usually aren’t in a position to handle detailed cost benefit analysis such as might be completed by a certified accountant, but they can create an idea of cost benefit relationships via the payback method of analysis.
sentences.translation: 六西格玛团队通常无法处理详细的成本效益分析，例如由注册会计师完成的成本效益分析，但他们可以通过投资回收期分析法创建成本效益关系的概念。

sentences.source: This is the simplest way to approach such an analysis and provides leadership with an estimated time before a project “pays off.”
sentences.translation: 这是进行此类分析的最简单方法，并为领导提供项目“获得回报”之前的预计时间。

sentences.source: Payback, or Pay Off, Analysis
sentences.translation: 回报或回报分析

ch15-s03-cost-benefit-analysis-en-005.translation: 为了进行投资回收分析，六西格玛团队必须估算项目成本以及每年的财务收益。请记住，财务收益不仅仅包括收入的增加。节省成本、新客户或减少客户流失都可以被视为每年带来的收益。团队还需要了解每年改进的预计运营成本。

sentences.source: To conduct a payback analysis, Six Sigma teams must have an estimated cost for the project as well as the estimated financial benefit per year.
sentences.translation: 为了进行投资回收分析，六西格玛团队必须估算项目成本以及每年的财务收益。

sentences.source: Remember, financial benefits don’t just include increases in revenue.
sentences.translation: 请记住，财务收益不仅仅包括收入的增加。

sentences.source: Cost savings, new customers, or mitigation of customer loss can all be considered as contributing to benefits each year.
sentences.translation: 节省成本、新客户或减少客户流失都可以被视为每年带来的收益。

sentences.source: The team also needs to understand the estimated operating costs of an improvement for each year.
sentences.translation: 团队还需要了解每年改进的预计运营成本。

sentences.source: The formula for this analysis is:
sentences.translation: 该分析的公式为：

ch15-s03-cost-benefit-analysis-en-007.translation: （实施解决方案的成本）/（年度经济效益 - 年度成本）

sentences.source: (Cost of implementing solution) / (Annual financial benefits – annual costs)
sentences.translation: （实施解决方案的成本）/（年度经济效益 - 年度成本）

ch15-s03-cost-benefit-analysis-en-008.translation: 如果一个项目的实施成本为 50,000 美元，每年的额外劳动力成本为 2,000 美元，并且团队预计该项目每年产生 15,000 美元的经济效益，则计算结果为：

sentences.source: If a project costs $50,000 to implement and $2,000 per year in extra labor, and the team expects the project to generate $15,000 in financial benefits each year, then the calculation is:
sentences.translation: 如果一个项目的实施成本为 50,000 美元，每年的额外劳动力成本为 2,000 美元，并且团队预计该项目每年产生 15,000 美元的经济效益，则计算结果为：

ch15-s03-cost-benefit-analysis-en-011.translation: 或者，大约需要 3.84 年，项目才能收回成本。

sentences.source: Or, approximately 3.84 years until the project pays for itself.
sentences.translation: 或者，大约需要 3.84 年，项目才能收回成本。

ch15-s03-cost-benefit-analysis-en-012.translation: 显然，组织领导者正在寻求尽可能短的投资回收期计算，但如果解决方案能够解决主要问题或为未来的非凡成功奠定基础，那么较长的投资回收期并不一定会排除解决方案。

sentences.source: Obviously, organizational leaders are looking for payback calculations that are as short as possible, but if the solution will solve a major problem or set a foundation for extraordinary success in the future, a longer payback time doesn’t necessarily keep a solution off the table.
sentences.translation: 显然，组织领导者正在寻求尽可能短的投资回收期计算，但如果解决方案能够解决主要问题或为未来的非凡成功奠定基础，那么较长的投资回收期并不一定会排除解决方案。

sentences.source: Net Present Value
sentences.translation: 净现值

ch15-s03-cost-benefit-analysis-en-014.translation: 计算成本效益的一种更简洁的方法称为净现值（NPV）。 NPV 随着时间的推移调整收益和成本，因为由于通货膨胀和其他经济因素，未来的现金流不如当前的现金流有价值。各种努力的贴现率可以使用预期回报、利率或通货膨胀率来计算。通常，企业财务部门可以为六西格玛团队提供用于公司净现值的折扣率。一个非常基本的 NPV 模型如下所示。

sentences.source: A more concise way of calculating cost benefits is known as the Net Present Value, or NPV.
sentences.translation: 计算成本效益的一种更简洁的方法称为净现值（NPV）。

sentences.source: NPV adjusts benefits and costs as time passes because cash flow in the future is not as valuable as current cash flow due to inflation and other economic factors.
sentences.translation: NPV 随着时间的推移调整收益和成本，因为由于通货膨胀和其他经济因素，未来的现金流不如当前的现金流有价值。

sentences.source: The discount rate for various endeavors can be calculated using expected return, interest rates, or inflation rates.
sentences.translation: 各种努力的贴现率可以使用预期回报、利率或通货膨胀率来计算。

sentences.source: Often, corporate finance departments can provide Six Sigma teams with a discount rate used for NPV in the company.
sentences.translation: 通常，企业财务部门可以为六西格玛团队提供用于公司净现值的折扣率。

sentences.source: A very basic NPV model is shown below.
sentences.translation: 一个非常基本的 NPV 模型如下所示。

ch15-s04-piloting-a-solution-en-001.translation: 一旦选择了解决方案并完成了将其投入生产的最低水平的工作，六西格玛团队就准备好进行试点。试点是在实际环境中对解决方案进行有限的试验。 无论完成了多少分析或测试用例运行得如何，团队都无法确定解决方案如何

sentences.source: Once a solution is selected and work done to bring it into production at a minimal level, the Six Sigma team is ready for a pilot.
sentences.translation: 一旦选择了解决方案并完成了将其投入生产的最低水平的工作，六西格玛团队就准备好进行试点。

sentences.source: A pilot is a limited trial of a solution in a live environment.
sentences.translation: 试点是在实际环境中对解决方案进行有限的试验。

sentences.source: No matter how much analysis was completed or how well test cases were run, teams can’t know for certain how a solution
sentences.translation: 无论完成了多少分析或测试用例运行得如何，团队都无法确定解决方案如何

ch15-s04-piloting-a-solution-en-002.translation: 会在“野外”表现。现场生产环境总是存在团队无法解释的变量，特别是当人们参与该过程时。

sentences.source: will behave in the “wild.” The live production environment will always have variables that teams can’t account for, particularly when people are involved in the process.
sentences.translation: 现场生产环境总是存在团队无法解释的变量，特别是当人们参与该过程时。

sentences.source: Benefits of a limited pilot include:
sentences.translation: 有限试点的好处包括：

ch15-s04-piloting-a-solution-en-004.translation: 资源的使用是有限的，如果解决方案被证明不正确或不能有效解决问题，这可以减少浪费

sentences.source: Use of resources are limited, which reduces waste if the solution turns out to be incorrect or not effective in resolving the problem
sentences.translation: 资源的使用是有限的，如果解决方案被证明不正确或不能有效解决问题，这可以减少浪费

sentences.source: Confirmation that expected results occur
sentences.translation: 确认预期结果发生

ch15-s04-piloting-a-solution-en-006.translation: 允许对新解决方案进行小规模故障排除，以最大程度地减少完整过渡期间的中断

sentences.source: Allows troubleshooting of a new solution on a smaller scale to minimize disruption during full transition
sentences.translation: 允许对新解决方案进行小规模故障排除，以最大程度地减少完整过渡期间的中断

ch15-s04-piloting-a-solution-en-007.translation: 让六西格玛团队之外的员工对解决方案和实施提供反馈，使最终的部署更加成功

sentences.source: Lets employees outside of the Six Sigma team provide feedback on the solution and implementation to make the final rollout more successful
sentences.translation: 让六西格玛团队之外的员工对解决方案和实施提供反馈，使最终的部署更加成功

ch15-s04-piloting-a-solution-en-008.translation: 团队不必尝试他们所做的每一个改变。只要团队很好地记录更改并测量结果以进行验证，就可以在不进行试点的情况下进行简单或小的更改。当变更范围很大、可能导致昂贵或广泛的后果或难以逆转时，团队应该从试点开始。对于全面实施可能成本高昂的任何解决方案来说也是如此。

sentences.source: Teams don’t have to pilot every change they make.
sentences.translation: 团队不必尝试他们所做的每一个改变。

sentences.source: Simple or small changes can be made without piloting as long as teams document the changes well and measure results for verification.
sentences.translation: 只要团队很好地记录更改并测量结果以进行验证，就可以在不进行试点的情况下进行简单或小的更改。

sentences.source: When changes are large in scope, could cause expensive or expansive consequences, or would be difficult to reverse, teams should begin with a pilot.
sentences.translation: 当变更范围很大、可能导致昂贵或广泛的后果或难以逆转时，团队应该从试点开始。

sentences.source: The same is true for any solution that might be expensive to implement at a full scale.
sentences.translation: 对于全面实施可能成本高昂的任何解决方案来说也是如此。

ch15-s04-piloting-a-solution-en-009.translation: 试点可以在有限的规模或有限的时间内进行。有限规模试点包括特定区域、团队、人员或机器。限时试点实施临时变更；在预定时间结束时，团队决定是否应将更改永久化。

sentences.source: Pilots can occur on a limited scale or for a limited time.
sentences.translation: 试点可以在有限的规模或有限的时间内进行。

sentences.source: Limited scale pilots incorporate a specific region, team, group of people, or machinery.
sentences.translation: 有限规模试点包括特定区域、团队、人员或机器。

sentences.source: Limited time pilots implement a temporary change;
sentences.translation: 限时试点实施临时变更；

sentences.source: at the end of a scheduled time, the team makes a decision about whether the change should be made permanent.
sentences.translation: 在预定时间结束时，团队决定是否应将更改永久化。

ch15-s04-piloting-a-solution-en-010.translation: 试点可以针对流程或产品进行。流程试点可能会测试特定位置，与一些客户一起测试结果，与一些员工一起测试新流程，或者在不影响最终用户的情况下进行流程试运行。产品试点是通过测试市场、产品模型或与某些最终用户对产品进行 alpha 和 beta 测试来进行的。

sentences.source: Pilots can occur with either processes or products.
sentences.translation: 试点可以针对流程或产品进行。

sentences.source: Process pilots might feature testing specific locations, testing results with some customers, working with some employees to test new processes, or conducting dry runs of a process without impact to the end-user.
sentences.translation: 流程试点可能会测试特定位置，与一些客户一起测试结果，与一些员工一起测试新流程，或者在不影响最终用户的情况下进行流程试运行。

sentences.source: Product pilots are conducted using test markets, product models, or alpha and beta testing of the product with certain end-users.
sentences.translation: 产品试点是通过测试市场、产品模型或与某些最终用户对产品进行 alpha 和 beta 测试来进行的。

ch15-s04-piloting-a-solution-en-011.translation: 要制作试播集，六西格玛团队必须首先选择试播集的受众。内部流程试点可以由选定的团队或选定的少数员工来执行。可以使用一部分客户来执行外部产品试点。为了获得最佳试点结果，请选择最有可能努力确保产品成功的最佳表现者或客户，以避免结果出现偏差。 当该解决方案全面实施时，它将被每个人使用，因此您需要确保它适用于每个人。

sentences.source: To create a pilot, a Six Sigma team must first select the audience for the pilot.
sentences.translation: 要制作试播集，六西格玛团队必须首先选择试播集的受众。

sentences.source: Internal process pilots can be performed by a select team or a select few employees.
sentences.translation: 内部流程试点可以由选定的团队或选定的少数员工来执行。

sentences.source: External product pilots can be performed using a subset of customers.
sentences.translation: 可以使用一部分客户来执行外部产品试点。

sentences.source: For the best pilot results, avoid biasing results by selecting the best possible performers or customers who are most likely to work hard to ensure a product succeeds.
sentences.translation: 为了获得最佳试点结果，请选择最有可能努力确保产品成功的最佳表现者或客户，以避免结果出现偏差。

sentences.source: When the solution is implemented on a full scale, it will be used by everyone, so you want to ensure it works for everyone.
sentences.translation: 当该解决方案全面实施时，它将被每个人使用，因此您需要确保它适用于每个人。

ch15-s04-piloting-a-solution-en-012.translation: 如果可能，先在很小的范围内进行试点，然后将试点范围扩大到更大的受众。这是 alpha 和 beta 测试背后的前提。一小部分忠实客户首先测试产品，因为您知道他们会提供反馈。接下来，在团队根据第一组用户的反馈进行相关更改后，更多的客户测试产品。最后，如果有限的测试成功，团队就会选择向所有受众推出该产品。

sentences.source: When possible, pilot at a very small level and then expand the pilot to a larger audience.
sentences.translation: 如果可能，先在很小的范围内进行试点，然后将试点范围扩大到更大的受众。

sentences.source: This is the premise behind alpha and beta testing.
sentences.translation: 这是 alpha 和 beta 测试背后的前提。

sentences.source: A very small set of loyal customers tests the product first, because you know they will provide feedback.
sentences.translation: 一小部分忠实客户首先测试产品，因为您知道他们会提供反馈。

sentences.source: Next, an expanded set of customers tests the product after teams have made changes associated with feedback from the first group of users.
sentences.translation: 接下来，在团队根据第一组用户的反馈进行相关更改后，更多的客户测试产品。

sentences.source: Finally, if the limited tests are successful, teams choose to roll out the product to the entire audience.
sentences.translation: 最后，如果有限的测试成功，团队就会选择向所有受众推出该产品。

sentences.source: Analyze Pilot and Test Results
sentences.translation: 分析试点和测试结果

ch15-s04-piloting-a-solution-en-014.translation: 六西格玛专家可以使用与分析阶段相关的所有工具来测试解决方案在测试或试点项目期间是否产生积极影响。假设检验可用于比较解决方案之前的数据与解决方案之后的数据，确定是否存在统计上显着且积极的变化。图形分析非常有助于向执行领导者展示解决方案如何通过减少缺陷、提高产量或效率或降低成本来对问题产生积极影响。

sentences.source: Six Sigma experts can use all the tools associated with the analyze phase to test whether solutions have a positive impact during testing or pilot programs.
sentences.translation: 六西格玛专家可以使用与分析阶段相关的所有工具来测试解决方案在测试或试点项目期间是否产生积极影响。

sentences.source: Hypothesis testing can be used to compare data from before the solution to data after the solution, determining if there is a statistically significant and positive change.
sentences.translation: 假设检验可用于比较解决方案之前的数据与解决方案之后的数据，确定是否存在统计上显着且积极的变化。

sentences.source: Graphical analysis can be very helpful in demonstrating for executive leaders how a solution has positively impacted a problem by reducing defects, improving production or efficiency, or reducing costs.
sentences.translation: 图形分析非常有助于向执行领导者展示解决方案如何通过减少缺陷、提高产量或效率或降低成本来对问题产生积极影响。

ch15-s05-planning-implementation-en-001.translation: 一旦解决方案通过测试和分析得到验证，团队就可以开始大规模实施变更的工作。在 DMAIC 流程的这一重要而活跃的阶段，团队应制定并执行行动计划，以确保没有任何计划或要求被遗漏。在改进阶段的积极部分，项目负责人可能会将大量活动委托给团队成员，并且团队还将依赖六西格玛团队之外的人员的投入和帮助。保留行动计划文档可以帮助团队中的每个人了解他们在流程中的位置、他们负责什么以及工作必须在什么日期之前完成。

sentences.source: Once solutions have been verified through tests and analysis, teams can begin the work of implementing changes on a large scale.
sentences.translation: 一旦解决方案通过测试和分析得到验证，团队就可以开始大规模实施变更的工作。

sentences.source: Teams should create and work from an action plan during this vital and active stage of the DMAIC process to ensure that no plans or requirements fall through the cracks.
sentences.translation: 在 DMAIC 流程的这一重要而活跃的阶段，团队应制定并执行行动计划，以确保没有任何计划或要求被遗漏。

sentences.source: During the active part of the improve phase, the project leader will likely delegate numerous activities to members of the team, and the team will also rely on input and assistance from those outside of the Six Sigma team.
sentences.translation: 在改进阶段的积极部分，项目负责人可能会将大量活动委托给团队成员，并且团队还将依赖六西格玛团队之外的人员的投入和帮助。

sentences.source: Keeping an action plan document helps everyone on the team see where they are in the process, what they are responsible for, and what date work must be completed by.
sentences.translation: 保留行动计划文档可以帮助团队中的每个人了解他们在流程中的位置、他们负责什么以及工作必须在什么日期之前完成。

ch15-s05-planning-implementation-en-002.translation: 如果六西格玛团队与项目经理合作，他或她可能负责行动计划的文件记录和后续工作。团队还可以使用基本的电子表格或 Word 文档（应保存在公共位置）来跟踪要完成的工作以及由谁来完成。

sentences.source: If the Six Sigma team is working with a project manager, he or she is likely responsible for action plan documentation and follow-up.
sentences.translation: 如果六西格玛团队与项目经理合作，他或她可能负责行动计划的文件记录和后续工作。

sentences.source: Teams can also use a basic spreadsheet or Word document, which should be saved in a common location, to keep track of what work is to be done and who will do it.
sentences.translation: 团队还可以使用基本的电子表格或 Word 文档（应保存在公共位置）来跟踪要完成的工作以及由谁来完成。

ch15-s05-planning-implementation-en-003.translation: 由于每个项目都是独一无二的，因此改进行动计划也是独一无二的。大多数行动计划将包含常见任务，例如文档、培训和过渡。

sentences.source: Because every project is unique, improve action plans are also unique.
sentences.translation: 由于每个项目都是独一无二的，因此改进行动计划也是独一无二的。

sentences.source: Most action plans will contain common tasks such as documentation, training, and transition.
sentences.translation: 大多数行动计划将包含常见任务，例如文档、培训和过渡。

sentences.source: Documentation
sentences.translation: 文档

ch15-s05-planning-implementation-en-005.translation: 首先，六西格玛团队应该记录 DMAIC 流程中迄今为止的所有工作。如果被要求，黑带或指定的团队成员应该能够以数据表格、统计计算和解释以及图形分析的形式进行分析。所有头脑风暴活动和图表都应保存在一个中央文件位置，所有团队成员都可以在其中查看它们，并且适当的团队成员可以根据需要对其进行编辑。访问这些文档有助于团队成员有效地处理实施所需的其他文档。

sentences.source: First, the Six Sigma team should have documented all of its work so far during the DMAIC process.
sentences.translation: 首先，六西格玛团队应该记录 DMAIC 流程中迄今为止的所有工作。

sentences.source: If asked, the Black Belt or designated team member should be able to present analysis in the form of data tables, statistical calculations and explanations, and graphical analysis.
sentences.translation: 如果被要求，黑带或指定的团队成员应该能够以数据表格、统计计算和解释以及图形分析的形式进行分析。

sentences.source: All brainstorming activities and diagrams should be saved in a central file location where all team members can view them and appropriate team members can edit them as needed.
sentences.translation: 所有头脑风暴活动和图表都应保存在一个中央文件位置，所有团队成员都可以在其中查看它们，并且适当的团队成员可以根据需要对其进行编辑。

sentences.source: Access to these documents helps team members work efficiently on additional documentation required for implementation.
sentences.translation: 访问这些文档有助于团队成员有效地处理实施所需的其他文档。

ch15-s05-planning-implementation-en-006.translation: 几乎所有组织都需要将新流程或流程变更记录在标准操作程序中。根据企业的组织结构，六西格玛团队可能负责起草此类文件，或者他们可能需要与知识管理资源合作来创建与企业品牌和模板保持一致的SOP。团队还可以创建一般性沟通，让其他员工了解即将发生的变化和这些变化的原因，以及一般参考文档，例如备忘单和常见问题解答。

sentences.source: Almost any organization will require new processes or changes to processes to be recorded in standard operating procedures.
sentences.translation: 几乎所有组织都需要将新流程或流程变更记录在标准操作程序中。

sentences.source: Depending on the organizational structure of a business, Six Sigma teams might be responsible for drafting such documents or they might need to work with knowledge management resources to create SOPs in keeping with corporate branding and templates.
sentences.translation: 根据企业的组织结构，六西格玛团队可能负责起草此类文件，或者他们可能需要与知识管理资源合作来创建与企业品牌和模板保持一致的SOP。

sentences.source: Teams might also create general communications letting other staff members know about the upcoming changes and the reasons for those changes as well as general reference documents such as cheat sheets and Frequently Asked Questions.
sentences.translation: 团队还可以创建一般性沟通，让其他员工了解即将发生的变化和这些变化的原因，以及一般参考文档，例如备忘单和常见问题解答。

sentences.source: Training
sentences.translation: 培训

ch15-s05-planning-implementation-en-008.translation: 强大的文档是实施改进的下一部分（即员工培训）的关键。 六西格玛团队通常不负责对他们所做的任何改进进行完整的员工培训。相反，团队通过与受即将发生的变化影响的部门中的培训主题专家或代表合作来开始培训过程。六西格玛团队培训这些人，然后他们继续培训其他将受到该过程影响的人。在某些时候，过程培训应该被培训师或知识管理部门纳入定期的组织培训中。

sentences.source: Strong documentation is key to the next part of implementing improvements, which is staff training.
sentences.translation: 强大的文档是实施改进的下一部分（即员工培训）的关键。

sentences.source: Six Sigma teams usually aren’t in charge of complete staff training on any improvement they make.
sentences.translation: 六西格玛团队通常不负责对他们所做的任何改进进行完整的员工培训。

sentences.source: Instead, teams begin the training process by working with training subject matter experts or delegates in the department impacted by the upcoming changes.
sentences.translation: 相反，团队通过与受即将发生的变化影响的部门中的培训主题专家或代表合作来开始培训过程。

sentences.source: The Six Sigma team trains these individuals, who then go on to train other individuals who will be impacted by the process.
sentences.translation: 六西格玛团队培训这些人，然后他们继续培训其他将受到该过程影响的人。

sentences.source: At some point, the process training should be integrated into regular organizational training by trainers or knowledge management departments.
sentences.translation: 在某些时候，过程培训应该被培训师或知识管理部门纳入定期的组织培训中。

sentences.source: Transition
sentences.translation: 过渡

ch15-s05-planning-implementation-en-010.translation: 在 DMAIC 项目的改进阶段，团队应开始考虑将流程移交回业务和传统流程所有者的必要性。过渡是控制阶段的一部分，但团队应该从改进转向控制，并充分了解流程应该如何进行

sentences.source: During the improve phase of a DMAIC project, teams should begin to consider the need to transition a process back to the business and traditional process owner.
sentences.translation: 在 DMAIC 项目的改进阶段，团队应开始考虑将流程移交回业务和传统流程所有者的必要性。

sentences.source: Transition is part of the control phase, but teams should move from improve to control with a good understanding of how the process should be
sentences.translation: 过渡是控制阶段的一部分，但团队应该从改进转向控制，并充分了解流程应该如何进行

ch15-s05-planning-implementation-en-011.translation: 测量和监测。改进阶段的强大文档和培训有助于巩固控制阶段的成功。

sentences.source: measured and monitored.
sentences.translation: 测量和监测。

sentences.source: Strong documentation and training during the improve phase helps cement the success of the control phase.
sentences.translation: 改进阶段的强大文档和培训有助于巩固控制阶段的成功。

ch15-s06-improve-tollgate-checklist-en-0.translation: o 对解决方案进行审查并确定优先级。 o 选择一两个最佳解决方案来实施。 o 解决方案的实施是有限的。 o 对有限试验的数据进行了分析，解决方案似乎按预期发挥作用。 o 进行了成本效益分析。 o 发起人、支持者或执行指导委员会签署完全实施该解决方案。 o 所有团队成员都同意应该实施该解决方案。 o 该解决方案通过 SOP 和培训材料进行了完整记录。 o 关键员工接受了有关解决方案的培训，并准备将培训传授给其他人。

sentences.source: o Solutions were reviewed and prioritized.
sentences.translation: o 对解决方案进行审查并确定优先级。

sentences.source: o One or two top solutions were selected for action.
sentences.translation: o 选择一两个最佳解决方案来实施。

sentences.source: o Solutions were implemented on a limited basis.
sentences.translation: o 解决方案的实施是有限的。

sentences.source: o Data from limited trials was analyzed and solutions appear to work as expected.
sentences.translation: o 对有限试验的数据进行了分析，解决方案似乎按预期发挥作用。

sentences.source: o Cost-benefits analysis was performed.
sentences.translation: o 进行了成本效益分析。

sentences.source: o Sponsor, champion, or executive steering committee signed off on implementing the solution completely.
sentences.translation: o 发起人、支持者或执行指导委员会签署完全实施该解决方案。

sentences.source: o All team members agree the solution should be implemented.
sentences.translation: o 所有团队成员都同意应该实施该解决方案。

sentences.source: o The solution is fully documented through SOPs and training materials.
sentences.translation: o 该解决方案通过 SOP 和培训材料进行了完整记录。

sentences.source: o Critical staff received training on the solution and are prepared to pass that training on to others.
sentences.translation: o 关键员工接受了有关解决方案的培训，并准备将培训传授给其他人。

ch16-s01-control-en-001.translation: DMAIC 项目的最后阶段是控制。在控制阶段，团队构建监视器，以确保在常规业务流程中实施变更后流程继续成功运行。与此同时，六西格玛团队致力于将流程交还给流程所有者。

sentences.source: The last stage of a DMAIC project is control.
sentences.translation: DMAIC 项目的最后阶段是控制。

sentences.source: During the control phase, teams build monitors that let them ensure the process continues to work successfully after changes are implemented across the regular business process.
sentences.translation: 在控制阶段，团队构建监视器，以确保在常规业务流程中实施变更后流程继续成功运行。

sentences.source: At the same time, Six Sigma teams work to transition the process back to the process owner.
sentences.translation: 与此同时，六西格玛团队致力于将流程交还给流程所有者。

ch16-s01-control-en-002.translation: 到目前为止，DMAIC流程中，六西格玛团队一直在使用统计分析工具，并有黑带或其他六西格玛专家在场，带领团队成员进行分析和解读。虽然许多组织对流程所有者和其他员工进行六西格玛基础知识培训，但流程所有者及其团队并不总是熟悉六西格玛专家一直在使用的统计控制。因此，可能需要通过控制计划和有关控制图等工具的教育进行适当的记录，以确保业务团队能够维护流程并确定流程何时失控并需要补救。

sentences.source: Up until this point in the DMAIC process, Six Sigma teams have worked with statistical analysis tools, and a Black Belt or other Six Sigma expert has been present to walk team members through analysis and interpretation.
sentences.translation: 到目前为止，DMAIC流程中，六西格玛团队一直在使用统计分析工具，并有黑带或其他六西格玛专家在场，带领团队成员进行分析和解读。

sentences.source: While many organizations train process owners and other employees in Six Sigma fundamentals, it isn’t always true that a process owner and his or her team will be familiar with the statistical controls that Six Sigma experts have been using.
sentences.translation: 虽然许多组织对流程所有者和其他员工进行六西格玛基础知识培训，但流程所有者及其团队并不总是熟悉六西格玛专家一直在使用的统计控制。

sentences.source: Because of that, appropriate documentation via a control plan and education regarding tools such as control charts might be necessary to ensure business teams can maintain a process and identify when it is out of control and needs remediation.
sentences.translation: 因此，可能需要通过控制计划和有关控制图等工具的教育进行适当的记录，以确保业务团队能够维护流程并确定流程何时失控并需要补救。

ch16-s02-revise-fmea-en-001.translation: 此时，六西格玛团队可能需要重新审视最初在第13章中介绍的FMEA工具。六西格玛团队最初使用故障模式和影响分析来识别过程中的潜在故障以及这些故障的原因。在第13章中，我们讨论了FMEA如何列出潜在的故障点，并根据严重程度、发生情况和检测情况对它们进行排序，计算总风险优先级数。

sentences.source: At this time, Six Sigma teams might want to revisit the FMEA tool originally introduced in chapter 13.
sentences.translation: 此时，六西格玛团队可能需要重新审视最初在第13章中介绍的FMEA工具。

sentences.source: Six Sigma teams initially use the Failure Modes and Effect Analysis to identify potential failures in a process and causes of those failures.
sentences.translation: 六西格玛团队最初使用故障模式和影响分析来识别过程中的潜在故障以及这些故障的原因。

sentences.source: In chapter 13, we discussed how the FMEA listed potential failure points and ranked them according to severity, occurrence, and detection, calculating a total risk priority number.
sentences.translation: 在第13章中，我们讨论了FMEA如何列出潜在的故障点，并根据严重程度、发生情况和检测情况对它们进行排序，计算总风险优先级数。

ch16-s02-revise-fmea-en-002.translation: 在改进阶段结束或控制阶段开始时，六西格玛团队应重新审视 FMEA，记录已完成的建议行动，并重新计算改进过程的风险优先级编号。重新审视 FMEA 有两个原因。首先，团队能够看到由于改进阶段采用的解决方案而发生了积极且重大的变化。对于与所实施的解决方案相匹配的任何根本原因，团队希望看到更小的风险优先级数字。

sentences.source: At the end of the improve phase or beginning of the control phase, Six Sigma teams should revisit the FMEA, noting what recommended actions were completed and recalculating risk priority numbers for the improved process.
sentences.translation: 在改进阶段结束或控制阶段开始时，六西格玛团队应重新审视 FMEA，记录已完成的建议行动，并重新计算改进过程的风险优先级编号。

sentences.source: There are two reasons for revisiting the FMEA.
sentences.translation: 重新审视 FMEA 有两个原因。

sentences.source: First, the team is able to see that positive and significant changes have occurred because of the solutions adapted during the improve phase.
sentences.translation: 首先，团队能够看到由于改进阶段采用的解决方案而发生了积极且重大的变化。

sentences.source: For any root cause that matched a solution implemented, the team would hope to see a smaller risk priority number.
sentences.translation: 对于与所实施的解决方案相匹配的任何根本原因，团队希望看到更小的风险优先级数字。

ch16-s02-revise-fmea-en-003.translation: 其次，更新的 FMEA 可以帮助团队识别下一个可能需要解决的问题或根本原因。请记住，六西格玛是一项持续改进的举措。团队可能已经实施了解决方案并达到了改进目标，但始终可以进行进一步的改进。控制是审查流程并为未来项目提出可能的改进建议的时间。

sentences.source: Second, an updated FMEA helps the team identify the next problem or root cause that might be addressed.
sentences.translation: 其次，更新的 FMEA 可以帮助团队识别下一个可能需要解决的问题或根本原因。

sentences.source: Remember, Six Sigma is a continuous improvement initiative.
sentences.translation: 请记住，六西格玛是一项持续改进的举措。

sentences.source: The team might have implemented a solution and met an improvement goal, but further improvements can always be made.
sentences.translation: 团队可能已经实施了解决方案并达到了改进目标，但始终可以进行进一步的改进。

sentences.source: Control is a time to review the process and suggest possible improvements for future projects.
sentences.translation: 控制是审查流程并为未来项目提出可能的改进建议的时间。

ch16-s03-create-a-control-plan-en-001.translation: 为了促进持续成功，六西格玛团队应为流程所有者制定书面控制计划。控制计划的目的是帮助流程所有者和业务团队跟踪和响应关键绩效指标，以便流程不断得到改进。控制计划应该是一份简洁、易于参考的文档，告诉业务团队何时进行监控、如何监控、监控者可接受的数据范围以及如果测量的范围不可接受时如何采取纠正措施。

sentences.source: To facilitate continued success, Six Sigma teams should create a written control plan for the process owner.
sentences.translation: 为了促进持续成功，六西格玛团队应为流程所有者制定书面控制计划。

sentences.source: The purpose of a control plan is to help the process owner and business team track and respond to key performance indicators so that the process remains improved.
sentences.translation: 控制计划的目的是帮助流程所有者和业务团队跟踪和响应关键绩效指标，以便流程不断得到改进。

sentences.source: The control plan should be a concise, easy-to-reference document that tells the business team when to monitor, how to monitor, what range of data is acceptable to the monitor, and how to respond with corrective action if the range measured is not acceptable.
sentences.translation: 控制计划应该是一份简洁、易于参考的文档，告诉业务团队何时进行监控、如何监控、监控者可接受的数据范围以及如果测量的范围不可接受时如何采取纠正措施。

ch16-s03-create-a-control-plan-en-002.translation: 控制计划可以是电子表格、专门的数字文档或张贴在工作站上的硬拷贝文档。控制计划的常见要素包括：

sentences.source: Control plans can be spreadsheets, specialized digital documents, or hard-copy documents posted at a work station.
sentences.translation: 控制计划可以是电子表格、专门的数字文档或张贴在工作站上的硬拷贝文档。

sentences.source: Common elements of a control plan include:
sentences.translation: 控制计划的常见要素包括：

sentences.source: Company, division, or department name
sentences.translation: 公司、部门或部门名称

ch16-s03-create-a-control-plan-en-004.translation: 创建该计划的人的姓名

sentences.source: Name of person who created the plan
sentences.translation: 创建该计划的人的姓名

sentences.source: Date the plan was created
sentences.translation: 计划创建日期

ch16-s03-create-a-control-plan-en-006.translation: 最后编辑该计划的人员姓名

sentences.source: Name of the person who last edited the plan
sentences.translation: 最后编辑该计划的人员姓名

sentences.source: Date the plan was last edited
sentences.translation: 上次编辑计划的日期

ch16-s03-create-a-control-plan-en-008.translation: 项目和/或流程名称或标识符

sentences.source: Project and/or process name or identifier
sentences.translation: 项目和/或流程名称或标识符

sentences.source: Process owner
sentences.translation: 流程所有者

ch16-s03-create-a-control-plan-en-010.translation: 需要控制操作的过程步骤列表

sentences.source: List of process steps where control action is required
sentences.translation: 需要控制操作的过程步骤列表

ch16-s03-create-a-control-plan-en-011.translation: 与所需的每项操作相关的 CTQ 或指标

sentences.source: CTQ or metric associated with each action required
sentences.translation: 与所需的每项操作相关的 CTQ 或指标

ch16-s03-create-a-control-plan-en-012.translation: 限制规格或可接受的测量范围

sentences.source: Limit specifications, or the acceptable range of measurements
sentences.translation: 限制规格或可接受的测量范围

sentences.source: The unit of measurement
sentences.translation: 计量单位

sentences.source: The method of measurement
sentences.translation: 测量方法

sentences.source: The necessary sample size
sentences.translation: 必要的样本量

sentences.source: The frequency of measurement
sentences.translation: 测量频率

sentences.source: The person responsible for measurement
sentences.translation: 测量负责人

sentences.source: Where the information is recorded
sentences.translation: 信息记录在哪里

sentences.source: Correction actions
sentences.translation: 纠正措施

sentences.source: Associated policy and procedure documents
sentences.translation: 相关政策和程序文件

ch16-s03-create-a-control-plan-en-021.translation: 在第 8 章讨论质量时，我们介绍了一家生产巧克力棒的公司的例子，并指出巧克力棒配方中的糖含量对于客户对最终产品的体验至关重要。如果六西格玛团队的任务是提高客户对新巧克力棒产品的满意度，他们可能会实施一种解决方案，确保在正确的温度下将适量的糖添加到混合物中，以适当地混合成分。

sentences.source: In discussing quality in chapter 8, we introduced the example of a company that makes chocolate bars and noted that the amount of sugar in the chocolate bar recipe was critical to the customer’s experience with the end product.
sentences.translation: 在第 8 章讨论质量时，我们介绍了一家生产巧克力棒的公司的例子，并指出巧克力棒配方中的糖含量对于客户对最终产品的体验至关重要。

sentences.source: If a Six Sigma team were tasked with improving customer satisfaction with a new chocolate bar product, they might have implemented a solution that ensures the proper amount of sugar is added to the mixture at the right temperature to incorporate the ingredient appropriately.
sentences.translation: 如果六西格玛团队的任务是提高客户对新巧克力棒产品的满意度，他们可能会实施一种解决方案，确保在正确的温度下将适量的糖添加到混合物中，以适当地混合成分。

ch16-s03-create-a-control-plan-en-022.translation: 新巧克力棒解决方案的控制计划可能类似于下面的文档。

sentences.source: A control plan for the new chocolate bar solution might look something like the document below.
sentences.translation: 新巧克力棒解决方案的控制计划可能类似于下面的文档。
