sentences.translation: I-MR图

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 当您不将数据分组为子组时，将使用 I-MR（个体和移动极差）图表。收集足够的样本进行分组是不可行的，或者由于某种原因在数据点级别查看图表很重要。

sentences.source: The I-MR (individual and moving range) chart is used when you aren’t grouping data into subgroups.
sentences.translation: 当您不将数据分组为子组时，将使用 I-MR（个体和移动极差）图表。

sentences.source: Either it isn’t feasible to gather enough samples for subgrouping or it is important for some reason to view the chart at the data-point level.
sentences.translation: 收集足够的样本进行分组是不可行的，或者由于某种原因在数据点级别查看图表很重要。

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 例如，一家中型汽车经销商想要衡量每天完成的销售数量。 大多数汽车经销商每天不会完成数百笔销售，因此每小时或批量跟踪不会为单月数据提供太多信息。如果查看一年的数据，经销商可能会按周进行分组；否则，I-MR 图是一个不错的选择。

sentences.source: For example, a medium-sized car dealership wants to measure the number of sales closed on a daily basis.
sentences.translation: 例如，一家中型汽车经销商想要衡量每天完成的销售数量。

sentences.source: Most car dealers aren’t closing hundreds of sales a day, so tracking per hour or in batch sizes won’t provide much information for data in a single month.
sentences.translation: 大多数汽车经销商每天不会完成数百笔销售，因此每小时或批量跟踪不会为单月数据提供太多信息。

sentences.source: If looking at a year’s worth of data, the dealership might subgroup by week;
sentences.translation: 如果查看一年的数据，经销商可能会按周进行分组；

sentences.source: otherwise, the I-MR chart is a good option.
sentences.translation: 否则，I-MR 图是一个不错的选择。

sentences.source: Test Failed at points: 16
sentences.translation: 测试失败点：16

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 在这种特殊情况下，顶部单独图表中描绘的每月销售数量处于控制范围内。移动极差（每天的数字之间有多少变化）受到控制，但点 16 除外。如果查看数据，您会发现点 16 和点 17 之间存在 8 销售差异。这是日常数据点差异最大的点，这可能是测试失败的原因。

sentences.source: In this particular case, the number of sales per month, which is depicted on the top individual chart, are within control.
sentences.translation: 在这种特殊情况下，顶部单独图表中描绘的每月销售数量处于控制范围内。

sentences.source: The moving range – how much change there is between the numbers for each day – is in control except for point 16.
sentences.translation: 移动极差（每天的数字之间有多少变化）受到控制，但点 16 除外。

sentences.source: If you look at the data, you see that between point 16 and point 17, there is an 8-sale difference.
sentences.translation: 如果查看数据，您会发现点 16 和点 17 之间存在 8 销售差异。

sentences.source: This is the point with the biggest difference in day-to-day data points, which likely accounts for the test failure.
sentences.translation: 这是日常数据点差异最大的点，这可能是测试失败的原因。

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 处理这些数据的汽车经销商或六西格玛团队可能不会太在意这一点。当你从实际角度考虑时，可能是一些前一天开始的销售没有结束，这人为地增加了当天的数量，并导致价差突然超出正常水平。在这种情况下，经销商或六西格玛团队只需记下这一点，并密切关注控制图，以防止将来发生类似的测试失败，这些失败可能表明流程中存在某种类型的模式或问题。

sentences.source: A car dealership or Six Sigma team working with this data would probably not be too concerned about that one point.
sentences.translation: 处理这些数据的汽车经销商或六西格玛团队可能不会太在意这一点。

sentences.source: When you consider it in practical terms, it could be that some sales that might have begun the day before didn’t close, which bumped up the day’s numbers artificially and caused the sudden wider-than-normal spread.
sentences.translation: 当你从实际角度考虑时，可能是一些前一天开始的销售没有结束，这人为地增加了当天的数量，并导致价差突然超出正常水平。

sentences.source: In this case, the dealership or Six Sigma team would simply note the point and keep an eye on the control chart for similar test failures in the future that might indicate some type of pattern or problem with the process.
sentences.translation: 在这种情况下，经销商或六西格玛团队只需记下这一点，并密切关注控制图，以防止将来发生类似的测试失败，这些失败可能表明流程中存在某种类型的模式或问题。

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 请记住，p 图用于跟踪属性、比率数据。 它可能是最常用的基于属性的控制图之一，因为比率通常比实际属性数据更容易使用，特别是因为您不必担心确保相同的样本或子组大小。您还可以在同一报告中组合多种类型的缺陷，因为 p 图通常关注的是产品、零件或测试是否通过或失败，而不是导致通过或失败的缺陷的具体情况。

sentences.source: P-Chart
sentences.translation: 请记住，p 图用于跟踪属性、比率数据。

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 请记住，p 图用于跟踪属性、比率数据。 它可能是最常用的基于属性的控制图之一，因为比率通常比实际属性数据更容易使用，特别是因为您不必担心确保相同的样本或子组大小。您还可以在同一报告中组合多种类型的缺陷，因为 p 图通常关注的是产品、零件或测试是否通过或失败，而不是导致通过或失败的缺陷的具体情况。

sentences.source: Remember, a p-Chart is used to track attribute, rate data.
sentences.translation: 请记住，p 图用于跟踪属性、比率数据。

sentences.source: It’s probably one of the most-used attribute- based control charts because rates are often easier to work with than actual attribute data, particularly because you don’t have to worry about ensuring the same sample or subgroup size.
sentences.translation: 它可能是最常用的基于属性的控制图之一，因为比率通常比实际属性数据更容易使用，特别是因为您不必担心确保相同的样本或子组大小。

sentences.source: You can also combine multiple types of defects in the same report, because p-charts are typically concerned with whether the product, part, or test passed or failed – not with the specifics about the defects that caused the pass or fail.
sentences.translation: 您还可以在同一报告中组合多种类型的缺陷，因为 p 图通常关注的是产品、零件或测试是否通过或失败，而不是导致通过或失败的缺陷的具体情况。

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 在管理层报告的数据类型也往往由 p 图特征来补充。执行领导通常想了解审核结果、首轮良率、废品率或缺陷率，所有这些都可以用 p 图表来说明。

sentences.source: The type of data that is reported at a management level also tends to be complemented by the p-Chart characteristics.
sentences.translation: 在管理层报告的数据类型也往往由 p 图特征来补充。

sentences.source: Executive leadership often want to know audit results, first-run yields, scrap rates, or defect rates, all of which can be illustrated with p-Charts.
sentences.translation: 执行领导通常想了解审核结果、首轮良率、废品率或缺陷率，所有这些都可以用 p 图表来说明。

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 比例数据通常是六西格玛团队最先获得的数据之一——甚至在六西格玛团队与流程关联之前，许多业务操作员和经理都会捕获通过/失败类型的数据。这意味着六西格玛团队也许能够根据比例数据创建第一个基线控制图，并看到随着流程改进，比率有所提高。

sentences.source: Proportion data is usually one of the first available to Six Sigma teams – even before a Six Sigma team is associated with a process, many business operators and managers capture pass/fail type data.
sentences.translation: 比例数据通常是六西格玛团队最先获得的数据之一——甚至在六西格玛团队与流程关联之前，许多业务操作员和经理都会捕获通过/失败类型的数据。

sentences.source: This means that a Six Sigma team might be able to create a first baseline control chart from proportion data and see rates improve as process improvements are made.
sentences.translation: 这意味着六西格玛团队也许能够根据比例数据创建第一个基线控制图，并看到随着流程改进，比率有所提高。

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 要了解如何在 Minitab 中创建 p 图表，请考虑以下实际场景。一家专业印刷公司发现用于打印名片的打印过程可能存在问题。客户报告缺陷率很高。该公司开始更密切地监控流程，每天检查 100 个样本，以确定每张印刷卡上是否存在任何缺陷。结果记录在下面的数据表中。

sentences.source: To understand how to create a p-Chart in Minitab, consider the following real-world scenario.
sentences.translation: 要了解如何在 Minitab 中创建 p 图表，请考虑以下实际场景。

sentences.source: A professional printing company discovers a possible problem with a printing process used to print business cards.
sentences.translation: 一家专业印刷公司发现用于打印名片的打印过程可能存在问题。

sentences.source: Customer are reporting high rates of defects.
sentences.translation: 客户报告缺陷率很高。

sentences.source: The company begins monitoring the process more closely, reviewing 100 samples daily to determine if there are any defects on each printed card.
sentences.translation: 该公司开始更密切地监控流程，每天检查 100 个样本，以确定每张印刷卡上是否存在任何缺陷。

sentences.source: The results are recorded in the data table below.
sentences.translation: 结果记录在下面的数据表中。

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: Minitab 生成缺陷率控制图以及控制测试的测试结果。

sentences.translation: Minitab 生成缺陷率控制图以及控制测试的测试结果。

sentences.translation: 缺陷 P 图的测试结果

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 测试 1. 距中心线超过 3.00 个标准差的一个点。测试失败点：11、13、19

sentences.translation: 测试 1. 距中心线超过 3.00 个标准差的一个点。

sentences.translation: 测试 1. 距中心线超过 3.00 个标准差的一个点。

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 在这种情况下，考虑到三点失败，过程中可能存在控制问题。流程所有者或与此流程相关的六西格玛团队希望调查样本和流程，以查明此处是否存在持续的流程问题或特定于样本的问题。

sentences.source: In this case, there is likely a problem of control within the process, given the failure of three points.
sentences.translation: 在这种情况下，考虑到三点失败，过程中可能存在控制问题。

sentences.source: The process owner or Six Sigma team associated with this process would want to investigate both the samples and the process to find out if there is an ongoing process problem or a sample-specific issue here.
sentences.translation: 流程所有者或与此流程相关的六西格玛团队希望调查样本和流程，以查明此处是否存在持续的流程问题或特定于样本的问题。

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 创建其他属性控制图（包括 np、u、c 控制图）的步骤与创建 p 图的步骤相同。

sentences.source: The steps for creating other attribute control charts, including np, u, and c charts, are the same as those for creating the p-chart.
sentences.translation: 创建其他属性控制图（包括 np、u、c 控制图）的步骤与创建 p 图的步骤相同。

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 练习解释控制图

sentences.source: Practice Interpreting Control Charts
sentences.translation: 练习解释控制图

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 使用 Minitab，创建控制图只需遵循上述步骤并进行一些练习即可确定哪个控制图适合具体情况，并为控制图设置数据。更困难的部分是解释控制图以做出有效的业务决策或建议。在本节中，您将查看各种现实场景的控制图并练习解释它们。

sentences.source: With Minitab, creating control charts simply requires following the steps outlined above and some practice determining which control chart is correct for the situation and setting up data for the control chart.
sentences.translation: 使用 Minitab，创建控制图只需遵循上述步骤并进行一些练习即可确定哪个控制图适合具体情况，并为控制图设置数据。

sentences.source: The harder part is interpreting control charts to make valid business decisions or recommendations.
sentences.translation: 更困难的部分是解释控制图以做出有效的业务决策或建议。

sentences.source: In this section, you’ll review control charts for a variety of real-world scenarios and practice interpreting them.
sentences.translation: 在本节中，您将查看各种现实场景的控制图并练习解释它们。

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 帮助台票务流程

sentences.source: Help Desk Ticket Process
sentences.translation: 帮助台票务流程

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 办公室的技术支持台每小时跟踪打开和关闭的票证数量。该数据可在下表中找到。

sentences.source: The technical support desk in an office tracks the number of tickets opened and closed each hour.
sentences.translation: 办公室的技术支持台每小时跟踪打开和关闭的票证数量。

sentences.source: That data is found in the table below.
sentences.translation: 该数据可在下表中找到。

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 管理层希望仅根据这些信息就可以了解帮助台流程是否运行良好。六西格玛专家可以做一些事情来为管理层提供初步答案。

sentences.source: Management wants to know whether the help desk process is performing well given only this information.
sentences.translation: 管理层希望仅根据这些信息就可以了解帮助台流程是否运行良好。

sentences.source: A Six Sigma expert can do a few things to provide a preliminary answer to management.
sentences.translation: 六西格玛专家可以做一些事情来为管理层提供初步答案。

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 首先，您可以为完整任务数据创建 I-MR 图表。为什么使用 I-MR 图？我们没有足够的数据来创建 X 条形图，因为我们只有几个子组。

sentences.source: First, you might create an I-MR chart for the Complete Tasks data.
sentences.translation: 首先，您可以为完整任务数据创建 I-MR 图表。

sentences.source: Why use an I-MR chart?
sentences.translation: 为什么使用 I-MR 图？

sentences.source: We don’t have enough data to create an X-bar chart, because we would only have a few subgroups.
sentences.translation: 我们没有足够的数据来创建 X 条形图，因为我们只有几个子组。

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: I-MR 图表如下所示，您可以看到移动范围或每小时关闭的票数都没有控制失败。

sentences.source: The I-MR chart is shown below, and you can see that there are no control failures for either the moving range or the number of tickets closed per hour.
sentences.translation: I-MR 图表如下所示，您可以看到移动范围或每小时关闭的票数都没有控制失败。

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 不过，有人可能会指出，完成的工单数量的控制图只能告诉我们每小时完成的工作量没有太大偏差，这是事实。该控制图实际上并未考虑每小时的工作量以及服务台是否正在清理该工作。

sentences.source: Someone might point out, though, that a control chart of the number of tickets completed only tells us there isn’t a great deal of deviation in the amount of work completed each hour, and this is true.
sentences.translation: 不过，有人可能会指出，完成的工单数量的控制图只能告诉我们每小时完成的工作量没有太大偏差，这是事实。

sentences.source: This control chart does not actually take into account the amount of work that came in each hour and whether the help desk was clearing that work.
sentences.translation: 该控制图实际上并未考虑每小时的工作量以及服务台是否正在清理该工作。

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 因此，六西格玛专家可能会在数据中添加另一列。此列记录了当天该时刻仍有多少张门票处于开放状态。

sentences.source: So, a Six Sigma expert might add another column to the data.
sentences.translation: 因此，六西格玛专家可能会在数据中添加另一列。

sentences.source: This column keeps a running total of how many tickets at that point of the day remain open.
sentences.translation: 此列记录了当天该时刻仍有多少张门票处于开放状态。

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: Incoming Tickets Complete Tickets Tickets Left Unresolved 10 8 2 12 10 4 15 12 7 7 9 5 2 5 2 8 9 1 9 8 2 11 12 1 1 2 0

sentences.source: Incoming Tickets Complete Tickets Tickets Left Unresolved 10 8 2 12 10 4 15 12 7 7 9 5 2 5 2 8 9 1 9 8 2 11 12 1 1 2 0
sentences.translation: Incoming Tickets Complete Tickets Tickets Left Unresolved 10 8 2 12 10 4 15 12 7 7 9 5 2 5 2 8 9 1 9 8 2 11 12 1 1 2 0

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 创建该图的 I-MR 图表会产生截然不同的结果。

sentences.source: Creating an I-MR chart of this figure yields very different results.
sentences.translation: 创建该图的 I-MR 图表会产生截然不同的结果。

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 未解决的票据 I 图表的测试结果 测试 1. 与中心线的标准偏差超过 3.00 个点。测试失败点：17 测试 2。在中心线同一侧连续 9 个点。测试失败点： 13 测试 5。 3 个点中的 2 个与中心线（CL 一侧）的标准差超过 2 个。测试失败点：18

sentences.source: Test Results for I Chart of Tickets Left Unresolved TEST 1.
sentences.translation: 未解决的票据 I 图表的测试结果 测试 1. 与中心线的标准偏差超过 3.00 个点。

sentences.source: One point more than 3.00 standard deviations from center line.
sentences.translation: 未解决的票据 I 图表的测试结果 测试 1. 与中心线的标准偏差超过 3.00 个点。

sentences.source: Test Failed at points: 17 TEST 2.
sentences.translation: 测试失败点：17 测试 2。

sentences.source: 9 points in a row on same side of center line.
sentences.translation: 在中心线同一侧连续 9 个点。

sentences.source: Test Failed at points: 13 TEST 5.
sentences.translation: 测试失败点： 13 测试 5。

sentences.source: 2 out of 3 points more than 2 standard deviations from center line (on one side of CL).
sentences.translation: 3 个点中的 2 个与中心线（CL 一侧）的标准差超过 2 个。

sentences.source: Test Failed at points: 18
sentences.translation: 测试失败点：18

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 测试 6。 5 个点中的 4 个与中心线（CL 一侧）的标准差超过 1 个。测试失败点：8、9、10、12

sentences.source: TEST 6.
sentences.translation: 测试 6。

sentences.source: 4 out of 5 points more than 1 standard deviation from center line (on one side of CL).
sentences.translation: 5 个点中的 4 个与中心线（CL 一侧）的标准差超过 1 个。

sentences.source: Test Failed at points: 8, 9, 10, 12

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 图表上的许多点的许多测试都失败了。这是一件坏事吗？不一定，只要理解了这个过程。失败的前五个点之所以失败，是因为它们位于中心线下方。这意味着该流程每小时留下的未处理票数比预期要少。造成这样的结果可能有几个原因：

sentences.source: Numerous tests are failed at numerous points on the chart.
sentences.translation: 图表上的许多点的许多测试都失败了。

sentences.source: Is this a bad thing?
sentences.translation: 这是一件坏事吗？

sentences.source: Not necessarily, given an understanding of the process.
sentences.translation: 不一定，只要理解了这个过程。

sentences.source: The first five points that fail do so because they are below the centerline.
sentences.translation: 失败的前五个点之所以失败，是因为它们位于中心线下方。

sentences.source: That means the process was leaving fewer tickets open per hour than might be expected.
sentences.translation: 这意味着该流程每小时留下的未处理票数比预期要少。

sentences.source: Several reasons could exist for such results:
sentences.translation: 造成这样的结果可能有几个原因：

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: - 该团队在这些时间关闭门票方面特别高效。 - 该团队收到的票证在这些时间内异常容易处理和关闭。 - 团队在没有真正解决问题的情况下关闭了票证。 - 团队收到的工作票数减少了。

sentences.source: - The team was just especially efficient at closing tickets those hours. - The team received tickets that were abnormally easy to deal with and close during those hours. - The team closed tickets without really resolving them. - The team simply received fewer tickets to work on.
sentences.translation: - 该团队在这些时间关闭门票方面特别高效。

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 前两个原因是积极的，第三个原因可能表明团队存在问题。最后一个原因可能是积极的，也可能是消极的：票数减少是因为一切都比正常情况更好，还是票务软件存在问题？

sentences.source: The first two reasons are positive, and the third could point to a problem with the team.
sentences.translation: 前两个原因是积极的，第三个原因可能表明团队存在问题。

sentences.source: The last reason could be positive or negative: Were there fewer tickets because everything was working better than normal, or was there a problem with the ticketing software?
sentences.translation: 最后一个原因可能是积极的，也可能是消极的：票数减少是因为一切都比正常情况更好，还是票务软件存在问题？

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 所有这些问题都值得研究——它们不仅告诉团队流程是否可能失控，而且还提供了有价值的业务信息。

sentences.source: All of these questions are worth looking into – they not only tell the team whether the process is possibly out of control, but they also provide valuable business information.
sentences.translation: 所有这些问题都值得研究——它们不仅告诉团队流程是否可能失控，而且还提供了有价值的业务信息。

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 该图表上接下来失控的两点是由于上升趋势造成的——这是服务台经理不希望看到的。他或她希望继续监控该图表，看看该过程是否会自行纠正或继续呈上升趋势。

sentences.source: The next two points that are out of control on this chart are due to upward trend – something a help desk manager would not want to see.
sentences.translation: 该图表上接下来失控的两点是由于上升趋势造成的——这是服务台经理不希望看到的。

sentences.source: He or she would want to continue monitoring this chart to see if the process corrects itself or continues to trend upward.
sentences.translation: 他或她希望继续监控该图表，看看该过程是否会自行纠正或继续呈上升趋势。

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 运行假设检验

sentences.source: Running a Hypothesis Test
sentences.translation: 运行假设检验

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 有了所有这些信息，六西格玛专家甚至可以根据任何控制图进行假设检验。他或她可能会运行 2 样本 T 检验，以确定团队平均关闭的工单数量是否与打开的工单数量相同。如果答案是肯定的，那么帮助台可能表现良好。如果答案是否定的，那么团队可能会问“平均有多少票没有关闭服务台？”

sentences.source: Given all of this information, a Six Sigma expert might even run a hypothesis test to go along with any control charts.
sentences.translation: 有了所有这些信息，六西格玛专家甚至可以根据任何控制图进行假设检验。

sentences.source: He or she might run a 2-Sample T test to determine whether the team is closing on average the same number of tickets that are being opened.
sentences.translation: 他或她可能会运行 2 样本 T 检验，以确定团队平均关闭的工单数量是否与打开的工单数量相同。

sentences.source: If the answer is yes, then the help desk is probably performing well.
sentences.translation: 如果答案是肯定的，那么帮助台可能表现良好。

sentences.source: If the answer is no, then the team might ask “how many tickets on average is the help desk not closing?”
sentences.translation: 如果答案是否定的，那么团队可能会问“平均有多少票没有关闭服务台？

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 在 Minitab 中运行 2 样本 T 检验的结果如下所示。

sentences.source: The results of running the 2-Sample T test in Minitab are seen below.
sentences.translation: 在 Minitab 中运行 2 样本 T 检验的结果如下所示。

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 两个样本 T 检验和 CI：传入门票、完整门票 传入门票与完整门票的两个样本 T N 均值 StDev SE 平均传入门票 19 9.42 4.89 1.1 完整门票 19 9.11 3.62 0.83 差异 = μ（传入门票）- μ（完整门票） 差异估计值：0.32 差异的 95% CI： (-2.52, 3.16) 差异 T 检验 = 0（vs ≠）：T 值 = 0.23 P 值 = 0.822 DF = 33

sentences.source: Two-Sample T-Test and CI: Incoming Tickets, Complete Tickets Two-sample T for Incoming Tickets vs Complete Tickets N Mean StDev SE Mean Incoming Tickets 19 9.42 4.89 1.1 Complete Tickets 19 9.11 3.62 0.83 Difference = μ (Incoming Tickets) - μ (Complete Tickets) Estimate for difference: 0.32 95% CI for difference: (-2.52, 3.16) T-Test of difference = 0 (vs ≠): T-Value = 0.23 P-Value = 0.822 DF = 33
sentences.translation: 两个样本 T 检验和 CI：传入门票、完整门票 传入门票与完整门票的两个样本 T N 均值 StDev SE 平均传入门票 19 9.42 4.89 1.1 完整门票 19 9.11 3.62 0.83 差异 = μ（传入门票）- μ（完整门票） 差异估计值：0.32 差异的 95% CI： (-2.52, 3.16) 差异 T 检验 = 0（vs ≠）：T 值 = 0.23 P 值 = 0.822 DF = 33

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 诚然，在样本量为 19 的情况下，出现 II 类错误的可能性相对较高，但 p 值也非常有利于接受原假设，即已开票和已结票的数据在统计上是相同的。有了这些信息，六西格玛团队可能会积累更多数据，然后再进行另一次测试来验证这些结果。

sentences.source: Granted, with a sample size of 19, the chance of a Type II error is relatively high, but the p-Value is also very strong in favor of accepting the null hypothesis that the mean is statistically the same between the data for opened tickets and closing tickets.
sentences.translation: 诚然，在样本量为 19 的情况下，出现 II 类错误的可能性相对较高，但 p 值也非常有利于接受原假设，即已开票和已结票的数据在统计上是相同的。

sentences.source: Given this information, the Six Sigma team might accumulate more data before running another test to verify these results.
sentences.translation: 有了这些信息，六西格玛团队可能会积累更多数据，然后再进行另一次测试来验证这些结果。

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 绞纱

sentences.source: Yarn Skeins
sentences.translation: 绞纱

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 在一家生产用于零售的绞纱的公司中，每个 244 码的绞纱都具有特定的颜色或颜色图案。该公司允许每 244 码纱线长度 10 个染料轻微缺陷，然后绞纱才被视为整体缺陷。

sentences.source: At a company that produces yarn skeins for retail sales, each 244-yard skein features a certain color or color pattern.
sentences.translation: 在一家生产用于零售的绞纱的公司中，每个 244 码的绞纱都具有特定的颜色或颜色图案。

sentences.source: The company allows slight defects in dye at a rate of 10 per 244-yard yarn length before the skein is considered defective overall.
sentences.translation: 该公司允许每 244 码纱线长度 10 个染料轻微缺陷，然后绞纱才被视为整体缺陷。

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 一个团队的任务是控制该过程的质量。该团队每天在将纱线卷绕成绞纱之前检查 10 段取样纱线，以确定缺陷数量。在几天的时间里，团队收集数据并创建控制图以表明其过程是否受控。

sentences.source: A team has been tasked with controlling the quality of this process.
sentences.translation: 一个团队的任务是控制该过程的质量。

sentences.source: This team reviews 10 lengths of sampled yarn each day before it is wound into a skein to determine the number of defects.
sentences.translation: 该团队每天在将纱线卷绕成绞纱之前检查 10 段取样纱线，以确定缺陷数量。

sentences.source: Over several days, the team gathers data and creates a control chart to indicate whether its process is in control.
sentences.translation: 在几天的时间里，团队收集数据并创建控制图以表明其过程是否受控。

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 该团队生成了以下数据表。

sentences.source: The team generates the following data table.
sentences.translation: 该团队生成了以下数据表。

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 由于所有样本量都相同，并且团队关注缺陷数量，因此选择在 Minitab 中创建 c 控制图。

sentences.source: Because all the sample sizes are the same and the team is concerned with the number of defects, it chooses to create a c-chart in Minitab.
sentences.translation: 由于所有样本量都相同，并且团队关注缺陷数量，因此选择在 Minitab 中创建 c 控制图。

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 已发现缺陷 C 图表的测试结果

sentences.source: Test Results for C Chart of Defects Found
sentences.translation: 已发现缺陷 C 图表的测试结果

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 测试 1. 距中心线超过 3.00 个标准差的一个点。测试在以下点失败：2、12、21

sentences.source: TEST 1.
sentences.translation: 测试 1. 距中心线超过 3.00 个标准差的一个点。

sentences.source: One point more than 3.00 standard deviations from center line.
sentences.translation: 测试 1. 距中心线超过 3.00 个标准差的一个点。

sentences.source: Test Failed at points: 2, 12, 21
sentences.translation: 测试在以下点失败：2、12、21

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 根据未通过控制测试的三个点，该过程未完全受控，应进行审查。

sentences.source: Based on three points that fail the control tests, this process is not completely in control and should be reviewed.
sentences.translation: 根据未通过控制测试的三个点，该过程未完全受控，应进行审查。

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 呼叫中心合规性

sentences.source: Call-Center Compliance
sentences.translation: 呼叫中心合规性

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 银行呼叫中心监控其员工是否遵守众多联邦法规以及内部政策和程序。监控来自质量保证团队，他们随机监听电话并记录团队成员在打电话时可能犯的错误信息。团队成员在每次通话中可能会犯多个错误；例如，团队成员可能忘记让呼叫者知道呼叫正在录音，并且没有向呼叫者提供正确的信息。

sentences.source: A banking call center monitors its employees for compliance with numerous federal regulations as well as internal policies and procedures.
sentences.translation: 银行呼叫中心监控其员工是否遵守众多联邦法规以及内部政策和程序。

sentences.source: The monitoring comes from a quality assurance team who randomly listens to phone calls and records information about errors that team members might make when on the phone.
sentences.translation: 监控来自质量保证团队，他们随机监听电话并记录团队成员在打电话时可能犯的错误信息。

sentences.source: Team members can make more than one error on each phone call;
sentences.translation: 团队成员在每次通话中可能会犯多个错误；

sentences.source: for example, a team member might forget to let the caller know the call is being recorded and not provide the caller with the right information.
sentences.translation: 例如，团队成员可能忘记让呼叫者知道呼叫正在录音，并且没有向呼叫者提供正确的信息。

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 在 10 小时轮班中，质量保证团队每小时监控一次呼叫并创建以下数据表。

sentences.source: In a 10-hour shift, the quality assurance team monitored calls each hour and created the following data table.
sentences.translation: 在 10 小时轮班中，质量保证团队每小时监控一次呼叫并创建以下数据表。

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 呼叫监控错误 1 15 3

sentences.source: Calls Monitored Errors 1 15 3
sentences.translation: 呼叫监控错误 1 15 3

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 小时

sentences.source: Hour
sentences.translation: 小时

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 2 13 5 3 18 4 4 10 0 5 12 2 6 9 2 7 11 4 8 12 5 9 8 0 10 7 1 样本大小（以每小时监控的呼叫数表示）在本示例中不一致。在这种情况下，子组不一致的原因可能是每小时收到的呼叫数量有所不同，并且质量保证团队仅审查呼叫的特定部分。也可能有些电话需要更长的时间 - 因此需要更长的时间来审查。不管子组大小不一致的原因是什么，它都会导致我们选择 u 图表，它与每单位的错误数有关。在这种情况下，可以通过将误差除以监控的呼叫来计算，创建比率或比例数据，以便实际样本大小不那么重要。

sentences.source: 2 13 5 3 18 4 4 10 0 5 12 2 6 9 2 7 11 4 8 12 5 9 8 0 10 7 1 The sample size, which is indicated by the number of calls monitored each hour, is not consistent in this example.
Reasons for inconsistent subgroups in this case could be that the number of calls received each hour vary and the quality assurance team only reviews a certain portion of calls.
sentences.translation: 在这种情况下，子组不一致的原因可能是每小时收到的呼叫数量有所不同，并且质量保证团队仅审查呼叫的特定部分。

sentences.source: It could also be that some calls take longer – and thus take longer to review.
sentences.translation: 也可能有些电话需要更长的时间 - 因此需要更长的时间来审查。

sentences.source: Regardless of the reason for inconsistent subgroup sizes, it leads us to choose the u-Chart, which is concerned with the number of errors per unit.
sentences.translation: 不管子组大小不一致的原因是什么，它都会导致我们选择 u 图表，它与每单位的错误数有关。

sentences.source: In this case, that would be calculated by dividing errors by calls monitored, creating rate or proportion data so that the actual sample size isn’t as important.
sentences.translation: 在这种情况下，可以通过将误差除以监控的呼叫来计算，创建比率或比例数据，以便实际样本大小不那么重要。

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 将数据插入 Minitab 来创建此控制图时，错误是变量，监控的调用是子组大小。

sentences.source: When plugging data into Minitab to create this control chart, Errors are the Variables and Calls Monitored are the Subgroup size.
sentences.translation: 将数据插入 Minitab 来创建此控制图时，错误是变量，监控的调用是子组大小。

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: Minitab 生成以下控制图。

sentences.source: Minitab generates the following control chart.
sentences.translation: Minitab 生成以下控制图。

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 您可以看到没有测试失败，这表明该过程处于控制之中。您还会注意到，控制上限似乎到处都是阶梯式的。这是因为每个样本的大小不同，因此每个控制上限是按不同的值计算的。

sentences.source: You can see that no tests are failed, which indicates the process is in control.
sentences.translation: 您可以看到没有测试失败，这表明该过程处于控制之中。

sentences.source: You’ll also note that the upper control limit seems to stair-step all over the place.
sentences.translation: 您还会注意到，控制上限似乎到处都是阶梯式的。

sentences.source: This is because each sample was a different size, so each upper control limit is calculated at a different value.
sentences.translation: 这是因为每个样本的大小不同，因此每个控制上限是按不同的值计算的。

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 如果呼叫中心管理层特别关注特定错误怎么办？

sentences.source: What if call center management was especially concerned with a specific error?
sentences.translation: 如果呼叫中心管理层特别关注特定错误怎么办？

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 如果呼叫中心管理层关心 PCI 合规性（遵守支付卡行业的法规），他们可能需要深入研究数据以查看与 PCI 合规性相关的错误数量信息。他们可能会要求质量保证团队在审查呼叫时选中一个复选框，以表明该呼叫是否符合 PCI 标准。

sentences.source: If call center management was concerned with PCI-compliance (compliance with the regulations for the payment card industry), they might want to dig into the data to see information about the number of errors related to PCI-compliance.
sentences.translation: 如果呼叫中心管理层关心 PCI 合规性（遵守支付卡行业的法规），他们可能需要深入研究数据以查看与 PCI 合规性相关的错误数量信息。

sentences.source: They might ask the quality assurance team to check a box when reviewing a call to denote whether the call was compliant with PCI standards or not.
sentences.translation: 他们可能会要求质量保证团队在审查呼叫时选中一个复选框，以表明该呼叫是否符合 PCI 标准。

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 新的数据表如下所示。

sentences.source: The new data table is seen below.
sentences.translation: 新的数据表如下所示。

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: Hour Calls Monitored Errors PCI Non- compliance 1 15 3 1 2 13 5 0 3 18 4 1 4 10 0 0 5 12 2 1 6 9 2 1 7 11 4 2 8 12 5 2 9 8 0 0 10 7 1 1

sentences.source: Hour Calls Monitored Errors PCI Non- compliance 1 15 3 1 2 13 5 0 3 18 4 1 4 10 0 0 5 12 2 1 6 9 2 1 7 11 4 2 8 12 5 2 9 8 0 0 10 7 1 1
sentences.translation: Hour Calls Monitored Errors PCI Non- compliance 1 15 3 1 2 13 5 0 3 18 4 1 4 10 0 0 5 12 2 1 6 9 2 1 7 11 4 2 8 12 5 2 9 8 0 0 10 7 1 1

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 我们不想担心每次调用的错误数量，而是想了解 PCI 错误发生率。为此，我们可以使用 p 图。

sentences.source: Instead of worrying about the number of errors per call, we want to understand the rate of PCI errors occurring.
sentences.translation: 我们不想担心每次调用的错误数量，而是想了解 PCI 错误发生率。

sentences.source: We can use a p-chart for that purpose.
sentences.translation: 为此，我们可以使用 p 图。

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 该图表很好地说明了受控流程仍然可能是一个有问题的流程。此过程处于控制之中，但最后 5 个点中有 4 个点高于 0.10 比例标记。这意味着在 PCI 合规性方面，10 个样本中有 4 个样本的失败率为 10% 或更高。

sentences.source: This chart is a great illustration of how an in-control process can still be a problematic process.
sentences.translation: 该图表很好地说明了受控流程仍然可能是一个有问题的流程。

sentences.source: This process is in control, but four of the last five points are above the 0.10 proportion mark.
sentences.translation: 此过程处于控制之中，但最后 5 个点中有 4 个点高于 0.10 比例标记。

sentences.source: That means that out of 10 samples, four had a fail rate of 10 percent or more when it comes to PCI compliance.
sentences.translation: 这意味着在 PCI 合规性方面，10 个样本中有 4 个样本的失败率为 10% 或更高。

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 在银行业，PCI 合规问题可能会花费大量资金，这意味着银行呼叫中心希望看到 PCI 合规错误率尽可能接近于零。该呼叫中心的流程所有者可能会采取行动来减少该流程的平均比例，即使它处于控制之中。

sentences.source: In the banking world, PCI compliance issues can cost a great deal of money, which means banking call centers will want to see PCI compliance error rates as close to zero as possible.
sentences.translation: 在银行业，PCI 合规问题可能会花费大量资金，这意味着银行呼叫中心希望看到 PCI 合规错误率尽可能接近于零。

sentences.source: The process owner for this call center is likely to take action to reduce the mean proportion of this process, even though it is in control.
sentences.translation: 该呼叫中心的流程所有者可能会采取行动来减少该流程的平均比例，即使它处于控制之中。

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 常见原因与特殊原因变异

sentences.source: Common Cause versus Special Cause Variation
sentences.translation: 常见原因与特殊原因变异

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 在 Minitab 中选择控制检验时，您会注意到我们选择执行所有特殊原因检验。这让 Minitab 知道要执行特殊原因变异的所有检验 - 特殊原因变异是由过程中正常预期之外的事物引起的。

sentences.source: When selecting the control tests in Minitab, you’ll note that we selected to perform all tests for special causes.
sentences.translation: 在 Minitab 中选择控制检验时，您会注意到我们选择执行所有特殊原因检验。

sentences.source: This lets Minitab know to perform all the tests for special cause variation – special cause variation is that which is caused by something outside of the normal expectations within a process.
sentences.translation: 这让 Minitab 知道要执行特殊原因变异的所有检验 - 特殊原因变异是由过程中正常预期之外的事物引起的。

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 任何过程都会有一定程度的变化。过程中的正常变异（由过程本身引起的变异）称为共因变异。 例如，在呼叫中心工作的电话接线员在履行工作职责时偶尔会出现说话或打字错误。这种变化在控制图上得到了说明。然而，操作员如果工作时间过长、耳机质量不好或者是新工作人员，可能会犯下比正常情况更多的错误。这种异常可能会出现在控制图上，并且可以通过特殊原因（例如耳机故障）来解释。

sentences.source: Any process is going to have some amount of variation.
sentences.translation: 任何过程都会有一定程度的变化。

sentences.source: The normal variation within a process – the variation that is caused by the process itself – is called common cause variation.
sentences.translation: 过程中的正常变异（由过程本身引起的变异）称为共因变异。

sentences.source: For example, a phone operator working at a call center is going to make an occasional speaking or typing error while performing job duties.
sentences.translation: 例如，在呼叫中心工作的电话接线员在履行工作职责时偶尔会出现说话或打字错误。

sentences.source: That variation is accounted for on a control chart.
sentences.translation: 这种变化在控制图上得到了说明。

sentences.source: However, an operator who is working too many hours, has a bad headset, or is new on the job might make more than the normal amount of errors.
sentences.translation: 然而，操作员如果工作时间过长、耳机质量不好或者是新工作人员，可能会犯下比正常情况更多的错误。

sentences.source: That abnormality is likely to show up on a control chart and it is explained by the special causes such as a malfunctioning headset.
sentences.translation: 这种异常可能会出现在控制图上，并且可以通过特殊原因（例如耳机故障）来解释。

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 其他 Minitab 控制图

sentences.source: Additional Minitab Control Charts
sentences.translation: 其他 Minitab 控制图

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: Minitab 提供了各种其他控制图。我们在本章中介绍了最常用的控制图，但下面简要介绍了其他一些控制图。

sentences.source: Minitab offers a variety of other control charts.
sentences.translation: Minitab 提供了各种其他控制图。

sentences.source: We have covered the most commonly used control charts in this chapter, but highlight a few others briefly below.
sentences.translation: 我们在本章中介绍了最常用的控制图，但下面简要介绍了其他一些控制图。

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: I 和 MR 图表（内/间）

sentences.source: The I & MR Chart (Within/Between)
sentences.translation: I 和 MR 图表（内/间）

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 不要与前面提到的 I-MR（独立移动极差）图表混淆，I & MR（组内/组间）图表提供了一个三向图表，指示组内和组间的变化。当批次之间的变异与批次内的变异相比较大或变异不是随机分布时，您可以使用此图表。例如，在处理跨班次的流程时，班次组内可能有子组，并且班次之间可能会出现差异。

sentences.source: Not to be confused with the aforementioned I-MR (Individual Moving Range) chart, the I & MR (Within/Between) chart provides a three-way chart that indicates variation within a group and between groups.
sentences.translation: 不要与前面提到的 I-MR（独立移动极差）图表混淆，I & MR（组内/组间）图表提供了一个三向图表，指示组内和组间的变化。

sentences.source: You might use this chart when the variation between batches is high compared to variation within batches or when variation is not randomly distributed.
sentences.translation: 当批次之间的变异与批次内的变异相比较大或变异不是随机分布时，您可以使用此图表。

sentences.source: For example, when working with a process that spans shifts, you might have subgroups within shift groups, and differences might appear between the shifts.
sentences.translation: 例如，在处理跨班次的流程时，班次组内可能有子组，并且班次之间可能会出现差异。

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 您可以在统计 > 控制图 > 子组变量下找到此图表

sentences.source: You can find this chart under Stat > Control Charts > Variables for Subgroups
sentences.translation: 您可以在统计 > 控制图 > 子组变量下找到此图表

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 指数加权移动平均线

sentences.source: Exponentially Weighted Moving Average
sentences.translation: 指数加权移动平均线

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: EWMA 图表提供单独的移动极差图。该图表很少用于常见的统计分析，因为它很难使用。最常见的是，EWMA 图表在处理自动数据系统时使用。

sentences.source: The EWMA chart delivers an individual and moving range graph.
sentences.translation: EWMA 图表提供单独的移动极差图。

sentences.source: This chart is rarely used in common statistical analysis, as it is difficult to work with.
sentences.translation: 该图表很少用于常见的统计分析，因为它很难使用。

sentences.source: Most often, the EWMA chart is used when dealing with automatic data systems.
sentences.translation: 最常见的是，EWMA 图表在处理自动数据系统时使用。

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: 累计金额

sentences.source: Cumulative Sum
sentences.translation: 累计金额

ch23-s03-creating-and-reading-control-ch.translation: CUSUM 图处理每个样本与目标值相关的偏差的累积和。 CUSUM 非常擅长检测目标的微小变化，特别是在受控过程中。与 EWMA 一样，CUSUM 并不是大多数业务环境中常用的控制图。

sentences.source: The CUSUM chart deals with the cumulative sums of the deviations of each sample as they relate to a target value.
sentences.translation: CUSUM 图处理每个样本与目标值相关的偏差的累积和。

sentences.source: CUSUM is very adept at detecting a small shift from a target, particularly in a process that is in control.
sentences.translation: CUSUM 非常擅长检测目标的微小变化，特别是在受控过程中。

sentences.source: Like the EWMA, CUSUM is not a commonly used control chart for most business environments.
sentences.translation: 与 EWMA 一样，CUSUM 并不是大多数业务环境中常用的控制图。

sentences.source: Applications through Six Sigma
sentences.translation: 通过六西格玛申请

ch24-s01-applying-statistics-to-business.translation: 你还没有完成统计数据，但是，最好从数字和分析中休息一下，重新审视六西格玛的一些基本概念。

sentences.source: You aren’t done with statistics yetbut, it’s a good idea to take a break from the numbers and analysis to revisit some fundamental concepts of Six Sigma.
sentences.translation: 你还没有完成统计数据，但是，最好从数字和分析中休息一下，重新审视六西格玛的一些基本概念。

ch24-s01-applying-statistics-to-business.translation: 在第 4 单元和第 5 单元中，我们广泛使用了数据和分析，很容易陷入数字之中，而忘记了业务需求。事实上，您对统计分析了解得越多，就越容易陷入分析的挑战中，而忘记企业正在依靠您来解决其自身挑战的问题。在本章中，我们将介绍在向企业员工和领导者传达统计结果时可能遇到的一些障碍。我们还将讨论在业务演示中包含统计数据的重要性以及在这些演示中集成统计数据的一些技巧。

sentences.source: Throughout Unit 4 and 5, we’ve worked extensively with data and analysis, and it can be easy to get wrapped up in the numbers without remembering the business need.
sentences.translation: 在第 4 单元和第 5 单元中，我们广泛使用了数据和分析，很容易陷入数字之中，而忘记了业务需求。

sentences.source: In fact, the more you learn about statistical analysis, the easier it is to get caught up in the challenge of the analysis and forget that the business is relying on you for answers about its own challenges.
sentences.translation: 事实上，您对统计分析了解得越多，就越容易陷入分析的挑战中，而忘记企业正在依靠您来解决其自身挑战的问题。

sentences.source: In this chapter, we’ll cover some obstacles you might run into when communicating your statistical findings to business employees and leaders.
sentences.translation: 在本章中，我们将介绍在向企业员工和领导者传达统计结果时可能遇到的一些障碍。

sentences.source: We’ll also talk about the importance of including statistics in business presentations and some tips for integrating statistics within those presentations.
sentences.translation: 我们还将讨论在业务演示中包含统计数据的重要性以及在这些演示中集成统计数据的一些技巧。

ch24-s02-common-challenges-when-presenti.translation: 这是六西格玛专家在提供统计分析信息时面临的第一个，也许是最大的挑战：大多数人并不关心。确实，除非你的发起人也是六西格玛专家，或者你的领导委员会精通六西格玛方法，否则你所向的人并不关心你使用了哪种假设检验或你的卡方统计量或 p 值是多少。这并不是说企业领导者和其他人不关心你的分析结论或结果，他们当然关心整个项目的结果。但你必须找到一种与他们关心的内容相关的方式来呈现你的信息，而不仅仅是依赖统计概念和语言。

sentences.source: Here is the first, and perhaps biggest, challenge faced by Six Sigma experts when delivering information from statistical analysis: Most people don’t care.
sentences.translation: 这是六西格玛专家在提供统计分析信息时面临的第一个，也许是最大的挑战：大多数人并不关心。

sentences.source: Truly, unless your sponsor is a Six Sigma expert too or your leadership committee is well-versed in Six Sigma methods, the people you are presenting to don’t care about which hypothesis test you used or what your Chi-Squared statistic or p-value was.
sentences.translation: 确实，除非你的发起人也是六西格玛专家，或者你的领导委员会精通六西格玛方法，否则你所向的人并不关心你使用了哪种假设检验或你的卡方统计量或 p 值是多少。

sentences.source: That isn’t to say that business leaders and others don’t care about the conclusions or results of your analysis, and they certainly care about the results of the project as a whole.
sentences.translation: 这并不是说企业领导者和其他人不关心你的分析结论或结果，他们当然关心整个项目的结果。

sentences.source: But you have to find a way to present your information in a way that ties in with what they care about and doesn’t rely solely on statistical concepts and language.
sentences.translation: 但你必须找到一种与他们关心的内容相关的方式来呈现你的信息，而不仅仅是依赖统计概念和语言。

ch24-s02-common-challenges-when-presenti.translation: 第二个挑战是，一般业务人员和领导者不可能像六西格玛专家那样对统计分析有同样的理解。然后，当数据的备份可能无法理解时，六西格玛演示者的任务是演示数据。作为六西格玛专家，你必须能够解释为什么团队选择朝某个方向前进，或者你如何知道流程已经改进，而不是每个人都会简单地相信你的话，即 p 值适合你所做的决定。

sentences.source: A second challenge is that general business staff and leaders are unlikely to have the same understanding of statistical analysis as a Six Sigma expert does.
sentences.translation: 第二个挑战是，一般业务人员和领导者不可能像六西格玛专家那样对统计分析有同样的理解。

sentences.source: The Six Sigma presenter is then tasked with presenting data when the backup for the data might not be understood.
sentences.translation: 然后，当数据的备份可能无法理解时，六西格玛演示者的任务是演示数据。

sentences.source: As a Six Sigma expert, you have to be able to explain why the team chose to move in a certain direction or how you know a process has improved, and not everyone is simply going to take your word that the p-Value was appropriate for the decision you made.
sentences.translation: 作为六西格玛专家，你必须能够解释为什么团队选择朝某个方向前进，或者你如何知道流程已经改进，而不是每个人都会简单地相信你的话，即 p 值适合你所做的决定。

ch24-s02-common-challenges-when-presenti.translation: 展示分析时的第三个挑战是，您很容易因统计数据而分心或偏离轨道，而无法阐明您的业务要点。 发生这种情况可能有两个原因之一。首先，如果你的赞助商或其他听众了解六西格玛和统计分析，他或她可能会开始问统计问题，而不是商业问题。为什么使用 1-比例检验？您是如何选择样本量的？您真的认为 0.2 的 beta 值就足够了，还是应该选择 0.1 的 beta 值？

sentences.source: A third challenge when presenting your analysis is that you can easily become distracted or derailed by the statistics without getting your business point across.
sentences.translation: 展示分析时的第三个挑战是，您很容易因统计数据而分心或偏离轨道，而无法阐明您的业务要点。

sentences.source: This can happen for one of two reasons.
sentences.translation: 发生这种情况可能有两个原因之一。

sentences.source: First, if your sponsor or another member of your audience is knowledgeable about Six Sigma and statistical analysis, he or she might begin asking statistical questions instead of business questions.
sentences.translation: 首先，如果你的赞助商或其他听众了解六西格玛和统计分析，他或她可能会开始问统计问题，而不是商业问题。

sentences.source: Why did you use the 1-Proportion test?
sentences.translation: 为什么使用 1-比例检验？

sentences.source: How did you choose the sample size?
sentences.translation: 您是如何选择样本量的？

sentences.source: Do you really think a beta of 0.2 is sufficient, or should you have gone with a beta of 0.1?
sentences.translation: 您真的认为 0.2 的 beta 值就足够了，还是应该选择 0.1 的 beta 值？

ch24-s02-common-challenges-when-presenti.translation: 一些统计问题很可能是有效的。您是如何选择样本量的？这可能是在演示中涉及的相关内容，以便观众了解团队做出了哪些假设以及哪些风险被认为是可以接受的。另一方面，如果您已经完成分析并根据样本量和假设检验做出决策，那么功效设置是否正确就没有实际意义了。防止此类脱轨发生的一种方法是

sentences.source: Some statistical questions might very well be valid.
sentences.translation: 一些统计问题很可能是有效的。

sentences.source: How did you choose the sample size?
sentences.translation: 您是如何选择样本量的？

sentences.source: That might be something relevant to cover in a presentation so that the audience understands what assumptions were made by the team and what risks were considered acceptable.
sentences.translation: 这可能是在演示中涉及的相关内容，以便观众了解团队做出了哪些假设以及哪些风险被认为是可以接受的。

sentences.source: On the other hand, if you’ve already done the analysis and made decisions based on sample size and hypothesis testing, then it’s a moot point on whether the power was set correctly.
sentences.translation: 另一方面，如果您已经完成分析并根据样本量和假设检验做出决策，那么功效设置是否正确就没有实际意义了。

sentences.source: One way to keep this type of derailment from occurring is
sentences.translation: 防止此类脱轨发生的一种方法是

ch24-s02-common-challenges-when-presenti.translation: 让拥有六西格玛知识的赞助商了解整个项目的情况；这样，如果需要，他或她可以实时提供有关此类事情的输入。

sentences.source: to keep a sponsor with Six Sigma knowledge in the loop throughout the project;
sentences.translation: 让拥有六西格玛知识的赞助商了解整个项目的情况；

sentences.source: that way, he or she can provide input on such things in real time if desired.
sentences.translation: 这样，如果需要，他或她可以实时提供有关此类事情的输入。

ch24-s02-common-challenges-when-presenti.translation: 当您应该演示与业务相关的信息时，您可能会迷失在统计数据中的另一个原因是您的观众不理解统计数据，导致演示变成统计课程。重要的是要在向观众介绍有关六西格玛过程的必要信息和提供统计分析的深入讨论之间保持平衡。例如，您可能应该确保您的受众了解标准差是什么以及它的重要性。您可能不需要解释所有类型的假设检验，甚至在某些情况下，您根本不需要解释假设检验。

sentences.source: The other reason you might get lost in statistics when you are supposed to be presenting business- relevant information is because your audience doesn’t understand the statistics, leading to the presentation becoming a statistics lesson.
sentences.translation: 当您应该演示与业务相关的信息时，您可能会迷失在统计数据中的另一个原因是您的观众不理解统计数据，导致演示变成统计课程。

sentences.source: It’s important to walk the line between educating the audience on necessary information regarding the Six Sigma process and providing an in-depth discussion of statistical analysis.
sentences.translation: 重要的是要在向观众介绍有关六西格玛过程的必要信息和提供统计分析的深入讨论之间保持平衡。

sentences.source: For example, you probably should ensure your audience understands what standard deviation is and why it’s important.
sentences.translation: 例如，您可能应该确保您的受众了解标准差是什么以及它的重要性。

sentences.source: You probably don’t need to explain all the types of hypothesis tests – or even, in some cases, that you used a hypothesis test at all.
sentences.translation: 您可能不需要解释所有类型的假设检验，甚至在某些情况下，您根本不需要解释假设检验。

ch24-s02-common-challenges-when-presenti.translation: 呈现统计数据的最后一个挑战是包含太多信息或太多示例。您有一个箱线图、一个条形图、一个饼图、一个假设检验以及一些基于概率分布的计算。他们对你来说看起来都很好。他们对数据的说法都有些不同。他们都应该参加演示，对吧？错误——太多的数据说明方式让观众不知所措。企业内的大多数人也可能不会像训练有素的六西格玛专家那样看到数据中的细微差别，这意味着从他们的角度来看，您只是一遍又一遍地显示相同的数据。 这不是对演示空间或会议时间的有效利用。

sentences.source: A final challenge in presenting statistical data is in a tendency to include too much information or too many examples.
sentences.translation: 呈现统计数据的最后一个挑战是包含太多信息或太多示例。

sentences.source: You have a box plot, a bar graph, a pie chart, a hypothesis test, and several calculations based on probability distributions.
sentences.translation: 您有一个箱线图、一个条形图、一个饼图、一个假设检验以及一些基于概率分布的计算。

sentences.source: They all look good to you.
sentences.translation: 他们对你来说看起来都很好。

sentences.source: They all say a little something different about the data.
sentences.translation: 他们对数据的说法都有些不同。

sentences.source: They should all go in the presentation, right?
sentences.translation: 他们都应该参加演示，对吧？

sentences.source: Wrong – too many ways of illustrating the data overwhelms the audience.
sentences.translation: 错误——太多的数据说明方式让观众不知所措。

sentences.source: It’s also likely that the majority of people within the business won’t see the nuances in the data that a trained Six Sigma expert does, which means from their perspective, you’re simply showing the same data over and over.
sentences.translation: 企业内的大多数人也可能不会像训练有素的六西格玛专家那样看到数据中的细微差别，这意味着从他们的角度来看，您只是一遍又一遍地显示相同的数据。

sentences.source: It’s not an effective use of presentation space or meeting time.
sentences.translation: 这不是对演示空间或会议时间的有效利用。

ch24-s02-common-challenges-when-presenti.translation: 为什么要包括一些统计数据？

sentences.source: Why Include Some Statistics?
sentences.translation: 为什么要包括一些统计数据？

ch24-s02-common-challenges-when-presenti.translation: 即使面临上面讨论的所有挑战，您也不应该将统计数据完全排除在演示文稿之外。无论您是在测量或分析收费站审查中展示调查结果，还是在改进方面提交最终批准，统计数据都可以为您的结论或结果提供可信度。将数据合并到演示文稿中可能很困难，但我们在下一节中提供了一些技巧。

sentences.source: Even with all the challenges discussed above, you shouldn’t leave statistics out of your presentation altogether.
sentences.translation: 即使面临上面讨论的所有挑战，您也不应该将统计数据完全排除在演示文稿之外。

sentences.source: Whether you are presenting findings at a Measure or Analyze tollgate review or you are presenting for final approval on improvements, statistics are what provides your conclusions or results credibility.
sentences.translation: 无论您是在测量或分析收费站审查中展示调查结果，还是在改进方面提交最终批准，统计数据都可以为您的结论或结果提供可信度。

sentences.source: Incorporating your data into a presentation can be difficult, but we’ve provided some tips for doing so in the next section.
sentences.translation: 将数据合并到演示文稿中可能很困难，但我们在下一节中提供了一些技巧。

ch24-s03-tips-for-creating-business-frie.translation: 如果包含统计数据以提高可信度很重要，但您的业务受众中的许多人可能不了解实际分析的复杂性，您会怎么做？这实际上是六西格玛统计过程控制的一些最大好处的体现。如果您在真正的六西格玛环境中工作，那么您永远不会只与数字打交道。请记住，在第一单元中，六西格玛更关心业务及其目标和成功，而不是数据和分析。事实上，分析和数据的相关性仅限于可以用作进行或衡量业务流程改进的工具。

sentences.source: If it’s important to include statistics for credibility, but many people in your business audience are likely not to follow the intricacies of the actual analysis, what do you do?
sentences.translation: 如果包含统计数据以提高可信度很重要，但您的业务受众中的许多人可能不了解实际分析的复杂性，您会怎么做？

sentences.source: This is actually where some of the biggest benefits of Six Sigma’s statistical process control come in.
sentences.translation: 这实际上是六西格玛统计过程控制的一些最大好处的体现。

sentences.source: If you are working in a true Six Sigma environment, then you are never working only with the numbers.
sentences.translation: 如果您在真正的六西格玛环境中工作，那么您永远不会只与数字打交道。

sentences.source: Remember from Unit 1 that Six Sigma is more concerned with the business – and its goals and success – than it is with the data and the analysis.
sentences.translation: 请记住，在第一单元中，六西格玛更关心业务及其目标和成功，而不是数据和分析。

sentences.source: In fact, the analysis and data is only relevant in so much that it can be used as a tool to make or measure improvements to business processes.
sentences.translation: 事实上，分析和数据的相关性仅限于可以用作进行或衡量业务流程改进的工具。

ch24-s03-tips-for-creating-business-frie.translation: 正因为如此，六西格玛团队应该已经扎根于商业术语和短语。考虑起草问题陈述的行为，我们在第 5 章中对此进行了介绍。问题陈述将统计概念与业务目标和需求相结合，对于在整个 DMAIC 项目中和后续展示六西格玛信息的任何人来说，它都是一个很好的参考点。如果您不确定演示文稿中是否应包含某些内容，请问问自己：它与问题陈述或问题陈述的解决方案相关吗？如果没有，那么可能没有必要在一般商业环境中进行沟通或展示。当您处理数据和统计数据时，您可能会惊讶地发现您对数字的兴趣与日俱增。 虽然对数字的兴趣可能会导致

sentences.source: Because of this, the Six Sigma team should already be rooted in business terms and phrases.
sentences.translation: 正因为如此，六西格玛团队应该已经扎根于商业术语和短语。

sentences.source: Consider the act of drafting the problem statement, which we covered in chapter 5.
sentences.translation: 考虑起草问题陈述的行为，我们在第 5 章中对此进行了介绍。

sentences.source: The problem statement combines statistical concepts with business goals and needs – and it is a good reference point for anyone presenting Six Sigma information throughout and following a DMAIC project.
sentences.translation: 问题陈述将统计概念与业务目标和需求相结合，对于在整个 DMAIC 项目中和后续展示六西格玛信息的任何人来说，它都是一个很好的参考点。

sentences.source: If you aren’t sure if something should be included in a presentation, then ask yourself: does it relate to the problem statement or a solution for the problem statement?
sentences.translation: 如果您不确定演示文稿中是否应包含某些内容，请问问自己：它与问题陈述或问题陈述的解决方案相关吗？

sentences.source: If not, then it’s probably not necessary to communicate or present in a general business environment.
sentences.translation: 如果没有，那么可能没有必要在一般商业环境中进行沟通或展示。

sentences.source: As you work with data and statistics, you might be surprised by how your interest in the numbers grow.
sentences.translation: 当您处理数据和统计数据时，您可能会惊讶地发现您对数字的兴趣与日俱增。

sentences.source: While interest in the numbers can lead
sentences.translation: 虽然对数字的兴趣可能会导致

ch24-s03-tips-for-creating-business-frie.translation: 为了获得有价值的发现和结论，您确实需要避免仅仅因为您认为有趣或“酷”而将数据或结论包含在演示文稿中的诱惑。

sentences.source: you to valuable discoveries and conclusions, you do need to avoid the temptation to include data or conclusions in a presentation simply because you think they are interesting or “cool.”
sentences.translation: 为了获得有价值的发现和结论，您确实需要避免仅仅因为您认为有趣或“酷”而将数据或结论包含在演示文稿中的诱惑。

ch24-s03-tips-for-creating-business-frie.translation: 在处理统计和分析时，您可以创建可行的业务演示文稿的其他方法包括为观众定制演示文稿、创建故事式叙述、保持内容简短、整合适当的图片以及避免滥用技术、演示文稿或统计工具。

sentences.source: Other ways you can create viable business presentations when dealing with statistics and analysis include tailoring presentation to the audience, creating a story-style narrative, keeping things short and simple, integrating appropriate pictures, and avoiding misuse of technology, presentation, or statistical tools.
sentences.translation: 在处理统计和分析时，您可以创建可行的业务演示文稿的其他方法包括为观众定制演示文稿、创建故事式叙述、保持内容简短、整合适当的图片以及避免滥用技术、演示文稿或统计工具。

ch24-s03-tips-for-creating-business-frie.translation: 了解目标受众

sentences.source: Understand the Target Audience
sentences.translation: 了解目标受众

ch24-s03-tips-for-creating-business-frie.translation: 在展示或交流六西格玛项目或统计分析时，定制信息以反映受众的关注和知识水平。例如，假设有一名六西格玛黑带在改进收费站审查会议上进行演示。黑带正在向包括项目发起人在内的领导团队进行展示。领导班子里至少有两名也是黑带人员，或许其中一名甚至是黑带大师。

sentences.source: When presenting or communicating about a Six Sigma project or statistical analysis, tailor the information to reflect your audience’s level of concern and knowledge.
sentences.translation: 在展示或交流六西格玛项目或统计分析时，定制信息以反映受众的关注和知识水平。

sentences.source: For example, consider a Six Sigma Black Belt who is presenting during an Improve tollgate review meeting.
sentences.translation: 例如，假设有一名六西格玛黑带在改进收费站审查会议上进行演示。

sentences.source: The Black Belt is presenting to a leadership team, which includes the project sponsor.
sentences.translation: 黑带正在向包括项目发起人在内的领导团队进行展示。

sentences.source: At least two members of the leadership team are also Black Belts – perhaps one is even a Master Black belt.
sentences.translation: 领导班子里至少有两名也是黑带人员，或许其中一名甚至是黑带大师。

ch24-s03-tips-for-creating-business-frie.translation: 在这种情况下，观众既投入了信息，也能够理解六西格玛团队在项目期间做出的决策背后的许多统计概念。这并不意味着您应该自动将所有数据包含在演示文稿中 - 您的观众也很忙。但这确实意味着您应该至少预见到一些有关方法论或统计分析的问题，并且您可以将一些技术术语或结果纳入您的演示文稿中，而不必担心需要解释它们。

sentences.source: Given this scenario, the audience is both invested in the information and capable of understanding many of the statistical concepts behind the decisions made by the Six Sigma team during the project.
sentences.translation: 在这种情况下，观众既投入了信息，也能够理解六西格玛团队在项目期间做出的决策背后的许多统计概念。

sentences.source: That doesn’t mean you should automatically include all of your data in the presentation – your audience is also busy.
sentences.translation: 这并不意味着您应该自动将所有数据包含在演示文稿中 - 您的观众也很忙。

sentences.source: But it does mean you should anticipate at least a few questions about methodology or statistical analysis, and you can incorporate a few technical terms or results into your presentation without worrying about having to explain them.
sentences.translation: 但这确实意味着您应该至少预见到一些有关方法论或统计分析的问题，并且您可以将一些技术术语或结果纳入您的演示文稿中，而不必担心需要解释它们。

ch24-s03-tips-for-creating-business-frie.translation: 与此类受众打交道时，创建演示文稿附录通常是个好主意。您可以将分析、数据表甚至特定的 Minitab 结果放在附录中，如果特定问题需要，可以在其中快速显示它们。在涉及高成本或高风险的情况下，领导团队更有可能希望看到背景分析，因为他们需要充分了解所有假设和风险，然后才能对建议的改进做出决定。

sentences.source: When dealing with this type of audience, it’s often a good idea to create a presentation appendix.
sentences.translation: 与此类受众打交道时，创建演示文稿附录通常是个好主意。

sentences.source: You can put your analysis, data tables, and even specific Minitab results in the appendix, where they can be quickly displayed if a specific question calls for it.
sentences.translation: 您可以将分析、数据表甚至特定的 Minitab 结果放在附录中，如果特定问题需要，可以在其中快速显示它们。

sentences.source: In situations that involve high costs or high risks, leadership teams are more likely to want to see the background analysis because they need to fully understand all assumptions and risks before making a decision on the recommended improvements.
sentences.translation: 在涉及高成本或高风险的情况下，领导团队更有可能希望看到背景分析，因为他们需要充分了解所有假设和风险，然后才能对建议的改进做出决定。

ch24-s03-tips-for-creating-business-frie.translation: 在其他情况下，您可能会被要求向投资较少或没有任何统计背景的受众展示六西格玛信息或统计结果。 例如，向一般管理层介绍或向受六西格玛流程改进影响的部门的员工介绍变动背后的原因。发生这种情况时，依赖分析的图形表示会很有帮助，特别是当您尝试共享的信息在某种类型的图表上非常明显时。

sentences.source: In other situations, you might be called upon to present Six Sigma information or statistical findings to audiences that are less invested or who don’t have any background with statistics.
sentences.translation: 在其他情况下，您可能会被要求向投资较少或没有任何统计背景的受众展示六西格玛信息或统计结果。

sentences.source: Examples include presenting to general management or presenting the reasons behind changes to the staff in a department impacted by a Six Sigma process improvement.
sentences.translation: 例如，向一般管理层介绍或向受六西格玛流程改进影响的部门的员工介绍变动背后的原因。

sentences.source: When this happens, it can be helpful to rely on graphical representations of your analysis, particularly if the information you are trying to share is very apparent on a certain type of graph.
sentences.translation: 发生这种情况时，依赖分析的图形表示会很有帮助，特别是当您尝试共享的信息在某种类型的图表上非常明显时。

ch24-s03-tips-for-creating-business-frie.translation: 例如，政府办公室的六西格玛团队的任务是改进涉及审查经济援助申请的工作流程的制作。团队对流程进行了改进，现在将更改之前流程的平均每小时生产率与当前的平均每小时生产率进行比较。为此，他们完成了 2 样本 T 检验，以确定新数据的平均平均值是否高于旧数据。 Minitab 结果如下所示。

sentences.source: For example, a Six Sigma team in a government office has been task with improving the production of a workflow process that involves reviewing applications for financial aid.
sentences.translation: 例如，政府办公室的六西格玛团队的任务是改进涉及审查经济援助申请的工作流程的制作。

sentences.source: The team has made improvements to the process and now compares the average hourly production rate of the process before the changes with the current average hourly production rate.
sentences.translation: 团队对流程进行了改进，现在将更改之前流程的平均每小时生产率与当前的平均每小时生产率进行比较。

sentences.source: To do so, they complete a 2- Sample T Test to determine whether the new data has a higher average mean than the old data.
sentences.translation: 为此，他们完成了 2 样本 T 检验，以确定新数据的平均平均值是否高于旧数据。

sentences.source: The Minitab results are presented below.
sentences.translation: Minitab 结果如下所示。

ch24-s03-tips-for-creating-business-frie.translation: 两样本 T 检验和 CI：C1、C2 C1 与 C2 的两样本 T N 平均值 StDev SE 平均值 C1 23 4.00 2.76 0.58 C2 23 6.35 3.11 0.65

sentences.source: Two-Sample T-Test and CI: C1, C2 Two-sample T for C1 vs C2 N Mean StDev SE Mean C1 23 4.00 2.76 0.58 C2 23 6.35 3.11 0.65
sentences.translation: 两样本 T 检验和 CI：C1、C2 C1 与 C2 的两样本 T N 平均值 StDev SE 平均值 C1 23 4.00 2.76 0.58 C2 23 6.35 3.11 0.65

sentences.source: Difference = μ (C1) - μ (C2) Estimate for difference: -2.348 95% upper bound for difference: -0.889 T-Test of difference = 0 (vs <): T-Value = -2.70 P-Value = 0.005 DF = 43

ch24-s03-tips-for-creating-business-frie.translation: 了解您对假设检验和 p 值所做的操作后，您很快就会发现我们拒绝原假设并接受替代假设。是的，过程的平均值已经改变。根据我们的统计分析，这是一个更有成效的过程。

sentences.source: Knowing what you do about hypothesis tests and p-values, you can see quickly that we reject the null hypothesis and accept the alternative.
sentences.translation: 了解您对假设检验和 p 值所做的操作后，您很快就会发现我们拒绝原假设并接受替代假设。

sentences.source: Yes, the mean averages of the process have changed.
sentences.translation: 是的，过程的平均值已经改变。

sentences.source: It is, according to our statistical analysis, a more productive process.
sentences.translation: 根据我们的统计分析，这是一个更有成效的过程。

ch24-s03-tips-for-creating-business-frie.translation: 但是您可以将 Minitab 数据复制到 PowerPoint 幻灯片中吗？可能不会——只有六西格玛或统计分析专家才能在 p 值和现实世界的结论之间建立联系。

sentences.source: But can you just copy that Minitab data into a PowerPoint slide?
sentences.translation: 但是您可以将 Minitab 数据复制到 PowerPoint 幻灯片中吗？

sentences.source: Probably not – only a Six Sigma or statistical analysis expert is going to be able to make that connection between p-value and real-world conclusion.
sentences.translation: 可能不会——只有六西格玛或统计分析专家才能在 p 值和现实世界的结论之间建立联系。

ch24-s03-tips-for-creating-business-frie.translation: 考虑下面的图形。

sentences.source: Consider the graphical image below.
sentences.translation: 考虑下面的图形。

ch24-s03-tips-for-creating-business-frie.translation: C1、C2 的箱线图

sentences.source: Boxplot of C1, C2
sentences.translation: C1、C2 的箱线图

ch24-s03-tips-for-creating-business-frie.translation: 数据

sentences.source: Data
sentences.translation: 数据

ch24-s03-tips-for-creating-business-frie.translation: C2

sentences.translation: C2

sentences.translation: C1

ch24-s03-tips-for-creating-business-frie.translation: 这是用于创建上述 2 样本 T 检验的相同数据的箱线图，但它为大多数企业员工提供了更友好的数据版本。您很快就会发现流程 C2 的生产率高于流程 C1 – 即使您对箱线图和耳语图一无所知。

sentences.source: This is a box plot of the same data used to create the 2-Sample T Test above, but it provides a friendlier version of the data for most business employees.
sentences.translation: 这是用于创建上述 2 样本 T 检验的相同数据的箱线图，但它为大多数企业员工提供了更友好的数据版本。

sentences.source: You can quickly see that the process C2 has a higher rate of production than the process C1 – even if you don’t know anything about box and whisper plots.
sentences.translation: 您很快就会发现流程 C2 的生产率高于流程 C1 – 即使您对箱线图和耳语图一无所知。

ch24-s03-tips-for-creating-business-frie.translation: 仅了解目标受众可能如何与数据和统计分析进行交互是不够的。 在创建有关项目或统计数据的演示文稿时，您还需要了解目标受众想要了解什么以及他们需要如何了解这些信息。

sentences.source: It’s not enough to understand how the target audience is likely to interact with data and statistical analysis.
sentences.translation: 仅了解目标受众可能如何与数据和统计分析进行交互是不够的。

sentences.source: When creating a presentation about your project or statistical data, you also need to understand what the target audience wants to know and how they need to know it.
sentences.translation: 在创建有关项目或统计数据的演示文稿时，您还需要了解目标受众想要了解什么以及他们需要如何了解这些信息。

ch24-s03-tips-for-creating-business-frie.translation: 高层领导通常想知道项目是否成功，您如何知道它是成功的，预计可以节省或获得哪些收益，以及您如何控制流程以确保不再出现同样的问题。

sentences.source: High-level leadership typically wants to know whether the project was a success, how you know it was a success, what savings or gains can be expected, and how you are controlling the process to ensure the same issues don’t arise again.
sentences.translation: 高层领导通常想知道项目是否成功，您如何知道它是成功的，预计可以节省或获得哪些收益，以及您如何控制流程以确保不再出现同样的问题。

ch24-s03-tips-for-creating-business-frie.translation: 流程所有者和接近流程的员工应该了解上述所有内容，尽管您可能必须扩大有关成本和节省的讨论，以忽略可能包含在高管级别演示文稿中的敏感数据（例如有关员工薪酬的假设）。流程所有者和员工也可能想了解有关流程具体更改的更多详细信息 - 为什么要实施此类更改以及它如何影响日常工作流程？例如，当领导层可能对高级流程图感到满意时，流程负责人希望看到更精细的流程图。

sentences.source: Process owners and employees close to the process should know all of the above, though you might have to broaden discussions about costs and savings to leave out sensitive data that could be included in an executive-level presentation (such as assumptions about employee pay).
sentences.translation: 流程所有者和接近流程的员工应该了解上述所有内容，尽管您可能必须扩大有关成本和节省的讨论，以忽略可能包含在高管级别演示文稿中的敏感数据（例如有关员工薪酬的假设）。

sentences.source: Process owners and employees are also likely to want to know more details about the specific changes to the process – why were such changes implemented and how does it impact daily workflow?
sentences.translation: 流程所有者和员工也可能想了解有关流程具体更改的更多详细信息 - 为什么要实施此类更改以及它如何影响日常工作流程？

sentences.source: Where leadership might be satisfied with a high-level process map, for example, process owners want to see more granular maps.
sentences.translation: 例如，当领导层可能对高级流程图感到满意时，流程负责人希望看到更精细的流程图。

ch24-s03-tips-for-creating-business-frie.translation: 来自不同部门的观众可能会提出从他们的角度来看有意义的问题，因此要知道谁将参加收费站或其他类型的演示会议，并准备好回答针对他们的世界的问题。

sentences.source: Audience members from disparate departments are likely to ask questions that make sense from their perspective, so know who will be in a tollgate or other type of presentation meeting, and be prepared to answer questions specific to their world.
sentences.translation: 来自不同部门的观众可能会提出从他们的角度来看有意义的问题，因此要知道谁将参加收费站或其他类型的演示会议，并准备好回答针对他们的世界的问题。

ch24-s03-tips-for-creating-business-frie.translation: o 合规人员询问法规的遵守情况。团队在做决策时是否考虑了法规？当合规性要求做出似乎与统计推论引导团队的方向相反的决定时，会发生什么？团队是否计算了与合规失败相关的风险和成本（这些风险和成本通常比其他流程失败更大）？ o 会计或财务人员询问预算、收入和储蓄。团队是否有以美元格式显示结果的图表？储蓄超过一定金额的可能性有多大？团队能否将美元金额与各种分析、变更或改进联系起来？ o 营销、销售和客户服务人员可能会询问面向客户和以客户为中心的信息。团队是如何收集客户之声（VOC）的？团队对客户做出了哪些假设？在进行流程变更或分析数据时，团队如何考虑客户？

sentences.source: o Compliance staff asks about adherence to regulations.
sentences.translation: o 合规人员询问法规的遵守情况。

sentences.source: Did the team consider regulations when making decisions?
sentences.translation: 团队在做决策时是否考虑了法规？

sentences.source: What happens when compliance required a decision that seemed opposite of where the statistical inferences led the team?
sentences.translation: 当合规性要求做出似乎与统计推论引导团队的方向相反的决定时，会发生什么？

sentences.source: Did the team calculate risks and costs associated with compliance failures, which are often greater than other process failures?
sentences.translation: 团队是否计算了与合规失败相关的风险和成本（这些风险和成本通常比其他流程失败更大）？

sentences.source: o Accounting or finance staff asks about budget, revenue, and savings.
sentences.translation: o 会计或财务人员询问预算、收入和储蓄。

sentences.source: Does the team have a graph that shows results in a dollar format?
sentences.translation: 团队是否有以美元格式显示结果的图表？

sentences.source: What is the likelihood of saving over a certain amount?
sentences.translation: 储蓄超过一定金额的可能性有多大？

sentences.source: Can the team associate a dollar amount with various analysis, changes, or improvements?
sentences.translation: 团队能否将美元金额与各种分析、变更或改进联系起来？

sentences.source: o Marketing, sales, and customer service staff are likely to ask about customer-facing and customer-centric information.
sentences.translation: o 营销、销售和客户服务人员可能会询问面向客户和以客户为中心的信息。

sentences.source: How did the team gather the voice of the customer?
sentences.translation: 团队是如何收集客户之声（VOC）的？

sentences.source: What assumptions about the customer did the team make?
sentences.translation: 团队对客户做出了哪些假设？

sentences.source: When making process changes or analyzing data, how did the team consider the customer?
sentences.translation: 在进行流程变更或分析数据时，团队如何考虑客户？

ch24-s03-tips-for-creating-business-frie.translation: 显然，您无法创建一个演示文稿来回答有关流程、项目或统计分析的所有可能问题。演示内容将会非常庞大​​，并且需要花费很长的时间来演示。 通常最好将演示时间控制在 10 到 20 分钟以内，并留出足够的时间来提问，并且根据组织的业务实践，您的演示时间可能会受到更多限制。因此，您应该始终在演示中回答有关您的改进、项目或 DMAIC 阶段的最大和最重要的问题，并为问答环节中的其他类型问题做好准备（这是附录可以提供帮助的地方）。

sentences.source: You obviously can’t create a presentation that answers every possible question about your process, project, or statistical analysis.
sentences.translation: 显然，您无法创建一个演示文稿来回答有关流程、项目或统计分析的所有可能问题。

sentences.source: The presentation would be enormous and take much too long to present.
sentences.translation: 演示内容将会非常庞大​​，并且需要花费很长的时间来演示。

sentences.source: It’s typically a good idea to keep a presentation under 10 to 20 minutes with plenty of time for questions, and your presentation time might be even more constrained depending on organizational business practices.
sentences.translation: 通常最好将演示时间控制在 10 到 20 分钟以内，并留出足够的时间来提问，并且根据组织的业务实践，您的演示时间可能会受到更多限制。

sentences.source: So, you should always answer the biggest and most important questions about your improvements, project, or DMAIC stage in the presentation and be prepared for other types of questions in the question and answer session (this is where an appendix can be helpful).
sentences.translation: 因此，您应该始终在演示中回答有关您的改进、项目或 DMAIC 阶段的最大和最重要的问题，并为问答环节中的其他类型问题做好准备（这是附录可以提供帮助的地方）。

ch24-s03-tips-for-creating-business-frie.translation: 用文字和图像讲故事

sentences.source: Tell a Story with Text and Images
sentences.translation: 用文字和图像讲故事

ch24-s03-tips-for-creating-business-frie.translation: 使用 PowerPoint 或其他演示程序以讲述观众可以理解和关心的故事的方式组合您的信息。牢记您的观众和演示文稿的目的，尝试在整个演示文稿中讲述一个整体故事，同时在每张幻灯片上呈现“微型叙述”。

sentences.source: Use PowerPoint or another presentation program to combine your information in a way that tells a story that the audience can understand and care about.
sentences.translation: 使用 PowerPoint 或其他演示程序以讲述观众可以理解和关心的故事的方式组合您的信息。

sentences.source: Keeping your audience and the purpose of your presentation in mind, attempt to tell an overall story across your entire presentation while presenting “miniature narratives” on each slide.
sentences.translation: 牢记您的观众和演示文稿的目的，尝试在整个演示文稿中讲述一个整体故事，同时在每张幻灯片上呈现“微型叙述”。

ch24-s03-tips-for-creating-business-frie.translation: 考虑下面的示例幻灯片，其中介绍了我们在本章前面使用的 2 样本 T 检验信息。该幻灯片通过信息的放置、图形的包含以及问答格​​式讲述了一个故事。这是一个简单的模板，可用于大多数六西格玛演示幻灯片，特别是在演示统计分析或数据时。

sentences.source: Consider the example slide below, which presents the 2-Sample T Test information we used previously in this chapter.
sentences.translation: 考虑下面的示例幻灯片，其中介绍了我们在本章前面使用的 2 样本 T 检验信息。

sentences.source: The slide tells a story with the placement of information, the inclusion of a graphic, and the question-and answer format.
sentences.translation: 该幻灯片通过信息的放置、图形的包含以及问答格​​式讲述了一个故事。

sentences.source: This is an easy template that can be used in a majority of Six Sigma presentation slides, particularly when presenting statistical analysis or data.
sentences.translation: 这是一个简单的模板，可用于大多数六西格玛演示幻灯片，特别是在演示统计分析或数据时。

ch24-s03-tips-for-creating-business-frie.translation: - 首先，提出一个问题作为幻灯片的标题。创建一个简洁的问题，但尝试编写一个独立的问题。幻灯片示例并没有很好地说明这一点：正在讨论哪些变化、哪些流程以及每小时费率是多少？在整个演示的背景下，这不是问题。然而，您可能想拿出一张幻灯片来作为电子邮件通信或培训文档，而执行领导者往往会拿出一张幻灯片或图形图像来传达有关赞助项目的信息。这张幻灯片的更好标题可能是“援助申请审查工作流程的软件更改是否提高了每小时的生产率？” - 接下来，添加一张图片来回答您的问题或提供有关数据或过程的附加信息。图片、图表和地图打破了演示文稿中的长文本块，使观众更容易理解。通过在一张幻灯片上以多种格式呈现数据，您还可以吸引更广泛受众的兴趣和理解。数据的图形表示通常可以更快地传达要点，并可以帮助您在短时间内讲述复杂的数据故事。 - 包含一些基本统计信息可能是个好主意，例如原假设和备择假设的商业友好版本。至少，在场的所有人都能明白，这两种说法是团队正在评估的，而且只有一种是真实的。包括测试运行的类型和 p 值是可选的，但对于团队自己的参考以及通知赞助商或其他也了解六西格玛的人来说都是一个好主意。 - 最后，用简短的、基于文本的结论回答标题中提出的问题。结论应与幻灯片上包含的任何图形表示或统计测试数据一致。您应该避免在一张幻灯片上呈现相互矛盾的数据和结论，除非您有这样做的具体原因并且解释了为什么矛盾很重要。

sentences.source: - First, ask a question as the title of the slide.
sentences.translation: - 首先，提出一个问题作为幻灯片的标题。

sentences.source: Create a concise question, but try to write a stand-alone question.
sentences.translation: 创建一个简洁的问题，但尝试编写一个独立的问题。

sentences.source: The slide example doesn’t do a great job of that: what changes, what process, and what hourly rates are being discussed?
sentences.translation: 幻灯片示例并没有很好地说明这一点：正在讨论哪些变化、哪些流程以及每小时费率是多少？

sentences.source: In the context of an entire presentation, this isn’t a problem.
sentences.translation: 在整个演示的背景下，这不是问题。

sentences.source: However, you might want to pull a single slide out for an email communication or training document – and executive leaders tend to pull out one slide or graphical image to communicate information about a sponsored project.
sentences.translation: 然而，您可能想拿出一张幻灯片来作为电子邮件通信或培训文档，而执行领导者往往会拿出一张幻灯片或图形图像来传达有关赞助项目的信息。

sentences.source: A better title for this slide might be “Did software changes to the Aid Application Review workflow increase hourly production rates?” - Next, include an image that answers your question or provides additional information regarding the data or process.
sentences.translation: 这张幻灯片的更好标题可能是“援助申请审查工作流程的软件更改是否提高了每小时的生产率？

sentences.source: Pictures, graphs, and maps break up long blocks of text in a presentation, making it easier for the audience to digest.
sentences.translation: 图片、图表和地图打破了演示文稿中的长文本块，使观众更容易理解。

sentences.source: By presenting data in a variety of formats on one slide, you also capture the interest and understanding of a wider audience.
sentences.translation: 通过在一张幻灯片上以多种格式呈现数据，您还可以吸引更广泛受众的兴趣和理解。

sentences.source: Graphical representations of data often get the point across quicker and can help you tell a complex data story in a small amount of time. - It can be a good idea to include some basic statistical information, such as a business-friendly version of the null and alternative hypothesis.
sentences.translation: 数据的图形表示通常可以更快地传达要点，并可以帮助您在短时间内讲述复杂的数据故事。

sentences.source: At the very least, everyone in the audience can understand that these two statements are what the team were evaluating, and only one of them can be true.
sentences.translation: 至少，在场的所有人都能明白，这两种说法是团队正在评估的，而且只有一种是真实的。

sentences.source: Including the type of test run and the p-Value is optional, but can be a good idea both for the team’s own reference and for informing sponsors or others who are also knowledgeable in Six Sigma. - Finally, answer the question posed in the title in a short, text-based conclusion.
sentences.translation: 包括测试运行的类型和 p 值是可选的，但对于团队自己的参考以及通知赞助商或其他也了解六西格玛的人来说都是一个好主意。

sentences.source: The conclusion should align with any graphical representation or statistical test data included on the slide.
sentences.translation: 结论应与幻灯片上包含的任何图形表示或统计测试数据一致。

sentences.source: You should avoid presenting contradicting data and conclusions on a single slide unless you have a specific reason for doing so and an explanation of why the contradiction is important.
sentences.translation: 您应该避免在一张幻灯片上呈现相互矛盾的数据和结论，除非您有这样做的具体原因并且解释了为什么矛盾很重要。

ch24-s03-tips-for-creating-business-frie.translation: 并非所有问题都需要上述幻灯片的所有要素。有时，以简洁的文字提供答案是有意义的。例如，您可能会问“团队试图解决什么问题？”该幻灯片的正确内容是在定义阶段编写的问题陈述。

sentences.source: Not all questions require all elements of the above slide.
sentences.translation: 并非所有问题都需要上述幻灯片的所有要素。

sentences.source: Sometimes, it makes sense to provide the answer in concise text.
sentences.translation: 有时，以简洁的文字提供答案是有意义的。

sentences.source: For example, you might ask “What problem is the team trying to solve?” The right content for that slide would be the problem statement as written in the Define phase.
sentences.translation: ”该幻灯片的正确内容是在定义阶段编写的问题陈述。

ch24-s03-tips-for-creating-business-frie.translation: 有时，您需要在幻灯片上包含的唯一内容是图形或图表。考虑下面的幻灯片。

sentences.source: Sometimes, the only thing you need to include on the slide is a graph or chart.
sentences.translation: 有时，您需要在幻灯片上包含的唯一内容是图形或图表。

sentences.source: Consider the slide below.
sentences.translation: 考虑下面的幻灯片。

ch24-s03-tips-for-creating-business-frie.translation: 这张幻灯片询问了是什么导致发出有缺陷的订单，并用帕累托图回答了这个问题。即使有人不熟悉帕累托图，考虑到标签和数据，很明显，造成最多缺陷的问题是在产品精加工中。了解 Pareto 图的人可以在几秒钟内发现整理错误和有缺陷的原始输入占错误的 60% 以上；如果添加“选择了错误的产品”，则 80% 的错误都是由您造成的。

sentences.source: This slide asks what is causing defective orders to be sent out, and it answers the question with a Pareto chart.
sentences.translation: 这张幻灯片询问了是什么导致发出有缺陷的订单，并用帕累托图回答了这个问题。

sentences.source: Even if someone is not familiar with the Pareto chart, it’s fairly obvious given the labels and data that the issue creating the biggest number of defects is in product finishing.
sentences.translation: 即使有人不熟悉帕累托图，考虑到标签和数据，很明显，造成最多缺陷的问题是在产品精加工中。

sentences.source: Someone who knows about Pareto charts could see within seconds that finishing errors and defective raw inputs account for over 60 percent of the errors;
sentences.translation: 了解 Pareto 图的人可以在几秒钟内发现整理错误和有缺陷的原始输入占错误的 60% 以上；

sentences.source: if you add “wrong product selected,” you account for 80 percent of the errors.
sentences.translation: 如果添加“选择了错误的产品”，则 80% 的错误都是由您造成的。

ch24-s03-tips-for-creating-business-frie.translation: 一些六西格玛工具，例如帕累托图，很容易向那些对数据分析或六西格玛没有了解的观众解释。给定一两分钟的演示时间，您可以充分解释上面的图表如何回答幻灯片的问题，这就是帕累托图（和其他条形图）在此类演示中受欢迎的原因之一。

sentences.source: Some Six Sigma tools, such as the Pareto chart, are easy to explain to audience members who don’t have a pre-existing understanding of data analysis or Six Sigma.
sentences.translation: 一些六西格玛工具，例如帕累托图，很容易向那些对数据分析或六西格玛没有了解的观众解释。

sentences.source: Given a minute or two of presentation time, you could sufficiently explain how the above chart answers the slide’s question, and this is one reason Pareto (and other bar-type charts) are popular in such presentations.
sentences.translation: 给定一两分钟的演示时间，您可以充分解释上面的图表如何回答幻灯片的问题，这就是帕累托图（和其他条形图）在此类演示中受欢迎的原因之一。

ch24-s03-tips-for-creating-business-frie.translation: 清晰简洁

sentences.source: Be Clear and Concise
sentences.translation: 清晰简洁

ch24-s03-tips-for-creating-business-frie.translation: 无论您如何呈现数据，请确保每张幻灯片以及幻灯片上的每个元素都清晰简洁。 这意味着尽可能使用活跃的语言进行写作，避免长文本解释，并确保所有内容拼写正确，并且不会意外使用错误的单词。当在演示文稿中包含统计数据时，很容易做出错误的用词选择，从而改变整个陈述的含义。当你的意思是“小于”时简单地说“大于”，或者当你的意思是“增加”时简单地说“减少”可能会扭曲你所提供的信息或让你的听众感到困惑。

sentences.source: No matter how you are presenting your data, make sure each slide – and each element on the slide – is clear and concise.
sentences.translation: 无论您如何呈现数据，请确保每张幻灯片以及幻灯片上的每个元素都清晰简洁。

sentences.source: This means writing in active language as much as possible, avoiding long text explanation, and ensuring everything is spelled correctly and that you didn’t use the wrong word by accident.
sentences.translation: 这意味着尽可能使用活跃的语言进行写作，避免长文本解释，并确保所有内容拼写正确，并且不会意外使用错误的单词。

sentences.source: When including statistics in a presentation, it can be easy to make an incorrect word choice that changes the meaning of your entire statement.
sentences.translation: 当在演示文稿中包含统计数据时，很容易做出错误的用词选择，从而改变整个陈述的含义。

sentences.source: Simply saying “greater than” when you meant “less than” or “decrease” when you meant “increase” can skew the information you are providing or make it confusing to your audience.
sentences.translation: 当你的意思是“小于”时简单地说“大于”，或者当你的意思是“增加”时简单地说“减少”可能会扭曲你所提供的信息或让你的听众感到困惑。

ch24-s03-tips-for-creating-business-frie.translation: 清晰度不仅仅是单词选择和句子结构的问题。您还应该关注幻灯片上的元素如何组合在一起。不要在一张幻灯片上放置太多信息，以免观众无法理解文字或图像。在某些情况下，您可能需要提出问题并通过一系列幻灯片来回答。

sentences.source: Clarity isn’t just a concern in word choice and sentence structure.
sentences.translation: 清晰度不仅仅是单词选择和句子结构的问题。

sentences.source: You should also be concerned with how elements on your slide come together.
sentences.translation: 您还应该关注幻灯片上的元素如何组合在一起。

sentences.source: Don’t put so much information on a single slide that words or images become unintelligible to the audience.
sentences.translation: 不要在一张幻灯片上放置太多信息，以免观众无法理解文字或图像。

sentences.source: In some cases, you might need to ask a question and answer it over a series of slides.
sentences.translation: 在某些情况下，您可能需要提出问题并通过一系列幻灯片来回答。

ch24-s03-tips-for-creating-business-frie.translation: 请注意，投影的幻灯片图像永远不会像计算机上的图像那么清晰。因此，您应该始终避免在浅色背景上分层浅色字体或图像，或在深色背景上分层深色字体或图像。不要为了容纳所有信息而将字体最小化为 12 号——记住，您的观众可能坐在几英尺远或几码远的地方。您也不需要在幻灯片上包含所有信息 - 当您口头添加信息时，幻灯片应该充当观众的视觉参考点。

sentences.source: Be cognizant of the fact that a projected slide image is never as clear as the image on your computer.
sentences.translation: 请注意，投影的幻灯片图像永远不会像计算机上的图像那么清晰。

sentences.source: Because of this, you should always avoid layering light font or images over a light background or layer dark font or images over a dark background.
sentences.translation: 因此，您应该始终避免在浅色背景上分层浅色字体或图像，或在深色背景上分层深色字体或图像。

sentences.source: Don’t minimize fonts to something as small as 12-point just to fit all the information -- remember, your audience could be sitting feet away or yards away.
sentences.translation: 不要为了容纳所有信息而将字体最小化为 12 号——记住，您的观众可能坐在几英尺远或几码远的地方。

sentences.source: You also don’t need to include every bit of information on a slide – the slide should act as the visual reference point for the audience while you add information verbally.
sentences.translation: 您也不需要在幻灯片上包含所有信息 - 当您口头添加信息时，幻灯片应该充当观众的视觉参考点。

ch24-s03-tips-for-creating-business-frie.translation: 直接添加到幻灯片中的文本和图像不应该是您唯一关心的问题。您还需要确保图表中的文本和图像尽可能清晰简洁。考虑下面的两个箱线图。

sentences.source: The text and images you add directly to the slide shouldn’t be your only concern.
sentences.translation: 直接添加到幻灯片中的文本和图像不应该是您唯一关心的问题。

sentences.source: You also need to make sure text and images within graphs are as clear and concise as possible.
sentences.translation: 您还需要确保图表中的文本和图像尽可能清晰简洁。

sentences.source: Consider the two boxplots below.
sentences.translation: 考虑下面的两个箱线图。

ch24-s03-tips-for-creating-business-frie.translation: 应用程序工作流程的平均每小时产量
